lines.label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_NoSuccessFindingScanner
lines.text: I'm investigating this ship on behalf\nof CAPT. STERN.\pHe also asked me to find a SCANNER,\nbut I haven't had any success…$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_OhCanYouDeliverScanner
lines.text: Oh! That's a SCANNER!\pListen, can I get you to deliver that\nto CAPT. STERN?\pI want to investigate this ship a\nlittle more.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_ThisIsSSCactus
lines.text: This ship is called S.S. CACTUS.\nIt seems to be from an earlier era.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieIntro
lines.text: What's so funny about having my inner\ntube aboard the ship?$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieDefeat
lines.text: Whoa, you overwhelmed me!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharliePostBattle
lines.text: It's not easy throwing POKé BALLS\nwhile hanging on to an inner tube!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_IsntItFunHere
lines.text: Isn't it fun here?\nI get excited just being here!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanIntro
lines.text: When we go out to sea, we SAILORS\nalways bring our POKéMON.\lHow about a quick battle?$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanDefeat
lines.text: Whoops, I'm sunk!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanPostBattle
lines.text: The ship's bottom has sunk into the\ndepths.\pIf a POKéMON knew how to go underwater,\nwe might make some progress…$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_YayItsAShip
lines.text: Yay!\nIt's a ship!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DoorIsLocked
lines.text: The door is locked.\p“STORAGE” is painted on the door.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_InsertedStorageKey
lines.text: {PLAYER} inserted and turned the\nSTORAGE KEY.\pThe inserted KEY stuck fast,\nbut the door opened.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Text_TheDoorIsOpen
lines.text: The door is open.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm1DoorIsLocked
lines.text: The door is locked.\p“RM. 1” is painted on the door.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm2DoorIsLocked
lines.text: The door is locked.\p“RM. 2” is painted on the door.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm4DoorIsLocked
lines.text: The door is locked.\p“RM. 4” is painted on the door.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm6DoorIsLocked
lines.text: The door is locked.\p“RM. 6” is painted on the door.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_InsertedKey
lines.text: {PLAYER} inserted and turned the\nKEY.\pThe inserted KEY stuck fast,\nbut the door opened.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorRooms_Text_BrightShinyTrash
lines.text: It's bright and shiny!\nBut it's just trash…$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanIntro
lines.text: DAN: While searching for treasures,\nwe discovered a TRAINER!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanDefeat
lines.text: DAN: We couldn't win even though\nwe worked together…$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostBattle
lines.text: DAN: We can't find any treasures…\nI wonder if someone got them already?$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanNotEnoughMons
lines.text: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON.\nYou can't expect to beat us like that.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraIntro
lines.text: KIRA: Oh?\nWe were searching for treasures.\lBut we discovered a TRAINER instead!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraDefeat
lines.text: KIRA: Ooh, so strong!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostBattle
lines.text: KIRA: Where could the treasures be?\pI've already decided what I'm buying\nwhen we find the treasures!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraNotEnoughMons
lines.text: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?\nWe'll have to battle some other time!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRegister
lines.text: KIRA: Oh, you make me so angry!\nI'm going to register you for that!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchIntro
lines.text: DAN: We've been searching for\ntreasures all this time.\pOur POKéMON have grown stronger, too.\nLet us show you, okay?$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchDefeat
lines.text: DAN: You're strong, as usual!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostRematch
lines.text: DAN: We can't find any treasures,\nwe lose at POKéMON…\pI want to go home… But if I say that,\nshe gets all angry with me…$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchNotEnoughMons
lines.text: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON.\nYou can't expect to beat us like that.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchIntro
lines.text: KIRA: Oh? We meet again!\pJust like us, you still haven't given up\nsearching for treasures, have you?\pWant to make it so the loser has\nto give up searching?$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchDefeat
lines.text: KIRA: Oh, we lost again…$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostRematch
lines.text: KIRA: We're not leaving until we raise\nour POKéMON some more and we find\lthe treasures here!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchNotEnoughMons
lines.text: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?\nWe'll have to battle some other time!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniIntro
lines.text: I'm not good at swimming,\nbut I am good at battles!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniDefeat
lines.text: Oops.\nThat didn't go very well.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniPostBattle
lines.text: Walking around barefoot in this ship\nis kind of gross.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonIntro
lines.text: Strength and compassion…\nThose are a TRAINER's treasures!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonDefeat
lines.text: Ah, there is something about you\nthat sparkles.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonPostBattle
lines.text: In a cabin somewhere on board,\nI saw something sparkle.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_B1F_Text_PerfectPlaceToGoExploring
lines.text: This is a perfect place to go exploring!\nIt's exciting here!\pI bet there're amazing treasures on\nboard.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_TakingALookAround
lines.text: Ships of this sort are rare, so I'm\ntaking a look around.\pHmhm…\nThere appear to be other cabins…$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaIntro
lines.text: What on earth would compel you to\ncome here? You must be curious!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaDefeat
lines.text: Not just curious, but also strong…$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostBattle
lines.text: The man next door…\pHe says he's just sightseeing,\nbut I don't know about that.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRegister
lines.text: You're such a tough TRAINER!\nLet me register you as a memento!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRematchIntro
lines.text: What on earth would compel you to\ncome back? You must really be curious!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRematchDefeat
lines.text: Aren't you too strong?$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostRematch
lines.text: I'm sure that man's up to something!\nHe just acts so suspiciously!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusIntro
lines.text: Waaah!\nI've been found! …Huh?$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusDefeat
lines.text: Oh, you're not my mom.$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusPostBattle
lines.text: I'm in trouble with my mom, so I ran.\nKeep it a secret where I am!$

lines.label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQueasy
lines.text: Urrrrppp…\pI'm getting queasy just being aboard\nthis ship…\pIt's not even moving, but…$

lines.label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_OurBossIsSnatchingSomething
lines.text:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here! He's gone off to
snatch something important!\p… …
Where did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$

lines.label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_WhereMightMagmaHideoutBe
lines.text: What? What?\nAre you a TEAM MAGMA grunt?\pI hear that TEAM MAGMA is trying to\nawaken an awesome POKéMON at their\lHIDEOUT.\pBut where might their HIDEOUT be?$

lines.label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossWentToJackASubmarine
lines.text:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here!
He's gone off to jack a submarine!\p… …
Where did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$

lines.label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsOnRoute122
lines.text:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here! He's on his way to
MT. PYRE on ROUTE 122!\p… …
Why did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$

lines.label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_TeamMagmaAtMtChimney
lines.text: What? What?\nAre you a TEAM MAGMA grunt?\pI hear that TEAM MAGMA is after\nan awesome POKéMON at MT. CHIMNEY.\pBut what is that POKéMON like?$

lines.label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsInSlateportCity
lines.text:
What? What? What do you want with
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here!
He's on his way to SLATEPORT CITY!\p… …
Why did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$

lines.label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: Ayiyiyi!\nSuspicious character spotted!$

lines.label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Grrrrr…\nI lost it!$

lines.label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: I took the loss for the TEAM,\nbut I did my job…$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: If you want to know the secret about\nour HIDEOUT, you have me to beat!$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: I can't win at all…$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: Our HIDEOUT's secret?\pWell, let's just say…\nThere's a submarine at the far end!\pBut, by now…\nKekekeke…$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
lines.text: Fuel supply loaded A-OK!\nIn-cruise snacks loaded A-OK!\pNothing left to do but KO a pesky\nmeddler!$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
lines.text: I took a serious licking!$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
lines.text: Humph!\nThis was supposed to happen!\pMy mission was to just hold you up!$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro
lines.text: Yawn… Keeping watch over the\nHIDEOUT bores me. I'll take you on.$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
lines.text: Yawn…\nOh, I lost…$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
lines.text: If you scurry too much, other TEAM\nAQUA members might get you.$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Intro
lines.text: Hey!\nYou there!\pWhich do you think is cooler?\nTEAM AQUA's uniform or TEAM MAGMA's?$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Defeat
lines.text: I lost in a cool way…$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
lines.text: If you have a cool uniform, you look\ngood even in a loss, don't you think?$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
lines.text:
Hehehe…\pGot here already, did you?
We underestimated you!\pBut this is it!\pI'm a cut above the GRUNTS you've seen
so far.\pI'm not stalling for time.
I'm going to pulverize you!$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattDefeat
lines.text: Hehehe…\nSo, I lost, too…$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_OurBossGotThroughHisPreparations
lines.text: Hehehe!\pWhile I was toying with you, our BOSS\ngot through his preparations!$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle
lines.text:
Hehehe!\pOur BOSS has already gone on his way to
some cave under the sea!\pIf you're going to give chase, you'd
better search the big, wide sea beyond\lLILYCOVE.\pBut will you find it then?
Hehehe!$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro
lines.text: Wahahah, I grew weary of waiting!\nYou owe me a battle, too!$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
lines.text: Tired of waiting…\nLost and dazed…$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
lines.text: BOSS…\nIs this good enough?$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
lines.text:
Warp panels, the HIDEOUT's pride
and joy!\pYou're clueless about where you are,
aren't you?\pFluster and tire out the enemy, then
lower the boom! That's our plan!$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Defeat
lines.text: What's wrong with you?\nYou're not tired at all!$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
lines.text: That reminds me… I can't remember\nwhere I put the MASTER BALL.\pIf I fail to guard it, our BOSS will\nchew me out…$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Intro
lines.text: When I joined TEAM AQUA, the first\nthing I had to learn was how these\lwarp panels connected.$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Defeat
lines.text: I was too occupied thinking about\nthe warp panels…$

lines.label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8PostBattle
lines.text: I'll have to learn about how I can\nbattle more effectively…$

lines.text: REFEREE: Set KO Tourney!\nBegin!$

lines.text: REFEREE: The winner is {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_WinnerIsOpponent
lines.text: REFEREE: The winner is {STR_VAR_1}!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_MonsWillBeRestored
lines.text: Your POKéMON will be restored to\nfull health.$

lines.text: Next up, your second opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$

lines.text: Next up, your third opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor4thOpponent
lines.text: Next up, your fourth opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor5thOpponent
lines.text: Next up, your fifth opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor6thOpponent

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor7thOpponent
lines.text: Next up, your seventh opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$

lines.text: Would you like to save the game and\nshut down now?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_RetireFromChallenge
lines.text: Would you like to retire from your\nSet KO Tourney challenge?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SavingPleaseWait
lines.text: I am saving your game data.\nPlease wait.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_RecordLastBattle
lines.text: Would you like to record your last\nbattle on your FRONTIER PASS?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_NowFaceTycoon
lines.text: My dear challenger!\pYour skill level is truly astounding!\pWe now would like you to face our\nleader, the ARENA TYCOON!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_PreparedForTycoon
lines.text: A battle with the ARENA TYCOON!\nAre you prepared?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_MakeWayForGreta
lines.text: REFEREE: The ARENA TYCOON!\nMake way for GRETA!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureChallenger
lines.text: GRETA: Hey!\nHowdy!\p…Wait, are you the challenger?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IsThatRight
lines.text: Is that right? Hmm…\nHmhm…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_YouLookWeakTakeThingsEasy
lines.text: I don't know how to say it, but…\nTo put it bluntly, you look pretty weak.\lAre you sure you're up for me?\pHmm…\pWell, all right!\nWe'll take things easy to start with!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IgniteMyPassionForBattle
lines.text: Okay! Let's see you ignite my passion\nfor battle!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureToughAfterAll
lines.text: GRETA: Ow, wait a second!\nYou are tough after all!\pI like you!\nLet's see your FRONTIER PASS.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedGutsSymbol
lines.text: The Guts Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GoingToBeFunNextTime
lines.text: Hmm…\pIt's going to be fun the next time!\nI'm looking forward to it!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaLookingForwardToSeeingAgain
lines.text: GRETA: Hey! Howdy!\nYou finally won your way up to me!\pI was getting worried waiting for you!\nI was really looking forward to seeing\lyou again!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SoAreYouReady
lines.text: … … …\nSo, are you ready?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_WontAllowHalfheartedEffort
lines.text: I won't allow a halfhearted effort!\nBe ready for a thrashing!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_LetsGetThisStarted
lines.text: Come on, REFEREE!\nLet's get this started!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaBlownAway
lines.text: GRETA: Gaaah! Blown away!\nLet's see your FRONTIER PASS!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GutsSymbolTookGoldenShine
lines.text: The Guts Symbol took on\na golden shine!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IfWeBattleAgainWontLose
lines.text: Arrrgh!\nThis is so infuriating!\pIf we ever battle again, I won't lose!\nDon't you forget it! Bye-bye!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaCorridor_Text_PleaseStepIn
lines.text: Your battles shall be waged in\nthe next room. Please step in!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
lines.text: Where the battling spirit of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pI welcome you to the BATTLE ARENA!\pI am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WishToTakeChallenge
lines.text: Now, do you wish to take\nthe BATTLE ARENA challenge?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge
lines.text: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
lines.text:
In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake
the Set KO Tourney.\pAll participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.\pThe three POKéMON must be lined up in
the order in which they are to appear.\pDuring battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.\pOnce a POKéMON enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.\pIf a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.\pIf you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.\pIf you pull off the feat of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OkayToSave
lines.text: Before showing you to the BATTLE\nARENA, you must save. Is that okay?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
lines.text: The BATTLE ARENA offers two levels\nof challenge, Level 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
lines.text: Very well, now select your\nthree POKéMON, please.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
lines.text:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pTo qualify, you must bring three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pWhen you have made your preparations,
please do return.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
lines.text:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pTo qualify, you must bring three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThe three different POKéMON
must all be Level 50 or lower.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pWhen you have made your preparations,
please do return.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_GuideYouToArena
lines.text: I shall now guide you to\nthe BATTLE ARENA.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
lines.text:
My dear challenger!\pYou did not save the game before
shutting down, did you?\pIt is unfortunate, but that has
resulted in your disqualification\lfrom your challenge.\pYou may, of course, start with a fresh
challenge.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnSevenWins
lines.text: We congratulate you for your splendid\nstring of wins over seven TRAINERS!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordAchievement
lines.text: Your achievement will be recorded.\nPlease wait while I save the game.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize
lines.text: In commemoration of your 7-win streak,\nwe present you with this prize.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize
lines.text: Oh?\nYour BAG seems to be full.\pI urge you to clear space and\nreturn for your prize.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSave
lines.text: Thank you so much for participating!\pPlease wait while I save the game.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge2
lines.text: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrivalSaveGame
lines.text: We have been looking forward to\nyour arrival.\pBefore I show you to the BATTLE\nARENA, I must save the game.\lPlease wait.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
lines.text: Shall I record your last BATTLE ARENA\nmatch on your FRONTIER PASS?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
lines.text:
The Set KO Tourney has special rules,
unlike standard battles.\pFirst, one battle lasts only
three turns.\pIf the outcome is not decided after
three turns, it goes to judging.\pThe REFEREE will choose the winner
based on how the POKéMON battled.\pAlso, a POKéMON cannot be switched out
until its battle's outcome is decided.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules
lines.text: The first judging factor is “Mind.”\nThis factor evaluates how aggressive\lthe battlers were.\pThe judging is based on how often\nthe TRAINERS ordered the use of\loffensive moves.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
lines.text:
The second judging factor is “Skill.”
This factor evaluates how effectively\lPOKéMON moves were used.\pIf a move worked successfully,
the Skill rating goes up.\pIf a move failed, the Skill rating
is lowered.\pIf it was an offensive move, the Skill
rating goes up if the move was “super\leffective” and goes down if it was\l“not very effective.”\pThe Skill rating will not go up for
moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.\pIf the opponent used PROTECT or
DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to\lhit with a move, its Skill rating will not\lgo down.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules
lines.text: The third judging factor is “Body.”\nThis factor is based on how much HP\lremained at the end of a battle.\pThe rating takes into account how much\nHP a POKéMON had at the start of\lbattle, and what remained at the end.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge

The SINGLE BATTLE Tournament
is exactly as the name suggests--\la tournament of SINGLE BATTLES.\pAll participating TRAINERS must
enter three POKéMON each.\pIn each battle, one of the three
POKéMON must be held in reserve.\pThe other two POKéMON can battle
one at a time.\pChoose the two battling POKéMON after
examining the opponent's trio.\pYou win the tournament by defeating
four TRAINERS.\pBattle Points are awarded to
the tournament winner.\pIf you want to interrupt your
tournament, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

about reading books or doing desk work.\pJust doing that sort of thing…
It may as well be useless!\pYou have to experience things with
your heart and your body, understand?\pI'll take you on under the same

lines.text:
NOLAND: Hey, hey! How's it going?
You keeping up with your studies?\p…Oh?\pYou've taken on a harder look than
the last time I saw you.\pNow, this should be fun!
I'm getting excited, hey!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_AllRightBringItOn
lines.text: All right!\nBring it on!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_OutOfMyLeagueLetsSeePass
lines.text: NOLAND: What the…\nYou're getting out of my league!\pSheesh!\nLet's see that FRONTIER PASS!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_KnowledgeSymbolTookGoldenShine
lines.text: The Knowledge Symbol took on\na golden shine!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_LastTimeILoseToYou
lines.text: Pfft, man!\pThat's absolutely the last time\nI lose to you!\pWe have to do this again, hey?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
lines.text: Where the intelligence of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE FACTORY!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nSingle Tournament.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_TakeSinglesChallenge
lines.text: Would you like to take the Battle\nSwap Single challenge?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
lines.text:
The Battle Swap Single Tournament
is a SINGLE BATTLE competition using\lonly rental POKéMON.\pFirst, you will be loaned three
POKéMON specifically for this event.\pUsing the supplied rental POKéMON,
you must conduct a SINGLE BATTLE.\pIf you win, you are permitted to trade
one of your rental POKéMON.\pRepeat this cycle of battling and
trading--if you win seven times in\la row, you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will be
disqualified from your challenge.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextVisit
lines.text: We look forward to your next visit.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
lines.text: Which level do you wish to challenge?\nLevel 50 or Open Level?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeChallenge
lines.text: Before you begin your challenge,\nI need to save the game. Is that okay?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WillHoldMonsForSafekeeping
lines.text: Okay, I will hold your POKéMON for\nsafekeeping while you compete.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_StepThisWay
lines.text: Please step this way.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMonsSaveResults
lines.text: Thank you for participating!\pI will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.\pI must also save the event results.\nPlease wait.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMons
lines.text: I will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CongratsSevenWins
lines.text: Congratulations! You've won seven\nstraight Battle Swap matches!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_AwardBattlePointsForStreak
lines.text: In recognition of your 7-win streak,\nwe award you these Battle Point(s).$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_MaxBattlePoints
lines.text: Oh, oh, oh!\pYour Battle Points are maxed.\pPlease come back after using\nsome Battle Points.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WaitingForYouToResume
lines.text: We've been waiting for you!\pBefore we resume your challenge,\nI must save the game.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
lines.text: I'm sorry to say this, but you didn't\nsave before you quit playing last time.\pAs a result, you have been disqualified\nfrom your challenge.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WellReturnMons
lines.text: We'll return your personal POKéMON.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReceivedPrizeItem
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle
lines.text: Where the intelligence of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE FACTORY!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nDouble Tournament.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_TakeDoublesChallenge
lines.text: Would you like to take the Battle\nSwap Double challenge?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge
lines.text:
The Battle Swap Double Tournament
is a DOUBLE BATTLE competition using\lonly rental POKéMON.\pFirst, you will be loaned three
POKéMON specifically for this event.\pUsing the supplied rental POKéMON,
you must conduct a DOUBLE BATTLE.\pIf you win, you are permitted to trade
one of your rental POKéMON.\pRepeat this cycle of battling and
trading--if you win seven times in\la row, you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CongratsForDefeatingHead
lines.text: Congratulations for defeating\nthe FACTORY HEAD and winning\lseven matches in a row!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_AwardBattlePoints
lines.text: In recognition of your wealth of\nknowledge and keen intelligence,\lwe award you these Battle Point(s).$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExchangeMonsAndSave
lines.text: Let me exchange your POKéMON\nfor our rental POKéMON.\pI need to save the battle data,\nso please wait.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
lines.text: Would you like to record your last\nBATTLE FACTORY match on your\lFRONTIER PASS?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedKnowledgeOfMonsMoves
lines.text:
Hi!
You, there!\pAre you thinking that the events here
are easy since you don't need to have\la raised team of POKéMON?\pI wouldn't be too sure about winning
that easily.\pIf you don't have thorough knowledge
about POKéMON and their moves,\lit will be tough to keep winning.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_SwappedForWeakMon
lines.text: I swapped for a weak POKéMON…\nI thought it was a good kind to have…\pThey wiped the floor with us…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedToCheckOpponentsMons
lines.text: Things haven't been going my way\nat all.\pYou need to check your opponent's\nPOKéMON during battle to see if\lthey're any good.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CantFigureOutStaffHints
lines.text: You know how the staff here give you\na few hints about your next opponent?\pWell, I'm a full-grown man, but I have\ntrouble figuring out their hints.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RentalMonsAreVaried
lines.text: Like, I'm really tough, but I get bored\nreally easily, so I just kept swapping\land battling over and over.\pSo anyway, when I kept entering\nBattle Swap events, I noticed they\lvaried the rental POKéMON.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
lines.text: The Battle Swap rules are listed.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
lines.text: Which heading do you want to read?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
lines.text: In a Battle Swap event, you may use\nonly three POKéMON.\pWhether you are renting or swapping,\nyour team may not have two or more\lof the same POKéMON.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
lines.text: You may swap POKéMON only with\nthe TRAINER you have just defeated.\pYou may swap for only those POKéMON\nused by the beaten TRAINER.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
lines.text: After every battle you win, you may\nswap for one of your defeated\lopponent's POKéMON.\pYou will not be able to swap POKéMON\nwith the seventh TRAINER in the event.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotesRules
lines.text:
There are two key points to be aware
of when swapping POKéMON.\pFirst, when swapping, you can't check
the stats of the POKéMON you are\labout to receive.\pSecond, the POKéMON on your team
are lined up in sequence, depending on\lthe order in which you rented them.\pThis sequence remains unchanged
even when swaps are made.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainOpenLvRules
lines.text: In the Open Level, the rental POKéMON\nand the opposing TRAINERS' POKéMON\lare all Level 100.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_HoldMonsChooseFromSelection
lines.text: First, we will hold your POKéMON for\nsafekeeping.\pYou may then choose from our\nselection of POKéMON.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_LetUsRestoreMons
lines.text: Thank you for competing!\nLet us restore your POKéMON!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_YourSwapIsComplete

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_RightThisWay
lines.text: Right this way, please!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_RecordLatestBattle
lines.text: Would you like to record your latest\nbattle on your FRONTIER PASS?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_WaitFewMoments
lines.text: Excuse me! Excuse me, please!\nMay I get you to wait a few moments?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_UnderstoodSirWillDo
lines.text: …Uh-huh? What?! …Whoa!\nUnderstood, sir! Will do!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_MessageFromHeadComeRightNow
lines.text:
Oh, my…
Sorry to keep you waiting!\pI have a message from this facility's
boss, the FACTORY HEAD.\pHe says, “We're going to do it!
Come here right now!”$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_PreparedToFaceHead
lines.text: The FACTORY HEAD is demanding you.\nAre you prepared to face him?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_CantTellAnythingAboutHead
lines.text: I'm terribly sorry, but I can't tell you\nanything about the FACTORY HEAD.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_LetMeRestoreYourMons
lines.text: Excellent…\nLet me restore your POKéMON.$

lines.text: Do you wish to quit your challenge?$

lines.text: Saving the data.\nHave patience…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_RecordLastMatch
lines.text: Do you wish to record your latest\nmatch on your FRONTIER PASS?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ChallengingPalaceMaven
lines.text: And now…\pBy winning consistently, you have\nearned the privilege of challenging\lour master, the PALACE MAVEN…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForPalaceMaven
lines.text: I shall send for the PALACE MAVEN.\nAre you ready?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_AnnounceArrivalOfSpenser
lines.text: Let great fanfare announce the arrival\nof the PALACE MAVEN, SPENSER!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserFirstIntro
lines.text:
SPENSER: My physical being is with
POKéMON always!\pMy heart beats as one with
POKéMON always!\pYoung one of a TRAINER!
Do you believe in your POKéMON?\pCan you believe them through
and through?\pIf your bonds of trust are frail,
you will never beat my brethren!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ProveYourBondWithMons
lines.text: The bond you share with your POKéMON!\nProve it to me here!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserPostSilverBattle
lines.text: SPENSER: Gwahahah!\pHah, you never fell for my bluster!\nSorry for trying that stunt!\pHere!\nBring me the thing!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_LetsSeeFrontierPass
lines.text: My, my, if only you could maintain that\nfacade of distinguished authority…\pHere!\nLet's see your FRONTIER PASS!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedSpiritsSymbol
lines.text: The Spirits Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserAwaitNextTime
lines.text: SPENSER: Your POKéMON's eyes are \ntruly clear and unclouded.\pI will eagerly await the next\nopportunity to see you.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserThisTimeWontHoldBack
lines.text:
SPENSER: Gwahahah!
You've battled your way up again?\pYou must have developed a truly
formidable bond with your POKéMON.\pSo be it!\pThis time, I won't bluster or hold back.
This time, there's no fooling around.\pReady now?
Prepare to lose!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_Kaaah
lines.text: … … …Kaaah!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserYourTeamIsAdmirable
lines.text: SPENSER: Well, that was some display!\nEven fully unleashed, my brethren\lcould not overpower you.\pYour team spirit is truly admirable!\pHere!\nBring me that thing, will you?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_HurryWithFrontierPass
lines.text: My, my, if only you could maintain\na certain level of decorum…\pGaaah, here!\nHurry with that FRONTIER PASS, you!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpiritsSymbolTookGoldenShine
lines.text: The Spirits Symbol took on\na golden shine!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserComeSeeMeAgain
lines.text: SPENSER: Gwahahah!\pCome see me time and again!\nMy brethren and I will be waiting!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_PeopleAndMonAreSame
lines.text: People and POKéMON, they are but\nthe same…\pTheir individual nature makes them\ngood at certain things, and not good\lat others.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_LetMonDoWhatItLikes
lines.text: Rather than trying to make a POKéMON\ndo what it dislikes, try to let it do\lwhat it likes and is good at doing.\pPut yourself in the POKéMON's position\nand consider what moves it would like.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_MonDifferentWhenCornered
lines.text: A POKéMON's nature is a remarkable\nthing…\pSome POKéMON behave in a completely\ndifferent way when they are cornered.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_BeginningToUnderstandNature
lines.text: Are you beginning to understand how\na POKéMON's nature makes it behave?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_HeartfeltBondBetweenYouAndMons
lines.text: Ah… I see a strong, heartfelt bond\nbetween you and your POKéMON…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
lines.text: Where the hearts of TRAINERS\nare put to the test.\pI welcome you to the BATTLE PALACE.\pI accept challenges to the SINGLE\nBATTLE HALLS.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_TakeSingleBattleChallenge
lines.text: Do you wish to take\nthe SINGLE BATTLE HALL challenge?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
lines.text:
In the BATTLE PALACE, there are
several auditoriums for SINGLE BATTLES\lthat are named SINGLE BATTLE HALLS.\pThe SINGLE BATTLES are conducted in
the usual way, except with one crucial\lrule that must be obeyed.\pTRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.\pTRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.\pYou must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.\pIf you achieve the honor of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, you must save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReturnWhenFortified
lines.text: When you have fortified your heart\nand POKéMON, you must return.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhichChallenge
lines.text: There are two BATTLE HALLS,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice of a challenge?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
lines.text:
Sigh…\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for the challenge.\pTo enter, you must provide three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThese POKéMON must all be of
Level 50 or lower.\pThey also must not be holding
the same kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pCome back when you have made
your preparations.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
lines.text:
Sigh…\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for the challenge.\pTo enter, you must provide three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not be holding
the same kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pCome back when you have made
your preparations.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NowSelectThreeMons
lines.text: Good. Now, you must select your\nthree POKéMON.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MustSaveBeforeChallenge2
lines.text: I must save before I show you to\nthe BATTLE HALL. Is that okay?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FollowMe
lines.text: Good.\nNow, follow me.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded
lines.text: I feel privileged for having seen\nyour POKéMON's exploits.\pThe results will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FirmTrueBondsFor7WinStreak
lines.text: To achieve a 7-win streak…\pThe bonds that bind your heart with\nyour POKéMON seem firm and true.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FeatWillBeRecorded
lines.text: Your feat will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_BattlePointsFor7WinStreak
lines.text: For the feat of your 7-win streak,\nwe present you with Battle Point(s).$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NoSpaceForPrize
lines.text: You seem to have no space for\nour prize.\pYou should return when you have\norganized your BAG.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WeHaveBeenWaiting
lines.text: We have been waiting for you…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MustSaveBeforeChallenge
lines.text: I must save before I show you to\nthe BATTLE HALL. Is that okay?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeEndingChallenge
lines.text: Sigh…\pYou failed to save before you ended\nyour challenge the last time.\pAs a result, your challenge has been\ndisqualified. It is most unfortunate.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
lines.text:
For a hardy fellow like me,
hardy POKéMON are the best.\pOffense is the best defense!
A relentless attack is the ultimate!\pBut that's not what I wanted to chat
about.\pEvery so often a really cute lady
swings by here.\pShe says that she can tell what
POKéMON are thinking.\pI don't know about that part,
but she is really cute.\pHuh?
Why are you looking at me like that?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
lines.text:
Hmm…\pIt appears that the nature of POKéMON
and the moves that they have been\ltaught are the keys to battle here.\pTo be more precise, it's how well
the moves match the nature of\lthe POKéMON.\pIf your POKéMON is in trouble and
unable to live up to its potential,\lyou may need to examine how well\lits moves match its nature.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms
lines.text: My POKéMON is usually very docile.\pBut when it's in a BATTLE HALL,\nit sometimes seems to become\ltransformed into something wicked!\pIt becomes totally intimidating.\nIt's shocking, even.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway
lines.text: I wonder what sort of nature a POKéMON\nwould have if it favored enfeebling its\lopponents and chipping away slowly.\pI'd be surprised if it was a LAX nature.\pBut, nah, that can't be right.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle
lines.text: Where the hearts of TRAINERS\nare put to the test.\pI welcome you to the BATTLE PALACE.\pI accept challenges to the DOUBLE\nBATTLE HALLS.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_TakeDoubleBattleChallenge
lines.text: Do you wish to take\nthe DOUBLE BATTLE HALL challenge?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
lines.text:
In the BATTLE PALACE, there are
several auditoriums for DOUBLE BATTLES\lthat are named DOUBLE BATTLE HALLS.\pThe DOUBLE BATTLES are conducted in
the usual way, except with one crucial\lrule that must be obeyed.\pTRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.\pTRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.\pYou must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.\pIf you achieve the honor of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ToDefeatMavenAnd7Trainers
lines.text: To defeat the PALACE MAVEN\nand seven TRAINERS in a row…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_PresentYouWithBattlePoints
lines.text: In honor of the bond you share with\nyour POKéMON, we present you with\lthese Battle Point(s).$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LikeToRecordMatch
lines.text: Would you like to record your latest\nBATTLE PALACE match on your\lFRONTIER PASS?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
lines.text: The BATTLE HALL rules are listed.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
lines.text: Which heading do you want to read?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesBasics
lines.text: Here, POKéMON are required to think\nand battle by themselves.\pUnlike in the wild, POKéMON that live\nwith people behave differently\ldepending on their nature.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
lines.text:
Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.\pAnother POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.\pYet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.\pDue to its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good\lat using.\pIt may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
lines.text:
There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.\pThere are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or\lused to heal HP and so on.\pThere are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with\lstat problems including poison and \lparalysis.\pPOKéMON will consider using moves in
these three categories.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered
lines.text:
When not under command by its TRAINER,
a POKéMON may be unable to effectively\luse certain moves.\pA POKéMON is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.\pIf a POKéMON only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often\lbe unable to live up to its potential.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesWhenInDanger
lines.text: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may\nstart using moves that don't match its\lnature when it is in trouble.\pIf a POKéMON begins behaving oddly\nin a pinch, watch it carefully.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeCorridor_Text_YourChallengeHasBegun
lines.text: Your Battle Choice challenge\nhas now begun…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePike
lines.text: Where the luck of TRAINERS\nis put to the test…\pWelcome to the BATTLE PIKE…\pI am your guide to the BATTLE PIKE…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
lines.text: Would you like to take the Battle\nChoice challenge?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePike
lines.text:
Here we conduct an event we call
the Battle Choice.\pThe Battle Choice rules are very
simple…\pChoose one of three paths and make
your way to the goal room at the end\lof the BATTLE PIKE. It's that simple.\pHowever, what happens on the chosen
path depends entirely on the luck\lof the challenger…\pIf you reach the goal, you will be
rewarded with Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please have a word with\lour staff in the big rooms on the way.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_LookForwardToSeeingYou
lines.text: We look forward to seeing you\non another occasion…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_WhichChallengeMode
lines.text: You have the choice of two courses,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich will you challenge?$

lines.text:

POKéMON for the Battle Choice event.\pYou must have three different POKéMON
of Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pPlease come see me when
you are ready…$

lines.text: Arrgh! I blew my chance!\nI was one room away from the goal!\pIn this place, you'd better watch out\nfor poison, freezing, and so on.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_NeverHadToBattleTrainer
lines.text: I've completed the challenge 10 times\nnow, but I've never had to battle\la TRAINER once.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ThinkAbilitiesUsefulHere

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_TrainersWhicheverPathIChoose
lines.text: What is this weird place?\nI can't figure it out at all!\pI've taken the challenge a bunch\nof times, but all I ever do is run into\lTRAINERS whichever path I choose.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainHeldItemRules
lines.text: During a Battle Choice challenge,\nany BERRY or HERB held by POKéMON\lwill be effective only once.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainMonOrderRules

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreOneMon

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BestOfLuckFarewell

I am the law here…\lFor I am the PIKE QUEEN…\pYou already know it, but to advance,
you must defeat me…\p…I'm not one for idle chatter.
Hurry. Come on…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePyramid
lines.text: Where the courage of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE PYRAMID!\pI am your guide to\nthe Battle Quest.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_EmbarkOnChallenge
lines.text: Have you the courage to embark on\nthe Battle Quest challenge?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_AwaitFutureChallenge
lines.text: We await your challenge in the future!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
lines.text:
The Battle Quest is a battling
event in which you must explore\lthe PYRAMID and try to reach the top.\pIn the PYRAMID are seven floors of
mazes, all of them filled with not only\lskilled TRAINERS but also wild POKéMON.\pYou must enter with three POKéMON,
none of them holding an item.\pOn your ascent, you will be provided
with a BATTLE BAG for items.\pIf you fail in your challenge, any item
placed in the BATTLE BAG disappears.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, you must select “REST”\land save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
lines.text: The PYRAMID offers two courses,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich will you enter?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
lines.text: Very good. Now, please select the three\nPOKéMON you wish to accompany you.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
lines.text:
A slight problem, adventurer!\pYou seem to not have the three
POKéMON qualified for the challenge.\pPlease also remember to take all
items from your POKéMON.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pWhen you are ready, please have
a word with me.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
lines.text:
A slight problem, adventurer!\pYou seem to not have the three
POKéMON qualified for the challenge.\pThe three POKéMON must be different
and each no higher than Level 50.\pPlease also remember to take all
items from your POKéMON.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pWhen you are ready, please have
a word with me.$

lines.text:

your challenge the last time.\pConsequently, your challenge has
been disqualified, I'm sorry to say.\pHere is the BAG we've been holding
for you.\p{PLAYER} got the BAG back.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveConqueredPyramid

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TrainersNoticeRunning
lines.text: Did you know?\pIf you run fast, TRAINERS may notice\nand come after you for a battle.\pSo, if you want to avoid TRAINERS,\ndon't catch their eyes, but sneak\lcautiously and quietly past them.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LostLotOfItems
lines.text: Awaaaaaaarrrrgh!\pI had a whole lot of items, but I lost\nthem all when I lost!\pAwaaaaaaarrrrgh!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveDefeatedPyramidKing
lines.text: Welcome back!\nYou've done the unthinkable!\pYou've defeated the PYRAMID KING\nand conquered the BATTLE PYRAMID!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_GiveYouTheseBattlePoints
lines.text: Young explorer!\nIn commendation of your courage,\lwe give you these Battle Point(s)!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
lines.text: The Battle Quest rules are listed.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
lines.text: Which heading do you want to read?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
lines.text: When the PYRAMID is conquered,\nthe wild POKéMON that appear in it\lare replaced by different kinds.\pExplore, observe, and learn what kinds\nof wild POKéMON you may encounter.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules
lines.text:
TRAINERS are lying in wait for you
inside the PYRAMID.\pOn each floor, there are up to
eight TRAINERS.\pWhen you defeat a TRAINER, you will
get a helpful hint for your adventure.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules
lines.text:
The mazes in the PYRAMID rearrange
themselves every time you enter it.\pThe mazes are poorly lit.
You must advance with caution.\pThe light grows brighter whenever you
defeat a wild POKéMON or a TRAINER.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
lines.text:
The BATTLE BAG serves as your BAG
while in the PYRAMID.\pThere are two separate BATTLE BAGS--
one each for the Level 50 and\lOpen Level adventures.\pThey each can hold up to 99 pieces
of ten kinds of items.\pThe contents of the BATTLE BAG are
lost if you fail in your quest.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReachedSummitUpYouGo
lines.text:
It is a delight to see you here!
You have reached the summit of\lthe BATTLE PYRAMID!\pAbove here is the PYRAMID's
lookout point.\pIt is a place open only to those
who have conquered the PYRAMID.\pNow, please!
Up you go!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_PlayerConqueredPyramid
lines.text: The PYRAMID's new conqueror!\nLet the name {PLAYER} be known!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ChiefBeatYouHere
lines.text:
It is a delight to see you here!\pUnfortunately, you were second by
a mere fraction of time!\pOur chief has already conquered
the PYRAMID ahead of you.\pHowever, my young explorer…
You are a TRAINER!\pAssert your power and take the glory
of the pinnacle from our chief!\pNow, please! When you are ready,
take one more step of courage!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ExplorationsAreGrandestAdventure
lines.text: Young adventurer…\pWouldn't you agree that explorations\nare the grandest of adventures?\pYour own wits!\pYour own strength!\pYour own POKéMON!\pAnd, above all, only your own courage\nto lead you through unknown worlds…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ImPyramidKingBrandon
lines.text:
Aah, yes, indeed this life is grand!
Grand, it is! Eh?\pI'm BRANDON!\pI'm the PYRAMID KING, which means
I'm in charge here.\pMost people call me the chief!\pYou coming here means you have
that much confidence in yourself,\lam I right?\pHahahah!
This should be exciting!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BringCourageToOurBattle
lines.text: Now, then!\nBring your courage to our battle!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonFrontierPassPlease
lines.text: BRANDON: Hahahah! Grand it was!\nGrand, yes, indeed!\pWell done! You've earned recognition!\nYour FRONTIER PASS, please!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReceivedBraveSymbol
lines.text: The Brave Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_LookForwardToNextMeeting
lines.text: Young explorer!\nI look forward to our next meeting!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonYouveReturned
lines.text:
BRANDON: …You've finally returned,
young explorer…\pYour love of adventure seems to come
deep from within your heart…\pYes… You are exactly as I was in
my own youth…\p… … …Ah…\pThe passionate!\pThe dangerous!\pThe desperate!\pThose days of death-defying,
life-affirming adventures are back…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_MyCourageIsOffMeter
lines.text: Now, then!\pI sense my own courage is off\nthe meter!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_EverythingYouHave
lines.text: Everything you have!\nI'm braced for it all!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonRemarkableHaveThis
lines.text: BRANDON: Hahahah!\nRemarkable!\lYes, it's grand, indeed!\pYoung explorer!\pYou've bested me through and through!\nHere! I want you to have this!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BraveSymbolTookGoldenShine
lines.text: The Brave Symbol took on\na golden shine!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_FarewellForNow
lines.text: Ah, yes! It just goes to show that\nI have much to learn still!\pMay our paths cross again!\nFarewell for now, young explorer!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_StepForwardWhenReady
lines.text: Now, when you are ready, take courage\nand step forward.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RestoreMonsToFullHealth
lines.text: We will restore your POKéMON to\nfull health.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForOpponent
lines.text: You will be facing opponent no. {STR_VAR_1}.\nAre you ready?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor2ndOpponent
lines.text: You will be facing opponent no. 2.\nAre you ready?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor3rdOpponent
lines.text: You will be facing opponent no. 3.\nAre you ready?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor4thOpponent
lines.text: You will be facing opponent no. 4.\nAre you ready?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor5thOpponent
lines.text: You will be facing opponent no. 5.\nAre you ready?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor6thOpponent
lines.text: You will be facing opponent no. 6.\nAre you ready?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor7thOpponent
lines.text: You will be facing opponent no. 7.\nAre you ready?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RecordYourBattle
lines.text: Record your battle on your\nFRONTIER PASS?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_BattleRecordedOnPass
lines.text: {PLAYER}'s battle was recorded\non the FRONTIER PASS.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndQuitGame
lines.text: Would you like to save and\nquit the game?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SavingPleaseWait
lines.text: Saving your battle data.\nPlease wait.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_CancelYourChallenge
lines.text: Would you like to cancel your BATTLE\nROOM challenge?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RecordCouldntBeSaved
lines.text: There was an error of some sort.\nYour record could not be saved.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SalonMaidenOnHerWay
lines.text: Excuse me, but…\pOur leader, the SALON MAIDEN, is on\nher way here in hopes of battling you.\pShe should be arriving very shortly.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForSalonMaiden
lines.text: You will be facing the SALON MAIDEN.\nAre you prepared?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_GreetingsImAnabel
lines.text:
Greetings…
My name is ANABEL.\pI am the SALON MAIDEN, and I am in
charge of running the BATTLE TOWER…\pI have heard several rumors
about you…\pIn all honesty, what I have heard does
not seem attractive in any way…\pThe reason I've come to see you…
Well, there is but one reason…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_LetMeSeeYourTalent
lines.text: Let me see your talent in\nits entirety…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelTalentShallBeRecognized
lines.text: ANABEL: Fufufu, nicely done…\pYour FRONTIER PASS, please…\nYour talent shall be recognized.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedAbilitySymbol
lines.text: The Ability Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_UntilNextTime
lines.text:
… … … … … …\pYou have confidence in your POKéMON
battling talent, don't you?\pI urge you to keep battling and
keep on winning.\pI will be waiting for you.
Until the next time we meet…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelYouCameBack
lines.text:
ANABEL: You really did come back to
see me…\p… … … … … …\pYou've won straight matches to see me…
I won't have to hold back against you…\pIt's been too long now…\pToo long since I've been able to battle
without thinking about anything…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_LetsBeginShallWe
lines.text: Let's begin, shall we?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelCongratsYourPassPlease
lines.text: ANABEL: Fufu, congratulations…\nYour FRONTIER PASS, please…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AbilitySymbolTookGoldenShine
lines.text: The Ability Symbol took on\na golden shine!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_WishICouldBattleYouAgain
lines.text: That was fun…\pI have never had a POKéMON battle\nso enjoyable before…\pI wish I could battle with you again…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DirectYouToBattleRoom
lines.text: I'll direct you to your BATTLE ROOM now.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
lines.text: Excuse me!\pYou didn't save before you quit your\nchallenge last time.\pBecause of that, your challenge so far\nhas been disqualified. Sorry!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CongratsBeatenSeven
lines.text: Congratulations!\nYou've beaten all seven TRAINERS!\p$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_EarnedFabulousPrize
lines.text: For beating seven TRAINERS in a row,\nyou have earned this fabulous prize!\p$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_BagFullMakeRoom
lines.text: Oh, your BAG appears to be full.\pPlease make room in your BAG, then come\nsee me.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThankYouForPlaying
lines.text: Thank you for playing!\p$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_RecordWillBeSaved
lines.text: Your record will be saved.\nPlease wait.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WeveBeenWaitingForYou
lines.text: We've been waiting for you!\p$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ProgressWillBeSaved
lines.text: Before entering a BATTLE ROOM, your\nprogress will be saved. Please wait.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_AboutToFace50thTrainer
lines.text: You're finally about to face the\n50th TRAINER.\pFrom here on, every time you beat seven\nTRAINERS in a row, your POKéMON will\lreceive a commemorative RIBBON.\pGood luck!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_HereAreSomeRibbons
lines.text: Here are some RIBBONS for beating\nseven tough TRAINERS in a row.\p{PLAYER} received some RIBBONS!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PutRibbonOnMons
lines.text: {PLAYER} put the RIBBONS on\nthe challenger POKéMON.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DescribeFeelingsAboutBattleTower
lines.text: Excuse me, do you have a moment?\pCan you describe your feelings when\nyou're about to begin a BATTLE TOWER\lmatch, or when you've either won or\llost a match?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouBegin
lines.text: Okay, what are your feelings when\nyou're about to begin a match?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouveWon
lines.text: What do you feel when you've won\na match?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouveLost
lines.text: Can I hear about your feelings when\nyou have lost a match?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DontThinkMuchAboutIt
lines.text: Oh, so you don't think much about it?\nYou're one cool customer.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ChangedYourMind
lines.text: Hunh? You changed your mind?\nI guess you're fickle.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThatsHowYouFeel
lines.text: Okay, so that's how you feel?\nThat's quite original.\pThanks!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WinsInRowRecorded
lines.text: The number of matches you win in a row\nis recorded.\pI'd better not get beaten in\nan embarrassing way!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CanLeaveUntilLossOrSevenWins
lines.text: Once you've entered the BATTLE TOWER,\nyou can't leave until you either lose\lor you beat seven TRAINERS in a row.\pYou'd best be certain that you're up\nto the challenge.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DoubleBattleRoomConstruction
lines.text:
Welcome to the BATTLE TOWER
DOUBLE BATTLE CORNER!\pUnfortunately, the BATTLE ROOMS
are still under construction.\pPlease come back when the work
is completed.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_MultiBattleRoomConstruction
lines.text:
Welcome to the BATTLE TOWER
MULTI BATTLE CORNER!\pUnfortunately, the BATTLE ROOMS
are still under construction.\pPlease come back when the work
is completed.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_LookForwardToAnotherChallenge
lines.text: We look forward to seeing you on\nanother challenge!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
lines.text: The BATTLE ROOM offers two levels\nof challenge, Level 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PleaseSelectMons
lines.text: Please select the POKéMON you wish\nto enter.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeEntering
lines.text: Before entering a BATTLE ROOM, your\nprogress must be saved. Is that okay?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ShowYouToBattleRoom
lines.text: I will now show you to the\n{STR_VAR_1} BATTLE ROOM.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
lines.text: Shall I record your last BATTLE TOWER\nmatch on your FRONTIER PASS?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
lines.text: Excuse me!\pYou don't have {STR_VAR_2} eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have {STR_VAR_2} different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pPlease come see me when you are ready.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
lines.text: Excuse me!\pYou don't have {STR_VAR_2} eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have {STR_VAR_2} different POKéMON\nto enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pPlease come see me when you are ready.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50Singles
lines.text: Excuse me!\pYou don't have three eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have three different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pPlease come see me when you are ready.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpenSingles
lines.text: Excuse me!\pYou don't have three eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have three different POKéMON\nto enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pPlease come see me when you are ready.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50Doubles
lines.text: Excuse me!\pYou don't have four eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have four different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pPlease come see me when you are ready.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpenDoubles
lines.text: Excuse me!\pYou don't have four eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have four different POKéMON\nto enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pPlease come see me when you are ready.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50Multis
lines.text: Excuse me!\pYou don't have two eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have two different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pPlease come see me when you are ready.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpenMultis
lines.text: Excuse me!\pYou don't have two eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have two different POKéMON\nto enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pPlease come see me when you are ready.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomSingleBattle
lines.text: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the SINGLE\nBATTLE ROOMS.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeSinglesChallenge
lines.text: Would you like to take the SINGLE\nBATTLE ROOM challenge?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
lines.text:
The BATTLE TOWER's SINGLE BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lSINGLE BATTLES with three POKéMON.\pThere are many SINGLE BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn each of the SINGLE BATTLE ROOMS,
seven TRAINERS await your challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven,
you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
lines.text: Now please select the three POKéMON\nthat are to be entered.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeDoubleBattle
lines.text: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the DOUBLE\nBATTLE ROOMS.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeDoublesChallenge
lines.text: Would you like to take the DOUBLE\nBATTLE ROOM challenge?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge
lines.text:
The BATTLE TOWER's DOUBLE BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lDOUBLE BATTLES with four POKéMON.\pThere are many DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn each of the DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS,
seven TRAINERS await your challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven,
you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PleaseSelectFourMons
lines.text: Now please select the four POKéMON\nthat are to be entered.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeMultiBattle
lines.text: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the MULTI\nBATTLE ROOMS.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeMultisChallenge
lines.text: Would you like to take the MULTI\nBATTLE ROOM challenge?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultisChallenge
lines.text:
The BATTLE TOWER's MULTI BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lMULTI BATTLES.\pFor MULTI BATTLES, you must partner
with a TRAINER in the TOWER and enter\lwith two POKéMON each.\pInside the TOWER is a room named
the BATTLE SALON where you may meet\lother TRAINERS.\pThere, you must find a TRAINER to act
as your partner in MULTI BATTLES.\pOnce you have partnered up, you will
be shown to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM.\pIn the MULTI BATTLE ROOM, seven
tag teams await your challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven
teams, you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PleaseSelectTwoMons
lines.text: Now please select the two POKéMON\nthat are to be entered.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeLinkMultiBattle
lines.text: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the LINK MULTI\nBATTLE ROOMS.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeLinkMultisChallenge
lines.text: Would you like to take the LINK MULTI\nBATTLE ROOM challenge?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainLinkMultisChallenge
lines.text:
The BATTLE TOWER's MULTI BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lMULTI BATTLES with a friend.\pYou must link with your friend using
Wireless Adapters or a Game Boy\lAdvance Game Link cable.\pYou must partner with your friend and
enter two different kinds of POKéMON.\pThere are many MULTI BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn a MULTI BATTLE ROOM, seven
tag teams await you and your friend\lto make a tag-team challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven
teams, you will earn Battle Points.\pPlease beware that unlike other ROOMS,
you may not interrupt your challenge.\pOnce you start, you must battle seven
MULTI BATTLES in a row nonstop.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PleaseSelectTwoMons2
lines.text: Now please select the two POKéMON\nthat are to be entered.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ChoseSameMonAsFriend
lines.text: You have chosen the same kind of\nPOKéMON as your friend.\pPlease choose two POKéMON different\nfrom your friend's, match the level\lyou wish to enter, and register again.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_LinkMultiOnlyForTwoPlayers
lines.text: The LINK MULTI BATTLE ROOM challenge\nis only for two linked players.$

lines.text: Your friend has also selected the\nPOKéMON {STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_2}.$

lines.text: Your friend has chosen a different\nbattle level.$

lines.text: Your friend has chosen a different\nbattle level.\pYour friend has also selected\nthe POKéMON {STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.text: Your friend has chosen a different\nbattle level.\pYour friend has also selected the\nPOKéMON {STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_2}.$

lines.text: Please choose two POKéMON different\nfrom your friend's, match the level\lyou wish to enter, and register again.$

lines.text: I will save the game before\nshowing you in. Please wait.$

lines.text: In recognition of your infinite talent,\nwe award you these Battle Point(s).$

lines.text: {PLAYER} obtained {STR_VAR_1} Battle Point(s).$

lines.text: The BATTLE TOWER rules are listed.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainTowerRules
lines.text:
The BATTLE TOWER is a facility where
four types of battles are waged--\lSINGLE BATTLE, DOUBLE BATTLE, MULTI\lBATTLE, and LINK MULTI BATTLE.\pFor each of these types, there are
separate BATTLE ROOMS.\pPlease speak with a guide offering
the type of battle you wish to enter.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
lines.text:
Depending on the BATTLE ROOM you are
entering, you will be required to take\la certain number of POKéMON.\pThe SINGLE BATTLE mode requires
three POKéMON.\pThe DOUBLE BATTLE mode requires four,
and the MULTI modes both require two.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSalonRules
lines.text:
The BATTLE SALON is where you must
find a partner to form a tag team for\lthe MULTI BATTLE ROOM challenge.\pChoose the best partner for you by
examining other TRAINERS'\lPOKéMON and their moves.\pYou may choose a new tag partner
after winning seven straight matches.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
lines.text:
The LINK MULTI BATTLE Mode is for two
friends to mount a challenge together.\pYou and your friend must be linked with
Wireless Adapters or a GBA Game Link\lcable.\pYou must choose two POKéMON at
the registration counter.\pThese POKéMON must be different
from those of your friend.\pYou may not interrupt this challenge
in the middle, unlike other modes.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FrontierManiacIntro

the BATTLE FRONTIER, I'm no. 1.\pYou can think of me as
the FRONTIER MANIAC.\pJust checking, but you are a TRAINER,
isn't that right?\pI'll happily share the hottest news
I gathered about the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SwingByForTheLatestWord
lines.text: Howdy! Did you swing by to grill me\nabout the latest word? Oh, all right!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_MyInformationsBeenUsefulRight
lines.text: Well? Well? Well?\pI'm sure my information's been\nseriously useful to you, right?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FacilityIsHottest
lines.text: Let's see now…\pIt sounds like the {STR_VAR_1}\nis the hottest place going.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_BattleTowerIsHottest
lines.text: Let's see now…\pIt sounds like BATTLE TOWER\n{STR_VAR_1} is the hottest.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenIsThere
lines.text: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this mysterious TRAINER called\nthe SALON MAIDEN that runs the place.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenSilverMons
lines.text: Have you battled the SALON MAIDEN?\pWhen she's measuring up her opponent,\nshe apparently uses these POKéMON:\pA PSYCHIC-type PSI POKéMON,\na FIRE-type VOLCANO POKéMON,\land a NORMAL-type SLEEPING POKéMON.$

when she's serious?\pWhen she's battling flat out,

an ELECTRIC-type THUNDER POKéMON,\land a NORMAL-type SLEEPING POKéMON.$
