lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice1
lines.text:
Sure, there are several places where
you can enter DOUBLE BATTLES.\pBut the DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS of
the BATTLE TOWER are, like, basic!\pThey're where you should learn about
how DOUBLE BATTLES are played here\lin the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice2
lines.text: Watch yourself in the battles here.\pI hear there are TRAINERS that have\nstrategies they developed just for\lDOUBLE BATTLES.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice3
lines.text: Once you're confident and comfortable\nwith DOUBLE BATTLES here, you should\lthink about challenging other places\loffering DOUBLE BATTLES.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_LinkMultiBattleAdvice

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookToughExplainGambling
lines.text:
…Huh?
You look to me like a tough TRAINER.\pHeheh…
Listen, I have this proposition.\pWe have a little group going here,
and we play a little game with what\lgoes on in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThe rules are really simple.\pFirst, we pick one of the facilities
in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThen, we each pick a different TRAINER
who's taking that facility's challenge,\land bet with our Battle Points.\pThe guy who bet on the TRAINER with
the best record takes all the Battle\lPoints in the pool.\pSounds simple, huh?
So, anyway…$

lines.text: I'll see to it that you benefit, too.\nSo how about it?\lHow about entering that event for me?$

lines.text: All right, that's perfect.\nSo, uh… How about spotting me some\lof your Battle Points?\pTrust me, I'll show you my gratitude\nafterward.$

lines.text: Great, great!\nSo, how much can you spot me?$

lines.text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to battle!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will turn sneaky!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlHasty
lines.text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to battle!\nIt will battle even if it has a lot\lof ouchies!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlSerious
lines.text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to be sneaky!\nIt says it likes to be sneaky even\lif it has a lot of ouchies!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlJolly
lines.text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to be sneaky!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will worry about itself!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlModest
lines.text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nIt says it worries about itself whether\lor not it has a lot of ouchies!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlMild
lines.text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will turn sneaky!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlBashful
lines.text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nIt says it worries about itself even\lif it has a lot of ouchies!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlRash
lines.text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to be sneaky!\nIt says it likes to be sneaky even\lif it has a lot of ouchies!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlCalm
lines.text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nIt says it worries about itself even\lif it has a lot of ouchies!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlGentle
lines.text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will hit back!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlSassy
lines.text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to battle!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will turn sneaky!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlCareful
lines.text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will turn sneaky!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlEgg
lines.text: That's silly! An EGG is asleep!\nI can't talk to it!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_LadyClaimsSheUnderstandsPokemon
lines.text: How charming!\nThat little lady claims she can\lunderstand POKéMON!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlSayingSomethingProfound
lines.text: I have this feeling that the little girl\nis saying something profound.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlPlaysAtRedHouseALot
lines.text: I know something!\pThat little girl plays at the red house\na lot!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLikeToTrade
lines.text:
My POKéMON is a {STR_VAR_2}.
Do you know it?\lIt's quite cute and rather nice.\pThis little one, I could trade with
pride!\pWould you like to trade me a {STR_VAR_1}
for my {STR_VAR_2}?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_PromiseIllBeGoodToIt
lines.text: Oh, it's adorable!\nThank you!\lI promise I'll be good to it!\pOh! I hope you'll be good to\nmy {STR_VAR_2}, too!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_DontTradeForAnythingButMon
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry!\nI don't intend to trade for anything\lbut a {STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WellThatsFineToo
lines.text: Oh, you won't?\nWell, that's fine, too.\lPlease come visit us again.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_SkittySoMuchCuterThanImagined
lines.text: Giggle!\nA SKITTY is so much cuter than I had\limagined. I'm delighted!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
lines.text:
Buhahaha!\pYou couldn't tell it from looking now,
but I used to be one tough TRAINER.\pI had a reputation as the toughest
BEAUTY around, I tell you!\p… … … … … …\pWhat is it now?
You don't believe me.\pI'm not like that blowhard woman over
there. I'm actually talented!\pLet me prove it to you.
I can teach your POKéMON special and\lyet cute moves.\pBut my lessons don't come free.
How about paying for the moves I teach\lwith a wee bit of Battle Points?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWelcomeBack
lines.text: Buhahaha!\pAre you back to learn special and\nyet cute POKéMON moves?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMove
lines.text: Fine, fine, look here!\nWhich move should I teach?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MoveWillBeXBattlePoints
lines.text: The move {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat will be {STR_VAR_2} Battle Points, okay?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachMoveToWhichMon
lines.text: Fine, fine, now pick the POKéMON\nI should teach the move to.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_HaventGotEnoughPoints
lines.text: What the…\nYou haven't got enough Battle Points!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IllTakeBattlePoints
lines.text: Do you see how skilled I am now?\nI'll take your Battle Points, thanks!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantTo
lines.text: What's that?\nYou don't want to…\pIf you want to see how skilled I am,\nyou come see me anytime!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
lines.text:
Ihihihi!\pI know it's hard to see now, but I used
to be one fantastic TRAINER.\pI had a reputation as the most
invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you!\p… … … … … …\pWhat's wrong?
You don't believe me.\pI'm not like that buffoonish woman over
there. I'm actually experienced!\pI can prove it to you.
I can teach your POKéMON hard and\lyet pretty moves.\pBut my lessons don't come free.
How about paying for the moves I teach\lwith a wee bit of Battle Points?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWelcomeBack
lines.text: Ihihihi!\pHave you come to learn hard and\nyet pretty POKéMON moves?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesDontGetAlong
lines.text: Those ladies, the way they bad-mouth\neach other, you probably think that\lthey don't get along.\pBut if that were true, they wouldn't\nstay out here together, would they?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
lines.text:
When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER,
those ladies were strong and beautiful.\pThey were idols among us TRAINERS.\pEven now, age hasn't dulled their
abilities.\pIn fact, their POKéMON moves have
grown even more polished.\pBut… For some reason, I can't help
but feel this…\pTime is so cruel…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SoftboiledDesc
lines.text: Recovers up to\nhalf the user's\nmaximum HP.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SeismicTossDesc
lines.text: Inflicts damage\nidentical to the\nuser's level.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DreamEaterDesc
lines.text: Recovers half the\ndamage inflicted\non a sleeping foe.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaPunchDesc
lines.text: A strong punch\nthrown with\nincredible power.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaKickDesc
lines.text: An extremely\npowerful kick with\nintense force.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_BodySlamDesc
lines.text: A full-body slam\nthat may cause\nparalysis.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RockSlideDesc
lines.text: Large boulders\nare hurled. May\ncause flinching.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_CounterDesc
lines.text: Retaliates any\nphysical hit with\ndouble the power.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderWaveDesc
lines.text: A weak jolt of\nelectricity that\nparalyzes the foe.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwordsDanceDesc
lines.text: A fighting dance\nthat sharply\nraises ATTACK.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DefenseCurlDesc
lines.text: Curls up to con-\nceal weak spots\nand raise DEFENSE.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SnoreDesc
lines.text: A loud attack\nthat can be used\nonly while asleep.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MudSlapDesc
lines.text: Hurls mud in the\nfoe's face to re-\nduce its accuracy.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwiftDesc
lines.text: Sprays star-\nshaped rays\nthat never miss.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcyWindDesc
lines.text: A chilling attack\nthat lowers the\nfoe's SPEED.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_EndureDesc
lines.text: Endures any at-\ntack for 1 turn,\nleaving 1HP.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_PsychUpDesc
lines.text: Copies the foe's\neffect(s) and\ngives to the user.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcePunchDesc
lines.text: An icy punch\nthat may\nfreeze the foe.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderPunchDesc
lines.text: An electrified\npunch that may\nparalyze the foe.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_FirePunchDesc
lines.text: A fiery punch\nthat may burn\nthe foe.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
lines.text:
What a TRAINER needs…\pKnowledge…
Strategy…\lLuck…\lGuts…\lSpirit…\lBravery…\lAnd ability…\pWell, I'm all set in every way!
I'll be unstoppable at every building!\pHuh? POKéMON?
What's that?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFrontierBrains
lines.text: Do you know about the FRONTIER\nBRAINS?\pThat's what SCOTT calls the seven\nspecial TRAINERS that run the seven\lfacilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
lines.text: At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl\ntold me that I have a lot of talent\lfor battling!\pI like POKéMON CONTESTS more!\pBut I'm no good at CONTESTS!\pI guess having talent and liking\nsomething aren't the same.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ChaperonGrandson
lines.text: We came here to chaperon our\ngrandson.\pBut since we're here, we thought\nwe should get some souvenirs.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ProteinMakeNiceGift
lines.text: Dear, what do you think of this?\nWouldn't this make a nice gift?\pIt's…PRO…TE…IN?\nIt sounds delicious, doesn't it?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_FacilitiesDontAllowItems
lines.text: A lot of the BATTLE FRONTIER's\nfacilities don't allow the use of items\lduring battles.\pThat rule makes things tougher than\nthey already are!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerSign
lines.text: This is the BATTLE TOWER!\nKeep the win streak as the toughest\lTRAINER!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePalaceSign
lines.text: This is the BATTLE PALACE!\nKeep your eyes on POKéMON battles!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleArenaSign
lines.text: This is the BATTLE ARENA!\nLet the toughest teams gather!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePyramidSign
lines.text: This is the BATTLE PYRAMID!\nAdvance through the Battle Quest!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingHallSign
lines.text: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL\nSet your sights on new records!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ExchangeCornerSign
lines.text: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER\nExchange your Battle Points!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerFeelsSpecial
lines.text: Wow!\nIt's huge!\pThe BATTLE TOWER feels special.\nIt's different from the others.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier
lines.text: My grand ambition is to conquer both\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON\lLEAGUE.\pAnd if my dream comes true…\pI… I'm going to ask MIMI next door\nif she will be friends with me!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidTooHarsh
lines.text: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh!\nI just can't make it to the top!\pSince I'm out of options, maybe I can\nclimb the outside…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveInDarkness
lines.text: I thrive in darkness…\nYes… What is worthy of me?\lNone other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…\pWhat say you to wandering in darkness\nand in utter and total desperation?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutTogetherUltimateTeam
lines.text: I didn't sleep for a week, but then\nI put together the ultimate team!\pI can't see myself losing, no joke.\nWe're storming the BATTLE ARENA!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere
lines.text:
Did SCOTT bring you here, too?
What is it with that guy?\pIt sounds like he really does know
how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…\pI've never seen him battling in person
ever.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveInYouBuddy
lines.text: ZIGG!\nI believe in you, little buddy!\pI'll make my little ZIGG any favorite\ntasty treats you like if you win!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ZigzagoonLooksVacant
lines.text: ZIGZAGOON looks vacant…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody
lines.text:
People call me a busybody,
but I can't help it.\pYour hat's on crooked!
Oh, no, trash on the ground!\lOops, it's almost dinnertime!\pI don't know if I can stand to just
watch at the BATTLE PALACE…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeatGymLeader
lines.text: I may not look that impressive now,\nbut I once beat a GYM LEADER.\pWho knows, maybe I should give it\nanother shot at glory.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBikeAndBattles
lines.text: I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for\nthe way I battle, too.\pI win matches in the blink of\nan eye!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterThanDaddyAtPokemon
lines.text: I'm better than my daddy\nat POKéMON.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUpSomeWinsForDaddy
lines.text: Go on, my baby sweetie!\nGo rack up some wins for Daddy!\pYou're just like your mother,\nso you'll be dominating!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena
lines.text:
It wasn't easy getting here,
but I'd heard about this knockout\lpretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.\pInstead of her, do you know what
I found?\pA whole teeming mob of sweaty,
stinky, and primitive martial artists!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_SometimesImportantOldManInThere
lines.text: I sometimes see this really important-\nlooking old man going in there.\pHe has these really awesome POKéMON.\nHe seems really nice, though.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
lines.text:
Do you know it?
The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?\pWhen there comes a confident TRAINER
reaching for the golden pinnacle,\lthere shall appear a man among men.\pDon't know that legend?
Well, of course not!\lI just made it up!\pWhat's it supposed to mean?
That, my friend, I can't say!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut
lines.text:
Man! Oh man!
I've never lost once before!\pBut I got wiped out with no saving
grace at all!\pAnd then I'm told I don't have any
talent?! Man!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower
lines.text: This guy ran into a horribly tough\nTRAINER while he was on the BATTLE\lTOWER challenge.\pNow look at him…\pYou need to be cautious if you ever\ndecide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBattlePointsForDoll
lines.text: Yes!\nI've finally got enough Battle Points!\pI guess I'll trade for another giant\nplush DOLL!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere
lines.text: Oh, yeah, okay!\nSo this is the RANKING HALL!\pI'd like to go down in history as\na super champ and have my name\lrecorded here for posterity.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAnythingWithYou
lines.text: With you by my side, I can do anything.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
lines.text:
Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!\pOoh, I just can't wait anymore!\pLet's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM
right this instant!\pIf we get together in the BATTLE SALON,
the power of our love will overcome\leveryone we meet.\pWhy, before us, darling, everything
will topple like dominoes!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
lines.text:
The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively
for tough TRAINERS.\pMany people with special abilities
have been invited, it seems.\pThat man SCOTT…\pHe may have built this place to serve
a bigger objective…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeHereSeemsToWiggle
lines.text: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you good eyesight?\pThere is an odd tree past here, and to\nmy tired eyes it seems to wiggle.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOddTreePastHere
lines.text: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you a good memory?\pI have this feeling there once was\nan odd tree past here.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail
lines.text:
I…
I saw it!\pThere was a sticky sort of a POKéMON
with a long tail up ahead!\pIt was hiding under a boulder, and
it kept staring at me!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDomeSign
lines.text: This is the BATTLE DOME!\nYour path to the invincible superstar!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFactorySign
lines.text: This is the BATTLE FACTORY!\nSeek out the toughest POKéMON!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePikeSign
lines.text: This is the BATTLE PIKE!\nChoose one of three paths!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBattleTower
lines.text: This is the BATTLE TOWER.\pTRAINERS bring their best-raised\nPOKéMON for elimination-style matches.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
lines.text: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
lines.text: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…\pI'm terribly sorry.\pYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
lines.text: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SlateportItIs
lines.text: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LilycoveItIs
lines.text: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWithUsAnotherTime
lines.text: Please sail with us another time!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
lines.text: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWhereWouldYouLikeToGo
lines.text: Then, where would you like to go?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutOfAllMyFriends
lines.text: I'm the best out of all my friends.\nBut here…\lI've been useless!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFindBattleTower
lines.text: I want to go to the BATTLE TOWER,\nbut I can't find it even though I have\la map of the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThis place is just too big!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasickOnWayHere
lines.text: I wanted to take a challenge as soon\nas I arrived here.\pBut on the way, I got seasick…\nUrrrrp…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
lines.text:
It's not as if just anyone can come
here, you know?\pOnly those TRAINERS who've been
recognized as tough are brought here.\pThat's why many TRAINERS don't even
know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCanChallengeWithNoMons
lines.text: Hey, bro…\pAre you sure we can make challenges\neven if we don't have any POKéMON?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
lines.text: Uh…\nI'm sure it'll be okay.\pI think…\pBut remember that big scary guy?\nHe said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRaisingThoseRentalMons
lines.text: That's the BATTLE FACTORY.\nYou can rent strong POKéMON there.\pBut it makes me wonder.\nWho's raising those rental POKéMON?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOfPikeBecauseSeviper
lines.text: I'm scared of going into the BATTLE\nPIKE because of SEVIPER…\pB-but I came all the way here, so I will\ntry to conquer everything!\l…Shudder…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlayRockPaperScissors
lines.text: Let's play rock, paper, scissors!\nOne, two, three!\p… … … … … …$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTakePikeChallenge
lines.text: Yay! I won!\nI will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllPutOffPikeChallenge
lines.text: Oh, no…\nI lost.\pI guess I'm not very lucky today.\nI'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge\luntil tomorrow.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFishingOverBattling
lines.text: I believe I'm the only person here who,\nfor some unknown reason, would choose\lfishing over battling.\pHuh? You can't catch anything here?\nThat's disappointing…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBattlingUntilIGetSymbol
lines.text: Today, I'm going to keep battling, no\nmatter what, until I get a Symbol.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOffToChallengeDome
lines.text: Oh? You're off to challenge\nthe BATTLE DOME?\pI'll wish you the best of luck.\nLet us both win our way up and meet\lin challenges.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeIsHereGrandpa
lines.text: Grandpa, over here!\nThe BATTLE DOME is here!\lGo get 'em, Grandpa!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetGentlemenBeatMe
lines.text: Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME?\nI won't let GENTLEMEN beat me!\pBut where is the entrance?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingHereNotLongAgo
lines.text: There used to be nothing here not all\nthat long ago.\pBut, now look at this place! Amazing!\nI'll bring my mother out to see this.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyArrivedAtFrontier
lines.text: I've finally arrived at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER!\pI'm sure to grab attention with\nmy looks and ability!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
lines.text: Munch, munch…\pIt looks like this square's filled with\ntough people.\pMunch, munch…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
lines.text:
Crunch, munch…\pA while back, I met this older girl
at the BATTLE PIKE.\pShe had these eyes that were scary
in a real ornery way.\pCrunch, munch…\pShe got all furious: “Will you quit
eating!” Then she whaled on me.\pIt was a hair-raising kind of
scary experience, sure enough.\pCrunch, munch…$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTimeOurEyesMet
lines.text: Huh? Will you listen to yourself?\nThat's nothing!\pWhy, the last time I cheered for him,\nour eyes met and sparks flew!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
lines.text:
Whaaaaaat?!
Pfft!\pThat only happened because
I happened to be sitting next to you!\pThe DOME ACE only looked our way
because my cheering was so loud!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
lines.text:
Oh, shush!
Keep that racket down!\pYou fair-weather fans should stick
to cheering for some GYM LEADER!\pThe DOME ACE is mine!
The only idol for me!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
lines.text:
Those people squabbling over there…\pIt's hard to believe, but they once
were TRAINERS, and good ones, too.\pThey used to be incredibly tough,
and they were famous, too.\pBut they were obliterated by this
certain TRAINER at a tournament.\pThey were so thoroughly whipped,
they became smitten by the TRAINER.\pNow they're just fans of the TRAINER.
They go cheer for their idol at the\lBATTLE DOME every day now.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
lines.text: I heard a rumor that someone saw\na POKéMON with an unusually long tail\lsomewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pIt must be adorable. I'm sure of it…\pOh, challenges can wait. I feel driven\nto find the delightful creature!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeverSeenPokemon
lines.text:
There was someone here using a 
POKéMON I've never seen before.\pI never learned about it at
TRAINER'S SCHOOL at least.\pI wonder where you can catch POKéMON
like that.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NextStopBattleArena
lines.text: Okay! Next stop, the BATTLE ARENA!\nI'd better get the right POKéMON from\lthe PC Storage System.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoingThroughEveryChallenge
lines.text: Giggle… I'm going to go through every\nchallenge with just this baby!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Skitty
lines.text: SKITTY: Mya myaaah!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_ExplainRankingHall
lines.text: This is the RANKING HALL.\pThis is where we recognize the immortal\nTRAINERS who left great records in\lBATTLE FRONTIER events.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_DomePikeFactoryRecords
lines.text: BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE,\nand BATTLE FACTORY Records$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_PalaceArenaPyramidRecords
lines.text: BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA,\nand BATTLE PYRAMID Records$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_IsYourNameOnThisList
lines.text: Hi, is your name on this list?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WowThatsSuper
lines.text: Wow, that's super!\nI'll have to try harder, too!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHarderIfYouSawFriendsName
lines.text: Oh, is that right?\pIf you saw your friend's name up here,\nI bet it would make you work harder!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesNotUpThere
lines.text: Hmm…\nMy name's not up there…\pWell, it's only natural since I haven't\ntaken any challenges yet.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_FirstTimeHereThisWay
lines.text: Is it your first time here?\nPlease step this way!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
lines.text: The front lines of POKéMON battling!\nWelcome to the BATTLE FRONTIER!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueFrontierPass
lines.text: For a first-time visitor, we issue\nthe FRONTIER PASS.\pIt's for use at all the facilities\nin the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pHere you are!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ObtainedFrontierPass
lines.text: {PLAYER} obtained\nthe FRONTIER PASS.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_PlacedTrainerCardInFrontierPass
lines.text: {PLAYER} placed the TRAINER CARD\nin the FRONTIER PASS.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_EnjoyBattleFrontier
lines.text: We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE\nFRONTIER has to offer!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IfItIsntPlayerYouCame
lines.text: ???: Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nYou came out here!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OhMrScottGoodDay
lines.text: GUIDE: Oh! MR. SCOTT, sir!\nGood day to you, sir!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottGreatToSeeYouHere
lines.text:
SCOTT: It's great to see you here,
it really is!\pI hope you'll take your time and
explore everywhere.\pNaturally, I hope you'll also experience
the pure essence of battling.\pI also have my quarters here, so feel
free to visit if you have time.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFacilities
lines.text: I'm your guide to the various facilities\nhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich2
lines.text: Which would you like to learn about?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleTowerInfo
lines.text: It is the gigantic tower considered\nto be the BATTLE FRONTIER's symbol.\pThere are four kinds of BATTLE ROOMS\nin the tower for SINGLE, DOUBLE, MULTI,\land LINK MULTI BATTLES.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleDomeInfo
lines.text:
The BATTLE DOME is the large building
shaped like a huge egg.\pEvents named Battle Tourneys are held
in this facility.\pThe Battle Tourneys are offered in
two courses--for SINGLE and DOUBLE\lBATTLES.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePalaceInfo
lines.text: The BATTLE PALACE is the red building\non the right of the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThere are two kinds of BATTLE HALLS\nfor SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleArenaInfo
lines.text: The BATTLE ARENA is the dojo-like\nbuilding at the center-right of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pAn event called the Set KO Tourney\ntakes place at the BATTLE ARENA.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleFactoryInfo
lines.text:
The BATTLE FACTORY is the large
building that is the closest to us.\pAn event called the Battle Swap
is conducted there.\pThe Battle Swap event is offered in
two courses for SINGLE and DOUBLE\lBATTLES.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePikeInfo
lines.text: The BATTLE PIKE is the building shaped\nlike a POKéMON at the center-left of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pAn event called the Battle Choice\nis conducted there.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePyramidInfo
lines.text: The BATTLE PYRAMID is the enormous\npyramid.\pAn event called the Battle Quest\nis conducted there.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RankingHallInfo
lines.text: The RANKING HALL is located near\nthe BATTLE TOWER.\pThere, you may see the most fantastic\nrecords left by the TRAINERS that\ltook on the many challenges of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ExchangeCornerInfo
lines.text: The EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER is near\nthe BATTLE TOWER.\pThe Battle Points you have earned in\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER may be exchanged\lfor fabulous prizes there.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToRules
lines.text: I'm your guide to the basic rules that\nare common to all the challenges\loffered by the facilities in the BATTLE\lFRONTIER.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhat
lines.text: What would you like to learn about?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LevelModeInfo
lines.text: All the challenges at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER's facilities come in\ltwo courses--Level 50 and Open Level.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info
lines.text:
The Level 50 course is open to POKéMON
up to and including Level 50.\pPlease keep in mind, however, that
no TRAINER you face will have any\lPOKéMON below Level 50.\pThis course is the entry level for
battles at the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pTo begin, we hope you will challenge
this course.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLevelInfo
lines.text:
The Open Level course places no limit
on the levels of POKéMON entering\lchallenges.\pThe levels of your opponents will
be adjusted to match the levels of\lyour POKéMON.\pHowever, no TRAINER you face will
have any POKéMON below Level 60.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo
lines.text:
Virtually any kind of POKéMON may take
on the challenges at all facilities.\pEGGS and certain kinds of POKéMON,
however, are not permitted.\pThe numbers of POKéMON required for
challenges will depend on the facility.\pAt all facilities, however, two or more
of the same kind of POKéMON are not\lpermitted.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldItemsInfo
lines.text: When entering a challenge at a BATTLE\nFRONTIER facility, POKéMON may not\lbe holding the same kind of item.\pPlease make sure that all POKéMON\nentering a challenge are holding\ldifferent items.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFrontierPass
lines.text: I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich1
lines.text: Which would you like to learn about?$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo
lines.text:
There are seven facilities at
the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pTRAINERS who gain recognition for
their abilities may be rewarded with\lsymbols from each of the facilities.\pTo earn a symbol, TRAINERS may need
to defeat other TRAINERS in a row,\land may need to win events repeatedly.\pIt's certainly not easy to win symbols.
I wish you the best of luck!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo
lines.text:
It is possible to record one battle
on your FRONTIER PASS.\pYou may record a battle you had with
a friend or friends.\pOr you may record a battle conducted
at the BATTLE FRONTIER excluding\lmatches at the BATTLE PIKE or\lthe BATTLE PYRAMID.\pYou may choose to record your match
at the end of a battle.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePointsInfo
lines.text: Battle Points are rewards given to\nTRAINERS who battled outstandingly\lat the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pYou may trade in your Battle Points\nfor prizes at the EXCHANGE SERVICE\lCORNER.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
lines.text:
SCOTT: Well, hello and welcome!
Heheh… Sorry about the cramped space.\pAnyway, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me formally
welcome you to the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThis is my dream come true.
It took me years and years, but I've\lfinally given shape to my dream.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchEffortItTookToMakeReal
lines.text:
On reflection, it was a terribly long
journey…\pI left home alone on a quest to find
strong TRAINERS.\pNo one can imagine how much effort
or time it took to make this real.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThisAsMementoOfOurPathsCrossing
lines.text:
But that's all in the past.
No point dwelling on that!\pAll I want for you is to enjoy battling
to your heart's content here.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I want you to have this
as a memento for all the time our\lpaths crossed on our journeys.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ObtainedXBattlePoints
lines.text: {PLAYER} obtained\n{STR_VAR_1} Battle Point(s).$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainBattlePoints
lines.text:
SCOTT: You can check your Battle
Points on your FRONTIER PASS.\pThe more success you have here at
the BATTLE FRONTIER, the more Battle\lPoints you will collect.\pUse your Battle Points the way you
see fit, like trading them for items.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingGreatThings
lines.text: I'm expecting great things from you!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers
lines.text:
SCOTT: Every TRAINER is an individual.
They all lead lives of their own.\pBut when they're in a battle,
it doesn't matter who they are.\pThey're all the same!\pI love the purity of battle,
where everyone is equal.\pThat's why I go everywhere seeking
TRAINERS who are serious about\lbattling, and invite them here.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouMetFrontierBrain
lines.text:
SCOTT: Have you met any of
the FRONTIER BRAINS?\pBetter yet, have you obtained any
symbols from them?\pI handpicked the FRONTIER BRAINS
as the toughest TRAINERS anywhere.\pBut I'm sure that seeing how tough
you are will startle even them!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindWildMonsInFrontier
lines.text:
SCOTT: You don't just train for battle,
right?\pI think I remember you working on
a POKéDEX as well.\pWell, guess what?\pYou may run into wild POKéMON in
the BATTLE FRONTIER somewhere…\lFufufu!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
lines.text:
SCOTT: Are you enjoying things in
the BATTLE FRONTIER?\p…Wait a second…
Oh!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've collected the full set\lof silver symbols!\pThat's more than impressive!
You are tough, just as I suspected!\pNormally, I wouldn't do something
like this, but this is a special time!\pI want you to have this.
I'm sure you can put it to proper use.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
lines.text:
SCOTT: I hope you're enjoying
everything in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\p…Wait a second…
Oh, my disbelieving eyes!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've gathered up the full set\lof gold symbols!\pThat's more than stupendous!
You're incredible, just as I suspected!\p… … … … … …\p{PLAYER}, you've got to accept this!\pI think you will be able to
appreciate the value of my gift!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIBroughtYouHere
lines.text: I must say I have the gift of knowing\na good TRAINER when I see one.\pI'm so glad I had the foresight to\nbring you here!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_BerryPocketStuffed
lines.text: Your BERRY POCKET seems to\nbe stuffed.$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50TrainersInARow
lines.text: SCOTT: Oh, I heard about you!\nHow you ruled the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 50 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's fantastic!\nI want you to have this!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100TrainersInARow
lines.text: SCOTT: Oh, my! I heard about you!\nHow you overwhelmed the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 100 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's ridiculously spectacular!\nYou've got to have this!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingToHearEvenGreaterThings
lines.text: I'll be expecting to hear even greater\nthings about you now!$

lines.label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ComeBackForThisLater
lines.text: Oops, well, if you have too much\nstuff, come back for this later.$

lines.label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
lines.text:
Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}?
I've heard tales of your exploits.\pMy name is WALLACE.\pI was once the GYM LEADER of
SOOTOPOLIS, but something came up.\pSo now, I've entrusted my mentor JUAN
with the GYM's operation.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pGROUDON and KYOGRE, the two POKéMON
wreaking havoc here, are considered\lto be super-ancient POKéMON.\pBut there aren't just two super-
ancient POKéMON.\pThere is one more somewhere.\pSomewhere, there is a super-
ancient POKéMON named RAYQUAZA.\pIt's said that it was RAYQUAZA that
becalmed the two combatants in\lthe distant past.\pBut even I have no clue as to
RAYQUAZA's whereabouts…$

lines.label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza
lines.text: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, do you perhaps\nknow where RAYQUAZA is now?\pIf you do, please tell me.$

lines.label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
lines.text: WALLACE: The CAVE OF ORIGIN?\pBut that's right here!\nI need you to do better than that!\pPlease, I need you to think about\nwhere RAYQUAZA might be right now.$

lines.label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
lines.text:
WALLACE: MT. PYRE?\pBut when I met the old lady there
earlier, she made no mention of it.\pI very much doubt that the old lady
would try to hide something from me…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, could you think about this
more carefully for me?$

lines.label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSomehow
lines.text: WALLACE: Huh? You don't remember?\nHmm… That's a problem…\pCan't you remember somehow?$

lines.label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPillar
lines.text: WALLACE: The SKY PILLAR?\pThat's it!\nIt must be the SKY PILLAR!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, there's not a moment to lose!\nWe'll head to the SKY PILLAR right away!$

lines.label: DesertUnderpass_Text_FoundRootFossil
lines.text: {PLAYER} found the ROOT FOSSIL.$

lines.label: DesertUnderpass_Text_FoundClawFossil
lines.text: {PLAYER} found the CLAW FOSSIL.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_TinyIslandCommunity
lines.text: DEWFORD is a tiny island community.\nIf something gets trendy here,\leveryone picks up on it right away.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_TownSign
lines.text: DEWFORD TOWN\n“A tiny island in the blue sea.”$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_GymSign
lines.text: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BRAWLY\l“A big wave in fighting!”$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_HallSign
lines.text: DEWFORD HALL\n“Everyone's information exchange!”$

lines.label: Route104_Text_LandedInDewfordDeliverLetter
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've hit land in DEWFORD.\pI suppose you're off to deliver that\nLETTER to, who was it now, STEVEN!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: Have you delivered your\nLETTER?\pOr were you meaning to sail back to\nPETALBURG?$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail2
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG it is, then!\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_GoDeliverIllBeWaiting
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver\nthe LETTER. I'll be waiting.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInDewford
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've hit land in DEWFORD!\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail again!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\pNow, my friend, where are we bound?$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, is it?\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSail
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, is it?\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_JustTellMeWhenYouNeedToSetSail
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever\nyou need to set sail again!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_GettingItchToFish
lines.text: This is a renowned fishing spot.\nAre you getting the itch to fish?$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods
lines.text: I hear you, and I like what\nyou're saying!\pI'll give you one of my fishing RODS.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
lines.text:
And, as an added bonus, I'll even throw
in a little fishing advice!\pFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\pFocus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull on the ROD.\pSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,\lyou need to time the pulls on your ROD\lto haul them in.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_ThatsTooBadThen
lines.text: Oh, is that so?\nThat's too bad, then.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_HowsYourFishing
lines.text: Yo!\nHow's your fishing?$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_GreatHaulInSomeBigOnes
lines.text: Is that right! That's great!\nHaul in some big ones!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
lines.text:
Oh, hey, don't get down on yourself!
I'll give you a little fishing advice.\pFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\pFocus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull the ROD.\pSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,\lyou need to time the pulls on your ROD\lto haul them in.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
lines.text:
I like what's hip, happening, and trendy.
I'm always checking it out.\pListen, have you heard about this new
“{STR_VAR_1}”?\pThat's right!
Of course you know!\pI mean, sheesh,
“{STR_VAR_1}”…\lIt's the hottest thing in cool!\pWherever you're from,
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lis the biggest happening thing, right?$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_TellMeWhatsNewAndIn
lines.text: Hunh?\nIt's not the hip and happening thing?\pWell, hey, you have to tell me,\nwhat's new and what's “in”?$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
lines.text:
Hunh?
“{STR_VAR_2}”?\p… …\p…Uh… Yeah! That's right!
Yeah, I knew that! Knew it all along!\pOf course I know about that!
“{STR_VAR_2},” right?\pYeah, that's it, it's there!
Isn't “{STR_VAR_2}”\lthe coolest, or what?\pIt's the hippest thing in hip.
You think I'd not know about it?\p“{STR_VAR_1}”…
It's, like, so five minutes ago.\pNow, “{STR_VAR_2}” is
what's vital and in tune with the times!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_XHuhIThinkYIsCool
lines.text: Hmm…\n“{STR_VAR_2},” huh?\pBut personally, I think\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lis what's real in cool.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_HearOfAnyTrendsComeShareWithMe
lines.text: Well, if you hear of any happening new\ntrends, come share them with me, okay?$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_YeahDefinitionOfInRightNow
lines.text: Yeah, absolutely right!\p“{STR_VAR_1}” is the\ndefinition of “in” right now.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
lines.text:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pDEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY commands
FIGHTING-type POKéMON.\pGoing against him with NORMAL-type
POKéMON is asking for trouble.\pFIGHTING POKéMON will lay a serious
smack down on NORMAL POKéMON,\lso be careful!\pWhat's worse, the GYM is as dark as
the ocean floor.\pBut it will get brighter after defeating
the TRAINERS in your way.\pHey, okay, go for it!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
lines.text: Whoah! It's turned too bright in here!\pYour future is bright, too!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoIntro
lines.text: Might is right!\nCome on!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoDefeat
lines.text: Not enough power…$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoPostBattle
lines.text: Your skill overcame my strength!\nYour technique is commendable!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro
lines.text: There's no need for BRAWLY to be\ninvolved!\pI'll crush you!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynDefeat
lines.text: But… How?\nHow could I lose so easily?$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
lines.text: I'm not going to waste this loss.\nI'll use it to motivate me to train!\pOne day I'll become a GYM LEADER…\pNo, I'll become the POKéMON LEAGUE\nCHAMPION!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraIntro
lines.text: Don't you dare brush me off!\nIt's not my fault if you cry!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraDefeat
lines.text: Waaaaaaah!\nI lost!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle
lines.text: I battle in the dark to make my heart\nstronger.\pBut because it's so dark, I can never\nsee BRAWLY's face…$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithIntro
lines.text: Ufufu…\nAre you stumbling around in the dark?$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithDefeat
lines.text: Oh, you…\nI don't want to know you!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithPostBattle
lines.text: You deserve to stay lost and end up\nback at the entrance again!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenIntro
lines.text: I'll show you the gumption of\na sailing man!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenDefeat
lines.text: How'd this happen?\nIt's not like me to lose this way!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenPostBattle
lines.text: Oh, aye! You're worthy of seeing\nour GYM LEADER.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianIntro
lines.text: If you mean to pass, it has to be\nthrough me!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianDefeat
lines.text: Grrrrr!\nVastly overpowered!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianPostBattle
lines.text: You win!\nGo after that BADGE!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
lines.text:
I'm BRAWLY!
DEWFORD's GYM LEADER!\pI've been churned in the rough waves
of these parts, and I've grown tough\lin the pitch-black cave!\pSo you wanted to challenge me?
Let me see what you're made of!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
lines.text: Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger\nsplash than I expected!\pYou swamped me!\pOkay, you've got me.\nTake this GYM BADGE!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedKnuckleBadge
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the KNUCKLE BADGE\nfrom BRAWLY.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
lines.text:
The KNUCKLE BADGE makes all POKéMON
up to Level 30, even those you get in\ltrades, obey without question.\pAnd, you'll be able to use the HM move
FLASH outside of battle.\pIf you'd like, use this TECHNICAL
MACHINE, too.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainBulkUp
lines.text: That TM08 contains BULK UP.\pIt's a move that raises both ATTACK\nand DEFENSE stats.\p… … … … … …$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_RegisteredBrawly
lines.text: Registered GYM LEADER BRAWLY\nin the POKéNAV.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostBattle
lines.text: I can see your talent becoming a giant\nwave to cause a storm of astonishment\lamong TRAINERS one day!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
lines.text: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
lines.text: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM\pBRAWLY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
lines.text:
BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it
always returns to the shore.\pA giant wave of a talent like you…
I knew you would return!\pShow me how much higher
you've gone!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchDefeat
lines.text: Wow!\nSwamped again!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostRematch
lines.text: BRAWLY: Battling is vast and it's deep.\nYou can't see the bottom.\lIt's just like the sea of HOENN!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
lines.text:
BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it
always returns to the shore.\pA giant wave of a talent like you…
I knew you would return!\pOh? You only have one POKéMON
that can battle.\pI'm sorry, but I'd like you to come back
with at least two POKéMON.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CantImagineLifeWithoutTrend
lines.text: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be\n“{STR_VAR_1}”!\pI can't imagine what life would be like\nwithout “{STR_VAR_1}”!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GettingBoredOfTrend
lines.text: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be\n“{STR_VAR_1}”!\pBut I'm getting kind of bored with it.\pI should look for the next big thing.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TeachingMonAboutTrend
lines.text: I'm teaching my POKéMON about\n“{STR_VAR_1},”\lbut it's not going well.\pIt's a bit too much, I think.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_DeepLinkBetweenXAndY
lines.text: I'm studying up on the hip and trendy\n“{STR_VAR_1}” now.\pIs it true that there's a deep link\nbetween “{STR_VAR_1}”\land “{STR_VAR_2}”?$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_MyHunchWasRight
lines.text: Oh!\nSo, my hunch was right!\pI'm one step closer to being hip and\nhappening, yowza!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_NotEasyToKeepUp
lines.text: What?!\nIs that so?!\pIt's not easy for an older fellow like\nme to keep up with trends!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TVShowAboutTrend
lines.text: This whole business about\n“{STR_VAR_1}”…\lIsn't there a TV show on it?$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IsTrendMorePopularAcrossSea
lines.text: Across the sea…\pIs “{STR_VAR_1}”\neven more popular?$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CollectTrendMerchandise
lines.text:
I collect official
“{STR_VAR_1}”\llicensed merchandise.\pI have official
“{STR_VAR_1}” DOLLS…\pOfficial “{STR_VAR_1}”
brand clothing…\pAnd officially licensed
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lpicture books.\pHeheh, I own!
I'm not sharing anything with you!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BooksAboutTrend
lines.text:
IDENTIFYING GOOD
“{STR_VAR_1}” &\lBAD “{STR_VAR_1}”…\pTHE LINK BETWEEN
“{STR_VAR_1}” AND\lPOKéMON…\pUSEFUL
“{STR_VAR_1}”…\pIt's neatly jammed with books about
“{STR_VAR_1}.”$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendsScream
lines.text: “{STR_VAR_1}'S\nSCREAM” is the title.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendsSmile
lines.text: “{STR_VAR_1}'S\nSMILE” is the title.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_LastTrend
lines.text: It's titled “THE LAST\n{STR_VAR_1}”.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BirthOfTrend
lines.text: It's titled “THE BIRTH OF\n{STR_VAR_1}”.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_SawTrendCoolestThing
lines.text: I saw “{STR_VAR_1}”!\nCool, huh?\pIt's, like, the coolest thing going!\pIt was awesome!\nIt was the real thing, oh yeah!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_AllegedTrendNotAuthentic
lines.text: Oh, no, no, no.\pThat alleged\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lyou claim to have seen--it's not.\pThe authentic article is much…\nHow should I say it?\lSharper, yet more mellow!\pAh, no matter. It's astonishing!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_ComposedTrendThemeSong
lines.text:
Hey, listen, I composed a theme song
for “{STR_VAR_1}.”\p“{STR_VAR_1}”
is really popular right now.\pOkay, listen!
… …\pOh!
{STR_VAR_1}!\pWonderful
{STR_VAR_1}!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WorkOnYourSinging
lines.text: … …\pI dare say, chap, it would pay for you\nto work on your singing before you\ltrifle yourself with\l“{STR_VAR_1}.”$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_OrganizeTrendParty
lines.text: Anyway, as I was saying earlier, we\nshould get together and organize a\l“{STR_VAR_1}” party\lon the island.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BrilliantIndeed
lines.text: Oh, a smashing good idea!\pIt will settle once and for all\nwho is the best at\l“{STR_VAR_1}.”\lBrilliant, indeed!\pStarting today, our lives will revolve\naround “{STR_VAR_1}”!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendHasBecomePartOfLife
lines.text: I was thinking, though…\pWouldn't you agree that\n“{STR_VAR_1}” has\lgrown from being something trendy to\lbeing a part of our daily lives?$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendWeighsHeavilyOnMind
lines.text:
Beg pardon?
That much, what?\pHowever, it's true that
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lweighs heavily on your mind, whether\lyou're awake or asleep.\pAbsolutely, you're the
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lPROFESSOR, old sport!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IfWeTeamUpWellBeInvincible
lines.text: If you and me team up as a combo,\nwe'll be invincible when it comes to all\lthings “{STR_VAR_1}”!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WellBeTrendDuo
lines.text: Spot on, my friend!\pWe shall be the\n“{STR_VAR_1}” DUO!\pIsn't that a ripe image?\nHahahah!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GiveYouSludgeBomb
lines.text:
For me, SLUDGE BOMB is at the peak
of popularity. It's the one.\pHunh? You're telling me that you don't
know about SLUDGE BOMB?\pThat's outright pitiful.
I'll give you one.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_LoveSludgeBombButTrendInToo
lines.text: I love SLUDGE BOMB.\pBut POKéMON with the move\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lare in, too.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LotToBeSaidForLivingOnIsland
lines.text: There's a lot to be said for living on\na small island like this in harmony with\lPOKéMON and the family.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LifeGoesSlowlyOnIsland
lines.text: I left the major port of SLATEPORT\nCITY when I married my husband here.\pLife goes by slowly on this little\nisland. But being surrounded by the\lbeautiful sea--that's happiness, too.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_Zigzagoon
lines.text: ZIGZAGOON: Guguuh!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
lines.text:
Gorge your eyes on this!\pIt's a SILK SCARF. It's right at the
cutting edge of fashion, yeah!\pOh, I can see your eyes twinkling!
You appreciate my dazzling style!\pOh, you're a delight!
Here you go. I want you to have it!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom
lines.text: Oh, you don't have room?\pNow, listen tight, this SCARF is a must-\nhave! Why, I would sell all my items\lin order to get it!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainSilkScarf
lines.text: The SILK SCARF raises the power of\nNORMAL-type moves.\pIt's a marvelous SCARF that will go\nwith almost all POKéMON!$

lines.label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool
lines.text:
Wow, you bothered to cross the sea
to visit DEWFORD?\pDid you maybe come here because you
heard about BRAWLY?\pHe's so cool…
Everyone idolizes him.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_StoneCavern
lines.text: There's a stone cavern at the edge\nof town.\pI've heard you can find rare stones\nthere.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaintedMonCanUseHM
lines.text: Even if a POKéMON faints and can't\nbattle, it can still use a move learned\lfrom a HIDDEN MACHINE (HM).$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_Text_EnteringVictoryRoad
lines.text: ENTERING VICTORY ROAD$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_Text_EnteringPokemonLeague
lines.text: ENTERING POKéMON LEAGUE\nCENTER GATE$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_Text_CitySign
lines.text: EVER GRANDE CITY\p“The paradise of flowers, the sea,\nand POKéMON.”$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
lines.text:
WALLACE: Welcome, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pThat incident in SOOTOPOLIS CITY…
That was superb work, putting an end\lto that crisis all by yourself.\pOops!\pIt wouldn't be fair to say that you
alone ended the crisis.\pYou overcame that difficult situation
by working as one with your POKéMON.\pWe TRAINERS raise POKéMON by giving
them items and by teaching them new\ltechniques for battle.\pBut we ourselves also learn many
things from POKéMON.\pAnd this is where your achievements
are put to the test against what\lothers like you have achieved.\pNow!\pWho can most elegantly dance with
their POKéMON in HOENN?\pShow me right here and now!$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
lines.text: I, the CHAMPION, fall in defeat…\pThat was wonderful work.\nYou were elegant, infuriatingly so.\lAnd yet it was utterly glorious!\pKudos to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou are a truly noble POKéMON\nTRAINER!$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
lines.text:
WALLACE: The POKéMON you sent into
battle…\pAt times they danced like a spring
breeze, and at times they struck\llike lightning.\pIt was with light, yet surefooted,
elegance that you led your POKéMON.\pEven I felt bedazzled by your
masterful performance!\pYou now stand at the glorious peak
of the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI now proclaim you to be the new
HOENN region…$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayAdvice
lines.text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHere's some advice before you challenge\nthe CHAMPION…$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayItsAlreadyOver
lines.text: MAY: Huh?\nWhat, what, what?\p{PLAYER}{KUN}…\nCould it be that…\lIt's already over?$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanAdvice
lines.text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}!\pHow would you like some advice before\nyou challenge the CHAMPION?…$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanYouveWon
lines.text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}…\pAre you trying to tell me…\nYou've beaten the CHAMPION?$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
lines.text:
PROF. BIRCH: See?
What did I tell you, {RIVAL}?\pDidn't I tell you that you don't need
to worry about {PLAYER}{KUN}?\p… … … … … … … …
{PLAYER}{KUN}, you've finally done it.\pWhen I heard that you defeated your
own father at the PETALBURG GYM,\lI thought perhaps you had a chance…\pBut to think you've actually become
the CHAMPION!\pAh, yes!\pWhat became of your POKéDEX?
Here, let me see.$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchCongratulations
lines.text: PROF. BIRCH: Anyways,\ncongratulations!\pNow, go proudly into the final room!$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
lines.text: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pNo, let me rephrase that properly.\pThe new CHAMPION!\pCome with me.$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceWaitOutside
lines.text: WALLACE: I'm sorry, but…\pFrom here on, only those TRAINERS who\nhave become CHAMPIONS may enter.\pYou'll have to wait outside with\nPROF. BIRCH.$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCongratulations
lines.text:
MAY: Groan…\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pI'm just joking! That's okay!
That's the rule!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}!
Honestly, congratulations!$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanCongratulations
lines.text: BRENDAN: Whaaaat?! … … … … …\n… … … … … … … …\pIt can't be helped if that's the rule.\p{PLAYER}, way to go!\nCongratulations!$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
lines.text:
I am the last of the POKéMON LEAGUE
ELITE FOUR, DRAKE the DRAGON master!\pIn their natural state, POKéMON are
wild living things. They are free.\pAt times, they hinder us.
At times, they help us.\pFor us to battle with POKéMON as
partners, do you know what it takes?\pDo you know what is needed?\pIf you don't, then you will never
prevail over me!$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_Defeat
lines.text: Superb, it should be said.$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
lines.text:
You deserve every credit for coming
this far as a TRAINER of POKéMON.\pYou do seem to know what is needed.\pYes, what a TRAINER needs is a
virtuous heart.\pPOKéMON touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and learn good from wrong.\pThey touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and grow strong.\pGo! Go onwards!
The CHAMPION is waiting!$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
lines.text:
Welcome, my name is GLACIA
of the ELITE FOUR.\pI've traveled from afar to HOENN
so that I may hone my ice skills.\pBut all I have seen are challenges by
weak TRAINERS and their POKéMON.\pWhat about you?\pIt would please me to no end if I could
go all out against you!$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_Defeat
lines.text: You and your POKéMON…\nHow hot your spirits burn!\pThe all-consuming heat overwhelms.\pIt's no surprise that my icy skills\nfailed to harm you.$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
lines.text: Advance to the next room.\pAnd there, confirm the truly fearsome\nside of the POKéMON LEAGUE.$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_HereWeHonorLeagueChampions
lines.text: WALLACE: This room…\pThis is where we keep records of\nPOKéMON that prevailed through\lharsh battles.\pIt is here that the LEAGUE CHAMPIONS\nare honored.$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_LetsRecordYouAndYourPartnersNames
lines.text: WALLACE: Come on, let's record your\nname as a TRAINER who triumphed over\lthe POKéMON LEAGUE, and the names of\lthe partners who battled with you.$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
lines.text:
Ahahaha!\pI'm PHOEBE of the ELITE FOUR.
I did my training on MT. PYRE.\pWhile I trained, I gained the ability
to commune with GHOST-type POKéMON.\pYes, the bond I developed with POKéMON
is extremely tight.\pSo, come on, just try and see if you can
even inflict damage on my POKéMON!$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_Defeat
lines.text: Oh, darn.\nI've gone and lost.$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
lines.text:
There's a definite bond between you
and your POKéMON, too.\pI didn't recognize it, so it's only
natural that I lost.\pYup, I'd like to see how far your bond
will carry you.\pGo ahead, move on to the next room.$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LeagueAfterVictoryRoad
lines.text: The POKéMON LEAGUE is only a short\ndistance after the VICTORY ROAD.\pIf you've come this far, what choice\ndo you have but to keep going?$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BelieveInYourPokemon
lines.text: The long and harrowing VICTORY ROAD…\pIt's like reliving the path one has\ntraveled in life…\pBelieve in your POKéMON and give it\nyour very best!$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
lines.text:
SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've clawed your
way up to face the POKéMON LEAGUE!\pI'm happy for you!
You made my cheering worthwhile!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, if you were to become
the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION…\pI'll get in touch with you then.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
Go for greatness!$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_MustHaveAllGymBadges
lines.text: Beyond this point, only those TRAINERS\nwho have collected all the GYM BADGES\lare permitted to enter.\pTRAINER, let us confirm that you have\nall the GYM BADGES.$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_HaventObtainedAllBadges
lines.text: You haven't obtained all the BADGES.\pIf you're bound for the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must return with them.$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_GoForth
lines.text: TRAINER! Believe in yourself and your\nPOKéMON, and go forth!$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
lines.text:
Welcome, challenger!
I'm SIDNEY of the ELITE FOUR.\pI like that look you're giving me.
I guess you'll give me a good match.\lThat's good! Looking real good!\pAll right! You and me, let's enjoy
a battle that can only be staged\lhere in the POKéMON LEAGUE!$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_Defeat
lines.text: Well, how do you like that? I lost!\nEh, it was fun, so it doesn't matter.$

lines.label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
lines.text: Well, listen to what this loser has\nto say.\pYou've got what it takes to go far.\nNow, go on to the next room and enjoy\lyour next battle!$

lines.label: FallarborTown_Text_ShadyCharactersCozmosHome
lines.text: Something's happening,\nand I don't like it!\pI've seen shady characters wandering\nin and out of PROF. COZMO's home…$

lines.label: FallarborTown_Text_RegionKnownForMeteors
lines.text: This region's been known for meteors\nsince the olden days.\pThey say METEOR FALLS was gouged out\nby a falling meteorite long ago.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_Text_MyPreciousAzurill
lines.text: See! Take a look!\nThis is my precious AZURILL!\pIt's slick and smooth and plushy, too!$

lines.label: FallarborTown_Text_Azurill
lines.text: AZURILL: Rooreelooo.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlannery
lines.text:
Have you already challenged FLANNERY,
the LEADER of LAVARIDGE GYM?\pThe girl's grandfather was famous.
He was one of the ELITE FOUR in the\lPOKéMON LEAGUE at one point.\pIt wouldn't surprise me to see FLANNERY
become a great TRAINER in her own\lright.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_Text_BattleTentSign
lines.text: BATTLE TENT FALLARBOR SITE\n“May the Greatest Teams Gather!”$

lines.label: FallarborTown_Text_TownSign
lines.text: FALLARBOR TOWN\n“A farm community with small gardens.”$

lines.label: FallarborTown_Text_MoveTutorSign
lines.text: MOVE TUTOR'S HOUSE\n“New moves taught to POKéMON.”$

lines.label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_DoAllRightInPreliminary
lines.text: We do all right in the preliminary round,\nbut we can never win the appeals…\pMaybe it means I have to watch what\nother contestants are doing…$

lines.label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_MonAllTheseRibbons
lines.text: See!\nMy POKéMON won all these RIBBONS!\pHave your POKéMON earned any RIBBONS?\nYou can check them on your POKéNAV.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_CantWinEverywhere
lines.text: I can't beat GYM LEADERS…\pI can't win any CONTESTS…\pI've been here, there, and everywhere,\nand it's all for naught…$

lines.label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_SuperRankStage
lines.text: POKéMON CONTESTS\nSUPER RANK STAGE!$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MakeThinkImJustKid
lines.text: Fufufufufu.\pI'm going to make everyone think\nI'm just a kid and let them play down.\pThen, I'll shock them and grab\nthe title!$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_FallarborTentMyFavorite
lines.text:
You know how BATTLE TENTS offer
different events in different towns?\pMy favorite is definitely the BATTLE
TENT in FALLARBOR TOWN.\pI think it's fantastic how TRAINERS
try to win with all their faith in\ltheir POKéMON.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_CameToCampOut
lines.text:
I heard something about some tent,
so I came to camp out.\pI didn't know that tents these days
are so luxurious!\pSince I'm here, I may as well try
my hand at battling!$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottLookingForSomeone
lines.text:
SCOTT: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
So you came out to this BATTLE TENT!\pThe people in these parts tend to be
easygoing and laid-back.\pBut, you see, what I'm looking for are
people with…\pHow should I say this?\pSomeone bursting with the desire
and the drive to win.\pIf there were a TRAINER like that,
I'd immediately…\pWhoops! Never mind!
Keep working at it!$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottMakeChallenge
lines.text: SCOTT: Instead of wasting your\ntime with the likes of me, why not\lmake a challenge?$

lines.label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MeteoriteWillNeverBeMineNow
lines.text: PROF. COZMO: Oh…\nI never should have let myself be\lconned into telling TEAM MAGMA where\lyou can find METEORITES…\pThat METEORITE from METEOR FALLS…\nIt's never going to be mine now…$

lines.label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
lines.text:
Oh!
Hah?\pThat item…\pCould it be?\pIs it the METEORITE that TEAM MAGMA
took from METEOR FALLS?\pPlease, may I have it?\pI'm not asking for it for free.
How about in exchange for this TM?$

lines.label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_PleaseUseThisTM
lines.text: PROF. COZMO: This TM, it represents\nmy feeling of gratitude.\lPlease use it!$

lines.label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_ReallyGoingToHelpMyResearch
lines.text: PROF. COZMO: Oh, I can't believe it.\nThis is really, really great!\pThis is really going to help my research!$

lines.label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CrushedWithDisappointment
lines.text: PROF. COZMO: Oh, but…\nI'm crushed with disappointment…$

lines.label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MayIHaveMeteorite
lines.text: PROF. COZMO: Please, may I have that\nMETEORITE?\pI'm not asking for it for free.\nHow about in exchange for this TM?$

lines.label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoWentToMeteorFalls
lines.text: PROF. COZMO went off to METEOR FALLS\non ROUTE 114 with some people from\lTEAM MAGMA.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_FeelSorryForCozmo
lines.text: Poor PROF. COZMO…\nHe's so depressed… I feel sorry for him.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoIsSoHappy
lines.text: Look at PROF. COZMO…\nHe's so happy! I think it's cute.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_DecidingSkittyEvolve
lines.text:
I'm having a hard time deciding if I
should make my SKITTY evolve or not.\pI only have to use this MOON STONE,
but it's so hard to decide…\pIf I make it evolve, it will become
much stronger.\pBut it will look so different, too.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_Skitty
lines.text: SKITTY: Miyao?$

lines.label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_SellNuggetIFound
lines.text: This NUGGET I found here…\nI suppose I'll have to sell it, seeing\las how it has no other use.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ImTheMoveTutor
lines.text:
I'm the MOVE TUTOR.\pI know all the moves that POKéMON
learn--every one of them--and I can\lteach POKéMON those moves.\pI can teach a move to a POKéMON
of yours if you'd like.\pI'll do it for a HEART SCALE.
I'm collecting those now.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ThatsAHeartScaleWantMeToTeachMove
lines.text: Oh! That's it! That's an honest to\ngoodness HEART SCALE!\pLet me guess, you want me to teach\na move?$

lines.label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_TutorWhichMon
lines.text: Which POKéMON needs tutoring?$

lines.label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_TeachWhichMove
lines.text: Which move should I teach?$

lines.label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_DontHaveMoveToTeachPokemon
lines.text: Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have any move\nI can teach that POKéMON.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_HandedOverHeartScale
lines.text: {PLAYER} handed over one HEART SCALE\nin exchange.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ComeBackWithHeartScale
lines.text: If your POKéMON need to learn a move,\ncome back with a HEART SCALE.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_CantTeachEgg
lines.text: Hunh? There isn't a single move that\nI can teach an EGG.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
lines.text:
Oh, hello.
You are?\pOkay, your name's {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I can see that you're a TRAINER.\pSo that means you use the POKéMON
Storage System I developed.\pHow I arrived at that conclusion is
a simple deductive process.\pYou spoke to me because you wanted
to access something on this PC.\pOh, I'm sorry. I'm LANETTE.\pHonestly, I'm glad to meet you--it's
great you're using the Storage System.\pIf you could, please visit me at home.
My house is on ROUTE 114.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FossilManiacEdgeOfTown
lines.text: I wonder what POKéMON looked like\nlong, long ago?\pMaybe the FOSSIL MANIAC at the edge\nof town will know.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlantHardyTrees
lines.text: In the fields of FALLARBOR, we plant\nseedlings of hardy trees that thrive\leven in volcanic ash.$

lines.label: FarawayIsland_Interior_Text_TheFeelingOfBeingWatchedFaded
lines.text: The feeling of being watched faded…$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky
lines.text:
No one believes me, but I saw this
gigantic POKéMON in the sky.\pIt seemed to squirm as it flew toward
ROUTE 131.\pBy the way… Sniff…
Um… You, uh…smell singed.\pWere you at a volcano or something?$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingBlockingGym
lines.text: I want to go to the POKéMON GYM,\nbut something's blocking the way.\pAfter all the bother I went through\ntraining on ROUTE 120…$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Text_ThisTimeIllBeatWinona
lines.text: I've got my pride-and-joy POKéMON\nwith me. This time, I'll beat WINONA.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Text_TreesGrowByDrinkingRainwater
lines.text: The ground absorbs rainwater, and\ntrees grow by drinking that water…\pOur FORTREE CITY exists because\nthere's both water and soil.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLively
lines.text:
The CITY consists of homes built on
trees.\pPerhaps because of that lifestyle,
everyone is healthy and lively.\pWhy, even myself--I feel as if I've
grown thirty years younger.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Text_BugPokemonComeThroughWindow
lines.text: Living on top of trees is okay.\pBut sometimes BUG POKéMON come in\nthrough windows.\lIt can be really startling.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Text_PokemonThatEvolveWhenTraded
lines.text: There are POKéMON that evolve when\nyou trade them! That's what I heard.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingUnseeable
lines.text: Something unseeable is in the way.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Text_UnseeableUseDevonScope
lines.text: Something unseeable is in the way.\pWant to use the DEVON SCOPE?$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFled
lines.text: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.\pAn invisible POKéMON became completely\nvisible!\pThe startled POKéMON fled!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Text_CitySign
lines.text: FORTREE CITY\n“The treetop city that frolics with\lnature.”$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Text_GymSign
lines.text: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: WINONA\p“The bird user taking flight into\nthe world.”$

lines.label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_MerchandiseSentToPC
lines.text: Merchandise you buy here is sent to\nyour own PC.\pThat's fantastic! I wish they could\nalso deliver me home like that.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDeskForDolls
lines.text: I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm\nputting my cute DOLLS on it.\pIf I don't, when I decorate my\nSECRET BASE, my DOLLS will get\ldirty or poked with splinters.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
lines.text:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pFORTREE GYM LEADER WINONA is
a master of FLYING-type POKéMON.\pShe's waiting at the back of this GYM,
behind the rotating doors.\pShe's waiting for new challengers
who are trying to take wing!\pOkay, go for it!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
lines.text: You did it!\nYou've achieved liftoff!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredIntro
lines.text: Behold the elegant battle style of\nBIRD POKéMON!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredDefeat
lines.text: You…\nYou're strong…$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredPostBattle
lines.text: A TRAINER has to be smart to keep\nup with unexpected turns of events.\pDo you have the smarts to get to\nour LEADER?$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoIntro
lines.text: The lovers of BIRD POKéMON aspire\nto join this GYM.\pAs a member of the FORTREE GYM,\nI'm not allowed to lose!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoDefeat
lines.text: It was too much of a load for me\nto bear…$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoPostBattle
lines.text: The world is huge, and there are\ncountless tough TRAINERS.\pI'm going to keep training and make\nmyself even stronger.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintIntro
lines.text: There's no need for WINONA, our GYM\nLEADER, to deal with you!\pI'm plenty good enough for you!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintDefeat
lines.text: WINONA, I…\nI lost!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintPostBattle
lines.text: WINONA is cute and she's strong.\nShe's the ultimate LEADER!\pBlush…$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyIntro
lines.text: WINONA taught me personally!\nYou can't beat me easily!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyDefeat
lines.text: I was beaten…$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyPostBattle
lines.text: Thanks to WINONA, the people of\nFORTREE can live without fear.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoIntro
lines.text: When WINONA takes to battle, her face\nshines with beautiful determination…\pI'm not letting you witness that\nlovely sight!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoDefeat
lines.text: Urk!\nI couldn't stop you.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoPostBattle
lines.text: You'd better watch it!\nDon't get distracted staring at WINONA\lor you'll go crashing down in a heap!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro
lines.text: You'd better know that there are all\nsorts of FLYING-type POKéMON.\pYou do know that, right?$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusDefeat
lines.text: You seem to know your stuff!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusPostBattle
lines.text: Sure, you beat me all right.\nBut you'd better watch it! Our LEADER\lWINONA's POKéMON are all business.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
lines.text:
I am WINONA. I am the LEADER of
the FORTREE POKéMON GYM.\pI have become one with BIRD POKéMON
and have soared the skies…\pHowever grueling the battle, we have
triumphed with grace…\pWitness the elegant choreography
of BIRD POKéMON and I!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaDefeat
lines.text: Never before have I seen a TRAINER\ncommand POKéMON with more grace\lthan I…\pIn recognition of your prowess,\nI present to you this GYM BADGE.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedFeatherBadge
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the FEATHER BADGE\nfrom WINONA.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadgeTakeThis
lines.text:
With the FEATHER BADGE, all POKéMON up
to LV 70, even those received through\ltrades, will obey your every command.\pYou will also be able to use
the HM move FLY outside of battle.\pAnd this…
This is a gift from me.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainAerialAce
