lines.text: TM40 contains AERIAL ACE.\pIts speed…\nNo POKéMON should be able to avoid it.\p… … … … … …$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWinona
lines.text: Registered GYM LEADER WINONA\nin the POKéNAV.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostBattle
lines.text: Though I fell to you, I will remain\ndevoted to BIRD POKéMON.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
lines.text: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
lines.text: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM\pWINONA'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
lines.text:
WINONA: We humans can never escape
gravity's pull on the ground.\pBut by striving for excellence,
we have the power to soar!\pYou have scaled the pinnacle as
the reigning CHAMPION.\pPlease, allow me to see your power
at full flight!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchDefeat
lines.text: I failed to reach your height again…$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch
lines.text: WINONA: Even though I have lost,\nthe wings of my heart remain unbroken.\pI can rise and soar again and\nyet again.\pI am convinced of it!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
lines.text:
WINONA: We humans can never escape
gravity's pull on the ground.\pBut by striving for excellence,
we have the power to soar!\pYou have scaled the pinnacle as
the reigning CHAMPION.\pPlease, allow me to see your power
at full flight!\pOh, no… Do you have but one
POKéMON with you?\pPlease return with two POKéMON
at the very least.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWontYou
lines.text:
Wrooooaaar! I need it!
I have to get me a {STR_VAR_1}!\lI'll do anything for it!\p…Uh… Did you hear that?
My shout from the bottom of my heart?\pHaving heard that, you will trade
your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2},\lwon't you?$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_MonYouTakeCare
lines.text: Oh, yeah, right on!\p{STR_VAR_1}, welcome!\n{STR_VAR_2}, you take care!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_ThisIsntAMon
lines.text: Uh, no, I don't think so.\nThat isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWontTradeMe
lines.text: No? You won't trade me?\nEven after I bared my heart to you?$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_GoingToMakeVolbeatStrong
lines.text: I'm going to make VOLBEAT super\nstrong from this moment on!\pI hope you do the same with PLUSLE!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_TradingMemoriesWithOthers
lines.text: Trading POKéMON with others…\pIt's as if you're trading your own\nmemories with other people.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_Zigzagoon
lines.text: ZIGZAGOON: Gumomoh?$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_HiddenPowersArousedByNature
lines.text: People… POKéMON…\pTheir hidden powers are aroused by\nliving in natural environments…$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CoinInWhichHand
lines.text: Let this old woman see if your hidden\npower has awoken…\pI hold a coin in my hand.\pNow, tell me, have I palmed it in\nthe right hand? Or in the left?$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand
lines.text: Oh! Yes, correct!\pWe shall try again.\pIn which hand have I palmed the coin?\nThe right or left?$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand2
lines.text: Oh! Yes, correct!\pWe shall try again.\pIn which hand have I palmed the coin?\nThe right or left?$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_YourHiddenPowerHasAwoken
lines.text: Oh! Splendid!\nYour hidden power has awoken!\pHere, take this and awaken the hidden\npower of your POKéMON.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_ExplainHiddenPower
lines.text: HIDDEN POWER is a move that changes\nwith the POKéMON.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_YouGuessedWrong
lines.text: No, too bad.\nYou guessed wrong.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_MetStevenHadAmazingPokemon
lines.text:
While speaking about POKéDEXES,
I remembered something.\pI met this TRAINER, STEVEN, when
I was searching for rare stones.\pHoo, boy, he had some amazing POKéMON
with him.\pThey weren't just rare, they were
trained to terrifying extremes!\pHe might even be stronger than the
GYM LEADER in this town…$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_OhYouHavePokedex
lines.text: What's that thing you have there?\p… … … … … …\pOh, it's called a POKéDEX?\nIt's really awesome!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_BringsWorldCloserTogether
lines.text: By being together with POKéMON,\npeople make more and more friends.\pAnd that brings the world closer\ntogether. I think it's wonderful!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_GoBirdPokemon
lines.text: There!\nGo, BIRD POKéMON!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_AskedWingullToRunErrand
lines.text: Heheh, I asked my WINGULL to run\nan errand for me.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_WelcomeWingullTakeMentalHerb
lines.text:
Good!
Welcome back, WINGULL!\pHuh? What is this?
What is it holding?\pA MENTAL HERB?
It must have picked it up somewhere.\pBut I'm not a TRAINER, so you can
have it.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_FriendsFarAwayThanksToWingull
lines.text: Thanks to my WINGULL, I have friends\nwho live far away.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_Wingull
lines.text: WINGULL: Pihyoh!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_TreeHousesAreGreat
lines.text: The tree houses of FORTREE are great!\pI think it's the number one town for\nliving together with POKéMON.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_AdaptedToNature
lines.text: POKéMON and people have adapted to\nnature for survival.\pThere's no need to make nature\nconform to the way we want to live.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_Zigzagoon
lines.text: ZIGZAGOON: Bufuu!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SuperRepelBetter
lines.text: SUPER REPEL lasts a long time,\nand it gets the job done.\pIt's much better than an ordinary\nREPEL.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_StockUpOnItems
lines.text: I always stock up on more items than\nI'm sure I'll need.\pYou never know what might happen.\nBetter to be safe than sorry!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_RareCandyMakesMonGrow
lines.text: A RARE CANDY makes a POKéMON grow\nimmediately by one level.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoToSafariZone
lines.text: Listen, kid, are you working\non a POKéDEX?\pHmm… Go to the SAFARI ZONE.\nThat's my suggestion.$

lines.label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerIsNeat
lines.text:
Have you done anything at
the RECORD CORNER?\pIt's pretty neat. It mixes and matches
the records of TRAINERS.\pI don't know quite how it works,
but it's cool. It's exciting, even!$

lines.label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DoYouKnowAboutPokenav
lines.text:
Oh, wow, you have a POKéNAV!
And it's just like mine!\pDo you know about POKéNAV's
MATCH CALL system?\pAccess it, and you can chat with
registered TRAINERS anytime.\pIt also shows you which TRAINERS
want a rematch with you.\pIt's really nifty! Those DEVON guys
sure know what they're doing!$

lines.label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_GetsDarkAheadHereYouGo
lines.text:
Hey, you.
It gets awfully dark ahead.\lIt'll be tough trying to explore.\pThat guy who came by earlier…
STEVEN, I think it was.\pHe knew how to use FLASH, so he ought
to be all right, but…\pWell, for us HIKERS, helping out those
that we meet is our motto.\pHere you go, I'll pass this on to you.$

lines.label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_ExplainFlash
lines.text:
Teach that hidden move FLASH to
a POKéMON and use it.\pIt lights up even the inky darkness
of caves.\pBut, to use it, you need the GYM BADGE
from DEWFORD's POKéMON GYM.$

lines.label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ImStevenLetterForMe
lines.text: My name is STEVEN.\pI'm interested in rare stones,\nso I travel here and there.\pOh?\nA LETTER for me?$

lines.label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ThankYouTakeThis
lines.text:
STEVEN: Okay, thank you.\pYou went through all this trouble to
deliver that. I need to thank you.\pLet me see…
I'll give you this TM.\pIt contains my favorite move,
STEEL WING.$

lines.label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_CouldBecomeChampionLetsRegister
lines.text:
STEVEN: Your POKéMON appear quite
capable.\pIf you keep training, you could even
become the CHAMPION of the POKéMON\lLEAGUE one day. That's what I think.\pI know, since we've gotten to know each
other, let's register one another in\lour POKéNAVS.\p… … … … … …$

lines.label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_RegisteredSteven
lines.text: Registered STEVEN\nin the POKéNAV.$

lines.label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_IveGotToHurryAlong
lines.text: Now, I've got to hurry along.$

lines.label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_OhBagIsFull
lines.text: Oh, your BAG is full…\nThat's too bad, then.$

lines.label: InsideOfTruck_Text_BoxPrintedWithMonLogo
lines.text: The box is printed with a POKéMON logo.\pIt's a POKéMON brand moving and\ndelivery service.$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_EricIntro
lines.text: MT. CHIMNEY's JAGGED PASS…\pNow this is what I've always wanted\nin a mountain.\pThis jagged bumpiness…\nIt rocks my soul!$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_EricDefeat
lines.text: Losing left me bitter!$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_EricPostBattle
lines.text: Yes, I did lose at POKéMON…\pBut, when it comes to the love of\nthe mountains, I have you beat!$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaIntro
lines.text: This place isn't your casual hike.\nIt's not suited for a picnic.$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaDefeat
lines.text: Ohhh, no!\nThe ground is too bumpy…$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostBattle
lines.text: Did you know?\pSome people cleverly ride their\nbicycles up this horribly bumpy pass.$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaRegister
lines.text: Will you ever be back in this area?\nIf you do return, I'd like a rematch.$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchIntro
lines.text: Picnics are fun wherever you go.\nJust like POKéMON!$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchDefeat
lines.text: I only lost because the ground is\ntoo bumpy!$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostRematch
lines.text: I'll forget about losing and just\nenjoy this bumpy hike.$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanIntro
lines.text: JAGGED PASS is hard to walk on.\nIt's a good place for training.$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanDefeat
lines.text: It was all over while we were still\ntrying to find a good footing…$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostBattle
lines.text: If I had an ACRO BIKE, I'd be able to\njump ledges.$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanRegister
lines.text: When I get more used to this bumpiness,\nI'll be sure to win!\pCan you register me in your POKéNAV?$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchIntro
lines.text: I got used to this bumpiness.\nI sing while I climb now.$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchDefeat
lines.text: It's still not easy to battle on this\nbumpy ground…$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostRematch
lines.text: I should get an ACRO BIKE from RYDEL\nin MAUVILLE CITY…$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_GruntIntro
lines.text: Wah!\nWhat are you doing here?\pWhat am I doing in a place like this?\pWhat business is it of yours?$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_GruntDefeat
lines.text: Urrrgh…\pI should've ducked into our HIDEOUT\nright away…$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_GoWhereverYouWant
lines.text: Okay, oh-kay!\nI admit it--you're strong!\pDon't worry about me.\nGo wherever you want!$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_BoulderShakingInResponseToEmblem
lines.text: Oh! This boulder is shaking in response\nto the MAGMA EMBLEM!$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_JulioIntro
lines.text: Aiyeeh! It's awfully scary to shoot\ndown the mountain in one go!$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_JulioDefeat
lines.text: I feel like I'm falling apart…$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_JulioPostBattle
lines.text: My bicycle bounced around so much,\nmy rear end's sore…$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_AutumnIntro
lines.text: I climb this hill every day.\nI have confidence in my strength!$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_AutumnDefeat
lines.text: Hmm…\nWhat went wrong?$

lines.label: JaggedPass_Text_AutumnPostBattle
lines.text: What is that odd rock protrusion\na little up the hill from here?$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayNiceBadgesTakeThis
lines.text:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Long time no see!\pOh? While I visited the hot springs,
you got the LAVARIDGE GYM BADGE.\pYou must have collected
good POKéMON…\lNo, I believe you raised some.\pI guess it would be okay for you to
have this.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
lines.text:
MAY: With those GO-GOGGLES, you'll
have no trouble getting through the\ldesert near ROUTE 111.\pBut, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}…
Challenging GYMS…\pYou're trying hard because you don't
want to lose to me, I bet!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I think I should challenge
your dad in PETALBURG GYM.\pSee you again!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanNiceBadgesTakeThis
lines.text:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, hey, it's been a while.
How's it going?\pHmm…
That's a decent collection of BADGES.\pAll right, then.
You may as well have this.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
lines.text:
BRENDAN: Keep those with you if you're
planning on going into that desert near\lROUTE 111.\pThere should be some POKéMON that
are exclusively desert-dwellers.\lYou might look around for those.\pAs for me…
I'm considering challenging NORMAN,\lthe GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.\pUnlike you, {PLAYER}, your dad looks like
he really is tough.\pSee you around!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt
lines.text:
I have here an EGG.\pI'd hoped to hatch it by covering it in
hot sand by the hot springs.\lBut that doesn't seem to be enough…\pI've heard it would be best if it were
kept together with POKéMON and\lcarried about.\pYou are a TRAINER, yes?
And your POKéMON radiate vitality.\pSo, what say you?
Will you take this EGG to hatch?$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HopeYoullWalkPlentyWithEgg
lines.text: Good! I hope you'll walk plenty with\nthis here EGG!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_ReceivedTheEgg
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the EGG.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_NoRoomForThisEgg
lines.text: Oh? You've too many POKéMON.\nThere's no room for this EGG…$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_AsYouWishThen
lines.text: As you wish, then…\pIf you have a change of heart about\nhatching this EGG, I will be here.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_EverySoOftenEggFoundAtDayCare
lines.text: Every so often, an EGG will be found at\nthe POKéMON DAY CARE.\pOr at least that's how the rumor goes.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsNeverRunDry
lines.text: We draw as much hot water as we need,\nand yet the hot springs never run dry.\pIsn't it magical?\pThese hot springs appear near active\nvolcanoes. Veins of water under the\lground are heated by magma to well up\las hot springs.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_PokemonNippedBackside
lines.text: Being buried in this hot sand is…\nSigh…\pSo warm and heavenly…\pEh? Gyaah! Ouch!\pA POKéMON nipped my backside!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_OhYouLikeHotSprings
lines.text: Oh, you like hot springs, do you?\pThat's surprising for one as young\nas you.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BatheInHotSpringsEveryDay
lines.text: I bathe in the hot springs every day.\pI want to become a beautiful and strong\nGYM LEADER like FLANNERY.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_IfPokemonInHotSprings
lines.text: If people put POKéMON in hot springs,\nit might be seriously strange.\pWhy, it might be an electric bath, or\na bubble bath, or even a lava bath…$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsClaims
lines.text: They're claiming that these hot springs\nare good for calming nervous tension,\lrelieving aching muscles, solving\lromantic problems, and attracting\lmoney…$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_TownSign
lines.text: LAVARIDGE TOWN\p“POKéMON CENTER HOT SPRINGS\nAn excellent place for relaxing!”$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_GymSign
lines.text: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: FLANNERY\l“One with a fiery passion that burns!”$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HerbShopSign
lines.text: POKéMON HERB SHOP\n“Bitter taste--better cure!”$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
lines.text:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pLAVARIDGE's GYM LEADER FLANNERY
uses FIRE-type POKéMON.\pHer passion for POKéMON burns stronger
and hotter than a volcano.\pDon't get too close to her--you'll burn!
Hose her down with water and then\lgo for it!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
lines.text: Yow! That was a scorching-hot battle!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeIntro
lines.text: Owowowowow!\nYikes, it's hot!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeDefeat
lines.text: I'm blinded by sweat in my eyes…$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColePostBattle
lines.text: Being buried in hot sand promotes\ncirculation.\pIt's effective for healing pain in\nyour joints.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleIntro
lines.text: I'm trying to relieve my stress.\nDon't come along and stress me out!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleDefeat
lines.text: I hope FLANNERY flames you good!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxlePostBattle
lines.text: Haaah… Whew…\pIf you spend too much time buried in\nhot sand, it tuckers you out…$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganIntro
lines.text: You must be getting tired by now.\nYou'd like to rest in the hot sand,\lwouldn't you?\pBut you should know that maintaining\nyour willpower is an important ability\lfor all TRAINERS.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganDefeat
lines.text: Play with fire, and be burned…$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganPostBattle
lines.text: Your skill is real…\nBut our LEADER FLANNERY is strong.\pIf you don't watch yourself, you'll be\nburned seriously.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldIntro
lines.text: Can your POKéMON withstand\n392-degree heat?$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldDefeat
lines.text: It didn't burn hotly enough…$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldPostBattle
lines.text: The temperature of magma is\n392 degrees.\pYour POKéMON beat me, so they should\neasily survive in magma.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DanielleIntro
lines.text: Um…\nOkay, I'll battle with you.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DanielleDefeat
lines.text: Oh, but you're too strong.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DaniellePostBattle
lines.text: I'm going to be a pretty and strong\nTRAINER just like FLANNERY.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JaceIntro
lines.text: Come on, get with it!\nLet's go before my feelings cool!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JaceDefeat
lines.text: It's so hot, and yet my heart is\nclutched by ice…$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JacePostBattle
lines.text: The way the battling spirit burns\nwithin you, you may stand a chance\lagainst our LEADER.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffIntro
lines.text: See how the flames blaze wildly?\nThey flare in anticipation of my win!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffDefeat
lines.text: Something didn't go right.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffPostBattle
lines.text: Well, so what? I say so what?\nI can walk on hot coals barefoot!\p…Don't even think about trying it!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliIntro
lines.text: As much as I love mountains,\nI especially love volcanoes.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliDefeat
lines.text: Well, it seems to me I lost without\never being in control.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliPostBattle
lines.text: I stay here because I became a fan\nof FLANNERY's power.\pHehehehe.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
lines.text:
Welcome… No, wait.\pPuny TRAINER, how good to see you've
made it here!\pI have been entrusted with the…
No, wait.\pI am FLANNERY, and I'm the GYM
LEADER here!\pUh…
Dare not underestimate me, though\lI have been LEADER only a short time!\pWith skills inherited from my grand-
father, I shall, uh…demonstrate the\lhot moves we have honed on this land!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat
lines.text:
Oh…
I guess I was trying too hard…\pI… I've only recently become
a GYM LEADER.\pI tried too hard to be someone
I'm not.\pI have to do things my natural way. If
I don't, my POKéMON will be confused.\pThanks for teaching me that.
For that, you deserve this.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedHeatBadge
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the HEAT BADGE\nfrom FLANNERY.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainHeatBadgeTakeThis
lines.text:
If you have a HEAT BADGE, all POKéMON
up to Level 50, even those you get in\ltrades from other people, will obey\lyou completely.\pAnd, it lets POKéMON use the HM move
STRENGTH outside of battle.\pThis is a token of my appreciation.
Don't be shy about taking it!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainOverheat
lines.text: That TM50 contains OVERHEAT.\pThat move inflicts serious damage on\nthe opponent.\pBut it also sharply cuts the SP. ATK\nof the POKéMON using it. It might not\lbe suitable for longer battles.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredFlannery
lines.text: Registered GYM LEADER FLANNERY\nin the POKéNAV.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostBattle
lines.text: Your power reminds me of someone…\pOh! I know! You battle like NORMAN,\nthe GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatue
lines.text: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
lines.text: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM\pFLANNERY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPreRematch
lines.text:
FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going
to deflate me.\pI love POKéMON.
I love to battle.\lAnd… I love this GYM!\pLet's exchange superhot moves
in another battle!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchDefeat
lines.text: Whew!\nOn the verge of eruption!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostRematch
lines.text:
FLANNERY: I lost the match,
but I'm completely satisfied.\pIt's not often I get to enjoy a battle
this heated.\pLet's have another one like this
again sometime!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchNeedTwoMons
lines.text:
FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going
to deflate me.\pI love POKéMON.
I love to battle.\lAnd… I love this GYM!\pLet's exchange superhot moves
in another battle!\pOh, wait. Do you only have one POKéMON
that can battle?\pI hate to say this, but when you come
see me, bring at least two POKéMON.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_WelcomeToHerbShop
lines.text: Welcome to the HERB SHOP, home of\neffective and inexpensive medicine!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_YouveComeToLookAtHerbalMedicine
lines.text: You've come to look at herbal medicine\nin LAVARIDGE?\pThat's rather commendable.\pI like you! Take this!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_ExplainCharcoal
lines.text:
That CHARCOAL I gave you, it's used
for making herbal medicine.\pIt also does wonders when held by
a POKéMON.\pIt intensifies the power of FIRE-type
moves.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_HerbalMedicineWorksButMonWillDislike
lines.text: Herbal medicine works impressively well.\nBut your POKéMON will dislike you for it.\lIt must be horribly bitter!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_House_Text_WifeWarmingEggInHotSprings
lines.text: My wife's warming an EGG in the hot\nsprings. This is what she told me.\pShe left two POKéMON with the DAY CARE.\nAnd they discovered that EGG!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_House_Text_Zigzagoon
lines.text: ZIGZAGOON: Pshoo!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_XSpeedFirstStrike
lines.text: Use X SPEED to add to a POKéMON's\nSPEED in battle.\pThat will help it get in the first\nstrike--a decided advantage!$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_LocalSpecialtyOnMtChimney
lines.text: On MT. CHIMNEY's peak, there's a local\nspecialty that you can buy only there.\pGive it to a POKéMON--it will be elated.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersPokemonSpendTimeTogether
lines.text: I think POKéMON get closer to their\nTRAINERS if they spend time together.\pThe longer the better.\nThat's what I think.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HotSpringCanInvigorate
lines.text: It's sort of magical how just sitting\nin a hot-spring pool can invigorate.\pI wish I could let my POKéMON\nsoak, too.$

lines.label: LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersShouldRestToo
lines.text: Hohoho! Hey, kid, you can reach\nthe hot springs from here.\pIf POKéMON are getting rest, so too\nshould their TRAINERS.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayShoppingLetsBattle
lines.text:
MAY: Oh, hey?
{PLAYER}{KUN}, are you shopping, too?\pI bought a whole bunch of DOLLS and
POSTERS.\pOf course, I've also caught a lot of
POKéMON, and I'm raising them\lproperly, too.\pActually, I'm more worried if you're
raising POKéMON properly, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI'll battle with you, so you can show
me your POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayNotRaisingPokemon
lines.text: MAY: Oh, why? {PLAYER}{KUN}, haven't you\nbeen raising your POKéMON?\pThat's not a very good showing as a\nTRAINER…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayBattleMe
lines.text: MAY: Come on, battle with me, so I can\ncheck out your POKéMON!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayWontBeBeaten
lines.text: MAY: The POKéMON I raised won't be\nbeaten by your POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayDefeat
lines.text: … … … … … … … …\pI remember the battle I had with you,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, on ROUTE 103.\pThat battle helped you become this\nstrong, {PLAYER}{KUN}, didn't it?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayGoingBackToLittleroot
lines.text: MAY: I'm thinking of going back to\nLITTLEROOT soon.\pI've caught a decent group of POKéMON,\nand my POKéDEX is coming along, so\lI'm going home to show my dad.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToCollectBadges
lines.text: {PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?\pCollect all the GYM BADGES and take\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\pWell, while you're collecting BADGES,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm going to work on my\lPOKéDEX. I'll complete it before you!\pSee you!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToPokemonLeague
lines.text:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?\pAre you taking the POKéMON LEAGUE
challenge?\pOr, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?\pI might've lost to you in battling,
but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you!\pSee you!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToBattleFrontier
lines.text:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?\pAre you taking the BATTLE FRONTIER
challenge?\pOr, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?\pI might've lost to you in battling,
but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you!\pSee you!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanShoppingLetsBattle
lines.text: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, it's {PLAYER}.\pI'm running an errand for my dad.\nNo, I'm not buying any DOLLS.\pAnyways, it's been a while.\pWant to have a battle to see who's been\nraising POKéMON better?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidence
lines.text: BRENDAN: Oh, what's the matter?\nDon't have the confidence?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanBattleMe
lines.text: BRENDAN: Want to battle to see who's\nbeen raising POKéMON better?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanWontBeBeaten
lines.text: BRENDAN: Aww, but you know I'm not\ngoing to lose to no {PLAYER}.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanDefeat
lines.text: Humph…\nYou've done a lot of raising.\pThat stings a bit--I had a head start\non you as a TRAINER…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanGoingBackToLittleroot
lines.text: BRENDAN: I…\nI plan on going home to LITTLEROOT.\pYou know I'm helping out my dad on his\nPOKéDEX. It's coming together pretty\ldecently, so I should go show him.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToCollectBadges
lines.text: {PLAYER}, what are you going to do?\pCollect all the GYM BADGES and take\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\pMaybe I'll do that, too…\pWell, anyway, hang in there!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToPokemonLeague
lines.text: {PLAYER}, what are you going to do?\pSince you're that strong, are you\ntaking the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\pHeh, even me--if I trained my POKéMON\na bit more, I should be stronger than\lyou, {PLAYER}.\pWell, anyway, hang in there!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToBattleFrontier
lines.text:
{PLAYER}, what are you going to do?\pAre you taking the BATTLE FRONTIER
challenge?\pOr, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?\pSince you're that strong, you should
consider the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pHeh, if I train my POKéMON a bit more,
I'll get stronger than you, {PLAYER}.\pMaybe I should go to the BATTLE
FRONTIER.\pWell, anyway, hang in there!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MovedLootIntoHideoutToday
lines.text: Fufufu…\pWe moved more loot into our secret\nHIDEOUT today…\pWh-who are you?!\nI was just talking to myself!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_ChanceToDoBigThings
lines.text:
I'm just a GRUNT, so I don't know what
the BOSS is thinking…\pBut being on TEAM AQUA, I know I'll get
the chance to do big things!\pWh-who are you?!
I was just talking to myself!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_DontGoNearCaveInCove
lines.text: Hey, you!\pDon't go near the cave in the cove!\pWhy? You don't need a reason why!\nI'm an adult, so you just listen to me!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_IfWorldBecomesOurs
lines.text: If this whole wide world becomes ours,\nTEAM AQUA's, it will be a happier\lplace for POKéMON, too.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_WailmerLeapOutOfWater
lines.text: There! WAILMER!\nLeap out of the water now!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_GetLostMessingUpTraining
lines.text: Hunh? What do you want?\pYou're messing up our training,\nso can you, like, get lost?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallInTown
lines.text: There's a POKéMON CONTEST HALL\nright in this here town. \pThat means well-raised POKéMON will\ncome from all over the country.\pMy heart swells with excitement!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_StrangeCaveInCove
lines.text: Have you seen that strange cave in\nthe cove at the edge of town?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_GoingToMoveDeleterForHMs
lines.text: I'm going to teach my POKéMON some new\nmoves for entering a CONTEST.\pSo, I'm going to see the MOVE DELETER\nand make it forget HM moves.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImFromKanto
lines.text: I came from KANTO.\pThe HOENN region is beautiful with\nall its water and verdant nature.\pHunh? Wait a second…\pCould there be rare POKéMON that live\nonly in this area?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaBeenTrainingWailmer
lines.text: TEAM AQUA's been training their\nWAILMER in the cove.\pWe SAILORS can't get our boats out\nto sea with them in the way!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_SomeonePuntedTeamAquaOut
lines.text: Ahoy, did you know?\pSomeone punted TEAM AQUA out of\nthe way for us!\pThat got the WAILMER out of the cove,\nso we can get our boats out again.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_SomeoneStoleMyPokemon
lines.text: I was taking a relaxing snooze at the\nseaside inn to the sound of waves…\pWhen someone stole my POKéMON!\pWho's the abductor?\nTEAM AQUA? Is it TEAM AQUA?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MissingPokemonCameBack
lines.text: My missing POKéMON…\nIt came back without me noticing!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_ImArtDealer
lines.text: I'm an ART DEALER.\pI am a buyer and seller of fine art,\nespecially paintings.\pI've heard that the MUSEUM here has\nmagnificent works on exhibit…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_SeaRemainsForeverYoung
lines.text: Even as we grow old and wrinkled,\nthe sea remains forever young with\lthe vivid brilliance of life…\pFwohoho fwohohohoho…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_SixtyYearsAgoHusbandProposed
lines.text: It was sixty years ago that my husband\nproposed to me here.\lThe sea remains as beautiful as ever.\pMufufufu mufufufufufu…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaRenovatedCavern
lines.text:
Hm, you know of the peculiar cavern
in this cove?\pThat had been a natural formation,
but then that TEAM AQUA lot came\lalong and made their renovations.\pThey call themselves
the “nature-loving TEAM AQUA”!\pBut what they do and what they say
don't match at all!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaLotGoneForGood
lines.text: That cave in the cove…\pI didn't notice it right away,\nbut it's completely empty now.\pThat TEAM AQUA lot, they must\nhave gone away for good.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_CitySign
lines.text: LILYCOVE CITY\p“Where the land ends and the\nsea begins.”$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallSign
lines.text: POKéMON CONTEST HALL\n“The gathering place for TRAINERS!”$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MotelSign
lines.text: COVE LILY MOTEL\p“Remember us as COVE LILY of\nLILYCOVE.”$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSign
lines.text: LILYCOVE MUSEUM\p“POKéMON Masterpiece Collection\non exhibit!”$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSignPlayersExhibit
lines.text: LILYCOVE MUSEUM\p“{PLAYER}'s POKéMON Collection\non exhibit!”$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSignUnderConstruction
lines.text: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR\p“The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under\nconstruction in SLATEPORT CITY.\p“Service is scheduled to begin\nshortly.”$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSign
lines.text: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR\p“Enjoy a delightful cruise on\nthe ferry S.S. TIDAL.”$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign
lines.text: POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB\pThe names of TRAINERS are scribbled\nall over the sign…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_DepartmentStoreSign
lines.text: LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE\p“Overflowing with great merchandise\nand excitement!\p“A great place to find that something\nyou need!”$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_MoveDeletersHouseSign
lines.text: MOVE DELETER'S HOUSE\p“Unwanted POKéMON moves deleted.”$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_DoYouKnowAboutBerryBlender
lines.text: Do you know about the machine\nBERRY BLENDER?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_FasterSpinBetterPokeblocks
lines.text: People have to work together to get it\nto spin faster.\pThe faster you can make it spin, the\nbetter {POKEBLOCK}S you can get, I've heard.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_ExplainBerryBlender
lines.text: It's used for making a kind of candy\ncalled a {POKEBLOCK}.\pIf you give a good {POKEBLOCK} to a POKéMON,\nits condition will improve by a lot.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_HeardTowerCalledSkyPillar
lines.text: I heard there's a tower somewhere out\non the sea routes.\pIt's called the SKY PILLAR, I hear.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_SawTallTowerOnRoute131
lines.text: I saw this tall tower somewhere\naround ROUTE 131.\pCould that possibly be…?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_JustArrivedAndSawRarePokemon
lines.text:
We just arrived here on our
honeymoon vacation.\pWe happened to see a DRAGON-type
POKéMON flying way up in the sky.\pDo cool POKéMON like that live in
the HOENN region?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_HoneymoonVowToSeeRarePokemon
lines.text: On our honeymoon, we vowed to see as\nmany rare POKéMON as we can.\pSo we were delighted to see a rare\nPOKéMON as soon as we arrived.\pI mean, we are totally happy!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest
lines.text: This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST\nhere before.\pWell, guess what? Today, I made it\nwin a SMARTNESS CONTEST!\pMy abilities scare even me…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests
lines.text:
I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS,
so I'm seeing how things work.\pIf you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST,
cool moves go over as appeals.\pBut smart moves and cute moves
don't go over well, for instance.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonEarlierHadPokeblocks
lines.text: That young man who won earlier had\na whole bunch of different {POKEBLOCK}S.\pCan you win if you had that many\nof those things?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPlaceHumongous
lines.text: Whoa, isn't this place humongous!\pThe tension in the air… It's not\nlike a CONTEST hall in the sticks.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBestSmartAppeal
lines.text: MC: Okay, SMART POKéMON and their\nTRAINERS, are you ready?!\pGive it your best showing!\nLet's appeal!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjoyingThisContest
lines.text: JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST?\pCome back with three friends, and\nall of you may enter a CONTEST!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest
lines.text:
Ayayayay…
I entered the wrong CONTEST.\pI entered this tough POKéMON in
the SMARTNESS CONTEST…\pCome on, wow them with a smart-looking
ROCK SMASH.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart
lines.text: I've spent many a year, and all my\nwisdom besides, raising this POKéMON\lto be smart.\pIt won't be easily bested by some\nyoung pup's POKéMON.\pMy dear wife, are you seeing this?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPullsSmartMoveNext
lines.text: There it is!\pIf my POKéMON pulls a smart move next,\nthe audience's excitement will peak!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontAppreciateCuteLeechLife
lines.text: Oh, dear, no!\pMy darling ZUBAT's LEECH LIFE is so\ncute I kept using it over and over!\pBut these mean people don't appreciate\nit at all!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_YoureBeautifulGrandpa
lines.text: Kiyaaah! You're beautiful, Grandpa!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToUseDifferentMoves
lines.text: Even when TRAINERS enter the same\nkind of POKéMON, they all seem to use\ldifferent moves for appeals.\pIt's just like the way people have\ndifferent styles for battling.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonSmarterThanTrainers
lines.text: I think the POKéMON look smarter\nthan their TRAINERS. By a lot.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveSmartnessContests
lines.text: When all's said and done, I still love\nSMARTNESS CONTESTS.\pThat intellectual green color…\nIt's so… So… Cool.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnteringBeautyContest
lines.text: MC: Are you entering the BEAUTY\nCONTEST, too? Good luck!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokemonPristineBeauty
lines.text: JUDGE: Ah, every POKéMON here is\na model of pristine beauty!\pWhy, I almost forgot to score them!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBeGluedToMyBeauty
lines.text: A POKéMON this beautiful…\nThere isn't another one like it.\pEveryone's eyes will be glued to\nmy beauty.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
lines.text: Waaaah!\pI brushed and groomed my POKéMON\ncarefully for this CONTEST…\pBut I overdid it…\nMy POKéMON's coat turned all scraggly…\pWhat should I do?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontSeeAuroraBeam
lines.text: This AURORA BEAM is so dazzling,\nthe JUDGE won't be able to see it.\pUh, wait a second…\nThat'll be meaningless, then!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLooksLikeYoungerMe
lines.text: This pretty POKéMON looks just like\nme when I was younger.\pRight when I said that, my husband\nspewed the coffee he was drinking.\pDid I say something funny?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WinBeautyContestMakesMeHappy
lines.text: You know, if I win at a BEAUTY\nCONTEST, sure it makes me\lhappy. More than usual, anyway.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAllThosePrettyPokemon
lines.text: Wahahahah!\pWill you take a gander at all those\npretty POKéMON!\lI just love this sort of glitz!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnBeautyAlone
lines.text: You can't always win on just beauty\nalone.\pYou have to groom your POKéMON so\nit's nice and glossy like mine.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddleOfContest
lines.text: MC: Uh-oh! Hello!\nWe're in the middle of a CONTEST!\pPlease enter at our registration\ncounter and come out, okay?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmingCuteAppeals
lines.text: JUDGE: Oh, such charming and cute\nappeals!\pOh, my goodness! What a perfectly\nadorable WATER SPORT appeal!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyAzurillWasDistracted
lines.text: Oh, no… My sweet AZURILL was\ndistracted by another POKéMON.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_NeverWonBattleButContest
lines.text: My POKéMON has never won in a battle,\nbut put it in a CONTEST and look out!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDanceIsMarvel
lines.text: My POKéMON's PETAL DANCE is a marvel\nof elegance.\pI won't let anyone disturb its\nperformance.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppealSoMuchCuter
lines.text: Everyone's POKéMON are very cute.\pHowever, if my POKéMON were to make\na cute appeal…\pI'm sure that it would be so much \ncuter than the others.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyChildIsInContest
lines.text: My child is in this CONTEST.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ComeOnDear
lines.text: Come on, dear. Go for it!\nYour POKéMON is the best!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ThatGirlThereIsCutest
lines.text: I think that girl over there is\nthe cutest of the lot.\pWhat's that? They're judging\nPOKéMON by their looks?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WantCuteMonOfMyOwn
lines.text: Ohh, seeing all these cute POKéMON,\nthey make we want to get my own!\pI'm going to go catch some!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_BeautyContestStage
lines.text: BEAUTY CONTEST STAGE\nBE ALLURED BY BEAUTIFUL POKéMON!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CuteContestStage
lines.text: CUTENESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE CHARMED BY CUTE POKéMON!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SmartContestStage
lines.text: SMARTNESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE IMPRESSED BY SMART POKéMON!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LadyGaveMePokeblockCase
lines.text: Yippee!\pThe lady at the reception counter\ngave me a case for {POKEBLOCK}S!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MakePokeblocksDifferentBerries
lines.text: Make {POKEBLOCK}S and put them in there.\pWhen you make a {POKEBLOCK}, everyone\nhas to put in a different BERRY.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourPokemonSpurredMeToPaint
lines.text: Congratulations!\pI did a painting of your POKéMON to\ncommemorate its victory…\pWell, your POKéMON's appeals were\nso fantastic, it spurred me into\lpainting better than I usually do.\lLook, see?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITakePaintingToMuseum
lines.text:
What do you think? I'm confident in
what I've done, but do you like it?\pA work of this caliber, it wouldn't look
out of place in an art museum.\pHuh? An art museum really is looking
for paintings?\pDo you think I should take this there?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePaintingToMuseum
lines.text:
What, really? Then, sure, I will take
this painting there right now.\pI'll give it a proper title, too.\pI hope they'll like it and consider
exhibiting this.\pPlease check if they did accept this.
Thank you!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeMementoOfPainting
lines.text: Oh, that's right!\pAs a memento of me painting your\nPOKéMON, please take this.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ReceivedARibbon
lines.text: {PLAYER} received a RIBBON.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PutTheRibbonOnMon
lines.text: {PLAYER} put the RIBBON on\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_OkaySeeYou
lines.text: Okay, see you!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeHomeButIdLikeToTakeToMuseum
lines.text: Oh… Then, I guess I'll just take\nthis home with me…\pBut, you know, I would like to take\nthis to the art museum… Okay?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_FineThatsTheWayItIs
lines.text: Oh, fine, that's the way it is.\nI will hang this in my own house.\pI'll just have to try harder next time.\nWell, be seeing you.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MasterRankHereICome
lines.text: Hoo, boy… Master Rank CONTESTS,\nhere I come.\pThe world will know that my dearest\nPOKéMON is the cutest being in all\lexistence. The time has come!\lUheheheh.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WholeVarietyOfPokemonHere
lines.text: You can see a whole variety of\nPOKéMON here.\pThat's why I make this place a regular\npart of my daily stroll.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestFeastForEyes
lines.text: Wow, coming out to a CONTEST is\na feast for these eyes!\pWould you look at all the POKéMON\nthat just scream to be painted?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ToughContestIsExtreme
lines.text: The TOUGHNESS CONTEST is like\nextreme, man!\pThose muscular appeals…\nCascading sweat… I swoon!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LavishedCareOnMon
lines.text: Day in and day out, I lavished my care\non this POKéMON.\pIts condition is peaking.\nToday, victory is mine!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MadePokeblocksWithFamily
lines.text: I made {POKEBLOCK}S with Mom, Dad, and\nBig Sister. They turned out great!\pI bet you can make smoother, better\n{POKEBLOCK}S if you have more people.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_GuestsDoubledByMascot
lines.text:
Hm, so they doubled the guests by
using POKéMON as attractions?\pHm, well, maybe I should make a cute
POKéMON our inn's mascot.\pI wonder if that will attract more
guests to stay with us?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_NoGuestsWithTeamAqua
lines.text: Oh, sorry, sorry!\nI was too involved in watching TV!\pSince that TEAM AQUA came to town,\nthe tourists have been staying away.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_CantSeeTheTV
lines.text: Hey, down in front!\nI can't see the TV!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_MonFoundLostItem
lines.text:
Amazing! You're telling me a POKéMON
found someone's lost item?\pThat's something. If we had some smart
POKéMON like that…\pWe could recover anything that our
guests mislaid…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HeardAquaHideoutBusted
lines.text:
Oh, sorry, sorry!
I was too involved in watching TV!\pI heard that someone busted
the TEAM AQUA HIDEOUT.\pThanks to that, we just booked
a reservation from a big group.\pIt was a company called… Uh…
GAME something…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HouseSittingMonCaughtBurglar
lines.text:
Amazing! A house-sitting POKéMON
caught a burglar?\pThat's something. If we had a tough
POKéMON as a security guard…\pWe would be able to provide our guests
with greater safety.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_BetterGetWorkingOnGuestsDinner
lines.text:
Oh, sorry, sorry!
I was too involved in watching TV.\pOh, yes. A big group of guests arrived
a little while ago.\pThey booked in as GAME FREAK,
so I guess they must make games.\pUh-oh, I'd better get working on
their dinner!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ShowMeCompletedDex
lines.text:
I'm the GAME DESIGNER.\pOh, is that right?
You're working on a POKéDEX?\pIt's tough trying to complete it,
but don't give up.\pIf you do complete it, please come
show me.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_FilledPokedexGiveYouThis
lines.text:
Wow! That's awesome!
Yep, it's totally awesome!\pThis POKéDEX is completely filled!
You really must love POKéMON!\pI'm so impressed!\pLet me give you something in
recognition of your feat!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImTheProgrammer
lines.text: Me? You're talking to me?\nI'm the PROGRAMMER.\pI wonder what the SLOTS are\nlike here.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImTheGraphicArtist
lines.text: I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST! Aren't the\nPOKéMON of HOENN interesting?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_GirlsAreCute
lines.text: The girl TUBERS, they're cute, hey?\nTo battle against a cute TUBER…\pWhoop, it's so awesome!\pAnd the TWINS! Aren't they cute?\nA 2-on-2 battle with TWINS…\pWhoop, it's unbearably fun!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SeaBreezeTicklesHeart
lines.text: The sea breeze tickles my heart.\nIt feels wonderful here!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_NeverLeaveWithoutGameBoy
lines.text: You never know when and where\npeople will challenge you.\pThat's why I never leave home without\nmy GAME BOY ADVANCE.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SnoozingPreferBattles
lines.text:
SCOTT: … … … … …
… … … … … Zzz…\p… … … … … Huh?!
Oh, sorry, sorry! I was snoozing!\pI came to check out this POKéMON
CONTEST thing.\pI have to admit, it does look quite
entertaining, but…\pConsider me a purist--I prefer
battles and tough TRAINERS.\pBut that's just me.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I hope you'll enjoy everything
like the GYMS, CONTESTS, BATTLE TENT,\lthe whole works!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ContestsDoTakeStrategy
lines.text: SCOTT: I think it does take strategy\nto win a CONTEST.\pDevising CONTEST strategies is one way\nof becoming a better TRAINER, I'd say.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_SetDatesForClearOutSales
lines.text: Don't they have set dates for their\nclear-out sales?\pI watch TV, but they never show any\ncommercials.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_BeenWaitingForClearOutSale
lines.text: Yes! I've been waiting a long time for\nthis clear-out sale.\pThey have items that you can only get\nhere. I'm going to load up, that I am!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_BoneDryThirsty
lines.text: Ohh… I'm bone-dry thirsty!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_WhichDrinkWouldYouLike
lines.text: It's a VENDING MACHINE.\nWhich drink would you like?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_CanOfDrinkDroppedDown
lines.text: Clang!\pA can of {STR_VAR_1} dropped down.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_ExtraCanOfDrinkDroppedDown
lines.text: Clang!\pScore! An extra can of {STR_VAR_1}\ndropped down!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_NotEnoughMoney
lines.text: Not enough money…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_DecidedAgainstBuyingDrink
lines.text: Decided against buying a drink.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WelcomeToDeptStore
lines.text: Welcome to LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_IBuyAllSortsOfThings
lines.text: Whenever I come to the DEPARTMENT\nSTORE, I always end up buying all sorts\lof things because it's so fun.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_MomBuyingMeFurniture
lines.text: Today, my mom is going to buy me some\nnice furniture.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_BuyingSomethingForAzumarill
lines.text: I'm buying something for my AZUMARILL\nas a reward for winning a CONTEST.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Azumarill
lines.text: AZUMARILL: Maririroo!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
lines.text: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER\n    LOTTERY CORNER\p2F: TRAINER'S ZONE\p3F: BATTLE COLLECTION\p4F: TM CORNER\p5F: POKé DOLL FLOOR\pROOFTOP: ROOFTOP PLAZA$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
lines.text:
Wireless Communication is a
lot of fun, isn't it?\pI think it lets you do things that
weren't possible before.\pFor instance, you can now trade
with people you couldn't before.\pI think it's going to be exciting!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_SpreadWordAboutWirelessComm
lines.text: I want to spread the word about how\nfun Wireless Communication can be.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_LearnToUseItemsProperly
lines.text: Learn to use items properly.\nThat's basic, really.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_GoodGiftForHusband
lines.text: My husband is waiting at home.\nWhat would make a good gift for him?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_StockUpOnItems
lines.text: I'm leaving on a long journey soon.\nI need to stock up on items.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_ItemsBestForTougheningPokemon
lines.text: For quickly toughening up POKéMON,\nitems are the best.\pPROTEIN boosts ATTACK,\nand CALCIUM raises SP. ATK.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_WantMoreEndurance
lines.text: I want my POKéMON to have more\nendurance.\pI'm trying to decide whether to raise\nDEFENSE with IRON, or SP. DEF with ZINC.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_GaveCarbosToSpeedUpMon
lines.text: I gave a CARBOS to my POKéMON,\nand its SPEED went up.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_AttackOrDefenseTM
lines.text: Hmm…\pAn attacking move…\nOr a defensive move…\pIt's no easy matter to decide which TM\nmoves should be taught to POKéMON…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_FiftyDifferentTMs
lines.text: There are so many different kinds of\nTM moves.\pA catalog I read said there are fifty\ndifferent kinds.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_PokemonOnlyHaveFourMoves
lines.text: I'd like to get all the different TMs,\nbut a POKéMON learns only four moves.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_PlaceFullOfCuteDolls
lines.text: This place is full of cute DOLLS.\pI should buy some for me, instead of\njust for my children.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_GettingDollInsteadOfPokemon
lines.text: I'm not big enough to raise POKéMON,\nso I'm getting a cute DOLL instead.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_SellManyCuteMatsHere
lines.text: They sell many cute MATS here.\pI wonder which one I should get?\nMaybe I'll buy them all…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_ClosedRooftopForWeather
lines.text: I think they closed the rooftop\nbecause the weather is wild today.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FerryUnavailable
lines.text: I beg your pardon?\nYou're looking for a ship?\pI'm sorry, the ferry service isn't\navailable at present…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
lines.text: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_NoTicket
lines.text: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…\pI'm terribly sorry.\pYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FlashTicketWhereTo
lines.text: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime
lines.text: Please sail with us another time!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SlateportItIs
lines.text: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_BattleFrontierItIs
lines.text: BATTLE FRONTIER it is, then!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoard
lines.text: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
lines.text: Then, where would you like to go?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryUnavailable
lines.text: Until they finish making the ferry,\nwe sailors have nothing to do…\pI wish they'd get a move on, the folks\nat the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryAvailable
lines.text: The ferry S.S. TIDAL is finally in\noperation.\pThe folks at the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT\nmust've worked extra hard.\pWell, it's my turn to get busy now!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartnersNotTools
lines.text: POKéMON are partners to people.\nThey aren't our tools.\pUnfortunately, there are some people\nwho fail to understand that…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_Kecleon
lines.text: KECLEON: Ruroro?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_NotAwakeYetHaveThis
lines.text: Huh? What? What's that?\pI'm not near awake yet…\nYou can have this…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_SleepIsEssential
lines.text: Yawn…\pSleep is essential for good health…\nSleep and regain health…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LearnFromMasterOfPokeblocks
lines.text:
Oh, my, my! Are you traveling alone?
But you're so young! Good for you!\pI'm sure my kids could learn a thing
or two from you!\pMe? I'm a master of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pIf I get serious just a little, why,
I can concoct great {POKEBLOCK}S.\pWould you like to learn from me,
a master of {POKEBLOCK}S?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_OhAreYouSure
lines.text: Oh? Are you sure?\pYou shouldn't always try to do\neverything by yourself, dear!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
lines.text:
Oh, good! You're a smart soul!
This is a bit long, so listen up!\pAre you ready?\pIf you look at {POKEBLOCK}S, you should see
that they are rated on how they feel.\pThe lower the feel rating,
the better it is. Don't forget this!\pA good {POKEBLOCK} has a low feel
rating and a high level.\pA POKéMON can eat more good
{POKEBLOCK}S than ordinary ones, too.\pAnd this is important.\pIf you want to make smooth {POKEBLOCK}S,
use different kinds of BERRIES.\pDon't be stingy--the kinds of BERRIES
affect the smoothness of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pAnd another thing.\pThe more people blending BERRIES,
the smoother the {POKEBLOCK}S.\pThat's why you should talk to other
people and make {POKEBLOCK}S together.\pThat's about all you need to know to
make good {POKEBLOCK}S.\pIf everyone had POKéMON they love,
smooth {POKEBLOCK}S, and a loving family,\lthe world would be a happier place.\pDon't give up, dear!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_HappyToHaveQuadruplets
lines.text: When my wife gave birth to quadruplets,\nyou bet I was shocked.\pBut, now, seeing them play together,\nit makes me happy.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToWinMultiBattles
lines.text: We're having MULTI BATTLES, but I know\nI'm going to win.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LikeMixingAtRecordCorner
lines.text: We like mixing stuff at\nthe RECORD CORNER.\pBut what gets mixed up?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_MakePokeblocksWithBerryBlender
lines.text: We're going to make super {POKEBLOCK}S\nwith a BERRY BLENDER!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToEnterContest
lines.text: I want to brag about how tough my\nPOKéMON is, so we're going to enter\la CONTEST together.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_House4_Text_MysteriesAtBottomOfSea
lines.text: This planet's biggest mysteries are\nat the bottom of the sea.\pSomebody said that, but I don't know…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_House4_Text_UnderwaterTrenchMossdeepSootopolis
lines.text: There's a deep underwater trench\nbetween MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.\pThat's what someone told me, anyway.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WelcomeToLilycoveMuseum
lines.text: Welcome to LILYCOVE MUSEUM.\pPlease take the time to enjoy our\ncollection of fantastic artwork\lfeaturing POKéMON.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCuratorHaveYouViewedOurPaintings
lines.text:
I'm the CURATOR of this MUSEUM of
fine arts.\pIt's heartening to see someone so
young as you in our MUSEUM.\pHave you viewed our collection of
paintings already?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_NotDisturbYouTakeYourTime
lines.text: Ah, then let me not disturb you.\nPlease, do take your time.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HaveYouAnInterestInPaintings
lines.text: Oh? I do believe that you seem to\nbe a POKéMON TRAINER.\pHave you an interest in paintings,\ntoo?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HonoredYoudVisitInSpiteOfThat
lines.text: I see…\pI'm honored that you would visit\nus in spite of that.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ExcellentCanYouComeWithMe
lines.text: Ah, excellent!\nYou do like paintings!\pThen, may I ask you to come with me?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_VeryOldPainting
lines.text: It's a very old painting.\nThe paint is peeling here and there.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_OddLandscapeFantasticScenery
lines.text: It's an odd landscape with bizarre\nand fantastic scenery.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBeautifulWoman
lines.text: It's a painting of a beautiful, smiling\nwoman with a POKéMON on her lap.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfLegendaryPokemon
lines.text: It's a painting of a legendary POKéMON\nfrom long ago.\pThe artist painted this from\nimagination.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfGrassPokemon
lines.text: It's a painting of GRASS POKéMON\nswaying in a breeze.\pThey appear to be enjoying the wind's\ngentle caress.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBerries
lines.text: It's a delicious-looking painting\nof BERRIES.\pThis painting could make you hungry!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_Text_BirdPokemonSculptureReplica
lines.text: It's a replica of a famous sculpture.\pIt depicts an ancient BIRD POKéMON.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_BigPokeBallCarvedFromStone
lines.text: It's a big POKé BALL carved from\na black stone.\pIt was apparently used in festivals\nin the olden days.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_StoneTabletWithAncientText
lines.text: It's a huge stone tablet inscribed\nwith POKéMON and dense text in the\lsmall characters of an ancient,\lunreadable language.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WorksOfMagnificence
lines.text: Hmmm…\nWhat works of great magnificence…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MustntForgetLoveForFineArts
lines.text: Battling with POKéMON is fun,\nI'll grant you that.\pBut one mustn't forget our love for\nthe fine arts.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisMuseumIsInspiration
lines.text: This ART MUSEUM… Well, you could\nsee many fantastic paintings.\pAnd the CURATOR is a wonderful person.\pAmong artists like myself, this MUSEUM\nis an inspiration.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisLadyIsPretty
lines.text: This lady is pretty!\nShe's like Mommy!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisPokemonIsAdorable
lines.text: This POKéMON is adorable!\nJust like our little boy!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HeardMuseumGotNewPaintings
lines.text: I'd heard that this ART MUSEUM got\nin some new paintings.\pSo, naturally I hurried over.\pAre the new paintings up on\nthe second floor?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_CuratorHasBeenCheerful
lines.text: Lately, the CURATOR has been\nunusually cheerful.\pI bet something good happened for him.\nDefinitely.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_AimToSeeGreatPaintings
lines.text: I aim to see many great paintings\nhere and learn from them.\pI have this dream of one day having\nmy artwork exhibited here.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MuseumTouristDestination
lines.text:
The ART MUSEUM has become a favorite
tourist destination.\pIt's great for LILYCOVE…
No, great for the HOENN region!\pThis is what I've heard--a lone TRAINER
procured all the paintings upstairs.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThisIsExhibitHall
lines.text: This is our special exhibit hall.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
lines.text:
As you can plainly see, there is not
a single painting on exhibit.\pHere, I don't wish to exhibit works of
so-called classical art.\pSuch classical works you can see on
our ground floor.\pI wish to exhibit work that is far
different from the classics.\pArt, after all, is not restricted to old,
famous works!\pThis exhibit hall, I wish to fill it with…\pModern and vibrant artworks of
POKéMON seemingly ready to spring\lforth into glorious life!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
lines.text:
I beg your pardon. I didn't intend
to monopolize the conversation.\pNow, as you are young, and yet
obviously well traveled…\pYou must encounter lively POKéMON
and works of art depicting them.\pIf you were to come across such
a painting, may we ask you to obtain\lthe artist's permission to exhibit\lit here?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_WishToFillExhibit
lines.text: I wish to fill this exhibit hall with\nmodern and vibrant paintings of\lPOKéMON.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThanksAddedNewPainting
lines.text: Thanks to you, we've added a new\npainting to our collection!\pI've heard it depicts your POKéMON.\nTruly magnificent!\pThank you so very, very much!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsYouPlayer
lines.text: Ah! It's you!\n{PLAYER}!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
lines.text:
Isn't this marvelous?
This collection of paintings!\pEach one of them flawless!
None better than another!\pThese paintings have attracted
more guests to our ART MUSEUM.\pSincerely, I thank you, {PLAYER}.
This is my dream come true!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_TokenOfGratitude
lines.text: This is merely a token of my gratitude.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_KeepThisForYou
lines.text: I will keep this for you until we\nmeet again.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_HonorToHaveYouVisit
lines.text: Ah, so good to see you, {PLAYER}!\pIt's an honor to have you visit us\non your busy journeys.\pPlease, relax and do enjoy your\nvisit with us.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsPinkPictureFrame
lines.text: It's a picture frame with pink-colored\nadornments.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsYellowPictureFrame
lines.text: It's a picture frame with\nyellow-colored adornments.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsBluePictureFrame
lines.text: It's a picture frame with\nblue-colored adornments.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsRedPictureFrame
lines.text: It's a picture frame with\nred-colored adornments.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsGreenPictureFrame
lines.text: It's a picture frame with\ngreen-colored adornments.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsPaintingOfPokemon
lines.text: It's a painting of POKéMON.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsSurprisedMe
lines.text: I've been away awhile, so the new\npaintings up here surprised me.\pI wish someone would paint my POKéMON\nthis pretty.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsRatherAmusing
lines.text: Well… So this is where they show\nthe topical POKéMON paintings.\pI see, these new paintings are indeed\nrather amusing.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThesePaintingsOfYourPokemon
lines.text: Wow, is that right?\nThese paintings are of your POKéMON.\pIsn't that just the ultimate joy for\na TRAINER?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
lines.text: Uh…\nOh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.\pI can make POKéMON forget their moves.\pWould you like me to do that?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_WhichMonShouldForget
lines.text: Which POKéMON should forget a move?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_WhichMoveShouldBeForgotten
lines.text: Which move should be forgotten?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonOnlyKnowsOneMove
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1} knows only one move\nso it can't be forgotten…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonsMoveShouldBeForgotten
lines.text: Hm! {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2}?\nThat move should be forgotten?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonHasForgottenMove
lines.text: It worked to perfection!\p{STR_VAR_1} has forgotten\n{STR_VAR_2} completely.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ComeAgain
lines.text: Come again if there are moves that\nneed to be forgotten.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_EggCantForgetMoves
lines.text: What?\nNo EGG should know any moves.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_CantForgetSurf
lines.text: Hm!\pYour {STR_VAR_1} doesn't seem willing\nto forget SURF.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HowManyKindsOfPokemon
lines.text: I wonder how many kinds of POKéMON\nthere are in the world.\pIt'd be great to cross seas and\ntrade POKéMON with people far away.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HeardAboutRottenScoundrels
lines.text: I've been hearing about some rotten\nscoundrels who steal POKéMON and rip\loff METEORITES.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HaventSeenRottenScoundrels
lines.text: Those rotten scoundrels who steal\nPOKéMON and rip off METEORITES…\pI haven't seen them around recently.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OhWowItsPlayer
lines.text: Oh, wow!\nIt's {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HeardAboutYouImYourFan
lines.text:
I've heard the news!
You're really strong, aren't you?\pWe always argue about who is the
strongest of all TRAINERS here.\pSo when I heard about you, I decided
to be your fan!\pI hope you'll keep on battling other
tough TRAINERS.\pThat way, we'll be able to see more
of your hot, hot battles.\pThat will make the others here see
exactly how great you are.\pRemember, I'm cheering for you,
{PLAYER}!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoureOneWeWantToWin
lines.text: Yo, {PLAYER}!\nYou're the one we want to win!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OthersDontKnowYoureTheBest
lines.text: The others, they don't know that\nyou're the best of the best!\pIsn't that right, {PLAYER}?\nShow them you've got guts!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainersPowerIsOutOfTheOrdinary
lines.text: I hate to say this, but the TRAINER\neverybody's talking about is\l{STR_VAR_1}, no question about it!\pThat TRAINER's power…\nIt's out of the ordinary.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsBestNoOneWantsToListen
lines.text: Darn it… I've been telling people\nthat {STR_VAR_1} is the best now…\pBut no one wants to listen…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HearingAboutToughNewTrainer
lines.text:
I've been hearing things about
a tough new TRAINER.\pThis TRAINER's supposed to be beating
GYM LEADERS, even.\pDo you know anything about this
new TRAINER?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImPullingForYou
lines.text: Oh!\n{PLAYER}!\pGo for it!\nI'm pulling for you!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrawlyNoImYourFan
lines.text:
Sigh…
BRAWLY…\pOh, no! Wait!
That's not right! No, no, no!\pI'm your fan through and through!\pSo make me proud!
Go for it!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ICantHelpLikingBrawly
lines.text: I can't help it, I can only get to\nlike BRAWLY…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NobodyUnderstandsBrawly
lines.text: Nobody understands the charm of\nBRAWLY…\pI don't care!\pEven if I'm the only one, I'm going\nto keep cheering for BRAWLY!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_MyFavoriteTrainerIsBrawly
lines.text: Whatever anyone says, my favorite\nTRAINER is DEWFORD's GYM LEADER\lBRAWLY!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouveSurpassedYourFather
lines.text: You've surpassed your own father in\nevery regard!\pI'm telling you, so there's no question\nabout it at all!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourFatherNeverGaveUpSoKeepOnBattling
lines.text: Even when things turned bleak,\nyour father never gave up.\pThis I know to be true.\pYou never give up even if you lose!\nSo keep on battling!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_LongWayToGoComparedToNorman
lines.text:
NORMAN battled with more power,
charisma, and showmanship than you.\pEven though people may say that
you're strong…\pYou've still got a long way to go
compared to your father.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouAndNormanAreDifferent
lines.text:
You're beginning to get the same
air of awe NORMAN exudes.\pBut there's something conclusively
different between you and NORMAN.\pI can't tell you what that is.
You'll have to find it yourself.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WeDiscussStrongestTrainers
lines.text:
Everyone here, we're all huge fans
of POKéMON battles.\pWe discuss who we consider to be
the strongest of all TRAINERS.\pIf you were to become famous,
we might even become your fans!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OhWoweeItsPlayer
lines.text: Oh, woweee! It's {PLAYER}!\nFor real, too!\pPlease, shake my hand, shake my hand!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_AlwaysCheerForYou
lines.text:
I'll always cheer for you, {PLAYER}!
Always, always!\pI don't want to see you lose ever,
{PLAYER}.\pBecause I know you're really,
really strong, {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryoneThinksTrainerIsCool
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1} is really cool…\pEveryone thinks so, right, right?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsReallyCoolItsJustMe
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1} really is cool, don't\nyou think so?\pEven if it's just me, I'm going to keep\ncheering my favorite TRAINER.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WishThereWasTrainerLikeThat
lines.text: My favorite TRAINER is…\pCool…\pStrong…\pAnd really nice…\pI wish there was a TRAINER like that…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WantToBeStrongLikeYou
lines.text: Whoa! It's {PLAYER}!\nWicked!\pWhen I grow up, I want to be strong\nlike you, {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OnlyOneWhoCheersForYou
lines.text: Even if I'm the only one…\pYou'll always be the only one\nI cheer for, {PLAYER}!\pBecause I believe in you, {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsWickedlyCool
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1} is so wickedly cool…\nI want to shake hands with my hero.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NeverGoingToStopBeingTrainersFan
lines.text: Even if I'm the only one…\pI'm never going to stop being\n{STR_VAR_1}'s fan!\pBecause I've heard, {STR_VAR_1}\nnever loses!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoureAmazingAfterAll
lines.text: {PLAYER}!\nYou are amazing after all!\pEver since I set eyes on you,\nI knew that you were great.\pIt looks like my eyes didn't deceive me.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImInYourCorner
lines.text: Who cares about the others.\nI'm in your corner!\pYou don't need to worry. Just get\nout there and battle like always.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ThinkTrainerIsNumberOne
lines.text:
You're a pretty decent TRAINER,
I think.\pBut I also think that {STR_VAR_1}
is number one right now.\pThat's just my opinion.
Don't worry about it too much.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoureMaybeStrongerThanTrainer
lines.text: Wow, you really are strong.\nMaybe even stronger than {STR_VAR_1}.\pBut {STR_VAR_1} needs me.\pIf I don't cheer for {STR_VAR_1},\nwho will?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouChangedMyMind
lines.text: You've changed my mind!\nYou are strong, aren't you?\pI'd like you to tell me how you managed\nto get so strong!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouBattleAttractivelyInToughSituation
lines.text: The tougher the situation, the more\nattractively you battle.\pI can't wait for your next battle!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsStandout
lines.text: Among the recently hot TRAINERS,\n{STR_VAR_1} is the standout.\pThat toughness, it's simply not normal.\pYou're doing okay, but you're not in\nthe same class as {STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NoOneCanKnockYouButTrainerStronger
lines.text: You are really popular…\pYou're strong, and you're caring to\nPOKéMON. No one can knock you.\pBut, you know, I believe in {STR_VAR_1}.\p{STR_VAR_1} is definitely stronger!\nI'm positive!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouImpressive
lines.text: You…\pImpressive!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OnlyIRecognizeYourTrueWorth
lines.text: Your true worth, it is fine if only\nI recognized it.\pThe others I doubt will understand\nthe hidden power that beats within.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HaventRealizedPotential
lines.text: Yes, I see strength in your eyes.\pBut!\pYou still haven't realized your\npotential.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourePowerfulButNotTrueStrength
lines.text:
It is true that you are tremendously
powerful.\pBut!
I can tell…\pThat strength cannot be considered
true strength yet!\pTrue strength is…!
… …\pActually, I have no idea, either.$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
lines.text:
MOM: {PLAYER}, we're here, honey!\pIt must be tiring riding with our things
in the moving truck.\pWell, this is LITTLEROOT TOWN.\pHow do you like it?
This is our new home!\pIt has a quaint feel, but it seems to be
an easy place to live, don't you think?\pAnd, you get your own room, {PLAYER}!
Let's go inside.$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_WaitPlayer
lines.text: MOM: Wait, {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
lines.text:
MOM: {PLAYER}! {PLAYER}! Did you
introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH?\pOh! What an adorable POKéMON!
You got it from PROF. BIRCH. How nice!\pYou're your father's child, all right.
You look good together with POKéMON!\pHere, honey! If you're going out on an
adventure, wear these RUNNING SHOES.\pThey'll put a zip in your step!$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_SwitchShoesWithRunningShoes
lines.text: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the\nRUNNING SHOES.$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
lines.text:
MOM: {PLAYER}, those shoes came with
instructions.\p“Press the B Button while wearing these
RUNNING SHOES to run extra-fast!\p“Slip on these RUNNING SHOES and race
in the great outdoors!”$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
lines.text:
… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pTo think that you have your very own
POKéMON now…\lYour father will be overjoyed.\p…But please be careful.
If anything happens, you can come home.\pGo on, go get them, honey!$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems
lines.text: If you use a PC, you can store items\nand POKéMON.\pThe power of science is staggering!$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab
lines.text: PROF. BIRCH spends days in his LAB\nstudying, then he'll suddenly go out in\lthe wild to do more research…\pWhen does PROF. BIRCH spend time\nat home?$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemonWillJumpOut
lines.text: Um, um, um!\pIf you go outside and go in the grass,\nwild POKéMON will jump out!$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_DangerousIfYouDontHavePokemon
lines.text: It's dangerous if you don't have\nyour own POKéMON.$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
lines.text:
Um, hi!\pThere are scary POKéMON outside!
I can hear their cries!\pI want to go see what's going on,
but I don't have any POKéMON…\pCan you go see what's happening
for me?$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_YouSavedBirch
lines.text: You saved PROF. BIRCH!\nI'm so glad!$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_GoodLuckCatchingPokemon
lines.text: Are you going to catch POKéMON?\nGood luck!$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_TownSign
lines.text: LITTLEROOT TOWN\n“A town that can't be shaded any hue.”$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsLab
lines.text: PROF. BIRCH'S POKéMON LAB$

lines.label: LittlerootTown_Text_PlayersHouse
