lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketsBoggleMyMind
lines.text: A giant chunk of metal bursts through\nthe skies and flies into space…\pIt boggles my mind!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWantsToSpoilMyDream
lines.text: A giant chunk of metal bursts through\nthe skies and flies into space…\pBut TEAM MAGMA wants to spoil\nthat dream of mine!\pI'm not having any of that!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
lines.text:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, have you read that
proclamation already?\pTEAM MAGMA is coming after the rocket
fuel on this island.\pI don't know what they'd need it for,
but they can't be allowed to take it.\pI'll keep an eye on things for
a while longer.\pIn the meantime, why don't you go
check out the town?$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
lines.text: As promised, we've come for\nthe rocket fuel!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
lines.text: Ran out of fuel…$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
lines.text: Don't think you're on a roll just\nbecause you've beaten me!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: We gave you fair warning!\nThere's nothing sneaky about us!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Grrr…\nWe should've used sneaky treachery…$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: Okay, I get it already! The next time,\nwe'll come unannounced.$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
lines.text: The rocket fuel the SPACE CENTER has\nin storage--that's what we're after.\pWe mean to take every last bit of it!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
lines.text: Please, can you spare some fuel?\nEven a chintzy cup will do!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
lines.text: What are we going to do with\nthe rocket fuel?\pHow would I know?\nAsk our leader upstairs!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: Our leader said no one, but no one,\ngets past me!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Ack! Ack! Aaack!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: Please, tell our leader that\nI never abandoned my post.\lThat I stayed to the bitter end…$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
lines.text:
This is…
An intent-to-steal notice?\p“To the staff of the SPACE CENTER:
How are you? We are doing fine.\p“We will soon visit you to take your
rocket fuel.\p“Please don't try to stop us.
We will take the fuel no matter what.\p“Let there be more land!
                                          TEAM MAGMA”$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MossdeepIdealForRockets
lines.text: MOSSDEEP has mainly sunny weather,\nand its winds are stable.\pIt's an ideal location for launching\nrockets.$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WhyWouldMagmaStealRocketFuel
lines.text: Why would TEAM MAGMA want to steal\nour rocket fuel in the first place?$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WouldveLikedToBeAstronaut
lines.text: If only I was a little younger, I would\nhave liked being an astronaut…\pNo… It's not too late!\nI can and will try!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MagmaCantGetAwayWithThis
lines.text: If TEAM MAGMA takes the rocket fuel,\nI won't be able to go to space!\pThey can't be allowed to get away\nwith such an outrage!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WishOrdinaryPeopleCouldGoIntoSpace
lines.text: I wish ordinary people could go into\nspace one day…$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_DoesMagmaWantToGoToSpace
lines.text: TEAM MAGMA…\nDo they want to go to space, too?$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_YoureOutnumberedTakeUsOn
lines.text: What's wrong with you?\pYou're outnumbered three to one,\nbut you still want to take us on?$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_GoodAnswer
lines.text: Good answer!\nThat's what a smart person'll do!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5Intro
lines.text: A reckless go-getter, are you?\nOkay, I'll go first!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
lines.text: I lost!\nBut!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
lines.text: It's too soon to be relieved!\nI'm up next!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6Defeat
lines.text: I lost, too!\nBut!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7Intro
lines.text: I bet you want to take a break.\nBut I'm not about to let you do that!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7Defeat
lines.text: We should've taken a break…\nThat's what we should've done…$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
lines.text: Three of us here, and look at the sorry\nmess we got ourselves into.$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
lines.text: We three losing like this…\nWe look worse than usual by triple!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
lines.text: Are we being useful to our leader\nat all?$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WellTakeCareOfYou
lines.text: Hehehe!\pWe come all the way here to get some\nfuel, and we're interfered with again!\pIf you're going to mess with us too,\nwe'll take care of you at the same time!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieDontInterfere
lines.text: MAXIE: Clear out of the way!\nDon't you dare interfere!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenWhyStealRocketFuel
lines.text: STEVEN: TEAM MAGMA…\pWhat's the point of stealing rocket\nfuel?$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieUseFuelToEruptVolcano
lines.text:
MAXIE: Fufufu… Since you're so
curious, you deserve an explanation.\pWe're going to jettison the entire
load into MT. CHIMNEY!\pWith GROUDON gone, we have no need
for that slag heap of a mountain!\pSo we'll use the fuel's power to make
the volcano erupt!\pIt will be savage!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenAreYouReadyToBattle
lines.text: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nYou're going to help me?\pLet's go into battle together!\nAre you ready?$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenHurryGetReadyQuickly
lines.text: STEVEN: Then, hurry!\nGet ready quickly!$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_JustWantToExpandLand
lines.text: All I want…\nI just want to expand the land mass…$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_Text_TabithaDefeat
lines.text: I'm with our leader…$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeFailedIsAquaAlsoMisguided
lines.text:
MAXIE: We failed to make the volcano
erupt…\pWe failed to control GROUDON after
we had awoken it…\pIs our goal to expand the land
misguided?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pIf…
If we, TEAM MAGMA, are wrong…\l… … … … … …\pThen might TEAM AQUA's goal to expand
the sea also be equally misguided?$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeWillGiveUp
lines.text: MAXIE: All right…\nWe will give up on the fuel…\pThere appear to be more important\nmatters that I must examine…$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenThankYouComeSeeMeAtHome
lines.text:
STEVEN: Whew, that was too tense.
{PLAYER}{KUN}, thank you.\pI have something to give you as
thanks for your support.\pPlease come see me at home
after this.\pOh, yes, I don't live in RUSTBORO CITY.
I live right here on this island.$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarnedHMDive
lines.text:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pAs you can see, there's not much here,
but this is my home.\pThank you for all that you've done.\pThis is my token of appreciation.
It's the HIDDEN MACHINE DIVE.\pNo need to be shy--you've earned
this HM.$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDive
lines.text:
STEVEN: While you're using SURF, you
should notice dark patches of water.\pUse DIVE if you come to deep water
like it. You'll drop to the seafloor.\pWhen you want to come back up, use
DIVE again.\pIn some places, it won't be possible
for you to surface, though.$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_UnderwateCavernBetweenMossdeepSootopolis
lines.text: STEVEN: Apparently, there's an\nunderwater cavern between\lMOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.\pYou know, the one that CAPT. STERN\nfound in his submarine.$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_TakeBallContainingBeldum
lines.text: {PLAYER} checked the POKé BALL.\pIt contained the POKéMON\nBELDUM.\pTake the POKé BALL?$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ObtainedBeldum
lines.text: {PLAYER} obtained a BELDUM.$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_NoSpaceForAnotherMon
lines.text: There is no space for another POKéMON.$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LeftPokeBallWhereItWas
lines.text: {PLAYER} left the POKé BALL where\nit was.$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
lines.text:
It's a letter.\p… … … … … …\pTo {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pI've decided to do a little soul-
searching and train on the road.\pI don't plan to return home for some
time.\pI have a favor to ask of you.\pI want you to take the POKé BALL on
the desk.\pInside it is a BELDUM, my favorite
POKéMON.\pI'm counting on you.\pMay our paths cross someday.\pSTEVEN STONE$

lines.label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_CollectionOfRareRocks
lines.text: It's a collection of rare rocks and\nstones assembled by STEVEN.$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteWillActivateVolcano
lines.text: The power contained in the METEORITE…\pBy amplifying its power with this\nmachine, MT. CHIMNEY's volcanic\lactivity will instantly intensify…\pIts energy will grow deep inside\nthe crater and…\lFufufu…$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
lines.text:
MAXIE: Hm?
Who are you?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pI'd heard ARCHIE bemoaning a child
who's been meddling in TEAM AQUA's\laffairs.\pIt must be you he meant.\pHumph! So you're thinking of
interfering with us, TEAM MAGMA?\pNow you listen.
Long ago, living things used the\lland to live and grow.\pThat is why land is all important!
It is the cradle of all!\pThat is why TEAM MAGMA is dedicated
to the expansion of the land mass.\pIt is for further advancement of
humankind and POKéMON!\pAnd for that, we need the power of
what sleeps within this mountain…\pOh! There was no need for you to
learn that much.\pBut, no matter!
I'll teach you the consequences of\lmeddling in our grand design!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieDefeat
lines.text: What?!\pI, MAXIE, was caught off guard?!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfMagma
lines.text:
MAXIE: But, enough.
I will back off this time.\pBut don't think that this is the last
you've seen of TEAM MAGMA.\pFufufu…\pEven without the METEORITE, if we
obtain that ORB… Fufufu…$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaIntro
lines.text: Hehehe!\pSo you've come all the way here!\pBut you're too late!\nI've already delivered the METEORITE\lfrom METEOR FALLS to the BOSS!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaDefeat
lines.text: Hehehe…\pEven though I've lost, if our leader\nawakens that thing…$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaPostBattle
lines.text: BOSS, hurry!\nGive it the METEORITE's energy!\pHehehe…$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: We of TEAM MAGMA are working hard for\neveryone's sake.\pLike, if that thing's power made more\nland, there'd be more places to live.\pEveryone'd be happy!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Hunh?\nWhat do you mean I lost?$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: Our BOSS says, “It will make everyone\nhappy.”\pBut why does everyone keep getting\nin our way?$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: If there were more land, I'd be able\nto get a big house of my own!\pI'm going to build it on hardened lava!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: My dream of a big house…$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: A kid like you, you ought to be\nsplashing about in the waves!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_TeamAquaAlwaysMessingWithPlans
lines.text: That annoying TEAM AQUA…\nThey always mess with our plans!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoritesPackAmazingPower
lines.text: METEORITES pack amazing power!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_YouBetterNotMessWithUs
lines.text: You'd better not mess with us!\pWe're trying to awaken that thing\nfor the benefit of everyone!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_AquasNameSimilar
lines.text: We're TEAM MAGMA!\pThey're TEAM AQUA!\pIt totally annoys me that they'd\nuse a name like ours!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_DouseThemInFire
lines.text: Yeah!\nDouse them in fire!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_KeepMakingMoreLand
lines.text: We're going to keep making more land!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_Bufoh
lines.text: Bufoh!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma
lines.text:
ARCHIE: Grr, {PLAYER}!
I should've guessed you'd show up!\pSee for yourself what the fanatics
of TEAM MAGMA are up to!\pThey're trying to inject the stolen
METEORITE's power into the volcano!\pDoing something like that will cause
the volcano's eruption!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieIHaveMyHandsFull
lines.text: ARCHIE: Grrr…\pI want to stop that MAXIE,\nbut I can't!\pNot when I have my hands full battling\nthree opponents at once!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
lines.text:
ARCHIE: {PLAYER}!
Thank you!\pWith your help, we thwarted TEAM
MAGMA's destructive plan!\pBut… You…
Whose side are you on?\pAh, it doesn't matter.\pWe will remain vigilant and keep up
our pursuit of TEAM MAGMA.\p{PLAYER}, we shall meet again!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_MagmaOutnumbersUs
lines.text: Darn… TEAM MAGMA outnumbers us!\nWe can't keep up with them!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_LessHabitatForWaterPokemon
lines.text: If they expand the land, there'll be\nless habitats for WATER POKéMON!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_MagmasNameSimilar
lines.text: We're TEAM AQUA!\pThey're TEAM MAGMA!\pIt burns me up that they'd use such\na confusing name!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_Bushaa
lines.text: Bushaa!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_LavaCookiesJust200
lines.text: LAVA COOKIES are MT. CHIMNEY's local\nspecialty.\pTry one. It's just ¥200.$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_ThankYouDear
lines.text: Thank you, dear!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_YouveNotGotTheMoney
lines.text: Oh, dear. You can't buy a thing if\nyou've not got the money.$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_OhFineThen
lines.text: Oh, fine then.$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteFittedOnMachine
lines.text: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine…\pThe machine seems to be storing\nenergy in the METEORITE.$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_RemoveTheMeteorite
lines.text: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine…\pDo you want to remove the METEORITE?$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_PlayerRemovedMeteorite
lines.text: {PLAYER} removed the METEORITE from\nthe mysterious machine.$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_PlayerLeftMeteorite
lines.text: {PLAYER} left the METEORITE where\nit was.$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_MachineMakesNoResponse
lines.text: This mysterious machine…\nIt makes no response whatsoever.$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: {DOWN_ARROW} JAGGED PATH\nLAVARIDGE TOWN AHEAD$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyIntro
lines.text: I've been to the hot springs and\nrefreshed my tired bones.\lRight now I'm feeling strong!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyDefeat
lines.text: Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren't you something!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostBattle
lines.text: Well, well, I've lost. I can't call\nmyself an EXPERT now, can I?$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRegister
lines.text: Thank you, child. It was fun, as if\nI were battling my own grandchild.\pPlease, come see me again for\na rematch.$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchIntro
lines.text: If you can mesh your heart with those\nof your POKéMON, why, you should be\lable to achieve great things.$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchDefeat
lines.text: Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren't you something!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostRematch
lines.text: Perhaps your heart has become one\nwith the hearts of your POKéMON.$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaIntro
lines.text: I've got the fire in me, baby.\nI can't stand it! I have to battle!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaDefeat
lines.text: Ooh, that was a scorching-hot match!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaPostBattle
lines.text: The heat of MT. CHIMNEY warms\nme up, baby!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaIntro
lines.text: I've finally made it to MT. CHIMNEY.\nI want to make my POKéMON battle!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaDefeat
lines.text: The way you battle…\nIt's like a MT. CHIMNEY eruption!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaPostBattle
lines.text: Like I said, I've finally made it to\nMT. CHIMNEY. It would be a shame if\lI only do a little sightseeing…\pI want to get in some battles and buy\nCOOKIES as souvenirs.$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyIntro
lines.text: Since I bathed in the hot springs,\nI've been feeling great!\lI'm sure I'm going to win!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyDefeat
lines.text: Yowch!\nI'm getting a chill out of the water.$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyPostBattle
lines.text: I'll have to take another dip in the\nhot springs. Want to join me?\pJust joking!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerIntro
lines.text: This is one fine mountain! Plenty of\nhot people around for company!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerDefeat
lines.text: Oh, you're a real firebrand, too!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostBattle
lines.text: I think I need a dip in LAVARIDGE\nHOT SPRING with the locals!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRegister
lines.text: I like little fireballs like you.\nLet me register you in my POKéNAV.$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm happily surrounded by hot people\naround these parts. I won't lose!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchDefeat
lines.text: Gosh, you're still the same\nfirebrand as before!$

lines.label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostRematch
lines.text: Actually, it really is hot here.\nI'm overdressed for these parts.$

lines.label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarReadyGetOn
lines.text: The CABLE CAR is ready to go down.\nWould you like to be on it?$

lines.label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_StepThisWay
lines.text: Please step this way.$

lines.label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnotherTime
lines.text: Please ride with us another time.$

lines.label: MtPyre_1F_Text_TakeThisForYourOwnGood
lines.text: All sorts of beings wander the slopes\nof MT. PYRE…\pThere is no telling what may happen.\nTake this. It's for your own good.$

lines.label: MtPyre_1F_Text_ExplainCleanseTag
lines.text: Have a POKéMON hold that\nCLEANSE TAG.\pIt will help ward off wild POKéMON.$

lines.label: MtPyre_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespects
lines.text: Did you come to pay your respect\nto the spirits of departed POKéMON?\pYou must care for your POKéMON a lot.$

lines.label: MtPyre_1F_Text_RestingPlaceOfZigzagoon
lines.text: This is the final resting place of my\nZIGZAGOON. I cherished it…$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MemoriesOfSkitty
lines.text: Memories of my darling SKITTY…\nMy eyes overflow thinking about it.$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_TumbledFromFloorAbove
lines.text: Ooch, ouch… There are holes in the\nground here and there.\pI didn't notice and took a tumble from\nthe floor above.$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkIntro
lines.text: Hey! Are you searching for POKéMON?\nYou came along after me! You're rude!$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkDefeat
lines.text: Ayieeeeh!\nI'm sorry, forgive me, please!$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkPostBattle
lines.text: People don't come here often, so\nI thought there'd be rare POKéMON.$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeIntro
lines.text: LUKE: We're here on a dare.\pHeheh, if I show her how cool I am,\nshe'll fall for me. I know it!\pI know! I'll cream you and show her\nhow cool I am!$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeDefeat
lines.text: LUKE: Whoopsie!$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukePostBattle
lines.text: LUKE: Well, we lost but that's okay!\nI'm right here by your side.\lWe'll make it through this dare!$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeNotEnoughMons
lines.text: LUKE: If you want to take me on,\nbring some more POKéMON.\pIf you don't, I won't be able to show\noff to my girl how cool I am!$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezIntro
lines.text:
DEZ: I came here on a dare with my
boyfriend.\pIt's really scary, but I'm with my
boyfriend. It's okay.\pI know! I'll get my boyfriend to look
cool by beating you!$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezDefeat
lines.text: DEZ: Waaaah! I'm scared!$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezPostBattle
lines.text: DEZ: We're lovey-dovey, so we don't\ncare if we lose!$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_DezNotEnoughMons
lines.text: DEZ: If you want to challenge us, you\nshould bring at least two POKéMON.\pMy boyfriend's strong.\nJust one POKéMON won't do at all.$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahIntro
lines.text: You are an unfamiliar sight…\nDepart before anything befalls you!$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahDefeat
lines.text: Hmm…\nYou're durable.$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahPostBattle
lines.text: Our family has been TRAINERS here\nsince my great-grandmother's time…\pIt is my duty to protect this\nmountain…$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderIntro
lines.text: Kiyaaaaah!\nI'm terrified!$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderDefeat
lines.text: Nooooooo!\nI lost my wits!$

lines.label: MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderPostBattle
lines.text: I get freaked out every time I see\nanything move…\pI shouldn't have come here to train…$

lines.label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamIntro
lines.text: The rich atmosphere of the mountain\nhas elevated my psychic power!\pA mere child like you…\nYou dream of winning?$

lines.label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamDefeat
lines.text: I drown in self-pity…$

lines.label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamPostBattle
lines.text: My psychic powers have surely\ngrown several times, but…$

lines.label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaIntro
lines.text: Ahahahaha!\pThis is no place for children, least\nof all you!$

lines.label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaDefeat
lines.text: I lost that cleanly…$

lines.label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle
lines.text: This means my training is still not\nenough…\pI've got to keep working toward the\nsummit…\pGo, me!$

lines.label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleIntro
lines.text: Why have you come here?$

lines.label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleDefeat
lines.text: That was amazing!\nYou're a very special TRAINER.$

lines.label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle
lines.text:
POKéMON no longer of this world.
POKéMON that are with you now.\pAnd the POKéMON that you will meet
in the future…\pThey are all to be equally cherished.
Please remember that.$

lines.label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRegister
lines.text: I would like to see your POKéMON\nwhen they grow up some more…\pPlease, I need to see your POKéNAV.$

lines.label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchIntro
lines.text: Oh, it's you…\pHave you come to show me your grown\nPOKéMON?$

lines.label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchDefeat
lines.text: How amazing!\nYou are a special person.$

lines.label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch
lines.text:
POKéMON no longer of this world.
POKéMON that are with you now.\pAnd the POKéMON that you will meet
in the future…\pThey are all to be equally cherished.
I see that you've remembered that.$

lines.label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiIntro
lines.text: Teacher…\nPlease watch over my progress!$

lines.label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiDefeat
lines.text: Teacher…\nPlease forgive me!$

lines.label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiPostBattle
lines.text: Until I improve, my teacher, who rests\nhere, will never find true peace…$

lines.label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaIntro
lines.text: I love all things horrifying…\nIt's like a disease…\pWhen I'm here…\nI shiver with fear…$

lines.label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaDefeat
lines.text: Losing, I dislike…$

lines.label: MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaPostBattle
lines.text: I want to see dreadful things…\nI can't leave…\pStay…\nWon't you stay with me?$

lines.label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieIntro
lines.text: When I'm here…\nA curious power flows into me…$

lines.label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieDefeat
lines.text: The power is ebbing away…$

lines.label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostBattle
lines.text: Perhaps the power is from the spirits\nof POKéMON in fitful sleep here…$

lines.label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRegister
lines.text: Fufufu… I lost the match, but…\nI have this little ability…\pWithout ever laying my hands on\nyour POKéNAV… Hiyah!$

lines.label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRematchIntro
lines.text: Behind you…\nWhat is it…$

lines.label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRematchDefeat
lines.text: Something faded away…$

lines.label: MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostRematch
lines.text: The POKéMON at rest here…\nSometimes, they play…$

lines.label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricIntro
lines.text: Have you lost your bearings?\nHave no fear for I am here!$

lines.label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricDefeat
lines.text: Weren't you lost?$

lines.label: MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricPostBattle
lines.text: I had this feeling that a lost TRAINER\nwould be panicked and easy to beat.\pIt's dirty and I won't try it again…$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: No! Those TEAM MAGMA goons got\nhere ahead of us!\pWe can't fall behind!$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: I thought you were one of the MAGMAS\nwho happened to come back…$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: Yeah, so you are strong…\nBut there're a lot of us!$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text:
Hah!
Too bad for you!\pIf you came earlier, you only would've
had to battle the wimpy TEAM MAGMA.\pBut since you arrived now, you have
to take on us toughies!$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Urgh… I should've let you take on\nTEAM MAGMA first…$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: You don't know anything!\nSo why are you messing with us?$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Intro
lines.text: You…\nWe saw you at MT. CHIMNEY.\pYou don't belong to either TEAM,\nso why would you be here?$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Defeat
lines.text: If you're going to mess with anyone,\nlet it be TEAM MAGMA…$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
lines.text: Heh, it doesn't matter!\nWe bought ourselves some time!\pThe BOSS should have snatched what\nhe was after!$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Intro
lines.text: Oh, I know!\nYou tried to join TEAM MAGMA,\lbut they wouldn't have you!\pWell, don't think that we'll let you\njoin our TEAM AQUA!$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Defeat
lines.text: If you want to join TEAM AQUA that\nbadly, we can consider it…$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
lines.text: We have a great combination going\nwith us members and our leader.$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ArchieWeGotTheOrbLetsGo
lines.text:
ARCHIE: TEAM MAGMA's MAXIE got ahead
of us, but we also got what we wanted.\pThe RED ORB preserved at MT. PYRE…
I, ARCHIE, now have it in my possession!\pFufufu… Now we can bring our ultimate
objective to fruition!\pOkay, TEAM!
We're pulling out!$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLeftThis
lines.text:
Oh, no…
This cannot happen…\pNot only the BLUE ORB, but even
the RED ORB has been taken…\pThe BLUE ORB and RED ORB must never
be separated. They belong together.\pWhat are those men trying to do with
the two ORBS?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pOh, yes. Was it TEAM MAGMA who came
and took the BLUE ORB first?\pWell, in their haste, they left this
behind.\pI couldn't imagine what exactly it
could be.\pI would like you to have it.
Perhaps it will be useful in some way.$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_OrbsHaveBeenTaken
lines.text: The BLUE ORB and RED ORB taken by\nthose sinister men…\pThey must never be apart…\nI fear something terrible will happen…$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened
lines.text:
Oh, my goodness…\pYou say that both GROUDON and KYOGRE
have been awakened?\pIt is said that the BLUE ORB and
the RED ORB quelled the rage of\lthe two POKéMON…\pIt is also said that the true owner
of the ORBS still exists.\pHowever, no one knows who, or what
exactly, the ORBS belong to.\pIt could be a human, or perhaps
a POKéMON, but no one knows.$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ThoseTwoMenReturnedOrbs
lines.text: The two men who took the ORBS came\nback to return them on their own.\pThose men…\nPerhaps they are not so evil after all…$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_SuperAncientPokemonTaughtUs
lines.text:
The embodiments of the land, sea,
and the sky…\pThat is said to be the identities of
the super-ancient POKéMON…\pIn the same way that we humans and
POKéMON have life, our world, too,\lis alive…\pThe super-ancient POKéMON have
taught us that…$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_WillYouHearOutMyTale
lines.text:
MT. PYRE is where we calm the spirits
of POKéMON that have passed on…\pThis is a high place where one can
see all of HOENN…\pThe disembodied spirits of POKéMON
must find solace here…\pIs it coincidence that you are here…\pWill you hear out my tale? A tale long
told in the HOENN region?$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
lines.text:
It happened long, long ago…\pThe world was wracked by a ferocious
clash between the POKéMON of the land\land the POKéMON of the sea…\pThe POKéMON of the land raised
mountains and created continents…\pThe POKéMON of the sea raised huge
waves and carved out oceans…\pTheir fierce duel raged without end.\pThe world was engulfed in massive
infernos and vicious storms.\pThe BLUE ORB and the RED ORB brought
an end to the calamity.\pLight poured from the two ORBS and
becalmed the enraged adversaries.\pThe pair, made docile, dove deep into
the sea where eventually they\ldisappeared…$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_WellThatTooIsFine
lines.text: I see…\nWell, that, too, is fine…$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_MaxieSilence
lines.text: MAXIE: {PLAYER}…\p… … … … … …\n… … … … … …$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HearTheNewLegendOfHoenn
lines.text:
It is my role to pass on the legends
of HOENN to future generations.\pAnd the crisis that just ended in
SOOTOPOLIS rewrote a legend…\pHave you the time to hear the new
legend of HOENN?$

lines.label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
lines.text:
It happened long, long ago…\pThe world was wracked by a ferocious
clash between the POKéMON of the land\land the POKéMON of the sea…\pThe POKéMON of the land raised
mountains and created continents…\pThe POKéMON of the sea raised huge
waves and carved out oceans…\pTheir fierce duel raged without end.\pThe world was engulfed in massive
fires and vicious storms.\pIt was then that the POKéMON of
the sky descended from a storm.\pThe POKéMON, shining a vivid green,
becalmed the two enraged POKéMON.\pThen, its duty done, the green POKéMON
flew off into the wild blue yonder…$

lines.label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_DoorIsLocked
lines.text: The door is locked.$

lines.label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_UseBasementKey
lines.text: Use the BASEMENT KEY?$

lines.label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_UsedBasementKey
lines.text: {PLAYER} used the BASEMENT KEY.\pThe door opened!$

lines.label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorRadiatingHeat
lines.text: The generator is radiating heat that\ncan be felt even at a distance.\pIt looks like it should be turned off\nas soon as possible.$

lines.label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorQuietedDown
lines.text: The generator quieted down.$

lines.label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_SteppedOnSwitchGeneratorStopped
lines.text: {PLAYER} stepped on the switch.\pClick…\p… … … … … … … …\n… … … … … … … …\pThe generator appears to have\nstopped…$

lines.label: OldaleTown_Text_SavingMyProgress
lines.text: I want to take a rest, so I'm saving my\nprogress.$

lines.label: OldaleTown_Text_IWorkAtPokemonMart
lines.text: Hi!\nI work at a POKéMON MART.\pCan I get you to come with me?$

lines.label: OldaleTown_Text_ThisIsAPokemonMart
lines.text:
This is a POKéMON MART.
Just look for our blue roof.\pWe sell a variety of goods including
POKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.\pHere, I'd like you to have this as
a promotional item.$

lines.label: OldaleTown_Text_PotionExplanation
lines.text: A POTION can be used anytime, so it's\neven more useful than a POKéMON CENTER\lin certain situations.$

lines.label: OldaleTown_Text_WaitDontComeInHere
lines.text:
Aaaaah! Wait!
Please don't come in here.\pI just discovered the footprints of
a rare POKéMON!\pWait until I finish sketching
them, okay?$

lines.label: OldaleTown_Text_DiscoveredFootprints
lines.text: I just discovered the footprints of\na rare POKéMON!\pWait until I finish sketching\nthem, okay?$

lines.label: OldaleTown_Text_FinishedSketchingFootprints
lines.text: I finished sketching the footprints of\na rare POKéMON.\pBut it turns out they were only my\nown footprints…$

lines.label: OldaleTown_Text_MayLetsGoBack
lines.text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nOver here!\lLet's hurry home!$

lines.label: OldaleTown_Text_BrendanLetsGoBack
lines.text: BRENDAN: I'm heading back to my dad's\nLAB now.\l{PLAYER}, you should hustle back, too.$

lines.label: OldaleTown_Text_TownSign
lines.text: OLDALE TOWN\n“Where things start off scarce.”$

lines.label: OldaleTown_House1_Text_LeftPokemonGoesOutFirst
lines.text: When a POKéMON battle starts, the one\nat the left of the list goes out first.\pSo, when you get more POKéMON in your\nparty, try switching around the order\lof your POKéMON.\pIt could give you an advantage.$

lines.label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_PokemonLevelUp
lines.text: When POKéMON battle, they eventually\nlevel up and become stronger.$

lines.label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_YoullGoFurtherWithStrongPokemon
lines.text: If the POKéMON with you become\nstronger, you'll be able to go farther\laway from here.$

lines.label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_PokeBallsAreSoldOut
lines.text: The clerk says they're all sold out.\nI can't buy any POKé BALLS.$

lines.label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_ImGoingToBuyPokeBalls
lines.text: I'm going to buy a bunch of POKé BALLS\nand catch a bunch of POKéMON!$

lines.label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_RestoreHPWithPotion
lines.text: If a POKéMON gets hurt and loses its HP\nand faints, it won't be able to battle.\pTo prevent your POKéMON from fainting,\nrestore its HP with a POTION.$

lines.label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersCanUsePC
lines.text: That PC in the corner there is\nfor any POKéMON TRAINER to use.\pNaturally, that means you're welcome\nto use it, too.$

lines.label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonCentersAreGreat
lines.text: POKéMON CENTERS are great!\pYou can use their services as much\nas you like, and it's all for free.\lYou never have to worry!$

lines.label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WirelessClubNotAvailable
lines.text: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on\nthe second floor was built recently.\pBut they say they're still making\nadjustments.$

lines.label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedInWirelessClub
lines.text: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on\nthe second floor was built recently.\pI traded POKéMON right away.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_Text_FastRunningCurrent
lines.text: The sea between PACIFIDLOG and\nSLATEPORT has a fast-running tide.\pIf you decide to SURF, you could end\nup swept away somewhere else.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_Text_NeatHousesOnWater
lines.text: See, isn't it neat?\nThese houses are on water!\pI was born here!$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
lines.text:
The SKY PILLAR?\p…Oh, you must mean that tall, tall
tower a little further out.\pIf you asked me, I wouldn't climb it.
It's too scary to get up that high.\pLife at sea level in PACIFIDLOG,
that suits me fine.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_Text_TownSign
lines.text: PACIFIDLOG TOWN\p“Where the morning sun smiles upon\nthe waters.”$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_RegiStory
lines.text:
In the HOENN region, there are three
POKéMON that represent the power of\lrock, ice, and steel.\pEach of them is said to hide away deep
inside caves.\pThat's the story I heard when I was
just a little kid.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_SixDotsOpenThreeDoors
lines.text: “Six dots open three doors.”\pGrandpa used to say that, but I don't\nknow what he meant.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ChairmansYoungerBrotherOnVacation
lines.text: Er-hem!\pI am the POKéMON FAN CLUB's most\nimportant person, the CHAIRMAN's\lyounger brother.\pI'm here enjoying my vacation with\nPOKéMON, yes, indeed.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_AhYourPokemon
lines.text: Ah!\nYour POKéMON…$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_AdoringPokemonTakeThis
lines.text: It clearly likes you very much.\pA POKéMON that adoring and adorable\ndeserves a TM like this, no?$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_PutInSomeMoreEffort
lines.text: Hmm…\nIt's not bad, but it's also not good.\pYou, as the TRAINER, need to put in\nsome more effort.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ViciousPokemonTakeThis
lines.text: It has a vicious look to it.\pA frightening POKéMON like that\ndeserves a TM like this.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ExplainReturnFrustration
lines.text: If a POKéMON likes you a lot, RETURN's\npower is enhanced.\pIf it doesn't like you, FRUSTRATION's\npower goes up.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_GetGoodTMInXDays
lines.text: Oh, yes. In about {STR_VAR_1} or so days,\nI should be getting a good TM or two.\pYou should come see me then.\nI'll give you a TM that's suitable for\lyour POKéMON.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_Rurii
lines.text: AZURILL: Rurii.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_VeryFriendlyWithTrainer
lines.text: It appears to be very friendly with the\nTRAINER.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_Rururi
lines.text: AZURILL: Rururi!$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_DoesntLikeTrainerVeryMuch
lines.text: It doesn't appear to like the TRAINER\nvery much.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_WillingToTradeIt
lines.text:
Check out this {STR_VAR_2}!\pIt's the {STR_VAR_2} that I caught
yesterday to celebrate my birthday!\pOh, I can see that you want it!
After all, it's priceless!\pI'll tell you what. I might be willing
to trade it for a {STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_ItsSubtlyDifferentThankYou
lines.text: Oh, so this is a {STR_VAR_1}?\pIt's sort of like a {STR_VAR_2},\nand yet it's subtly different.\pThank you!$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_WontAcceptAnyLessThanRealMon
lines.text: No, no, no! I won't accept any\nless than a real {STR_VAR_1}!$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_NotDesperateOrAnything
lines.text: Oh, so you're not going to go through\nwith this?\pThat's cool. I'm not desperate to make\na trade or anything.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_ReallyWantedToGetBagon
lines.text: I know I could go looking for one\non my own, but…\pBut I really wanted to get a BAGON\nthat another TRAINER caught…$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_IsThatAPokedex
lines.text: Is that a POKéDEX?\pDid you get to meet a lot of different\nPOKéMON?\pI wish I was like you.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_PeopleSawHighFlyingPokemon
lines.text: People were saying they saw a POKéMON\nflying high above HOENN.\pIs it flying around all the time?\nDoesn't it need to rest somewhere?$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_SkyPokemon
lines.text: A sky POKéMON!\nA sky POKéMON!$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_WhereDidYouComeFrom
lines.text: Where did you come from?$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YesTown
lines.text: Yes?\nYES TOWN?\pI've never heard of a place like that.$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YouHaveToComeFromSomewhere
lines.text: No? That doesn't make any sense.\nYou have to come from somewhere.\pOh! Wait! You're not going to say you\nwere born at the bottom of the sea?$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_CantSeeMirageIslandToday
lines.text: I can't see MIRAGE ISLAND today…$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_CanSeeMirageIslandToday
lines.text: Oh! Oh my!\nI can see MIRAGE ISLAND today!$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_MirageIslandAppearDependingOnWeather
lines.text: MIRAGE ISLAND…\pIt must become visible and invisible\ndepending on the weather conditions\lthat make mirages appear.\pOr is it really appearing and\ndisappearing?$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WhatColorTrainerCard
lines.text: What color is your TRAINER CARD?\nMine's copper!$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnColonyOfCorsola
lines.text: PACIFIDLOG TOWN floats on top of\na colony of CORSOLA.\pIf I told you that, would you believe\nme?$

lines.label: PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AncestorsLivedOnBoats
lines.text: The ancestors of the people in\nPACIFIDLOG were said to have been\lborn on boats and then lived and died \laboard them.\pI understand that they lived that way\nbecause they were searching for\lsomething.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally
lines.text: Where has our WALLY gone?\pWe have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN\nvery soon…$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
lines.text:
Hiya! Are you maybe…
A rookie TRAINER?\pDo you know what POKéMON TRAINERS
do when they reach a new town?\pThey first check what kind of GYM
is in the town.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsPetalburgGym
lines.text: See? This is PETALBURG CITY's GYM.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsGymSign
lines.text: This is the GYM's sign. Look for it\nwhenever you're looking for a GYM.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
lines.text: My face is reflected in the water.\pIt's a shining grin full of hope…\pOr it could be a look of somber silence\nstruggling with fear…\pWhat do you see reflected in your face?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation
lines.text: Let's say you have six POKéMON.\nIf you catch another one…\pIt is automatically sent to a STORAGE\nBOX over a PC connection.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Text_GymSign
lines.text: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: NORMAN\l“A man in pursuit of power!”$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Text_CitySign
lines.text: PETALBURG CITY\n“Where people mingle with nature.”$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Text_WallyHouseSign
lines.text: WALLY'S HOUSE$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer
lines.text: Excuse me!\pLet me guess, from the way you're\ndressed, are you a POKéMON TRAINER?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot
lines.text: … … … … … …\pWell, maybe not.\nYour clothes aren't all that dirty.\pYou're either a rookie TRAINER,\nor maybe you're just an ordinary kid.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedTrainers
lines.text: I'm roaming the land in search of\ntalented TRAINERS.\pI'm sorry to have taken your time.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadYoureHereWithYourPokemon
lines.text:
DAD: Hm?\pWell, if it isn't {PLAYER}!
So you're all finished moving in?\pI'm surprised that you managed to
get here by yourself.\pOh, I see.
You're with your POKéMON.\pHm… Then I guess you're going to
become a TRAINER like me, {PLAYER}.\pThat's great news!
I'll be looking forward to it!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIdLikeAPokemon
lines.text: Um… I…\nI'd like to get a POKéMON, please…$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadOhYoureWallyRight
lines.text: DAD: Hm? You're… Uh… Oh, right.\nYou're WALLY, right?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIveNeverCaughtAPokemon
lines.text:
WALLY: I'm going to go stay with my
relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN.\pI thought I would be lonely by myself,
so I wanted to take a POKéMON along.\pBut I've never caught a POKéMON before.
I don't know how…$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHmISee
lines.text: DAD: Hm. I see.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadPlayerGoWithWally
lines.text: DAD: {PLAYER}, you heard that,\nright?\pGo with WALLY and make sure that he\nsafely catches a POKéMON.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_IllLoanYouMyZigzagoon
lines.text: WALLY, here, I'll loan you my POKéMON.\pWALLY received a ZIGZAGOON!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouAndDadGivesPokeBall
lines.text: WALLY: Oh, wow!\nA POKéMON!\pDAD: Hm. I'll give you a POKé BALL, too.\nGo for it!\pWALLY received a POKé BALL!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyOhWowThankYou
lines.text: WALLY: Oh, wow!\nThank you!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WouldYouReallyComeWithMe
lines.text: {PLAYER}… Would you really come\nwith me?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadSoDidItWorkOut
lines.text: DAD: So, did it work out?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye
lines.text:
WALLY: Thank you, yes, it did.
Here's your POKéMON back.\p{PLAYER}, thank you for coming along
with me.\pYou two are why I was able to catch
my POKéMON.\pI promise I'll take really good
care of it.\pOh! My mom's waiting for me,
so I have to go!\pBye, {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadges
lines.text:
DAD: Now…\p{PLAYER}, if you want to become a
strong TRAINER, here's my advice.\pHead for RUSTBORO CITY beyond this
town.\pThere, you should challenge
the GYM LEADER, ROXANNE.\pAfter her, go on to other POKéMON
GYMS and defeat their LEADERS.\pCollect BADGES from them,
understood?\pOf course, I'm a GYM LEADER, too.
We'll battle one day, {PLAYER}.\pBut that's only after you become
stronger.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToRustboro
lines.text:
DAD: Hm? Aren't you going to the
POKéMON GYM in RUSTBORO CITY?\pThere's no challenge for me to
battle a greenhorn TRAINER.\p{PLAYER}, I want you to challenge me
when you become a lot stronger.\pI'll battle you, {PLAYER}, when you
can show me four GYM BADGES, okay?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToDewford
lines.text:
DAD: I see… So, you've beaten
the GYM LEADER in RUSTBORO CITY.\pBut there are many more TRAINERS
who are stronger than you, {PLAYER}.\pAcross the sea in DEWFORD TOWN is a
GYM LEADER named BRAWLY.\pYou should go challenge him.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_YouHaveGottenStronger
lines.text: DAD: Hm… {PLAYER}, you have gotten\nstronger.\pI can tell by the number of BADGES\nthat you've earned.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro
lines.text:
DAD: Hm…
So, you did get four GYM BADGES.\pFine, as I promised, we will have
a POKéMON battle.\p{PLAYER}…\pI'm so happy that I can have
a real battle with my own child.\pBut, a battle is a battle!\pI will do everything in my power as
a GYM LEADER to win.\p{PLAYER}, you'd better give it your
best shot, too!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanDefeat
lines.text: …\pI… I can't…\pI can't believe it. {PLAYER}…\pI lost to {PLAYER}?\pBut, rules are rules!\nHere, take this.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBalanceBadge
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the BALANCE BADGE\nfrom DAD!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBadgeTakeThis
lines.text:
DAD: With that BADGE, the DEFENSE
of all your POKéMON will increase.\pPOKéMON that know the HM move SURF
will be able to travel over water.\pThis is my gift to you. {PLAYER}, I'm
sure you can use it correctly.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFacade
lines.text: DAD: TM42 contains FACADE.\pIt doubles the power of moves if\nthe POKéMON is poisoned, paralyzed,\lor burned.\pIt might be able to turn a bad\nsituation into an advantage.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHappyAndSad
lines.text: DAD: As the GYM LEADER, I can't\nexpress how upset I am…\pBut as a father, it makes me both\nhappy and a little sad. It's odd…$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
lines.text: Ah, there you are, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pPlease come with me.\nI have something I want you to have.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_LetMeBorrowPlayer
lines.text: NORMAN, you don't mind, do you?\pLet me borrow your {PLAYER}{KUN} for\na minute or two.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTraining
lines.text:
DAD: {PLAYER}, you should go visit
your mother every so often.\pI'm going to stay here and redouble
my training.\pIt would bother me as a TRAINER to
not avenge my loss to you, {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrainingIsEnough
lines.text: DAD: {PLAYER}, how are things going?\pThe world of POKéMON is deep.\pI honestly think that no amount of\ntraining would ever be enough.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
lines.text:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pThe doors in this GYM open when you
beat the awaiting TRAINERS.\pWhoops! The doors in this room are
already open, so don't attack me!\pThe TRAINERS of PETALBURG GYM
use all kinds of items.\pThe door at the left leads to
the SPEED ROOM.\pThe door at the right leads to
the ACCURACY ROOM.\pThe room's name will be on
the door, so choose carefully.\pOnce you've chosen the door…
Well, hey, go for it!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
lines.text: {PLAYER}! Whoa! You've overcome even\nyour own father!\pLike, whoa!\nWhat a stunning turn of events!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallIntro
lines.text: The ability to attack before the\nopponent…\pJust that alone puts me at a great\nadvantage, don't you agree?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallDefeat
lines.text: That was a magnificent battle!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle
lines.text: Go on to the next room where a new\nchallenge awaits you.\pAt the left is the CONFUSION ROOM.\pThe right door leads to the DEFENSE\nROOM.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBadge
lines.text: Whomever you beat, and whomever you\nmay lose to, you never shirk from\ltraining yourself and your POKéMON.\pThat's what I think being a\nGYM LEADER is all about.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerIntro
lines.text: This is the CONFUSION ROOM.\pLet me see how well bonded you are\nwith your POKéMON!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerDefeat
lines.text: I couldn't confuse your team enough…\nYou share a strong bond together.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBattle
lines.text: The next room is the STRENGTH ROOM.\nCan you withstand brute force?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBadge
lines.text: After you beat our LEADER, the\ntraining has become a lot tougher.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro
lines.text:
Just when you think you're going to
win, your opponent restores HP…\pCan you just imagine how awful that
must feel?\pI'll show you exactly how awful it
feels!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeDefeat
lines.text: I couldn't restore HP enough…\nWhat ATTACK power…$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle
lines.text:
I should have expected no less from
our LEADER's kid.\pNo, wait! A TRAINER's abilities are
earned only through effort.\pI lost because my own efforts
weren't enough.\pGo on! The ONE-HIT KO ROOM is next.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBadge
lines.text: I'm going to keep training at GYMS.\nOne day, I'll become a LEADER.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeIntro
lines.text: I'm not going to take it easy just\nbecause you're our LEADER's kid.\pI'll show you how horrid it is for\na POKéMON to take a critical hit!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeDefeat
lines.text: Your power…\nYou're the real deal.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle
lines.text:
Your father really is strong.
He's a TRAINER worth my respect.\pAnd, I sense the same glow coming
from you as your father.\pI hope that you'll stage a terrific
battle with your father!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBadge
lines.text: Since your dad became the LEADER,\nthe TRAINERS of PETALBURG CITY have\lbecome a lot tougher.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro
lines.text: Giggle…\nThis is the ACCURACY ROOM.\pIt's pretty nasty when every attack\nlands without fail.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryDefeat
lines.text: You were a cut above me…$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
lines.text:
There are some even stronger
TRAINERS waiting for you.\pThe left is the DEFENSE ROOM, and
the right is the RECOVERY ROOM.\pYour POKéMON's ATTACK power will be
on trial either way.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBadge
lines.text: Do you know what we're trying to\nachieve as TRAINERS?\pWe're striving to become soul mates\nwith our POKéMON.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaIntro
lines.text: The higher the DEFENSE, the more\nreckless I can be in attack.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaDefeat
lines.text: Our defenses weren't enough…$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle
lines.text:
I think you've taught me a valuable
lesson here.\pNow, go on! The left door goes to
the STRENGTH ROOM.\pThe right door opens to
the ONE-HIT KO ROOM.\pBoth of them have TRAINERS who are
skilled at offense.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBadge
lines.text: Hi! Have you tried using SURF?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyIntro
lines.text: Our GYM LEADER told us to go all out\nand beat you.\pEven if you happen to be the\nLEADER's kid!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyDefeat
lines.text: But… I went all out!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBattle
lines.text: The way you use your POKéMON…\nIt's like your father's style.\pGo on through! The GYM LEADER, your\nfather, is waiting!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge
lines.text: Sure, it's fine to make your POKéMON\nstronger.\pBut what decides the winner?\pWhy, it's the feelings TRAINERS have\nfor their POKéMON.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked
lines.text: This door appears to be locked\nright now…$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterSpeedRoom
lines.text: “SPEED ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked2
lines.text: This door appears to be locked\nright now…$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterAccuracyRoom
lines.text: “ACCURACY ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterConfusionRoom
lines.text: “CONFUSION ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterDefenseRoom
lines.text: “DEFENSE ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterRecoveryRoom
lines.text: “RECOVERY ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterStrengthRoom
lines.text: “STRENGTH ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterOHKORoom
lines.text: “ONE-HIT KO ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterGymLeadersRoom
lines.text: “GYM LEADER'S ROOM\p“See for yourself what POKéMON await\nyou!” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
lines.text: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
lines.text: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM\pNORMAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch
lines.text:
DAD: {PLAYER}…
I had a feeling that you would come.\pI would never refuse to accept
a challenge from you.\pYou do understand, don't you?\pInside a GYM, it doesn't matter that
we are a parent and child.\p…No, because we are parent and child,
we owe it to each other to do the best\lwe can. Isn't that right, {PLAYER}?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchDefeat
lines.text: Uh… Haha…\nMaybe that was going too hard…$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPostRematch
lines.text: DAD: {PLAYER}…\nWhat is your dream?\pMy dream…\nHahaha…\lIt has already come true, actually.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
lines.text:
DAD: {PLAYER}…
I had a feeling that you would come.\pI would never refuse to accept
a challenge from you.\pYou do understand, don't you?\pInside a GYM, it doesn't matter that
we are a parent and child.\pHm? Wait a second, {PLAYER}.\pDo you only have one POKéMON that is
capable of battle?\pSorry, but you'll have to come back
with at least two POKéMON.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWonderful
lines.text: Traveling is wonderful!\pWhen I was young, I roamed the seas\nand the mountains!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
lines.text:
Sigh…\pI wish I could go on an adventure
with some POKéMON…\pCrawl through some damp grass…
Climb rocky, rugged mountains…\pCross the raging seas…
Wander about in dark caves…\pAnd, sometimes, even get a little
homesick…\pIt must be fabulous to travel!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
lines.text: NORMAN became our town's new\nGYM LEADER.\pI think he called his family over from\nsomewhere far away.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
lines.text: I battled NORMAN once, but, whew,\nhe was way too strong.\pHow would I put it?\pI just got the feeling that he\nlives for POKéMON.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStronger
lines.text: Even if a POKéMON is weak now,\nit will grow stronger.\pThe most important thing is love!\nLove for your POKéMON!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful
lines.text: Do you use REPEL?\nIt keeps POKéMON away, so it's\luseful when you're in a hurry.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidotesWithYou
lines.text: Do you have any ANTIDOTES with\nyou?\pIf you walk around with a poisoned\nPOKéMON, it will lose HP until it faints.\lTake some ANTIDOTES with you.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCStorageSystem
lines.text: That PC-based POKéMON Storage\nSystem…\pWhoever made it must be some kind\nof a scientific wizard!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OranBerryRegainedHP
lines.text: When my POKéMON ate an\nORAN BERRY, it regained HP!$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManyTypesOfPokemon
lines.text: There are many types of POKéMON.\pAll types have their strengths and\nweaknesses against other types.\pDepending on the types of POKéMON,\na battle could be easy or hard.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TreeckoIsGrassType
lines.text:
For example, your TREECKO
is a GRASS type.\pIt's strong against the WATER and
GROUND types.\pBut, it's weak against FIRE-type
POKéMON.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TorchicIsFireType
lines.text:
For example, your TORCHIC
is a FIRE type.\pIt's strong against the GRASS and
BUG types.\pBut, it's weak against WATER-type
POKéMON.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MudkipIsWaterType
lines.text: For example, your MUDKIP\nis a WATER type.\pIt's strong against the FIRE type.\pBut, it's weak against GRASS-type\nand ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
lines.text:
You're…
Ah, you must be {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?\pThank you for playing with WALLY a
little while ago.\pHe's been frail and sickly ever
since he was a baby.\pWe've sent him to stay with my relatives
in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.\pThe air is a lot cleaner there
than it is here.\pWhat's that? Where's WALLY?
He's already left, our WALLY.\pI wonder where he could have
gotten by now?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WonderHowWallyIsDoing
lines.text: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
lines.text:
{PLAYER}{KUN}! Please excuse us for
dragging you here this way.\pBut our WALLY's become very healthy
since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN.\pWe owe it all to you!\pWhen WALLY left town, you helped
him catch a POKéMON, right?\pI think that made WALLY really
happy.\pActually, not just WALLY.
It made me, his father, happy too.\pHappy that he's gained such a great
friend as you.\pThis isn't a bribe or anything, but
I'd really like you to have this.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_SurfGoAllSortsOfPlaces
lines.text: If your POKéMON can SURF, you'll be\nable to go to all sorts of places.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyIsComingHomeSoon
lines.text: WALLY's coming home soon.\nI'm looking forward to that.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
lines.text: Oh? You met WALLY in\nEVER GRANDE CITY?\pOh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, don't be silly.\pHe may have gotten healthy, but he\ncan't go somewhere far away like\lthat all by himself.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasReallyHappy
lines.text: WALLY was really happy when he told\nus that he caught a POKéMON.\pIt's been ages since I've seen him\nsmile like that.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
lines.text:
I want you to keep this a secret
from my husband…\pBut our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN
without telling anyone.\pYou know, WALLY is frail, but
he's surprisingly strong-willed.\pI'm sure that he'll come back safe
and sound one day!$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NotAOneToBeFound
lines.text: Hmmm…\nNot a one to be found…$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HaveYouSeenShroomish
lines.text: Hello, have you seen any POKéMON\ncalled SHROOMISH around here?\pI really love that POKéMON.$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWasGoingToAmbushYou
lines.text: I was going to ambush you, but you\nhad to dawdle in PETALBURG WOODS\lforever, didn't you?\pI got sick of waiting, so here I am!$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HandOverThosePapers
lines.text: You! DEVON RESEARCHER!\pHand over those papers!$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouHaveToHelpMe
lines.text: Aiyeeeh!\pYou're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?\nYou've got to help me, please!$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NoOneCrossesTeamAqua
lines.text: Hunh? What do you think you're doing?\nWhat, you're going to protect him?\pNo one who crosses TEAM AQUA\ngets any mercy, not even a kid!\pCome on and battle me!$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureKiddingMe
lines.text: You're kidding me! You're tough!$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve
lines.text:
Grrr… You've got some nerve
meddling with TEAM AQUA!\lCome on and battle me again!\pI wish I could say that, but I'm out of
POKéMON…\pAnd, hey, we of TEAM AQUA are also
after something in RUSTBORO.\pI'll let you go today!$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose
lines.text:
Whew…
That was awfully close!\pThanks to you, he didn't rob me of
these important papers.\pI know, I'll give you a GREAT BALL as
my thanks!$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TeamAquaAfterSomethingInRustboro
lines.text: Didn't that TEAM AQUA thug say\nthey were after something in\lRUSTBORO, too?$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ICantBeWastingTime
lines.text: Uh-oh! It's a crisis!\nI can't be wasting time!$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems
lines.text: You're loaded with items.\nI can't give you this GREAT BALL.$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_GoBugPokemonTeam
lines.text: I caught a whole bunch of POKéMON!\pGo, go, go!\nMy BUG POKéMON team!$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ICouldntWin
lines.text: I have all these POKéMON,\nbut I couldn't win…$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ImOutOfPokeBalls
lines.text: I caught a bunch of POKéMON.\nNow I'm out of POKé BALLS.$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_InstantlyPopularWithBugPokemon
lines.text: If you take BUG POKéMON to school,\nyou get to be instantly popular!$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfILose
lines.text: I can't be popular if I lose.$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_PeopleRespectYou
lines.text: If you have a big BUG POKéMON,\npeople respect you for it.$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch1
lines.text: I want a rematch when my BUG\nPOKéMON grow up!\pI'm registering you in my POKéNAV!$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch2
lines.text: I want a rematch when my BUG \nPOKéMON grow up!\pI'm registering you in my POKéNAV!$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MyPokemonHaveGrown
lines.text: My BUG POKéMON have grown.\nI'll be popular again.$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfLose
lines.text: I can't be popular if I lose.$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IveBeenTrainingHard
lines.text: You get to be popular if you have\nstrong POKéMON, right?\lSo, I've been training hard.$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass
lines.text: Yo, there!\nYour POKéMON doing okay?\pIf your POKéMON are weak and you want\nto avoid battles, you should stay out\lof tall grass.$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanation
lines.text: Sometimes, there are things on the\nground even if you can't see them.\pThat's why I always check where I'm\nwalking.$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem
lines.text: Oh, neat!\nThat's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!\pYou must be a TRAINER.\nYou should try using this item.$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MiracleSeedExplanation
lines.text: It's a MIRACLE SEED.\nIf a POKéMON holds that item, its\lGRASS-type moves become stronger.\pBesides MIRACLE SEED, I think there are\nother convenient items for POKéMON\lto hold.$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
lines.text:
TRAINER TIPS\pAny POKéMON that appears even once
in a battle is awarded EXP Points.\pTo raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the
left of the team list.\pAs soon as a battle starts, switch it
out. It will earn EXP Points without\lbeing exposed to any harm.$

lines.label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pIn addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON\nhave Power Points (PP) that are used to\lmake moves during battle.\pIf a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be\ntaken to a POKéMON CENTER.$

lines.label: Route101_Text_HelpMe
lines.text: H-help me!$

lines.label: Route101_Text_PleaseHelp
lines.text: Hello! You over there!\nPlease! Help!\pIn my BAG!\nThere's a POKé BALL!$

lines.label: Route101_Text_DontLeaveMe
lines.text: Wh-Where are you going?!\nDon't leave me like this!$

lines.label: Route101_Text_YouSavedMe
lines.text:
PROF. BIRCH: Whew…\pI was in the tall grass studying wild
POKéMON when I was jumped.\pYou saved me.
Thanks a lot!\pOh?\pHi, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pThis is not the place to chat, so come
by my POKéMON LAB later, okay?$

lines.label: Route101_Text_TakeTiredPokemonToPokeCenter
lines.text: If POKéMON get tired, take them to\na POKéMON CENTER.\pThere's a POKéMON CENTER in OLDALE\nTOWN right close by.$

lines.label: Route101_Text_WildPokemonInTallGrass
lines.text: Wild POKéMON will jump out at you in\ntall grass.\pIf you want to catch POKéMON, you have\nto go into the tall grass and search.$

lines.label: Route101_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: ROUTE 101\n{UP_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN$

lines.label: Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon
lines.text: WALLY: {PLAYER}…\nPOKéMON hide in tall grass like this,\ldon't they?\pPlease watch me and see if I can\ncatch one properly.\p…Whoa!$

lines.label: Route102_Text_WallyIDidIt
lines.text: WALLY: I did it… It's my…\nMy POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route102_Text_LetsGoBack
lines.text: {PLAYER}, thank you!\nLet's go back to the GYM!$

lines.label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
lines.text: I'm…not very tall, so I sink right\ninto tall grass.\pThe grass goes up my nose and…\nFwafwafwafwafwa…\pFwatchoo!$

lines.label: Route102_Text_CatchWholeBunchOfPokemon
lines.text: I'm going to catch a whole bunch of\nPOKéMON!$

lines.label: Route102_Text_RouteSignOldale
lines.text: ROUTE 102\n{RIGHT_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN$

lines.label: Route102_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
lines.text: ROUTE 102\n{LEFT_ARROW} PETALBURG CITY$

lines.label: Route103_Text_MayRoute103Pokemon
lines.text: MAY: Let's see… The POKéMON found\non ROUTE 103 include…$

lines.label: Route103_Text_MayLetsBattle
lines.text:
Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\p…Oh, I see, my dad gave you
a POKéMON as a gift.\pSince we're here, let's have a quick
battle!\pI'll give you a taste of what being
a TRAINER is like.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_MayDefeated
lines.text: Wow! That's great!\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, you're pretty good!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_MayTimeToHeadBack
lines.text:
MAY: I think I know why my dad has
an eye out for you now.\pI mean, you just got that POKéMON,
but it already likes you.\pYou might be able to befriend any
kind of POKéMON easily.\pWell, it's time to head back to
the LAB.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_BrendanRoute103Pokemon
lines.text: BRENDAN: Okay, so it's this one and\nthat one that live on ROUTE 103…$

lines.label: Route103_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
lines.text: Hey, it's {PLAYER}!\p…Oh, yeah, Dad gave you a POKéMON.\pSince we're here, how about a little\nbattle?\pI'll teach you what being a TRAINER's\nabout!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_BrendanDefeated
lines.text: Huh, {PLAYER}, you're not too shabby.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_BrendanTimeToHeadBack
lines.text:
BRENDAN: I think I get it.
I think I know why my dad has his eye\lout for you now.\pLook, your POKéMON already likes you,
even though you just got it.\p{PLAYER}, I get the feeling that you
could befriend any POKéMON with ease.\pWe should head back to the LAB.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_ShouldHaveBroughtPotion
lines.text: My POKéMON is staggeringly tired…\nI should have brought a POTION…$

lines.label: Route103_Text_ShortcutToOldale
lines.text: If you cross the sea from here,\nit'll be a shortcut to OLDALE TOWN.\pFufufu, that's useful, isn't it?$

lines.label: Route103_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: ROUTE 103\n{DOWN_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN$

lines.label: Route104_Text_BrineyLivesInSeasideCottage
lines.text: That seaside cottage is where\nMR. BRINEY lives.\pHe was once a mighty sailor who never\nfeared the sea, however stormy.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_WhatsItLikeAtBottomOfSea
lines.text: The sea, huh?\pI wonder what it's like at the bottom\nof the sea?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_ThrowBallAtWeakenedPokemon
lines.text: If you're going to throw a POKé BALL,\nweaken the wild POKéMON first.\pIt will be easier to catch if it's been\npoisoned, burned, or lulled to sleep.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_OnlyThrowBallAtWildPokemon
lines.text: You're a thief if you try to steal\nsomeone else's POKéMON.\pYou should throw POKé BALLS only at\nwild POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_ImNotATrainer
lines.text: Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER.\pBut that's right, if TRAINERS lock eyes,\nit's a challenge to battle.\pIf you don't want to battle, stay out\nof their sight.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_LikeFillingMouthWithSeedsTakeThis
lines.text: I like filling my mouth with seeds,\nthen spitting them out fast!\pYou can have this, so you try it out!\pUse it on a POKéMON, and it will learn\na move for firing seeds rapidly.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_TMsAreOneTimeUse
lines.text: A word of advice!\pA TM, TECHNICAL MACHINE, is good only\nfor one-time use.\pOnce you use it, it's gone.\nThink twice before using it!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_DontNeedThisTakeIt
lines.text:
This FLOWER SHOP started selling
saplings recently.\pIt made me so happy, I went overboard
shopping.\pI don't need this WHITE HERB anymore.
Would you take it, please?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_FlowerShopSellingSaplings
lines.text: This FLOWER SHOP started selling\nsaplings recently.\pIt made me so happy, I went overboard\nshopping. Where should I put them?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_MrBrineysCottage
lines.text: MR. BRINEY'S COTTAGE$

lines.label: Route104_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
lines.text: ROUTE 1O4\n{RIGHT_ARROW} PETALBURG CITY$

lines.label: Route104_Text_RouteSignRustboro
lines.text: ROUTE 1O4\n{UP_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY$

lines.label: Route104_Text_PrettyPetalFlowShop
lines.text: PRETTY PETAL FLOWER SHOP$

lines.label: Route104_Text_TrainerTipsDoubleBattles
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pIn the HOENN region there are pairs\nof TRAINERS who challenge others\lfor 2-on-2 POKéMON battles called\lDOUBLE BATTLES.\pIn a DOUBLE BATTLE, the TRAINER must\nsend out two POKéMON, the one at the\lleft of the list and the top one.\lWatch how POKéMON are lined up.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_MayWeShouldRegister
lines.text: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pDEVON upgraded your POKéNAV with\nthe MATCH CALL system, huh?\pWe should register each other so we\ncan get in contact anytime.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_RegisteredMay
lines.text: {PLAYER} registered MAY\nin the POKéNAV.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_MayHowsYourPokedex
lines.text: MAY: Oh, by the way, {PLAYER}{KUN},\nhow's your POKéDEX coming along?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_MayMinesDecentLetsBattle
lines.text: Mine's looking pretty decent.\nSo…\lHow about a little battle?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_MayHaventRaisedPokemon
lines.text: MAY: Oh, what's the matter?\pHaven't you caught or raised your\nPOKéMON very much?\pThat's not very good for a TRAINER!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_MayLetsBattle
lines.text: MAY: So, what do you think?\nHow about a little battle here?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_MayIntro
lines.text: MAY: You just became a TRAINER,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_MayDefeat
lines.text: Yikes!\nYou're better than I expected!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_MayPostBattle
lines.text:
MAY: I can tell you've gotten pretty
good with the way you handle POKéMON.\pBut instead of only making them
battle, you should be like MR. BRINEY.\pIt's important to become friends with
POKéMON, too.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_BrendanWeShouldRegister
lines.text: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pCool, you had DEVON install the MATCH\nCALL system on your POKéNAV!\pLet's register each other in our\nPOKéNAVS so we can keep in touch.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_RegisteredBrendan
lines.text: {PLAYER} registered BRENDAN\nin the POKéNAV.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_BrendanHowsYourPokedex
lines.text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX?\nHave you filled in any pages yet?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_BrendanDoingGreatLetsBattle
lines.text: Me, I'm doing great!\pWant to check out how good I am with\na battle?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_BrendanNoConfidence
lines.text: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have\nany confidence in your POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
lines.text: BRENDAN: What's up?\nWant to have a battle with me?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_BrendanIntro
lines.text: BRENDAN: I know you just became\na TRAINER, but I won't go easy!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_BrendanDefeat
lines.text: Hmm…\nYou're pretty good.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_BrendanPostBattle
lines.text:
BRENDAN: You've gotten pretty decent
at handling POKéMON.\pBut, you know, you shouldn't just be
making POKéMON battle.\pLike MR. BRINEY, it's important to
become friends with your POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WaitUpPeeko
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: Hold on, lass!\nWait up, PEEKO!$

lines.label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsSailToDewford
lines.text:
Hm? You're {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You saved my darling PEEKO!\lWe owe so much to you!\pWhat's that?
You want to sail with me?\pHmhm…\pYou have a LETTER bound for DEWFORD
and a package for SLATEPORT, then?\pQuite the busy life you must lead!\pBut, certainly, what you're asking is
no problem at all.\pYou've come to the right man!
We'll set sail for DEWFORD.$

lines.label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_SetSailForDewford
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

lines.label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_DeclineDeliverySail
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: Is that so?\nYour deliveries can wait?\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!$

lines.label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToMakeDeliveriesSailToDewford
lines.text:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!\pYou're to deliver a LETTER to DEWFORD
and a package to SLATEPORT.\pWhat you need me to do is no problem
at all--I'm the man for the job!\pFirst, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.$

lines.label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToDeliverPackageSailToDewford
lines.text:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!\pYou're to deliver a package to
CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT.\pWhat you need me to do is no problem
at all--I'm the man for the job!\pFirst, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.$

lines.label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WhereAreWeBound
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\pNow, my friend, where are we bound?$

lines.label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_TellMeWheneverYouWantToSail
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: Is that so?\nWell, PEEKO owes her life to you.\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!$

lines.label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_Peeko
lines.text: PEEKO: Pii piihyoro!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall
lines.text:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pDAD: Oh, {PLAYER}?\p… … … … … …
Where are you now?\lIt sounds windy wherever you are.\pI just heard from DEVON's MR. STONE
about your POKéNAV, so I decided\lto give you a call.\pIt sounds like you're doing fine,
so that's fine with me.\pYou take care now.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_RegisteredDadInPokenav
lines.text: Registered DAD NORMAN\nin the POKéNAV.$

lines.label: Route106_Text_TrainerTips
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pAdvice on catching POKéMON with a ROD:\nPress the A Button if you get a bite.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateportDeliverGoods
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've made land in SLATEPORT!\pI suppose you're going to visit CAPT.\nSTERN and deliver the DEVON GOODS?$

lines.label: Route109_Text_BrineySailToDewfordQuestion
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: I thought you're supposed\nto deliver the DEVON GOODS.\pWould you like to sail back to\nDEWFORD, then?$

lines.label: Route109_Text_BrineyDewfordItIs
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_BrineyDeliverDevonGoods
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver\nthe DEVON GOODS. I'll be waiting.$

lines.label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateport
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've made land in\nSLATEPORT!\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail again!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_BrineyWhereAreWeBound
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\pNow, my friend, where are we bound?$

lines.label: Route109_Text_BrineyTellMeWhenYouNeedToSail
lines.text: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever\nyou need to set sail again!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_ChillAtMyPapasSpot
lines.text: Yo, TRAINERS!\nWhether you're hot to trot,\lor cool cat not,\lchill at my papa's spot!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_LittleKidsDartAround
lines.text: Little kids can dart around so quickly…\pYou don't dare take your eyes off them\nfor an instant. It's very taxing.\pMine are with my POKéMON, so they\nshould be okay, but…$

lines.label: Route109_Text_SandCastleTakingLongTime
lines.text: Our sand castle's taking a long time\nto make.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_YouCanHaveThis
lines.text: You can have this!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_WereGoingToMakeBigCastle
lines.text: We're going to get all the sand from\nthe beach and make a big castle!\pAnd then we're going to be a king and\nqueen.\pWe'll let you be a servant.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_ZigzagoonPicksUpLitter
lines.text:
The water around these parts is clean.\pBut, I get my ZIGZAGOON to pick up
litter from the shoreline at times.\pDirty water becomes rain and joins our
rivers, which we drink from…\pIf we pollute the sea, it all comes
back to haunt us eventually.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_ZigzagoonCry
lines.text: ZIGZAGOON: Guguu?$

lines.label: Route109_Text_SeashoreHouseSign
lines.text: SEASHORE HOUSE\p“May hot battles rage on hot sands!\nThe place for hot TRAINERS!”$

lines.label: Route109_Text_TrainerTipsSign
