lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pPOKéMON at the same level may not\nalways have identical stats.\pPOKéMON raised by TRAINERS are said\nto grow stronger than wild POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SeashoreHouseIntro
lines.text:
I'm the owner of the SEASHORE HOUSE.
But you can call me MR. SEA!\pWhat I love above all is to see hot
POKéMON battles.\pLet me see that your heart burns hot!\pIf you can defeat all the TRAINERS
here, I'll reward your efforts.$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_ShowMeSomeHotMatches
lines.text: Show me some hot matches!\pI run this SEASHORE HOUSE just for\nthat reason alone!$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_TakeTheseSodaPopBottles
lines.text: You're scorching hot!\nThose battles blazed!\lI'm more than just satisfied!\pAs thanks for showing me your hot\nstreak, I want you to take these.\pIt's half a dozen bottles of SODA POP!$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_BagFull
lines.text: Oh, but hey, your BAG's jammed full.\nI'll hang on to these for you.$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_WantToBuySodaPop
lines.text: Want to buy some SODA POP?\nPOKéMON love it!\pJust ¥300 a bottle!\nBuy some!$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_HereYouGo
lines.text: Here you go!$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_NotEnoughMoney
lines.text: You don't have the money.$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_ThatsTooBad
lines.text: No?\nThat's too bad.$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneIntro
lines.text: If you're looking for a battle in the\nSEASHORE HOUSE, you'll find no\lhotter TRAINER than me, matey!$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneDefeated
lines.text: That was a hot battle!\nI can accept that loss, matey!$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwaynePostBattle
lines.text: Whenever I'm in SLATEPORT, I enjoy\nhot battles and ice-cold SODA POP!$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaIntro
lines.text: Boring battles aren't worth the effort.\pFiery hot battles are what toughen up\nTRAINERS and POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaDefeated
lines.text: That's hot!$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaPostBattle
lines.text: Whew, I'm all thirsty.\nMaybe I'll have a SODA POP.$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonIntro
lines.text: I'm going to show you how great\nmy POKéMON are, but don't cry!$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonDefeated
lines.text: …I lost, but I won't cry…$

lines.label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonPostBattle
lines.text: If one of my POKéMON knew the move\nfor carrying me across water on its\lback, I could get rid of this inner tube.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_WeCantTalkAboutAquaActivities
lines.text: TEAM AQUA's activities…\nWe can't talk about them yet.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_KickUpARuckus
lines.text: I want to get going to SLATEPORT and\nkick up a ruckus!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_MyFirstJobInAqua
lines.text: This is my first job after joining\nTEAM AQUA. It's a little scary.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AquaActionsBringSmiles
lines.text: TEAM AQUA's actions should bring\nsmiles to people's faces!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_MayLetsBattle
lines.text: MAY: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}, long time no see!\pWhile I was searching for other\nPOKéMON, my POKéMON grew stronger.\pSo…\nHow about a little battle?$

lines.label: Route110_Text_MayDefeated
lines.text: Yikes!\nYou're better than I expected!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_MayTakeThis
lines.text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've been busy\ntraining, too, haven't you?\pI think you deserve a reward!\nThis is from me!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder
lines.text: MAY: That's an ITEMFINDER.\pTry it out. If there is an item that's\nnot visible, it emits a sound.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let's meet again!\pI know it's a little silly coming from\nme, but I think you should train a lot\lharder for the next time.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
lines.text: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}.\nSo this is where you were.\lHow's it going?\pHave you been raising your POKéMON?\nI'll check for you.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_BrendanDefeated
lines.text: Hmm…\nYou're pretty good.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_BrendanTakeThis
lines.text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, you've trained\nwithout me noticing…\pGood enough!\nHere, take this.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder
lines.text:
BRENDAN: That's an ITEMFINDER.\pUse it to root around for items that
aren't visible.\pIf it senses something, it emits
a sound.\pAnyway, I'm off to look for new
POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_RideBikeAtFullSpeed
lines.text: Wouldn't it be great to ride a BIKE\nat full speed on CYCLING ROAD?$

lines.label: Route110_Text_HairStreamsBehindMe
lines.text: How do you like the way my raven-\ncolored hair streams behind me?\pI grew my hair out just for that.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
lines.text:
Oh, hey, you got that BIKE from RYDEL!\pOh, it's glaringly obvious.
It says right on your bike…\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL…
That name's everywhere.\pYou should ride it around all over
the place--it's good advertising!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_TwoRoads
lines.text: The two roads, one above, one below…\pA road each for people and POKéMON.\nPerhaps that is right and fair.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_WalkOnTheLowRoad
lines.text: I don't have a BIKE, so I'll take\na leisurely walk on the low road.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_BikeTechniques
lines.text: Learning techniques will make BIKE\nriding even more fun.\pThere are some places that you can\nreach only by using a BIKE technique.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_WhichShouldIChoose
lines.text: Which should I choose?\pMake a beeline for MAUVILLE on\nCYCLING ROAD, or take the low road\land look for POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route110_Text_CyclingChallengeResultSummary
lines.text: Number of collisions:\n… … {STR_VAR_1}!\pTotal time:\n… … {STR_VAR_2}!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBest
lines.text: Bravo! Splendid showing!\pYour love of cycling comes from deep\nwithin your heart.\lYou've shaken me to my very soul!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionGood
lines.text: Your technique is remarkable.\pI suggest you speed up a bit while\nstill avoiding collisions.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionOk
lines.text: I would consider you a work in\nprogress.\pStill, I hope you don't forget the\nsheer pleasure of cycling.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBad
lines.text: My word… Your cycling skills border\non terrifying.\pMost certainly, you need much more\npractice riding.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionWorst
lines.text: …I am aghast…\pYou're perhaps not cut out for this\nunfortunate cycling business.\pYou ought to give serious thought to\nreturning that BIKE to RYDEL.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_RatedForNumberOfCollisions
lines.text: This is CYCLING ROAD.\pIf you were to ride from MAUVILLE to\nSLATEPORT on a MACH BIKE, you would\lbe rated for the number of collisions\land your total time.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AlwaysAimHigher
lines.text: Regardless of the results, I count on\nseeing more challenges from you.\lAlways aim higher!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AcroBikesDoNotQualify
lines.text: On this CYCLING ROAD, those riding\nMACH BIKES are rated for their number\lof collisions and their total times.\pACRO BIKES do not qualify for rating.\nThey are easy to turn, so it's not fair.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_SlateportCitySign
lines.text: ROUTE 110\n{DOWN_ARROW} SLATEPORT CITY$

lines.label: Route110_Text_CyclingRoadSign
lines.text: SEASIDE CYCLING ROAD$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AquaWasHere
lines.text: “TEAM AQUA was here!”\pSomeone painted that onto this sign,\nbut then someone else painted over it.\p“TEAM MAGMA rules!” is what it\nsays now.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_Route103Sign
lines.text: ROUTE 110\n{LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 103$

lines.label: Route110_Text_SeasideParkingSign
lines.text: SEASIDE PARKING$

lines.label: Route110_Text_MauvilleCitySign
lines.text: ROUTE 110\n{UP_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY$

lines.label: Route110_Text_TrainerTipsPrlzSleep
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pThe foe can be made helpless by\nparalyzing it or causing it to sleep.\pIt is an important technique for\nPOKéMON battles.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterItems
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pThe items in the BAG can be reorganized\nby pressing SELECT.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_TrickHouseSign
lines.text: “Three steps {RIGHT_ARROW} and two steps {UP_ARROW}\nto reach the wondrous TRICK HOUSE.”$

lines.label: Route110_Text_BestRecord
lines.text: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE…\pNo. of collisions: {STR_VAR_1}\pElapsed time: {STR_VAR_2}$

lines.label: Route110_Text_ThereIsNoRecord
lines.text: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE…\pNo one seems to have taken the\nchallenge. There is no record…$

lines.label: Route110_Text_ImagineSeeingYouHere
lines.text: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nImagine seeing you here!\pAnd where might my {RIVAL} be?$

lines.label: Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall
lines.text:
Oh, I see!
You two are running separately.\lWell, that's fine.\pOh, yes, I heard that your POKéNAV
had the MATCH CALL system installed.\pWell, then, I should register you in
my POKéNAV as well.\pThat way, even when we're apart,
I can rate your POKéDEX anytime.\p… … … … … …$

lines.label: Route110_Text_RegisteredBirchInPokenav
lines.text: Registered PROF. BIRCH\nin the POKéNAV.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_KeepAnEyeOutForRival
lines.text: PROF. BIRCH: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pPlease keep an eye out for my {RIVAL}.\n… … … … … …\pWell, I had better get going.\nSee you again, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$

lines.label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadNorthEntrance_Text_GoAllOutOnCyclingRoad
lines.text: On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out\nand cycle as fast as you'd like.\pIt feels great to go that fast, but try\nnot to crash into anyone!$

lines.label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadNorthEntrance_Text_TooDangerousToWalk
lines.text: Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING\nROAD. It's too dangerous.\pPlease come back with a BIKE.$

lines.label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_GoAllOutOnCyclingRoad
lines.text: On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out\nand cycle as fast as you'd like.\pIt feels great to go that fast, but try\nnot to crash into anyone!$

lines.label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_TooDangerousToWalk
lines.text: Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING\nROAD. It's too dangerous.\pPlease come back with a BIKE.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouveMadeItToMe
lines.text: Aak!\nYou've made it to me?\lHmmm… You're sharp!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPlantTrees
lines.text: It took me all night to plant all those\ntrees…\pYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three, four, five, six places!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMakeMaze
lines.text: It took me all night to make the maze…\pYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three, four, five places!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPreparePanels
lines.text: It took me all night to prepare\nthe wall panels…\pYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three, four places!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToShoveBoulders
lines.text: It took me all night to shove in those\nboulders…\pYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three places!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMakeMechadolls
lines.text: It took me all night to make MECHADOLLS\nand another to think up the quiz…\pYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two places!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToInstallDoors
lines.text: It took me all night to install\nthe doors…\pYou're almost my equal in greatness!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightSettingUpArrows
lines.text: It took me all night setting up arrows…\pYou're my equal in greatness!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightPolishingFloors
lines.text: It took me all night polishing floors…\pYou're above me in greatness!\nPossibly…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FountainOfIdeasRunDry
lines.text: Wh-what should I do?\nMy fountain of ideas for tricks has\lrun dry…\pPerhaps it is time I toured the country\non a quest to devise new tricks…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
lines.text:
I hate to admit defeat, but you have
bested me!\pStill, you must have been reeled in by
my charisma for you to visit me again\land again. Yes, you must have!\pBut that has nothing to do with my
losing!\pIn recognition of the friendship
between you, the driven, and the genius\lthat is myself, I demand that you take\lthis keepsake!\pActually there are two--
a RED TENT and a BLUE TENT.\lWhich do you prefer?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomInPC
lines.text: What? No room in your PC?\nWhat am I to make of that?\pI wish I could say that, but I am much\ntoo kind and caring, so come back later!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJourney
lines.text: … … … … … …\pI am leaving on a journey of discovery.\nA quest in search of new tricks.\pI wish that you will one day visit and\nentertain me again.\pAnd now, farewell!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouHaveEarnedThisReward
lines.text: Fine!\nYou have earned this reward!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomForThis
lines.text: What? Have you no room for this?\nWhat manner of items do you carry?\pBut fine, since you've reached me,\nyour reward will be with me till later.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTricksToStumpYou
lines.text:
Scrub that smug smirk from your face!
It's much too early to think you've won!\pI'll make new tricks to stump you, I will.
You may mock me only when you're done.\pCome back for the next exciting
installment!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YoureIgnoringMe
lines.text: Now, now! You're ignoring me now?\nNow that, I consider heartbreaking!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_YoureBeingWatched
lines.text: You're being watched…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBeneathDesk
lines.text: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nbeneath this desk? You're sharp!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBehindTree
lines.text: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nbehind this tree? You're sharp!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedInDresser
lines.text: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nin this dresser? You're sharp!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConealedBeyondWindow
lines.text: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nbeyond this window? You're sharp!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedInPlanter
lines.text: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nin this planter? You're sharp!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedInCupboard
lines.text: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nin this cupboard? You're sharp!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBehindWindow
lines.text: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nbehind this window? You're sharp!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBeneathCushion
lines.text: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nbeneath this cushion? You're sharp!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_TheyCallMeTrickMaster
lines.text: Behold!\pFor I am the greatest living mystery\nof a man in all of HOENN!\lThey call me…\pThe TRICK MASTER!\nWahahaha! Glad to meet you!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ComeToChallengeTrickHouse
lines.text:
You, you've come to challenge
my TRICK HOUSE, haven't you?\pThat's why you're here, isn't it?
Yes, it is!\pConsider your challenge accepted!\pEnter through the scroll there,
and let your challenge commence!\pI shall be waiting in the back!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ItsAScroll
lines.text: It's a scroll.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_GoInHoleBehindScroll
lines.text: There is a big hole behind the scroll!\pWant to go in?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_LeavingOnJourneyNote
lines.text: There is a note affixed to the scroll…\p“I am leaving on a journey.\nDon't look for me. TRICK MASTER”$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_NextTimeUseThisTrick
lines.text: For the next time, I'll use this trick,\nand that scheme, and those ruses…\pMufufufu… If I may say so, it's\nbrilliantly difficult, even for me!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_InMidstOfDevisingNewChallenges
lines.text:
Hah? What?!
Oh, it's you!\pI'm in the midst of devising new tricky
challenges!\pIt's not too much to ask for a bit more
time for me to think, is it now?\lYou wouldn't begrudge me that?\lCome back in a little while!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_YoureHereToAcceptReward
lines.text: Ah, it's you! You're here to accept the\nreward from before, isn't that right?\lYes, right I am!\pHere!\nI'll give it to you now!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_DidYouNotComeToClaimReward
lines.text: Hah?\nDid you not come to claim your reward?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_MechadollWhichTent
lines.text: MECHADOLL 5 I AM!\nIF REWARD IS NOT TAKEN BY YOU,\lTHEN TRICK MASTER YOU CANNOT FOLLOW.\pRED TENT OR BLUE TENT,\nWHICH DO YOU PREFER?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ThenFarewell
lines.text: THEN FAREWELL.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_PCFullAgain
lines.text: YOUR PC STATUS: FULL AGAIN.\nMEAN, YOU ARE.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle_Text_FoundAScroll
lines.text: {PLAYER} found a scroll.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle_Text_MemorizedSecretCode
lines.text: {PLAYER} memorized the secret code\nwritten on the scroll.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle_Text_SecretCodeWrittenOnIt
lines.text: A secret code is written on it.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_DoorLockedWriteSecretCodeHere
lines.text: The door is locked.\p…On closer inspection, this is written\non it: “Write the secret code here.”$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
lines.text: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER is fabulous.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_SallyIntro
lines.text: I'll hack and slash my way to victory\nwith the CUT we just learned!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_SallyDefeat
lines.text: Why are you so serious?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_SallyPostBattle
lines.text: I never get tired of hacking\nand slashing!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_EddieIntro
lines.text: I wandered into this weird house\nby accident…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_EddieDefeat
lines.text: And now I've lost…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_EddiePostBattle
lines.text: I lost my way, I lost a battle, and I'm\nnow even more lost… I can't get out…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinIntro
lines.text: Just who is the TRICK MASTER?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinDefeat
lines.text: I lost while I was lost in thought!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinPostBattle
lines.text: You're strong!\nJust who are you?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
lines.text: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER is smart.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedIntro
lines.text: Which switch closes which hole?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedDefeat
lines.text: After that battle, I'm even more\nconfused!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedPostBattle
lines.text: Can I get you to push all the buttons\nfor me?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulIntro
lines.text: Oh! You're on your second TRICK HOUSE\nchallenge!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulDefeat
lines.text: You're good at battling too?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulPostBattle
lines.text: The TRICK MASTER rigged all the tricks\nin this house all by himself.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaIntro
lines.text: I want to make my own GYM one day.\nSo, I'm studying how to set traps.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaDefeat
lines.text: I didn't study battling enough!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaPostBattle
lines.text: You're strong, aren't you?\nMaybe even enough to be a GYM LEADER!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
lines.text: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER is coveted.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinIntro
lines.text: I keep coming back to this same place!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinDefeat
lines.text: I'm already having trouble, and then\nyou have to beat me? It's not fair!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinPostBattle
lines.text: It's full of doors here!\nIt's too small and dark in here! Help!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_MarthaIntro
lines.text: I don't know what's going on here.\nI'm starting to feel sad…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_MarthaDefeat
lines.text: You… You're awful!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_MarthaPostBattle
lines.text: I know I'm weak!\nAnd, I have no sense of direction!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanIntro
lines.text: I don't get it. What would anyone want\nwith a house this bizarre?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanDefeat
lines.text: I don't get it.\nHow did I lose?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanPostBattle
lines.text: I don't get it.\nHow many traps are in this house?\pYou may be the one to solve that.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
lines.text: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER is cool.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraIntro
lines.text: It's too much bother to think this out.\nI only wanted to battle!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraDefeat
lines.text: Even though I lost, I still like battling\nthe best!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraPostBattle
lines.text: Wouldn't you agree? You would go\nanywhere if TRAINERS were there.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiIntro
lines.text: Heh! Boulders like this, I can brush\naside with one finger!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiDefeat
lines.text: I can push boulders, but I can't solve\nthe puzzle…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiPostBattle
lines.text: It's not good enough to be brawny…\nYou have to use your head. Be brainy!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaIntro
lines.text: The TRICK HOUSE is getting trickier,\nisn't it?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaDefeat
lines.text: Aaak!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaPostBattle
lines.text: Has anyone made it to the end?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
lines.text: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER is a genius.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll1Intro
lines.text: CLICKETY-CLACK…\nMECHADOLL 1 AM I!\pIF YOU ANSWER QUIZZES CORRECTLY,\nTHEN YOU WILL GO TO MECHADOLL 5.\lTHEN YOU CAN OBTAIN THE SECRET CODE.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll1Quiz1
lines.text: MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.\pOne of these POKéMON is not found\non ROUTE 110. Which one is it?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll1Quiz2
lines.text: MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.\pOne of these POKéMON is not of the\nWATER type. Which one is it?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll1Quiz3
lines.text: MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.\pOne of these POKéMON does not use\nLEECH LIFE. Which one is it?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_CorrectGoThrough
lines.text: CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.\nGO THROUGH. PLEASE.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_DisappointmentError
lines.text: BZZZT. DISAPPOINTMENT.\nERROR.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Wahahahaha
lines.text: WAHAHAHAHA! WAHAHAHAHA!\nCLICKETY-CLACK!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_WaitForNextChallenge
lines.text: YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE WE WAIT FOR.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll2Intro
lines.text: CLICKETY-CLACK…\nMECHADOLL 2 AM I!\pMECHADOLL 1'S QUIZ DIFFICULTY LEVEL\nIS SET TOO LOW.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll2Quiz1
lines.text: MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.\pWhich of these POKéMON did WALLY\nborrow from your father?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll2Quiz2
lines.text: MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.\pWhich of these POKéMON was chasing\nPROF. BIRCH?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll2Quiz3
lines.text: MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.\pWhich of these POKéMON did TEAM AQUA\nuse in PETALBURG FOREST?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll3Intro
lines.text: CLICKETY-CLACK…\nMECHADOLL 3 AM I!\pMATTERS OF MONEY ARE MY SOLE FOCUS.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll3Quiz1
lines.text: MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.\pWhich costs more?\nThree HARBOR MAILS or one BURN HEAL?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll3Quiz2
lines.text: MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.\pSell one GREAT BALL and buy\none POTION. How much money remains?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll3Quiz3
lines.text: MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.\pDo one REPEL and SODA POP cost\nmore than one SUPER POTION?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll4Intro
lines.text: CLICKETY-CLACK…\nMECHADOLL 4 THAT IS ME!\pMY QUIZ IS AN OBJECT OF BEAUTY.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll4Quiz1
lines.text: MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.\pIn SEASHORE HOUSE, were there more men\nor women?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll4Quiz2
lines.text: MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.\pIn LAVARIDGE TOWN, were there more\nelderly men or elderly women?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll4Quiz3
lines.text: MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.\pIn the TRAINER'S SCHOOL, how many\ngirl students were there?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll5Intro
lines.text: CLICKETY-CLACK…\nMECHADOLL 5 AM I!\pTHE MASTER'S BEST AND PROUDEST\nACHIEVEMENT AM I.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll5Quiz1
lines.text: MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.\pIn SLATEPORT's POKéMON FAN CLUB,\nhow many POKéMON were there?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll5Quiz2
lines.text: MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.\pIn FORTREE CITY, how many\ntree houses were there?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll5Quiz3
lines.text: MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.\pOn the CYCLING ROAD, how many\nTRIATHLETES were there?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
lines.text: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER is my life.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaIntro
lines.text: When I heard there was a strange\nhouse, I had to check it out.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaDefeat
lines.text: I've discovered a tough TRAINER!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaPostBattle
lines.text: I'm sure having a good time checking\nthis place out.\pIt's a challenge I've found worth\nrepeating!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyIntro
lines.text: Maybe I could get my BIRD POKéMON\nto fly over the wall…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyDefeat
lines.text: Gwaaah! I blew it!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyPostBattle
lines.text: Ehehehe… I guess I lost because\nI was trying to cheat.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianIntro
lines.text: I'm getting dizzy from these rotating\ndoors…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianDefeat
lines.text: Everything's spinning around and\naround. I can't take this anymore…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianPostBattle
lines.text: You don't seem to be affected at all.\nOr do you have your poker face on?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
lines.text: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER is huggable.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaIntro
lines.text: The TRICK MASTER always vanishes\nlike smoke. How does he do it?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaDefeat
lines.text: Aiyeeeh! You're much too strong!\nHow do you do it?$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaPostBattle
lines.text: I wish I could appear and disappear as\nif I were smoke, too.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaIntro
lines.text: Going around the same spot…\nIt begets ill fortune…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaDefeat
lines.text: Defeated!\nIt's a bad sign…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaPostBattle
lines.text: I've circled the same spot over ten\ntimes now… It's ill fortune…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisIntro
lines.text: Whoever wins will get through here\nfirst. That's the feeling I get.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisDefeat
lines.text: Oh!\nWell, go ahead, then!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisPostBattle
lines.text: You're solving all the puzzles in the\nTRICK HOUSE. That's the feeling I get.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaIntro
lines.text: Nufufufu, here at last!\nLet's get right with it!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaDefeat
lines.text: You're so casual about winning!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaPostBattle
lines.text: Humph! I'm not upset!\nNot me!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroIntro
lines.text: I ever so closely watched you coming!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroDefeat
lines.text: This outcome I didn't see coming…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroPostBattle
lines.text: Well, anyway, we both picked a weird\nplace to get acquainted.\pAs one weirdo to another,\nlet's do our best!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettIntro
lines.text: It's awfully cramped in here…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettDefeat
lines.text: Oh, yes, strong you are.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettPostBattle
lines.text: I was hoping to switch places with you\nwhen I beat you, but…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
lines.text: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER I love.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentIntro
lines.text: Not many TRAINERS have made it\nthis far.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentDefeat
lines.text: That must mean you're tough, too…$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentPostBattle
lines.text: You've beaten the POKéMON LEAGUE\nCHAMPION? That's too much!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraIntro
lines.text: Consider yourself lucky to be\nbattling me!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraDefeat
lines.text: This isn't right!\nI can't lose!$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraPostBattle
lines.text: It's a miracle that you beat me.\nYou can brag about it.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyIntro
lines.text: You've been slugging through the TRICK\nHOUSE challenge, too.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyDefeat
lines.text: I see…\nYou possess an extraordinary style.$

lines.label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyPostBattle
lines.text: Seeing someone like you should please\nthe TRICK MASTER.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BattleOurFamily
lines.text: Hello! I take it you're a traveler.\pHow's this? What do you say to taking\non our family of four in a series of\lPOKéMON battles?$

lines.label: Route111_Text_IsThatSo
lines.text: Is that so?\nDrop in, if you change your mind!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_VictorIntro
lines.text: That's the spirit! I like you!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_VictorDefeat
lines.text: Aiyah!\nYou're a lot tougher than I expected!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_VictorPostBattle
lines.text: Hey, all!\nI've found a pretty strong TRAINER!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro
lines.text: Oh, my goodness! Aren't you young?\pYou must be quite the TRAINER to beat\nmy husband, though.\pIt's my turn to battle now!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_VictoriaDefeat
lines.text: Oh, gosh!\nI can't get over how strong you are!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_VictoriaPostBattle
lines.text: There's a strong TRAINER here!\nThis one's really strong!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_ViviIntro
lines.text: You're stronger than Mommy? Wow!\pBut I'm strong, too!\nReally! Honestly!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_ViviDefeat
lines.text: Huh? Did I just lose?$

lines.label: Route111_Text_ViviPostBattle
lines.text: This stinks…\p…Snivel… Grandma!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_VickyIntro
lines.text: How dare you make my granddaughter\ncry!\pFor that, I'm going to smack you!\nPrepare to lose!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_VickyDefeat
lines.text: Kwah! You are strong…\nMy granddaughter was right…$

lines.label: Route111_Text_VickyPostBattle
lines.text: If you're not in any hurry,\nvisit with us awhile.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_ToughToKeepWinningUpTheRanks
lines.text: If you don't raise your POKéMON some\nmore, it could be tough to keep winning\lup through the ranks.\pI've heard the POKéMON LEAGUE's\nELITE FOUR are far stronger than\lany GYM LEADER.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_WinstrateFamilyDestroyedMe
lines.text: I challenged the WINSTRATE family,\nbut four matches in a row is tough\lgoing… They destroyed me.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_RouteSignMauville
lines.text: ROUTE 111\n{DOWN_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY$

lines.label: Route111_Text_WinstrateHouseSign
lines.text: “Our family's hearts beat as one!”\nTHE WINSTRATE'S HOUSE$

lines.label: Route111_Text_RouteSign112
lines.text: ROUTE 111\n{LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 112$

lines.label: Route111_Text_RouteSign113
lines.text: ROUTE 111\n{LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 113$

lines.label: Route111_Text_OldLadysRestStopSign
lines.text: OLD LADY'S REST STOP\n“Come in and rest your tired bones.”$

lines.label: Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pOne of the indicators of a POKéMON's\npowerfulness is SP. ATK. It stands for\l“SPECIAL ATTACK.”\pLikewise, SP. DEF stands for “SPECIAL\nDEFENSE.”$

lines.label: Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundHere
lines.text: There should be a tower made of sand\naround here somewhere.\pBut for some reason, it can be seen\nsometimes, and sometimes not.\pThat's why I call it the MIRAGE TOWER.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
lines.text:
I see it!
The tower of sand!\pThe sand tower they called a mirage
is clearly visible!\pBut it looks so fragile…
It could crumble away anytime…\pI want to go inside it, but I can't
get my courage up for it…$

lines.label: Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedDown
lines.text:
Whoa…
That was shocking.\pSand rained down in chunks all of
a sudden.\pWhat was it like inside?
Were there sandy ghosts and such?$

lines.label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerHasntBeenSeenSince
lines.text: Since I spoke to you, the tower of sand\nhasn't been seen.\pPerhaps it really was\nthe MIRAGE TOWER…$

lines.label: Route111_Text_ClawFossilDisappeared
lines.text: The CLAW FOSSIL disappeared into\nthe sand…$

lines.label: Route111_Text_RootFossilDisappeared
lines.text: The ROOT FOSSIL disappeared into\nthe sand…$

lines.label: Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeRockSmash
lines.text: Oh, no!\pMy uncle in MAUVILLE told me to take\nROCK SMASH with me if I was going to\lROUTE 111!\pMy uncle? He lives across from\nthe bike shop in MAUVILLE.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_TrainerHillSign
lines.text: {RIGHT_ARROW} TRAINER HILL ENTRANCE\p“Scale the heights, you hot-blooded\nTRAINERS!”$

lines.label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_RestUpHere
lines.text: Oh, dear, dear.\nAren't your POKéMON exhausted?\pIf you'd like, rest up here.\nThat's a fine idea! You should do that.$

lines.label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_TakeYourTimeRestUp
lines.text: That's right.\nTake your time and rest up!$

lines.label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_StillTiredTakeAnotherRest
lines.text: Oh, dear, dear.\nAre your POKéMON still tired?\pYou should take another rest here.\nThat's a fine idea. You should do that.$

lines.label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_DontNeedToBeShy
lines.text: Is that so?\nYou don't need to be shy about it.$

lines.label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySonIsStrongerThanYou
lines.text:
You're the first TRAINER I've seen who
deploys POKéMON so masterfully.\pBut, I should tell you--my son is
stronger than you.\pHe even took the POKéMON LEAGUE
challenge, I'll have you know.$

lines.label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_LikeYouToHaveMachoBrace
lines.text: We use this MACHO BRACE to more\neffectively strengthen our POKéMON\lin training.\pSince you've beaten all of us here,\nI don't know if you need it, but we\lwould like you to have our MACHO BRACE.$

lines.label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_PassionateAboutBattles
lines.text: When it comes to POKéMON battles,\nwe tend to be pretty passionate.$

lines.label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
lines.text: Mommy is stronger than Daddy.\pI'm stronger than Mommy.\pAnd Grandma's stronger than me!\pBut my big brother is even stronger\nthan Grandma.$

lines.label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
lines.text:
There's no question that you're strong.\pBut if you were to battle my grandson,
you'd end up crying in frustration.\pHe's much stronger than any TRAINER
our family knows.\pHe must be challenging the POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.\pKnowing my grandson, he could be the
CHAMPION already!$

lines.label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrongShort
lines.text: My grandson must be challenging the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.\pKnowing my grandson, he could be the\nCHAMPION already!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_LeaderGoingToAwakenThing
lines.text: Hey, man, is our leader really going\nto awaken that thing?$

lines.label: Route112_Text_YeahWeNeedMeteorite
lines.text: Sounds like it, yeah. But I heard\nwe need a METEORITE to do it.$

lines.label: Route112_Text_OhThatsWhyCrewWentToFallarbor
lines.text: Oh, I get it now. That's why the rest\nof the crew went out to FALLARBOR.$

lines.label: Route112_Text_CantLetAnyonePassUntilTheyreBack
lines.text: You got it. And until they come back,\nwe're not to let anyone pass, right.$

lines.label: Route112_Text_NotEasyToGetBackToLavaridge
lines.text: Eh, I'd like to get to MAUVILLE, but if\nI went down these ledges, it'd be no\leasy matter to get back to LAVARIDGE.$

lines.label: Route112_Text_MtChimneyCableCarSign
lines.text: MT. CHIMNEY CABLE CAR\n“A short walk {UP_ARROW} way!”$

lines.label: Route112_Text_MtChimneySign
lines.text: MT. CHIMNEY\p“For LAVARIDGE TOWN or the summit,\nplease take the CABLE CAR.”$

lines.label: Route112_Text_RouteSignLavaridge
lines.text: ROUTE 112\n{LEFT_ARROW} LAVARIDGE TOWN$

lines.label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarReadyGetOn
lines.text: The CABLE CAR is ready to go up.\nWould you like to be on it?$

lines.label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_StepThisWay
lines.text: Please step this way.$

lines.label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnotherTime
lines.text: Please ride with us another time.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_AshCanBeFashionedIntoGlass
lines.text: Wahahaha! Today's technology is a\nwondrous thing!\pTake this volcanic ash here.\nIt can be fashioned into glass.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_FunWalkingThroughAsh
lines.text: It's fun walking through the volcano's\nashes on the ground and grass.\pYou can see where you walked--it's\nreally neat!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_RouteSign111
lines.text: ROUTE 113\n{RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 111$

lines.label: Route113_Text_RouteSignFallarbor
lines.text: ROUTE 113\n{LEFT_ARROW} FALLARBOR TOWN$

lines.label: Route113_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterKeyItems
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pYou may register one of the KEY ITEMS\nin your BAG as SELECT.\pSimply press SELECT to use\nthe registered item conveniently.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_GlassWorkshopSign
lines.text: GLASS WORKSHOP\n“Turning Volcanic Ash into Glass Items”$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAshWithThis
lines.text: This area is covered in volcanic ash,\nhuff-puff!\pI'm specially gifted, huff-puff.\pI make glass out of volcanic ash\nand make items, huff-puff.\pGo collect ashes with this, huff-puff.$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_ExplainSootSack
lines.text:
Just take that SOOT SACK and walk
through piles of ash, huff-puff.\pAnd it will fill up with the volcanic ash,
huff-puff.\pOnce you think you've collected a good
amount, come see me, huff-puff.$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_LetsSeeCollectedAshes
lines.text: Have you collected ashes, huff-puff?\nLet me see, huff-puff.$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshNeedX
lines.text: Hmmm…\nThere's not enough ash here, huff-puff.\lI can't make glass with this, huff-puff.\pLet's see… {STR_VAR_1} is the number of steps\nyou'll need to walk for me to make you\la BLUE FLUTE, huff-puff.$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichGlassItemWoudYouLike
lines.text: Oh!\nYou've got a lot of ashes, huff-puff!\pI'll make you a glass item, huff-puff!\nWhich one would you like, huff-puff?$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IsThatTheItemForYou
lines.text: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff?\nIs that the one for you, huff-puff?$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichWouldYouLike
lines.text: Which one would you like, huff-puff?$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IllMakeItemForYou
lines.text: A {STR_VAR_1} it is, then, huff-puff!\pOkay! I'll make it for you, huff-puff.\nJust wait a little while, huff-puff.$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
lines.text:
A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff?\pThere's not enough ash here to make
that, though, huff-puff.\pLet's see… {STR_VAR_2} is the number of steps
you'll need to walk through volcanic ash\lfor me to make that item, huff-puff.\pWhich item would you rather have me
make instead, huff-puff?$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_AllThatAshButDontWantAnything
lines.text: You've collected all that ash, but you\ndon't want anything, huff-puff?$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IveFinishedGlassItem
lines.text: Ah, I've finished your {STR_VAR_1}.\nTake it, huff-puff.$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInBag
lines.text: Oh?\nYou've no room in your BAG, huff-puff.\pI'll hold on to it, so come back later,\nhuff-puff.$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInPC
lines.text: Oh?\nYou've no room in your PC, huff-puff?\pI'll hold on to it, so come back later,\nhuff-puff.$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_HaventGotYourSootSack
lines.text: Hah? You haven't got your SOOT SACK\nwith you, huff-puff.\pYou have to keep it with you to collect\nvolcanic ash, huff-puff.$

lines.label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_FunToBlowGlassFlute
lines.text: It's fun to blow a glass flute while\nmy boss is talking.\pHuff-huff! Puff-puff!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_AllMyMonDoesIsRoarTakeThis
lines.text: All my POKéMON does is ROAR…\nNo one dares to come near me…\pSigh… If you would, please take\nthis TM away…$

lines.label: Route114_Text_ExplainRoar
lines.text: TM05 contains ROAR.\nA ROAR sends POKéMON scurrying.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_Poochyena
lines.text: Bow! Bowwow!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_MeteorFallsSign
lines.text: METEOR FALLS\nRUSTBORO CITY THROUGH HERE$

lines.label: Route114_Text_FossilManiacsHouseSign
lines.text: FOSSIL MANIAC'S HOUSE\n“Fossils gratefully accepted!”$

lines.label: Route114_Text_LanettesHouse
lines.text: LANETTE'S HOUSE$

lines.label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThisToDigLikeMyBrother
lines.text:
My big brother's the FOSSIL MANIAC…
He's a nice guy who loves FOSSILS…\pHe loves digging holes, too…
He dug this hole by himself…\pYou can have this, so you can DIG
holes just like my big brother…$

lines.label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_DigReturnsYouToEntrance
lines.text: If you make a POKéMON DIG inside a\ncave, you're returned to the entrance…$

lines.label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_RocksFillDisplayCase
lines.text: Rocks in peculiar shapes fill\nthe display case…$

lines.label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_CrammedWithBooks
lines.text: THE COMPOSITION OF STRATA…\nHOW RAIN SHAPES THE LAND…\lSTONES, SOIL, AND ROCK…\pIt's crammed with books.$

lines.label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_LookInDesertForFossils
lines.text:
I'm the FOSSIL MANIAC…
I'm a nice guy who loves FOSSILS…\pDo you want a FOSSIL?\pBut the FOSSILS around these parts all
belong to me… None for you…\pIf you can't bear to go without
a FOSSIL, look in a desert where there\lare boulders and sand that may hide\lFOSSILS…$

lines.label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_DevonCorpRevivingFossils
lines.text:
You found a FOSSIL, didn't you?
That's so nice… It's so dreamy…\pWhat are you going to do with that
FOSSIL?\pFrom what I've heard, DEVON is doing
research on reviving POKéMON from\lFOSSILS…\pI love my FOSSILS, so I would never
do anything like that…$

lines.label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_FossilsAreWonderful
lines.text: FOSSILS are so… Wonderful…\nIt's so dreamy…$

lines.label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_NotSafeThatWay
lines.text:
Oh…
It's not safe that way…\pI was digging away, you see…
When the whole wall collapsed…\pI think there's a giant cavern
underneath now…\pBut I've left it alone because I don't
think there are any FOSSILS there…$

lines.label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
lines.text: LANETTE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI'm sorry everything is so cluttered…\nWhen I get engrossed in research,\lthings end up this way…\pThis is embarrassing… Please keep\nthis a secret in exchange for this.$

lines.label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYourBoxes
lines.text: May I offer advice about my POKéMON\nStorage System?\pYou should organize your BOXES so you\ncan tell which POKéMON are in them.$

lines.label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
lines.text: It's LANETTE's research notes.\nThere's information about BOXES.\pDesign BOXES to hold 30 POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER should be able to store\n420 POKéMON on the PC system.\pKeep reading?$

lines.label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
lines.text: A marking system should be added to\nmake POKéMON easier to organize.\pThe name and wallpaper design of each\nBOX will be made changeable to please\lthe stored POKéMON.\pKeep reading?$

lines.label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
lines.text:
When storing a POKéMON, it should be
sent to the BOX inspected last.\pIf that BOX is full, the received
POKéMON is stored in the next BOX.\pIn other words, when a BOX is examined,
it is automatically selected as the BOX\lto which POKéMON are sent.$

lines.label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ClosedTheNotebook
lines.text: {PLAYER} closed the notebook.$

lines.label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
lines.text:
There's an e-mail from someone on
the PC.\p“… … … … … … …\p“Your Storage System offers more
convenience than mine.\p“It has a lot of user-friendly features
that make it fun and useful, too.\p“It makes me proud that I played
a part in its development.\p“Here's hoping that you'll continue
research in Storage Systems.\p“From BILL
… … … … … … … …”$

lines.label: Route115_Text_NeverKnowWhenCavePokemonWillAppear
lines.text: Exploring a cave isn't like walking\non a road.\pYou never know when wild POKéMON will\nappear. It's full of suspense.$

lines.label: Route115_Text_RouteSignRustboro
lines.text: ROUTE 115\n{DOWN_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY$

lines.label: Route115_Text_MeteorFallsSign
lines.text: METEOR FALLS\nFALLARBOR TOWN THROUGH HERE$

lines.label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
lines.text: Ohhh, what am I to do?\pWe were on our walk, PEEKO and I, when\nwe were jumped by an odd thug…\pThe scoundrel made off with my\ndarling PEEKO!\pWrrrooooooaaaar! PEEKO!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_WantToDigTunnel
lines.text: Nnn… Roar!\pI want to dig that tunnel!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
lines.text:
Nnn… Roar!
What's going on?\pI was digging the tunnel without any
tools when some goon ordered me out!\pThat tunnel's filled with POKéMON
that react badly to loud noises.\lThey could cause an uproar.\pThat's why we stopped using heavy
equipment for tunneling…\pI'm worried that the goon will do
something stupid and startle the\lPOKéMON into an uproar.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_GoonHightailedItOutOfTunnel
lines.text: Nnn… Roar!\pThat goofy goon hightailed it out of\nthe tunnel! I can go back to digging!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
lines.text:
Oh! It's you!\pYou're that person who not only helped
me in PETALBURG WOODS, but also got\lback my stolen package and then even\lgraciously delivered it to SLATEPORT!\pCAPT. STERN informed us that the
package arrived, too!\pI thank you very, very much!\pWhy, if I were a rain cloud, I would
shower you with gratitude and hail\lyou as a hero!\pFor you, the most wonderful TRAINER,
I bear good news!\pRecently, our company developed
a new kind of POKé BALL.\pAs a token of our appreciation, this
is our gift to our wonderful TRAINER!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_NewBallAvailableAtMart
lines.text: Our new POKé BALL will be available\nat the POKéMON MART in RUSTBORO.\pPlease do try it out!\nThank you and bye-bye!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_BagIsJamPacked
lines.text: Your BAG is jam-packed.\nI can't give you this REPEAT BALL.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_TokenOfAppreciation
lines.text: As a token of our appreciation for\nyour delivering our package, I have\la gift of a new kind of POKé BALL\lfor our most wonderful TRAINER!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_CanYouHelpMeFindGlasses
lines.text: I dropped my glasses…\nCan you help me find them?$

lines.label: Route116_Text_MayISeeThoseGlasses
lines.text: Those glasses!\nMay I see them for a second?$

lines.label: Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingForMaybeTheyArentHere
lines.text: Hmm…\nThese are BLACKGLASSES.\lThey're not what I'm looking for…\pMaybe my glasses aren't around\nhere…$

lines.label: Route116_Text_CantFindGlassesNotHere
lines.text: Hmm…\nI can't find my glasses anywhere…\lMaybe they're not around here…$

lines.label: Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingFor
lines.text: Hmm…\nThese are BLACKGLASSES.\lThey're not what I'm looking for…$

lines.label: Route116_Text_RouteSignRustboro
lines.text: ROUTE 116\n{LEFT_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY$

lines.label: Route116_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
lines.text: RUSTURF TUNNEL\n“Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF\p“The tunnel project has been\ncanceled.”$

lines.label: Route116_Text_TunnelersRestHouse
lines.text: TUNNELER'S REST HOUSE$

lines.label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolution
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pIf you want to stop a POKéMON from\nevolving, press the B Button while it\lis trying to evolve.\lThe startled POKéMON will stop.\pThis is called an evolution cancel.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pYour BAG has several POCKETS.\pItems you obtain are automatically\nplaced in the appropriate POCKETS.\pNo TRAINER can afford to be without\na BAG of their own.$

lines.label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_WeHadToStopBoring
lines.text:
That RUSTURF TUNNEL there…\pAt first, we had a huge work crew boring
through rock with the latest machinery.\lBut, we had to stop.\pIt turns out that we would have had
a negative effect on wild POKéMON in\lthe area.\pSo, we've got nothing to do but loll
around here doing nothing.$

lines.label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_ManDiggingHisWayToVerdanturf
lines.text: There's a man digging his way to\nVERDANTURF all by his lonesome.\lHe's desperate to get through.\pHe says that if he digs little by little\nwithout using machines, he won't\ldisturb POKéMON, and he'll avoid\lharming the natural environment.\pI wonder if he made it through yet.$

lines.label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_GetToVerdanturfWithoutTunnel
lines.text: To get to VERDANTURF without using\nthis TUNNEL, you'd have to cross the\lsea to DEWFORD, sail on to SLATEPORT,\lthen travel through MAUVILLE.$

lines.label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_TunnelHasGoneThrough
lines.text: Did you hear? The TUNNEL to VERDANTURF\nhas gone through!\pSometimes, if you hope strongly enough,\ndreams do come true.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_DayCarePokemonHadNewMove
lines.text: I left my POKéMON at the DAY CARE.\pWhen I got it back, it had a new move\nthat I didn't teach it.\lI was really, really surprised.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty
lines.text: What do you think?\nAren't these flowers pretty?\pI planted them all!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_AirIsTastyHere
lines.text: The air is tasty here!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_RouteSignVerdanturf
lines.text: ROUTE 117\n{LEFT_ARROW} VERDANTURF TOWN$

lines.label: Route117_Text_RouteSignMauville
lines.text: ROUTE 117\n{RIGHT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY$

lines.label: Route117_Text_DayCareSign
lines.text: POKéMON DAY CARE\n“Let us raise your POKéMON.”$

lines.label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
lines.text:
STEVEN: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pIt's me, STEVEN!
We met in the cave near DEWFORD.\pHave you met many kinds of POKéMON
since I last saw you?\pThere are many, many kinds of POKéMON
in this wide world of ours.\pIf you wanted to raise only your
favorites, that's fine.\pPerhaps you find it more fun to raise
all sorts of POKéMON.\pAs a TRAINER of POKéMON,
what do you think?\pOf course, it's not any of my business.\pIt would be nice if we were to meet
again somewhere.$

lines.label: Route118_Text_YouAgreeGoodRodIsGood
lines.text: Hmm!\nA GOOD ROD is really good!\pWouldn't you agree?$

lines.label: Route118_Text_IdenticalMindsTakeThis
lines.text: Hmm!\nWe're of identical minds!\pHmm!\nTake this GOOD ROD!$

lines.label: Route118_Text_TryYourLuckFishing
lines.text: Wherever there's water, try your luck\nat fishing.$

lines.label: Route118_Text_DontYouLikeToFish
lines.text: Don't you like to fish?$

lines.label: Route118_Text_TryCatchingMonWithGoodRod
lines.text: Try catching all sorts of POKéMON\nwith your GOOD ROD.$

lines.label: Route118_Text_CanCrossRiversWithSurf
lines.text: Even if there isn't a boat, you can\ncross rivers and the sea if you have\la POKéMON that knows SURF.\pPOKéMON can be counted on to do so\nmuch!$

lines.label: Route118_Text_RouteSignMauville
lines.text: ROUTE 118\n{LEFT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY$

lines.label: Route118_Text_RouteSign119
lines.text: ROUTE 118\n{UP_ARROW} ROUTE 119$

lines.label: Route119_Text_MayIntro
lines.text:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Where were you? I was looking for you!\pHow much stronger have you gotten?
Let me check for you!\pReady with your POKéMON?
Of course you are! Go!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_MayDefeat
lines.text: Achah!\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, you're strong!\pI was worried that you might be\nstruggling with your training.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_MayPresentForYou
lines.text: MAY: But I had absolutely nothing to\nworry about! Keep it up!\pAnd, here! I have a present for you.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_MayExplainFly
lines.text:
MAY: Use FLY, and your POKéMON will
instantly carry you to any town you've\lalready visited.\pBut, to use FLY, you have to get
the GYM BADGE from FORTREE CITY.\lThat's important, so don't forget.\pYou should FLY home and visit
LITTLEROOT for a change.\pI bet your mom's worried about you,
{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pWell, let's meet again somewhere!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_BrendanIntro
lines.text:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! So this is where
you've been looking for POKéMON?\pLet me see how good you got.
I'll test you!\pNow!
It's a battle, so battle!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_BrendanDefeat
lines.text: Hmm…\nYou've gotten pretty darn decent.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_BrendanIllGiveYouThis
lines.text: BRENDAN: I'd say you're good enough\nto search for POKéMON anywhere.\pHere, I'll give you this.\nTry it out.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_BrendanExplainFly
lines.text: BRENDAN: Use FLY, and your POKéMON\ninstantly carries you to any town\lyou've already visited.\pBut you need the FORTREE GYM BADGE \nto do that.\pAnyway, I have to move along.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou
lines.text:
SCOTT: Hahahah!
Way to go, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI just passed by a TRAINER riding
a BIKE.\pYou just beat that TRAINER, didn't you?
It was pretty obvious that you did.\pThe kid looked really upset with
a face all red from anger.\pI sure seem to run into you often.
Are you off to FORTREE GYM next?\pI expect that you'll do well at the GYM.
Well, I'll be seeing you!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_ScottYouWonAtFortreeGym
lines.text:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pSCOTT: Hiya, {PLAYER}{KUN}, it's me!\pJust as I thought, you won at
the FORTREE GYM.\pYour strength…
Perhaps you really are the TRAINER\lthat I've been searching for.\pRemember, you have a fan in me.
I'll be cheering from the sidelines.\lKeep up the great work!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_StayAwayFromWeatherInstitute
lines.text: We're standing lookout here.\pHey, you! Stay away from the WEATHER\nINSTITUTE. It's not safe.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_DontGoNearWeatherInstitute
lines.text: Lookout duty is surprisingly boring.\pHey, you! Please don't go near the\nWEATHER INSTITUTE.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_ThoughtFlyByCatchingBirdMons
lines.text:
I thought you FLY by catching a whole
flock of BIRD POKéMON, and then\lhanging on to them somehow.\pBut it turns out there's an HM move
called FLY!\pI wish I'd known about that a long
time ago…$

lines.label: Route119_Text_TallGrassSnaresBikeTires
lines.text: Tch…\nIt's a no-go…\pThe tall grass snares BIKE tires.\nThere's no way you can cycle here.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_CanYourMonMakeSecretBase
lines.text: Can your POKéMON use its SECRET POWER\non a big pile of grass and make a\lSECRET BASE?$

lines.label: Route119_Text_RouteSignFortree
lines.text: ROUTE 119\n{RIGHT_ARROW} FORTREE CITY$

lines.label: Route119_Text_WeatherInstitute
lines.text: WEATHER INSTITUTE$

lines.label: Route119_Text_TrainerTipsDecoration
lines.text: TRAINER TIPS\pUp to sixteen decorations and\nfurniture items can be placed in\la SECRET BASE.\pPick your favorite items and create\nyour very own SECRET BASE exactly the\lway you want.$

lines.label: Route119_House_Text_RumorAboutCaveOfOrigin
lines.text: I heard about a cave called the CAVE\nOF ORIGIN.\pPeople rumor that the spirits of\nPOKéMON are revived there. Could\lsomething like that really happen?$

lines.label: Route119_House_Text_Wingull
lines.text: WINGULL: Pihyoh!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: The BOSS got interested in\nthe research they have going here,\lso he sent us out.\pYou quit meddling!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Blast it…\nBlasted by a kid…$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: Our BOSS knows everything.\pBut I'm just a GRUNT. What would I know\nabout what he's thinking?$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
lines.text: Huh?\nWhat's a kid doing here?$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
lines.text: Huh?\nI lost?!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
lines.text: Oh, no…\nI'll catch an earful for losing to a kid…\pI should just take a nap in the bed…$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_EveryoneWentUpstairs
lines.text: While I was sleeping, everyone went\nupstairs!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WowYoureStrong
lines.text: Wow, you're really strong!\pI wish I could be a POKéMON TRAINER\nlike you!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_ProfStudyingRain
lines.text:
The PROFESSOR loves rain.
That's a fact.\pBut if it keeps raining, people will be in
trouble. That's another fact.\pAnd thus, the PROFESSOR is studying
if the rain can be put to good use.$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_NoticingAbnormalWeather
lines.text: On the 2nd floor of the INSTITUTE,\nwe study the weather patterns over\lthe HOENN region.\pWe've been noticing temporary and\nisolated cases of droughts and\lheavy rain lately…$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WhatWereAquasUpTo
lines.text: Hello!\nWe've been saved by your actions!\pWhat I don't understand is what on\nearth the AQUAS were up to.$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_TakeRestInBed
lines.text: There's a bed…\nLet's take a rest.$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: The INSTITUTE created a type of\nPOKéMON that has something to do with\lthe weather. We're here to take them!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Our plan's being spoiled by a kid?$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: If the POKéMON they made here can\ncontrol the weather freely, then we of\lTEAM AQUA definitely need it!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3Intro
lines.text: We're TEAM AQUA!\nWe appear wherever anything rare is\lfound!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
lines.text: You got me!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
lines.text: You don't have any idea what we of\nTEAM AQUA are working towards!\lYou stay out of our way!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5Intro
lines.text: Don't tell me you're looking for that\nweather POKéMON, too?\pThat's a no-no!\nWe were here to get it first!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
lines.text: Oh, will you look at my POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
lines.text: Humph, so what?\nWhat we want…\pWhat we really want isn't here…\nIhihihihi…$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyIntro
lines.text:
Ahahahaha!\pYou're going to meddle in TEAM AQUA's
affairs?\pYou're either absolutely fearless,
simply ignorant, or both!\pYou're so cute, you're disgusting!
I'll put you down, kiddy!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyDefeat
lines.text: Ahahahaha!\nYou're disgustingly strong!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyPostBattle
lines.text: It's bad enough to have TEAM MAGMA\nblunder about, but now there's you!\pWhat makes you want to sniff around\nin our business, anyway?$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_TeamMagmaJustPassedBy
lines.text: We have a situation here!\pA TEAM MAGMA mob just passed\nthe WEATHER INSTITUTE.\pThey appear to be headed for\nMT. PYRE!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_WeHaveToHurryToMtPyre
lines.text: What?!\pWe can't waste any more time here!\nWe have to hurry to MT. PYRE, too!\pAhahahaha!\nTEAM MAGMA, just you wait!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ThanksPleaseTakePokemon
lines.text: Thanks!\nThanks to you, we're safe!\pIt might be an odd way of thanking you,\nbut take this POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoRoomForPokemon
lines.text: Hm? You don't seem to have any room\nfor this POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_PlayerReceivedCastform
lines.text: {PLAYER} received CASTFORM!$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_PokemonChangesWithWeather
lines.text: That POKéMON changes shape according\nto the weather conditions.\pThere're plenty of them in the\nINSTITUTE--go ahead and take it.$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ChangingWeatherRidiculous
lines.text: I've been researching rain for many\nyears, but it's ridiculous to think that\lhumans can freely change the weather.$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_GroudonWeather
lines.text:
I track weather patterns over
the HOENN region.\pPresently, a drought has been recorded
in {STR_VAR_1}.\pCould that mean, somewhere near
{STR_VAR_1}…$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_KyogreWeather
lines.text:
I track weather patterns over
the HOENN region.\pPresently, heavy rainfall has been
recorded over {STR_VAR_1}.\pCould that mean, somewhere near
{STR_VAR_1}…$

lines.label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoAbnormalWeather
lines.text: Abnormal weather conditions are\nno longer being reported.\pThe occasional rainfall is a blessing,\nreally.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
lines.text:
STEVEN: Hm? {PLAYER}{KUN}, hi.
It's been a while.\pThere's something here that you can't
see, right?\pNow, if I were to use this device on
the invisible obstacle…\pNo, no. Rather than describing it,
I should just show you.\lThat would be more fun.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON ready for
battle?$

lines.label: Route120_Text_StevenIllWaitHere
lines.text: STEVEN: No?\pI'll wait here, so you can get ready.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_StevenReadyForBattle
lines.text: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON\nready for battle?$

lines.label: Route120_Text_StevenShowMeYourPower
lines.text: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, show me your true\npower as a TRAINER!$

lines.label: Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope
lines.text: STEVEN used the DEVON SCOPE.\pAn invisible POKéMON became completely\nvisible!\pThe startled POKéMON attacked!$

lines.label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
lines.text:
STEVEN: I see…
Your battle style is intriguing.\pYour POKéMON have obviously grown
since I first met you in DEWFORD.\pI'd like you to have this
DEVON SCOPE.\pWho knows, there may be other
concealed POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
lines.text: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI enjoy seeing POKéMON and TRAINERS\nwho strive together.\pI think you're doing great.\pWell, let's meet again somewhere.$

lines.label: Kecleon_Text_SomethingUnseeable
lines.text: Something unseeable is in the way.$

lines.label: Kecleon_Text_WantToUseDevonScope
lines.text: Something unseeable is in the way.\pWant to use the DEVON SCOPE?$

lines.label: Kecleon_Text_UseDevonScopeMonAttacked
lines.text: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.\pAn invisible POKéMON became completely\nvisible!\pThe startled POKéMON attacked!$

lines.label: Route120_Text_RouteSignFortree
lines.text: ROUTE 120\n{LEFT_ARROW} FORTREE CITY$

lines.label: Route120_Text_RouteSign121
lines.text: {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 121\n{LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 120$

lines.label: Route121_Text_OkayMoveOutToMtPyre
lines.text: Okay!\nWe're to move out to MT. PYRE!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_AheadLoomsMtPyre
lines.text: Ahead looms MT. PYRE…\pIt is a natural monument to the spirits \nof departed POKéMON…$

lines.label: Route121_Text_MtPyrePierSign
lines.text: MT. PYRE PIER\p…The sign is old and worn out.\nThe words are barely legible…$

lines.label: Route121_Text_SafariZoneSign
lines.text: “Filled with rare POKéMON!”\nSAFARI ZONE$

lines.label: Route123_Text_LoveGrassMonsHaveAny
lines.text: I love GRASS-type POKéMON!\pDo you have any GRASS-type POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route123_Text_YouLikeGrassMonsTooHaveThis
lines.text: Oh?\pYou like GRASS-type POKéMON, too,\ndon't you?\pI'm so happy, you can have this!\nIt's a token of our friendship.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_CheckTreesWithMyGrassMon
lines.text: I check trees with my GRASS-type\nPOKéMON. I'm like a tree doctor.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_RouteSign
lines.text: {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 123\n{LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 118$

lines.label: Route123_Text_RouteSignMtPyre
lines.text: {UP_ARROW} MT. PYRE\n“Forbidden to the faint of heart.”$

lines.label: Route123_Text_BerryMastersHouse
lines.text: BERRY MASTER'S HOUSE$

lines.label: Route124_Text_HuntersHouse
lines.text: HUNTER'S HOUSE$

lines.label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_Greeting
lines.text: I'm the DIVING TREASURE HUNTER!\pI'm the awesome dude who makes\ndeep-sea dives to gather treasures\lresting at the bottom.$

lines.label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_HaveYouSeenAnyShards
lines.text: Tell me, have you seen any SHARDS of\ntools made in ancient times?$

lines.label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YouHaventGotAnyShards
lines.text: You haven't got any treasures\nfor me…\pIf you see any SHARDS, like the RED\nSHARD, you've got to trade it with me!$

lines.label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ThatsAShardIllTradeYou
lines.text: Oh, hey! That…\nThat's a SHARD! I'm looking for those!\pOh, man, you've got to trade that\nwith me! I'll give you something good!$

lines.label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_WhatDoYouWantToTrade
lines.text: What do you want to trade?$

lines.label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YoullTradeShardForStone
lines.text: You'll trade your {STR_VAR_1} for\nmy {STR_VAR_2}, then?$

lines.label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ItsADeal
lines.text: It's a done deal!\nUse that wisely!$

lines.label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_TradeSomethingElse
lines.text: Do you want to trade something else?$

lines.label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_BagFull
lines.text: Whoops, your BAG's full.\nGet rid of some items, friend!$

lines.label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ComeBackIfYouChangeMind
lines.text: No? That's a downer.\nWell, if you change your mind, come back.$

lines.label: Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened
lines.text: ARCHIE: What happened…\nWhat is this wretched scene…\pDid I…make a horrible mistake?$

lines.label: Route128_Text_ArchieIOnlyWanted
lines.text: I…\nI only wanted…$

lines.label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
lines.text:
MAXIE: Do you understand now,
ARCHIE?\pDo you finally see how disastrous
your dream turned out to be?\pWe have to hurry! We have to do
something before the situation goes\lcompletely out of control!$

lines.label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
lines.text:
MAXIE: {PLAYER}, don't say anything.\pI know that I have no right to be
critical of ARCHIE…\pBut the way things are now, I doubt
that we humans will be capable of\ldoing anything about it.\pBut neither can we stand by and
just watch helplessly.\pThe responsibility for putting an end
to this falls to ARCHIE and me…$

lines.label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
lines.text: MAXIE: This defies belief…\pThose super-ancient POKéMON…\pTheir power is unbelievable.\nThey've upset the balance of nature…$

lines.label: Route128_Text_StevenWhatIsHappening
lines.text: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nWhat is happening?$

lines.label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
lines.text:
This is terrible…\pAfter the scorching heat wave ended,
this deluge began.\pIf this doesn't stop, all of HOENN…
No, the whole world will drown.\pThis huge rain cloud is spreading
from above SOOTOPOLIS…\pWhat in the world is taking place there?\pThere's no point arguing here…
SOOTOPOLIS might provide answers…$

lines.label: Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis
lines.text: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\nI don't know what you intend to do,\lbut don't do anything reckless.\pOkay.\nI'm going to SOOTOPOLIS.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_WeShortenItToDevon
lines.text: The DEVON CORPORATION…\nWe all just shorten it to DEVON.\pThat company makes all sorts of\nconvenient products.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_SneakyLookingManWentAroundCorner
lines.text: Hm? A sneaky-looking man?\pCome to think of it, yes, a shady-\nlooking guy went around the corner.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_HaveYouChallengedGym
lines.text: Have you taken the POKéMON GYM\nchallenge?\pWhen you get that shiny GYM BADGE\nin hand, I guess TRAINERS begin to\lrealize what is required of them.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_HeyThatsRustborosGymBadge
lines.text: Hey, that's RUSTBORO's GYM BADGE!\pOut of all the POKéMON GYM BADGES,\nRUSTBORO's is the coolest, I'd say.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_YoureNewAroundHere
lines.text: Oh? Who might you be?\nYou're a new face around these parts.\pHave you just transferred into the\nPOKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_GymLeaderIsntEasyWithFire
lines.text: I challenged the GYM LEADER, but…\pIt's not going to be easy winning with\nmy FIRE-type POKéMON…\pFIRE-type POKéMON don't match up\nwell against ROCK-type POKéMON…$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyWalksInTheTunnel
lines.text: The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in\na cottage by the sea.\pHe goes for walks in the tunnel every\nso often.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyLovesPeeko
lines.text:
The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in
a cottage by the sea.\pHe said he was going shopping in
SLATEPORT for his pet, PEEKO.\pThat old sea dog, he must really love
that PEEKO.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_WowYouHavePokemon
lines.text: Wow, you have POKéMON with you, too.\pWhen I get bigger, I'm going to go\nplaces with POKéMON, too.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_CatchRarePokemonIfIGoToSchool
lines.text: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL!\pIf I go to this school, will I be able\nto catch rare POKéMON easily?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_PokemonCanChangeLookFromExp
lines.text: If a POKéMON gains experience in\nbattles, it can sometimes change in\lthe way it looks.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_PokemonChangeShape
lines.text: A POKéMON changes shape?\nIf one did that, I would be shocked!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_TradePokemonGrowFast
lines.text: A POKéMON you get in a trade from\nsomeone grows fast.\pBut if you don't have certain GYM\nBADGES, it may not obey you…$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_OutOfTheWay
lines.text: Get out!\nOut of the way!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_WaitDontTakeMyGoods
lines.text: Wait! Pleeeaaase!\pDon't take my GOODS!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_HelpMeIWasRobbed
lines.text:
Oh, it's you!\pYou're that fantastic TRAINER who
helped me in PETALBURG WOODS!\pHelp me! I was robbed by TEAM AQUA!
I have to get the DEVON GOODS back!\pIf I don't…
I'm going to be in serious trouble.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_ShadyCharacterTookOffTowardsTunnel
lines.text: That shady character, I think he took\noff towards the tunnel over there.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_YouGotItThankYou
lines.text:
Oh! How did it go?
The DEVON GOODS?\pYou did!
You got them back!\pYou really are a great TRAINER!\pI know! As my thanks, I'll give you
another GREAT BALL!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems
lines.text: You're loaded with items.\nI can't give you this GREAT BALL.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
lines.text: Excuse me, please!\nPlease come with me!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_MayHiLetsRegister
lines.text: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou had a MATCH CALL feature put\non your POKéNAV!\pLet's register each other so we can\ncontact one another anytime!\p… … … … … …$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_RegisteredMay
lines.text: Registered MAY\nin the POKéNAV.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_MayPassedBrineyWantToBattle
lines.text:
MAY: Oh, by the way, I passed
MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.\pI guess he's on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.\pHow's your POKéDEX coming along,
{PLAYER}{KUN}? Mine's looking pretty decent!\pSo…
How about a little battle?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_MayOhHaventRaisedPokemonEnough
lines.text: MAY: Oh, what's the matter?\pHaven't you caught or raised your\nPOKéMON very much?\pThat's not very good for a TRAINER!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_MayWantToBattle
lines.text: MAY: So, what do you think?\nHow about a little battle here?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_MayImNotGoingToLose
lines.text: MAY: You just became a TRAINER,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_MayDefeat
lines.text: Yikes!\nYou're better than I expected!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_MayMrBrineyHint
lines.text: MAY: Oh, by the way, MR. BRINEY, who\nI just passed…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, you just moved here so you\nmight not know this, but MR. BRINEY\lwas once a revered seafarer.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanHiLetsRegister
lines.text: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pYou had a MATCH CALL feature put\non your POKéNAV! Cool!\pLet's register each other so we can\nget in touch anytime!\p… … … … … …$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_RegisteredBrendan
lines.text: Registered BRENDAN\nin the POKéNAV.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWantToBattle
lines.text:
BRENDAN: By the way, {PLAYER}, I walked
by MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.\pI bet he was on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.\p{PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX?
Have you filled in any pages yet?\pMine rules.\pWant to have a battle to test how
far you've progressed?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidenceInPokemon
lines.text: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have\nany confidence in your POKéMON?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanWantToBattle
lines.text: BRENDAN: What's up?\nWant to have a battle with me?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanIWontGoEasy
lines.text: BRENDAN: I know you just became\na TRAINER, but I won't go easy!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanDefeat
lines.text: Hmm…\nYou're pretty good.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanMrBrineyHint
lines.text: BRENDAN: By the way, you know\nMR. BRINEY? The guy I just passed?\pI bet you didn't know this, since you\njust moved here, {PLAYER}, but\lMR. BRINEY was once a great sailor.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_TunnelNearingCompletion
lines.text: “Timesaving tunnel nearing\ncompletion!”\p…Is what it says on the sign, but\nthere's also a big “X” splashed\lacross it in red paint…$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpSign
lines.text: DEVON CORPORATION\p“For all your living needs, we make\nit all.”$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_GymSign
lines.text: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ROXANNE\p“The ROCK-loving honors student!”$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpBranchOfficeSign
lines.text: DEVON CORP. BRANCH OFFICE\p“Access limited to DEVON employees\nand authorized personnel.”$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_CitySign
lines.text: RUSTBORO CITY\p“The city probing the integration of\nnature and science.”$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_TrainersSchoolSign
lines.text: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL\p“We'll teach you anything about\nPOKéMON!”$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_CuttersHouse
lines.text: CUTTER'S HOUSE$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_DevelopedNewPokenavFeature
lines.text: I've been developing an added feature\nfor the POKéNAV…\pAnd it turned out great!\p{PLAYER}, may I see that POKéNAV?\nThe one our PRESIDENT gave you?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_AddedMatchCallPleaseCallMrStone
lines.text:
There you go, {PLAYER}!\pI added a new feature named
MATCH CALL to your POKéNAV.\pUsing the MATCH CALL feature,
you can chat with people who have\lbeen registered in your POKéNAV.\p{PLAYER}, our PRESIDENT STONE should
be registered in your POKéNAV.\pTest it out.
Please give our PRESIDENT a call.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_PleaseSelectPokenav
lines.text: Please select the POKéNAV.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_IdBetterGetBackToWork
