lines.text: Okay, I'd better get back to work.\nPlease take care, {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Text_YouCanHave2On2Battle
lines.text:
Did you know this?\pYou can have a 2-on-2 battle even
if you're not with another TRAINER.\pIf you catch the eyes of two TRAINERS
when you have two or more POKéMON,\lthey'll both challenge you.\pDon't you think it'd be cool if you
could beat two TRAINERS by yourself?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPutThisHMToGoodUse
lines.text:
That determined expression…
That limber way you move…\lAnd your well-trained POKéMON…\pYou're obviously a skilled TRAINER!\pNo, wait, don't say a word.
I can tell just by looking at you.\pI'm sure that you can put this
HIDDEN MACHINE to good use.\pNo need to be modest or shy.
Go on, take it!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_ExplainCut
lines.text:
That HIDDEN MACHINE, or HM for
short, is CUT.\pAn HM move is one that can be used
by POKéMON outside of battle.\pAny POKéMON that's learned CUT can
chop down thin trees if the TRAINER\lhas earned the STONE BADGE.\pAnd, unlike a TM, an HM can be used
more than once.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_DadHelpedClearLandOfTrees
lines.text: When they were expanding the city of\nRUSTBORO, my dad helped out.\pHe made his POKéMON use CUT to clear\nthe land of trees.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_WelcomeToDevonCorp
lines.text: Hello and welcome to the DEVON\nCORPORATION.\pWe're proud producers of items and\nmedicine that enhance your life.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_StaffGotRobbed
lines.text: One of our research staff stupidly\ngot robbed of an important parcel.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ThoseShoesAreOurProduct
lines.text: Hey, those RUNNING SHOES!\nThey're one of our products!\pIt makes me happy when I see someone\nusing something we made.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWasntVeryBright
lines.text: That stolen parcel…\pWell, sure it's important, but it's not\nanything that anyone can use.\pIn my estimation, that robber must not\nhave been very bright.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_SoundsLikeStolenGoodsRecovered
lines.text: It sounds like they've recovered\nthe ripped-off DEVON GOODS.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_OnlyAuthorizedPeopleEnter
lines.text: I'm sorry, only authorized people\nare allowed to enter here.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_HowCouldWeGetRobbed
lines.text: It's beyond stupid.\nHow could we get robbed?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_YoureAlwaysWelcomeHere
lines.text: Hi, there!\nYou're always welcome here!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
lines.text:
Samples of rocks and metal are
displayed in the glass case.\pThere's a panel with some writing
on it…\p“DEVON CORPORATION got its start as
a producer of stones from quarries.\p“The company also produced iron from
filings in the sand.\p“From that humble start as a producer
of raw materials, DEVON developed.\p“DEVON is now a manufacturer of a wide
range of industrial products.”$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDisplay
lines.text:
Prototypes and test products fill
the glass display case.\pThere's a panel with a description…\p“In addition to industrial products,
DEVON now markets sundries and\lpharmaceuticals for better lifestyles.\p“Recently, DEVON has begun marketing
tools for POKéMON TRAINERS, including\lPOKé BALLS and POKéNAV systems.”$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceForTalkingToPokemon
lines.text: We're developing a device for talking\nwith POKéMON.\pBut we haven't had much success…$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopingNewBalls
lines.text: I'm developing new kinds of\nPOKé BALLS…\pBut I haven't made much headway…$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
lines.text:
We finally made new kinds of
POKé BALLS!\pThe REPEAT BALL makes it easier to
catch POKéMON you've caught before.\pThe TIMER BALL gets better at catching
POKéMON the longer a battle runs.\pBoth are proudly developed by
the DEVON CORPORATION.\pPlease give them a try!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePokenav
lines.text: I made the POKéNAV!\pAs an engineer, I feel blessed to have\nmade something so great!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
lines.text:
Oh, wow!
That's a POKéNAV!\pIt came about as a result of our
PRESIDENT's desire to learn about\lthe feelings of POKéMON.\pWould you like me to describe its
features in detail?\pNo, no. I think you'll find out just by
trying the POKéNAV out.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToVisualizePokemonDreams
lines.text: I'm trying to develop a device that\nvisually reproduces the dreams of\lPOKéMON…\pBut it's not going well.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDeviceToResurrectFossils
lines.text: I've been trying to develop a device\nthat resurrects POKéMON from fossils…\pAnd, it's working!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
lines.text:
Wait! That thing you have there…
Is that a POKéMON fossil?\pWould you like to bring that POKéMON
back to life?\pI can with my newly developed
FOSSIL REGENERATOR.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatSo
lines.text: Oh, is that so?\pDEVON's technological expertise\nis outstanding, I tell you.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne
lines.text:
Oh, now that's a surprise!
You have not one, but two, fossils?\pUnfortunately, my machine can only
regenerate one POKéMON at a time.\pWould you like to pick one of your
fossils for regeneration?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFossilToResearcher
lines.text: Excellent!\nLet's do this right away.\p{PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to\nthe DEVON RESEARCHER.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
lines.text:
The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made,
is incredible.\pBut it has one drawback--it takes
a long time to work.\pSo, uh… How about you go for a stroll
and look around for a while?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
lines.text: Thanks for waiting!\pYour fossilized POKéMON has been\nbrought back to life!\pThe fossil was an ancient POKéMON.\n{STR_VAR_2}, it was!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ReceivedMonFromResearcher
lines.text: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_2} from\nthe DEVON RESEARCHER.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TooManyPokemon
lines.text: Uh-oh, you've got too many POKéMON.\nYou have no room for this one.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFeature
lines.text: I'm trying to develop a new feature\nfor the POKéNAV…\pBut it's not going well.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
lines.text:
Well, now what shall I work on
developing next?\pOur company allows us to make our
inspirations into reality.\pOne couldn't ask for a better
environment as an engineer.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
lines.text:
I'm MR. STONE, the PRESIDENT of
the DEVON CORPORATION.\pI'd just got word about you!\pYou saved our staff not just once,
but twice!\pI have a favor to ask of an amazing
person like you.\pI understand that you're delivering
a package to SLATEPORT's SHIPYARD.\pWell, on the way, could you stop off in
DEWFORD TOWN?\pI was hoping that you'd deliver a
LETTER to STEVEN in DEWFORD.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWantYouToHaveThis
lines.text: MR. STONE: Now, you should know that\nI am a great PRESIDENT.\pSo, I'd never be so cheap as to ask\na favor for nothing in return.\pThat's why I want you to have this!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ReceivedPokenav
lines.text: {PLAYER} received a POKéNAV.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
lines.text:
MR. STONE: That device…\pIt's a POKéMON NAVIGATOR, or POKéNAV
for short.\pIt's an indispensable tool for any
TRAINER on an adventure.\pIt has a map of the HOENN region.\pYou can check the locations of
DEWFORD and SLATEPORT easily!\pBy the way, I've heard that sinister
criminals--MAGMA and AQUA, I believe--\lhave been making trouble far and wide.\pI think it would be best if you rested
up before you go on your way.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneGoWithCautionAndCare
lines.text: MR. STONE: Well, then, {PLAYER}{KUN},\ngo with caution and care!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_CountingOnYou
lines.text: MR. STONE: I'm counting on you!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouForDeliveringLetter
lines.text: MR. STONE: You delivered my LETTER?\nThank you kindly!\pThis is my way of thanking you.\nIt should help you, a TRAINER.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainExpShare
lines.text:
MR. STONE: A POKéMON holding that
EXP. SHARE will be given some of the\lEXP Points from battle.\pIt will get EXP Points even if it didn't
actually battle.\pI would say EXP. SHARE is quite useful
for raising weak POKéMON.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamiliarWithTrends
lines.text:
MR. STONE: Since my youth, I've immersed
myself in work.\pConsequently, I'm not familiar with
trends and that sort of thing.\pBut do young people all want to be
TRAINERS in the POKéMON LEAGUE?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
lines.text:
This is the DEVON CORPORATION's
third floor.\pOur PRESIDENT's OFFICE is on
this floor.\pAnyway, I can't tell you how much I'm
grateful for what you've done.\pUm… By the way, that parcel
you got back for us…\pCould I get you to deliver that to
the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT?\pIt would be awful if those robbers
tried to take it again.\pUh… Hehehe, so, uh, could I count
on you to do that for me?\pOh, that's right.
Could you wait here a second?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithPresidentComeWithMe
lines.text: Our PRESIDENT would like to have\na word with you.\pPlease come with me.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_PleaseGoAhead
lines.text: Please, go ahead.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_VisitCaptSternShipyard
lines.text: If you visit the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT,\nyou should go see CAPT. STERN.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RepeatAndTimerHugelyPopular
lines.text: DEVON's new products, the REPEAT BALL\nand TIMER BALL, have become hugely\lpopular among TRAINERS.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RareRocksDisplay
lines.text: It's a collection of rare rocks and\nstones assembled by the PRESIDENT.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_EveryPokemonHasAbility
lines.text: Every POKéMON has a special ability\nthat it can use.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_PokemonStrange
lines.text: POKéMON are such strange creatures.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ComingUpWithMealsIsHard
lines.text:
Oh, it's so hard every day…\pWhat's hard?
You need to ask?\pIt's trying to figure out what to
make for meals every day.\pIt really isn't easy coming up with
meals every day.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKnowFunnyPhrase
lines.text:
Oh, hello!
Welcome to the PEPPER household.\pI have a question for you.
Have you ever baby-sat?\pYou see, I'm a new father, so raising
a child is all new to me.\pAnd I have a problem. My daughter
WALDA doesn't laugh enough.\pI think she'd laugh for me if I told
her something funny.\pDo you know of a funny word or
phrase you can tell me?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_BeenSayingXDoYouKnowBetterPhrase
lines.text: I've been saying “{STR_VAR_1}”\nto amuse her lately.\pDo you know of a better word or\na phrase that might work?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_WonderfulLetsHearSuggestion
lines.text: Oh, that's wonderful.\nSo, let's hear it, your suggestion.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhIsThatRight
lines.text: Oh, is that right?\pWell, if you come up with a good\nsuggestion, I'm all ears.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATry2
lines.text: Ah, I see.\nWell, let's give it a try, shall we?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhShesLaughing
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pOh, yes! She's laughing!\nOh, I am as delighted as she!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATry
lines.text: Ah, I see.\nWell, let's give it a try, shall we?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilingAtAll
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pHmmm… She's not smiling at all.\nMaybe WALDA is one serious child…$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThinkOfMyOwnPhrase
lines.text: Oh, so you don't know any good words.\nI'd better think for myself, then.\pHmm…\nHow about “{STR_VAR_1}”?\lLet's see if that will work.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilingAtAll2
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pHmmm… She's not smiling at all.\nMaybe WALDA is one serious child…$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhYouDontKnowAny
lines.text: Oh, so you don't know any good words.\nI guess I'll try to amuse her with\lthe saying I used before.\pAnyways, if you have a good suggestion,\ndon't hesitate in telling me, okay?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGiveYouWallpaper
lines.text:
Thank you!\pThanks to you, my darling WALDA
laughed for me!\pActually, I may not look all that
special, but I'm one of DEVON\lCORPORATION's top researchers.\pSo, how about I do something in return
for you?\pI know, I'll add some new wallpaper
patterns for the BOXES in the PC\lPOKéMON Storage System.\pIn the wallpaper pattern menu,
select “FRIENDS.”\pThat will give you access to the new
wallpaper patterns.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ItsAPokemonPlushDoll
lines.text: It's a POKéMON plush DOLL!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_DevonWorkersLiveHere
lines.text: DEVON CORPORATION's workers live in\nthis building.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_Skitty
lines.text: SKITTY: Gyaaaah!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_DevonWasTinyInOldDays
lines.text: Way back in the old days, DEVON was just\na teeny, tiny company.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDaddyMadeThisYouCanHaveIt
lines.text: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.\pMy daddy made this!\nBut I can't use it, so you can have it.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_GoingToWorkAtDevonToo
lines.text: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.\pWhen I grow up, I'm going to work for\nDEVON, too.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentCollectsRareStones
lines.text: DEVON's PRESIDENT likes to collect\nrare stones.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentsSonAlsoCollectsRareStones
lines.text: I think the PRESIDENT's son also\ncollects rare stones.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
lines.text:
Yo, how's it going?\pListen, my friend!
Would you like to become the CHAMPION?\pI'm no TRAINER, not me, but I can
sure give you winning advice.\pThat's settled, then! We'll aim for the
POKéMON CHAMPIONSHIP together!\pIt's your job as a TRAINER to collect
GYM BADGES, am I right?\pBut GYM LEADERS aren't pushovers!\pAnd that's where I come in!
I'm here to provide expert advice!\pROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, is a user
of ROCK-type POKéMON.\pThe ROCK type is very durable, but
it can't stand WATER-type and\lGRASS-type moves.\pCome see me afterwards, if you beat
the GYM LEADER.\pWell, go for it!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
lines.text:
Whoa! What a breathtaking victory!
My cheering must've worked!\pGreat!
Check your TRAINER CARD.\pThe STONE BADGE you got should be
properly recorded on it.\pIn other words…\pYou've climbed the first step on
the stairs to the CHAMPIONSHIP!\pThat's got to feel awesome!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshIntro
lines.text: Don't take us GYM TRAINERS lightly!\nI'll show you why we're better!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshDefeat
lines.text: You were too good for me…$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshPostBattle
lines.text: You haven't seen anything of the ROCK\ntype's terrifying power!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyIntro
lines.text: If you can't beat me, you won't stand\na chance against ROXANNE!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyDefeat
lines.text: Wow! You've got some potential!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyPostBattle
lines.text: ROXANNE is stronger than me by\nseveral times.\pYou'd better be on your guard!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcIntro
lines.text: We might be in the middle of town,\nbut so what?\pMy ROCK POKéMON need room to\nrampage!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcDefeat
lines.text: Oh, man oh man!\nOur challenger is one feisty customer!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcPostBattle
lines.text: I have to hand it to our LEADER.\pIt took smarts and sense for her to\npick the ROCK type at her young age.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneIntro
lines.text:
Hello, I am ROXANNE, the RUSTBORO
POKéMON GYM LEADER.\pI became a GYM LEADER so that I might
apply what I learned at the POKéMON\lTRAINER'S SCHOOL in battle.\pWould you kindly demonstrate how you
battle, and with which POKéMON?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneDefeat
lines.text:
So…
I lost…\pIt seems that I still have much more
to learn…\pI understand.\pThe POKéMON LEAGUE's rules state
that TRAINERS are to be given this\lif they defeat a GYM LEADER.\pPlease accept the official POKéMON
LEAGUE STONE BADGE.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedStoneBadge
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the STONE BADGE\nfrom ROXANNE.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_StoneBadgeInfoTakeThis
lines.text: The STONE BADGE heightens the ATTACK\npower of your POKéMON.\pIt also enables them to use the HM move\nCUT outside of battle.\pPlease take this with you, too.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRockTomb
lines.text:
That TECHNICAL MACHINE, TM39,
contains ROCK TOMB.\pIt not only inflicts damage by dropping
rocks, it also lowers SPEED.\pIf you use a TM, it instantly teaches
the move to a POKéMON.\pRemember, a TM can be used only once,
so think before you use it.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostBattle
lines.text: Since you are so strong, you should\nchallenge other GYM LEADERS.\pBy battling many TRAINERS, you should\nlearn many things.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
lines.text: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
lines.text: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM\pROXANNE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRegisterCall
lines.text:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pROXANNE: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}?
This is ROXANNE of RUSTBORO CITY.\pI heard from BRAWLY that you're
moving up through the ranks of\lTRAINERS at an incredible clip.\pWell, I'd rather not think that
I can't beat you.\pI promise, I will shape up my GYM
so that you may challenge us again.\pI hope you'll be looking forward to
that occasion as much as me!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredRoxanne
lines.text: Registered GYM LEADER ROXANNE\nin the POKéNAV.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePreRematch
lines.text:
ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again.
I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.\pI'm sure we've both experienced many
battles since we last met.\pI would like to see how much better
we've become. Let us battle!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchDefeat
lines.text: Grr…\nAgain, I have lost…$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostRematch
lines.text: ROXANNE: I still have much to learn\nwhen it comes to battling POKéMON.\pThat awareness makes me love battling\nall that much more!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchNeedTwoMons
lines.text:
ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again.
I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.\pI'm sure we've both experienced many
battles since we last met.\pI would like to see how much better
we've become…\pOh, no…
You only have one POKéMON with you?\pPlease return with at least one more
POKéMON.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWant
lines.text:
Huh? My POKéMON is cute?
Sure, I knew that.\pBut if you really want, I'm willing
to trade it to you.\pI'll trade you my {STR_VAR_2} for
a {STR_VAR_1} if you want.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_PleaseBeGoodToMyPokemon
lines.text: Eheheh…\nPlease be good to my POKéMON.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_DoesntLookLikeMonToMe
lines.text: Huh? That doesn't look anything like\na {STR_VAR_1} to me.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_YouDontWantToThatsOkay
lines.text: Oh, if you don't want to, that's okay.\nBut my POKéMON is cute, you know…$

lines.label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AnyPokemonCanBeCute
lines.text: Any POKéMON can be cute if you raise\nit with care and kindness.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlaces
lines.text: In all sorts of places, there are all\nsorts of POKéMON and people.\pI find that fascinating, so I go to all\nsorts of places.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_TrainerSchoolExcellent
lines.text: The TRAINER'S SCHOOL is excellent.\pIf you study there, you could even\nbecome a GYM LEADER.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_RoxanneKnowsALot
lines.text: ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, really knows\na lot about POKéMON.\pShe's really strong, too!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_IGivePerfectlySuitedNicknames
lines.text: For my own POKéMON, I give them\nperfectly suited nicknames!\pIt's my expression of, uh…\noriginality, yes, that's it!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_NamingPikachuPekachu
lines.text: But giving the name PEKACHU to\na PIKACHU? It seems pointless.\pI suppose it is good to use a name\nthat's easy to understand, but…$

lines.label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_Pekachu
lines.text: PEKACHU: Peka!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCaseOfShroomish
lines.text: I'm buying some PARLYZ HEALS and\nANTIDOTES.\pJust in case I run into SHROOMISH\nin PETALBURG WOODS.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPotionsInstead
lines.text: My POKéMON evolved.\nIt has a lot of HP now.\pI should buy SUPER POTIONS for it\ninstead of ordinary POTIONS.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRopeJustInCase
lines.text: I'm getting an ESCAPE ROPE just in\ncase I get lost in a cave.\pI just need to use it to get back to\nthe entrance.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonHavePersonalities
lines.text: My POKéMON has a NAIVE nature, and my\nfriend's has a JOLLY nature.\pIt's fascinating how POKéMON have\npersonalities!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MaleAndFemalePokemon
lines.text: Just like people, there are male and\nfemale POKéMON.\pBut no one seems to have any idea how\nthey're different.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCutNextDoor
lines.text: The man next door gave me an HM!\pI used it to teach my POKéMON how to\nCUT down skinny trees.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_BlackboardListsStatusChanges
lines.text: The blackboard lists status changes\nthat may affect POKéMON in battle.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ReadWhichTopic
lines.text: Which topic do you want to read?$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainPoison
lines.text:
If a POKéMON is poisoned, it will
steadily lose HP.\pThe effects of poison remain after
a battle.\pA poisoned POKéMON's HP will drop
while it is traveling.\pHeal a poisoning using an ANTIDOTE.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainParalysis
lines.text:
If a POKéMON becomes paralyzed,
its SPEED drops.\pIt may also not be able to move while
it is in battle.\pParalysis remains after battle.
Cure it using a PARLYZ HEAL.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainSleep
lines.text: If a POKéMON falls asleep, it will be\nunable to attack.\pA POKéMON may wake up on its own,\nbut if a battle ends while it is\lsleeping, it will stay asleep.\pWake it up using an AWAKENING.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainBurn
lines.text: A burn reduces ATTACK power, and it\nsteadily reduces the victim's HP.\pA burn lingers after battle.\nCure a burn using a BURN HEAL.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainFreeze
lines.text: If a POKéMON is frozen, it becomes\ncompletely helpless.\pIt will remain frozen after battle.\nThaw it out using an ICE HEAL.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsWhoDontStudyGetQuickClaw
lines.text: Students who don't study get a little\ntaste of my QUICK CLAW.\pWhether or not you are a good student \nwill be evident from the way you use\lthis item.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainQuickClaw
lines.text:
A POKéMON holding the QUICK CLAW will
occasionally speed up and get to move\lbefore its opponent.\pThere are many other items that are
meant to be held by POKéMON.\pJust those alone will give you many
topics to study!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_TradingRightNow
lines.text: I'm trading POKéMON with my friend\nright now.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_AlwaysWantedSeedot
lines.text: I always wanted a SEEDOT, and\nI'm finally getting one!$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemontCantUseManMadeItems
lines.text: POKéMON can hold items, but they\ndon't know what to do with man-made\litems like POTION and ANTIDOTE.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ConfusedPokemonAttacksItself
lines.text:
You know how some POKéMON moves can
confuse a POKéMON?\pA confused POKéMON will sometimes
attack itself without meaning to.\pBut once it leaves battle, it will
return to normal.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonHealItselfWithBerry
lines.text:
A POKéMON holding a BERRY will heal
itself…\pThere are many kinds of items that
POKéMON can hold…\pBoy, it sure is hard taking notes
down…$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
lines.text:
It's this student's notebook…\pPOKéMON are to be caught using
POKé BALLS.\pUp to six POKéMON can accompany
a TRAINER.\pA TRAINER is someone who catches
POKéMON, raises them, and battles\lwith them.\pA TRAINER's mission is to defeat
the strong TRAINERS who await\lchallengers in POKéMON GYMS.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
lines.text:
Hello? Didn't we meet before?
I think back in PETALBURG CITY.\pLet me introduce myself.
My name's SCOTT.\pI've been traveling everywhere in
search of outstanding TRAINERS.\pMore specifically, I'm looking for
POKéMON battle experts.\pSo, what brings you to this SCHOOL?
Are you a TRAINER, too?\pThe first thing you should do is to
have a POKéMON learn the move CUT.\pIf I remember correctly, someone in
this town has CUT.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentTalentLevelUnknown
lines.text: SCOTT: Hmm…\pThe talent levels of the students here\nare unknown. The potential's there.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottStoneBadge
lines.text:
SCOTT: Oh, what's that?\pIt's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?
That's pretty impressive, I'd say.\pBut, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.\pIt's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.$

lines.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyStoneBadge
lines.text:
Hello? Didn't we meet before?
I think back in PETALBURG CITY.\pLet me introduce myself.
My name's SCOTT.\pI've been traveling everywhere in
search of outstanding TRAINERS.\pMore specifically, I'm looking for
POKéMON battle experts.\pOh, what's that?
It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?\pThat's pretty impressive, I'd say, for
a starting TRAINER like yourself.\pBut, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.\pIt's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ComeAndGetSome
lines.text: What, are you coming?\nCome and get some, then!$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_Peeko
lines.text: PEEKO: Pii pihyoh!$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntIntro
lines.text:
Grah, keelhaul it all!\pThat hostage POKéMON turned out to
be worthless!\pAnd to think I made a getaway…
In this tunnel to nowhere!\pHey! You!
So you want to battle me?$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntDefeat
lines.text: Urrrggh! My career in crime comes to\na dead end!$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntTakePackage
lines.text:
This is plain not right…\pThe BOSS told me this would be a
slick-and-easy job to pull.\pAll I had to do was steal some package
from DEVON.\pTch!
You want it back that badly, take it!$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_PeekoGladToSeeYouSafe
lines.text: PEEKO!\nAm I glad to see you're safe!$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePeeko
lines.text:
PEEKO owes her life to you!\pThey call me MR. BRINEY.
And, you are?\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pAh, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I sincerely thank you!\pNow, if there's anything that troubles
you, don't hesitate to tell me!\pYou can usually find me in my cottage
by the sea near PETALBURG WOODS.\pCome, PEEKO, we should make our way
home.\pPEEKO: Pihyoh!$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WhyCantTheyKeepDigging
lines.text:
… …\pWhy can't they keep digging?
Is the bedrock too hard?\pMy beloved awaits me in VERDANTURF
TOWN just beyond here…\pIf RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF were
joined by this tunnel, I could visit\lher every day…\pBut this…
What am I to do?$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ToGetToVerdanturf
lines.text: To get from RUSTBORO to VERDANTURF,\nyou need to go to DEWFORD, then pass\lthrough SLATEPORT and MAUVILLE…$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_YouShatteredBoulderTakeHM
lines.text: Wow! You shattered that boulder\nblocking the way.\pTo show you how much I appreciate it,\nI'd like you to have this HM.$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ExplainStrength
lines.text: That HM contains STRENGTH.\pIf a muscular POKéMON were to learn\nthat, it would be able to move even\llarge boulders.$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WandaReunion
lines.text: WANDA!\nNow I can see you anytime!\pWANDA: That's…wonderful.\pPlease, take some rest at my home.$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_BoyfriendOnOtherSideOfRock
lines.text:
On the other side of this rock…
My boyfriend is there.\pHe… He's not just digging the tunnel
to come see me.\pHe works his hands raw and rough
for the benefit of everyone.$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeIntro
lines.text: What do you call a wild man up in the\nmountains? A mountain man, right?\pSo why don't they call a POKéMON in\nthe mountains a mountain POKéMON?$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeDefeat
lines.text: My POKéMON…\nRan out of power…$

lines.label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikePostBattle
lines.text: They halted development here to\nprotect POKéMON, right?\lThere's a feel-good story!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
lines.text:
Hey!
I remember your face!\pIf you're here, it must mean that
you're about to mess with us again!\pA punk like you, do you really think
you can take on TEAM AQUA?\pI'd say you're too early by about
a trillion years!\pYou're a perfect fit for the likes of
TEAM MAGMA!\pSpeaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they
were spotted near MOSSDEEP.\pThat bunch of goons, they sure don't
look good near the sea!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
lines.text:
A punk like you, do you really think
you can take on TEAM AQUA?\pI'd say you're too early by about
a trillion years!\pYou're a perfect fit for the likes of
TEAM MAGMA!\pSpeaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they
were spotted near MOSSDEEP.\pThat bunch of goons, they sure don't
look good near the sea!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Intro
lines.text: We don't need a kid around!\nGo on home already!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: I want to go home…$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
lines.text: I want to get a promotion so I can\nboss around the GRUNTS…$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Intro
lines.text: That submarine… It's tiny inside.\nI'm sore all over!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: Losing makes me sore!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
lines.text: That submarine we jacked, man,\nit's brutal as a ride.\lIt's way too tight in there!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
lines.text:
Ahahahaha!\pHow did you manage to get here without
a submarine?\lWhat an impressive child!\pBut… It won't do to have you
meddling about here.\pAnd, I do want payback for what
happened at the WEATHER INSTITUTE…\pI'm going to give you a little taste
of pain! Resign yourself to it!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyDefeat
lines.text: Ahahahaha!\pOuch!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBattle
lines.text:
Ahahahaha!
You're so darn strong.\pIt's terribly disappointing that you're
not a TEAM AQUA member.\pYou could have enjoyed the fabulous
world our BOSS has promised as\lone of us…$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro
lines.text:
For our dream to become real, we need
the power of POKéMON.\pBut meddlers like you use the power of
POKéMON to mess with us even at\la place like this!\pLife just doesn't work the way we
need it to!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Defeat
lines.text: Gwah!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
lines.text:
You know, we don't dare question
the motives of our leader.\pBut here you are, just some punk,
going up against our BOSS.\pMaybe…
You must be something…$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Intro
lines.text: Who are you?\nWhere did you come in from?$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Defeat
lines.text: Lost it…$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
lines.text: I can't find the way out!\pI'm not afraid. Don't get me wrong!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Intro
lines.text: Who are you?\nWhere do you think you're going?$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Defeat
lines.text: I failed to win!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
lines.text: My partner forgot the map in that\nsubmarine!\pHow's that for being useless?$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieHoldItRightThere
lines.text: ARCHIE: Hold it right there.$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieSoItWasYou
lines.text: ARCHIE: Fufufu…\nSo it was you, after all.$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKyogre
lines.text: ARCHIE: Behold!\pSee how beautiful it is, the sleeping\nform of the ancient POKéMON KYOGRE!\pI have waited so long for this day to\ncome…$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustDisappear
lines.text: ARCHIE: It surprises me, how you've\nmanaged to chase me here.\pBut that's all over now.\pFor the realization of my dream,\nyou must disappear now!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDefeat
lines.text: What?!\nI lost to a mere child like you?!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
lines.text: ARCHIE: Fufufu…\pI commend you. I must recognize that\nyou are truly gifted.\pBut!\nI have this in my possession!\pWith this RED ORB, I can make KYOGRE…$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_RedOrbShinesByItself
lines.text: The RED ORB suddenly began shining\nby itself!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDidKyogreGo
lines.text: ARCHIE: What?!\pI didn't do anything.\nWhy did the RED ORB…\pWhere did KYOGRE go?$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieAMessageFromOutside
lines.text: ARCHIE: Hm? It's a message from our\nmembers outside…$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
lines.text:
ARCHIE: Yes, what is it?\pHm…
It's raining heavily?\pGood… That should have happened.
That is why we awakened KYOGRE,\lto realize TEAM AQUA's vision of\lexpanding the sea.\pWhat?!\pIt's raining far harder than we
envisioned? You're in danger?\pThat can't be…
That's just not possible…\pHold your position and monitor
the situation!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
lines.text: ARCHIE: There's something wrong…\pThe RED ORB is supposed to awaken\nand control KYOGRE…\pBut… Why?\nWhy did KYOGRE disappear?\pWhy?!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
lines.text:
MAXIE: What have you wrought?\pARCHIE… You've finally awoken KYOGRE,
haven't you?\pWhat will happen to the world if this
downpour continues for all eternity?\pThe world's landmass will drown in
the deepening sea…$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
lines.text:
ARCHIE: W-what?!
Don't get all high and mighty with me!\pWasn't it you, TEAM MAGMA, that
infuriated GROUDON?\pSo long as I have this RED ORB,
I should be able to control KYOGRE…\pI should be able to control it…$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHaveTimeToArgue
lines.text: MAXIE: We don't have the time to\nargue about it here!\pGet outside and see for yourself!\pSee if what you've wrought is the\nworld that we desired!$

lines.label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieComeOnPlayer
lines.text: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, come on, you have\nto get out of here, too!$

lines.label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_CanOvercomeColdWithFocus
lines.text: The penetrating cold around these\nparts is an impediment to training.\pBut with focus, one can overcome!\pWith this FOCUS BAND, buckle down and\nwithstand the cold!$

lines.label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_EverythingStartsWithFocus
lines.text: Everything starts with focus!$

lines.label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_DoorIsClosed
lines.text: The door is closed.$

lines.label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
lines.text: WALLACE: Oh, my, I'm terribly sorry!\pIn my haste, I didn't notice that\nI'd left you behind!\pI've opened the locked door of\nthe SKY PILLAR.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, let's be on our way!$

lines.label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_EarthquakeNotMomentToWaste
lines.text: WALLACE: It's an earthquake!\pThere's not a moment to waste!\nWe've got to hurry!$

lines.label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_SituationGettingWorse
lines.text: WALLACE: Hmm…\nThe situation is getting worse…$

lines.label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
lines.text:
WALLACE: This isn't good…\pThe weather distortion is spreading
even here…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pRAYQUAZA should be farther up
from here.\pI'm worried about SOOTOPOLIS.
I've got to go back.\pEverything is in your hands now.
Don't fail us!$

lines.label: SkyPillar_Top_Text_RayquazaFlewOff
lines.text: The awakened RAYQUAZA flew off…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_EnergyGuruSellWhatYouNeed
lines.text: I'm the ENERGY GURU! I'll go for it and\nsell you what you need!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_OhYourPokemon
lines.text: Oh?\nYour {STR_VAR_1}…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_PleaseGiveItThisEffortRibbon
lines.text: Went for it stupendously!\pAs its reward, please give it this\nEFFORT RIBBON.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_ReceivedEffortRibbon
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the EFFORT RIBBON.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_PutEffortRibbonOnMon
lines.text: {PLAYER} put the EFFORT RIBBON\non {STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_GoForItLittleHarder
lines.text: You have to go for it a little harder.\pIf you do, I'll give your POKéMON\nsomething nice.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_EffortRibbonLooksGoodOnIt
lines.text: Oh! Your {STR_VAR_1}, that EFFORT\nRIBBON looks good on it!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_WonderIfLighthouseStartlesPokemon
lines.text: The light of the lighthouse reaches\ndozens of miles away.\pI wonder if it doesn't startle POKéMON\nin the sea.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_SeaweedFullOfLife
lines.text: Ooh, look at this!\pThe seaweed you can get around these\nparts is fresh and full of life.\pWhy, it looks like it can even rear up\nand attack!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_HowTownIsBornAndGrows
lines.text: Where the water is clean, the fruits\nof bountiful harvest gather.\pAnd where people gather, a market\nsoon starts.\pThat is how a town is born and grows.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_SlateportWonderfulPlace
lines.text: Shopping where you can breathe the\nscent of the ocean…\pSLATEPORT is such a wonderful place!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_BuyBricksSoDecorWontGetDirty
lines.text: If you put DOLLS or CUSHIONS on\nthe floor, they'll get dirty.\pI'm going to buy some BRICKS so my\nDOLLS and CUSHIONS won't get dirty\lwhen I leave them out.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_GoingToCompeteInBattleTent
lines.text: Wroooar! I'm going to compete in\nthe BATTLE TENT, too!\pBut before that, I need to catch\nsome POKéMON!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_BushedHikingFromMauville
lines.text: Whew… I'm just bushed…\pI hiked over from MAUVILLE CITY.\nBut, boy, this city's huge.\pIf I'd known this, I would've ridden\nmy BIKE here.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_EveryoneCallsHimCaptStern
lines.text: STERN, the fellow who built the\nMUSEUM, also happens to be the leader\lof an undersea exploration team.\pSo, everyone calls him CAPT. STERN.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatsLongLineOverThere
lines.text: What is that over there?\nThat long line…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_VisitedMuseumOften
lines.text: When I was a child, I visited\nthe MUSEUM often.\pI used to dream about the mysteries of\nthe sea after seeing the exhibits.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_QuitPushing
lines.text: Hey, there! Quit pushing!\nThis is the line, can't you see?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_AquaHasPolicy
lines.text: TEAM AQUA has a policy of\nassembling and dispersing at\lthe operation site.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_BossIsBrilliant
lines.text: Our BOSS is brilliant.\pWhat would he want to do with\na MUSEUM now?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatsNewSchemeIWonder
lines.text: What's the new scheme, I wonder?\pOur BOSS is scary when he's mad, so\nI'd better not screw things up…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_ShouldTakeItAll
lines.text: If there's something we need in\nthe MUSEUM, we should take it all!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_DontButtIn
lines.text: Hey, you there!\nDon't butt in!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_RemindsMeOfLongLineForGames
lines.text: A long line, huh?\pIt reminds me of the times I lined up to\nbuy smash-hit games…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_WhyAreWeLiningUp
lines.text: Why are we even lining up and paying?\nWe should just march in!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatDoYouWant
lines.text: What?\nWhat do you want?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_IllReadSignForYou
lines.text: You want to read this sign?\nI'll read it for you!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_SaysSomethingLikeSeaIsEndless
lines.text: Let's see…\pUm… I think it says something like\n“the life in the sea is endless.”\pYup, I'm pretty sure that's what\nit says.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_ShouldveBroughtMyGameBoy
lines.text: Grumble…\pI should've brought my Game Boy\nAdvance so I wouldn't get bored in line…\pGrumble…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_HotSpringsAfterOperation
lines.text: When this operation's over, I'll take\nyou to a hot spring spa!\pThat's what our leader said.\nI can't wait!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_SeaIsSoWet
lines.text: The sea is just so vast…\pCould the sea have been made by\nthe tears shed by POKéMON?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_SinkOldBoats
lines.text: Do you know what they do with old\nships that become too creaky to sail?\pThey sink them in the sea so they\nbecome habitats for POKéMON.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_BuyTooMuch
lines.text: Whenever I visit here, I get carried\naway and buy too much.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_GetNameRaterToHelpYou
lines.text: If you want to change your POKéMON's\nnickname, you'll have to get the NAME\lRATER to help you.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_CantChangeTradeMonName
lines.text: Any POKéMON you get in a trade,\nyou can't change its nickname.\pThe original TRAINER's love for that\nPOKéMON is in the nickname.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentBuiltRecently
lines.text:
Recently, a BATTLE TENT was built
in SLATEPORT.\pGYMS are fun, but the BATTLE TENT's
awesome in its own way.\pYou should go find tough POKéMON
for the BATTLE TENT!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptSternBeingInterviewed
lines.text: I was hoping that it was a famous star\nso I could get an autograph.\pBut who's that being interviewed?\nIsn't that CAPT. STERN?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_InterviewerSoCool
lines.text: That lady interviewer is so cool\nand pretty.\pWhen I grow up, I'm going to be\nan international journalist!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_SternSaysDiscoveredSomething
lines.text: CAPT. STERN says they discovered\nsomething at the bottom of the sea.\pI wonder what it is?\nWhat could it be?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptainComeBackWithBigFish
lines.text: What's going on here?\pDid the good CAPTAIN come back with\na big fish from the ocean floor?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_AmIOnTV
lines.text: Hey! Are you watching?\nAm I on TV?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptainsACelebrity
lines.text: A TV interview! Here!\nThe CAPTAIN's a celebrity!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_BigSmileForCamera
lines.text: TY: Okay, CAPT. STERN, a big smile\nfor the camera!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_MostInvaluableExperience
lines.text: GABBY: I see, I see. You've had a most\ninvaluable experience…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_SternMoveAheadWithExploration
lines.text: CAPT. STERN: Yes, indeed. We intend to\nmove ahead with our exploration.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_GabbyWonderfulThanksForInterview
lines.text: GABBY: That's wonderful, CAPT. STERN!\nThank you for taking the time from\lyour busy schedule to talk to us.\pWe hope we can interview you again\nwith news of more discoveries!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_SternWhewFirstInterview
lines.text: CAPT. STERN: Whew…\pThat was my first time to be filmed for\nTV. That was nerve-wracking.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_OhPlayerWeMadeDiscovery
lines.text:
Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You're looking great!\pWe made a huge discovery on our last
seafloor exploration.\pWe found an underwater cavern on
ROUTE 128.\pWe think it's the habitat of a POKéMON
that's said to have been long extinct.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_AquaWillAssumeControlOfSubmarine
lines.text:
Fufufu…
CAPT. STERN, I presume.\pWe of TEAM AQUA will assume
control of your submarine!\pYour objections are meaningless!
We expect your total cooperation!\pFufufu…
Just watch and learn what TEAM\lAQUA has planned!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_SternWhatWasAllThat
lines.text: CAPT. STERN: What was that all about?\pIt sounded like someone using\na megaphone…\pWhere did it come from?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_FromHarborTryingToTakeSub
lines.text: It's from the HARBOR!\pThe submarine!\nThey're trying to take it!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
lines.text: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nPlease, come with me!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentSign
lines.text: BATTLE TENT SLATEPORT SITE\n“Find it! The ultimate POKéMON!”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardWantedSign
lines.text: STERN'S SHIPYARD\p“Wanted: A sailor capable of sailing\nin all currents.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardNearsCompletion
lines.text: STERN'S SHIPYARD\p“The ferry S.S. TIDAL nears\ncompletion for serving the ports of\lSLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardFerryComplete
lines.text: STERN'S SHIPYARD\p“Boarding of the SLATEPORT-LILYCOVE\nferry S.S. TIDAL is handled at the\lHARBOR.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign
lines.text: POKéMON FAN CLUB\n“Calling all fans of POKéMON!”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_OceanicMuseumSign
lines.text: “The endless sea sustains\nall life.”\pOCEANIC MUSEUM$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_CitySign
lines.text: SLATEPORT CITY\p“The port where people and POKéMON\ncross paths.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_MarketSign
lines.text: SLATEPORT MARKET\n“Unique items found nowhere else!”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_HarborFerryUnderConstruction
lines.text: SLATEPORT HARBOR\p“The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under\nconstruction in the SHIPYARD.\p“Service is scheduled to begin\nshortly.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_HarborSign
lines.text: SLATEPORT HARBOR\p“Enjoy a delightful cruise on\nthe ferry S.S. TIDAL.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_NameRatersHouseSign
lines.text: NAME RATER'S HOUSE\n“POKéMON nicknames rated.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries
lines.text:
If a wild POKéMON gets hurt, it heals
itself by chewing on BERRIES.\pDid you know that?\pSomebody saw that and got the idea
of making medicine from BERRIES.\pDid you know that?\pTo turn BERRIES into medicine,
they must be crushed into powder.\pDid you know that?\pYou seem to have an interest
in BERRIES!\pI've got something good for someone
like you.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerryPowder
lines.text:
I recently had machines installed at
POKéMON CENTERS for crushing BERRIES.\pThe BERRY CRUSH machines are at
the DIRECT CORNER upstairs.\pDid you know?\pCould you make BERRY POWDER for
me using those machines?\pI can make you all sorts of medicine
if you bring me lots of BERRY POWDER.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_BroughtMeSomeBerryPowder
lines.text: Have you brought me some\nBERRY POWDER?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeWhatWithIt
lines.text: What would you like to exchange\nit with?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeBerryPowderForItem
lines.text: Okay, you want to exchange your\nBERRY POWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_DontHaveEnoughBerryPowder
lines.text: Oh, dear. You don't have enough\nBERRY POWDER.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_FineBerryPowderTradeSomethingElse
lines.text: This is fine BERRY POWDER.\nIt will make excellent medicine.\pWould you like to trade more of your\nBERRY POWDER for something else?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_WhenYouGetMoreBringItToMe
lines.text: Okay! When you get some more\nBERRY POWDER, bring it to me, please!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_ComeBackToTradeBerryPowder
lines.text: Come back if you'd like to trade your\nBERRY POWDER for some medicine.\pI'm always running a bazaar here.\pDid you know?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_YouDroveTeamAquaAway
lines.text:
SCOTT: Huh?
I'm sure I met you somewhere before.\pHave I introduced myself to you?
If not, my name's SCOTT.\pI just saw TEAM AQUA run away from
here like they were stung.\pLet me guess--you drove them away?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_MaybeThisTrainer
lines.text: SCOTT: Hmm…\nMaybe, just maybe, this TRAINER…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_LetsRegisterEachOther
lines.text: SCOTT: All right! I think you're going\nto become a good friend.\pSo, let's register each other in our\nPOKéNAVS.\p… … … … … …$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_RegisteredScott
lines.text: Registered this SCOTT person\nin the POKéNAV.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_KeepEyeOnTrainersBeSeeingYou
lines.text: SCOTT: What I'd like to do is tag along\nwith you, but I do want to keep an eye\lon the talents of other people, too.\pSo, I'll be off to roam other towns\na bit more.\pBe seeing you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Text_TakingBattleTentChallenge
lines.text:
SCOTT: Oh, hey!
If it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, let me guess--you're going
to take the BATTLE TENT challenge?\pYeah! That's a good idea!
That's a really great idea!\pAfter all, a tough TRAINER is
the perfect fit for the BATTLE TENT!\pGive it your best effort!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
lines.text:
Want a tasty little bit of advice
for CONTESTS?\pUsing a certain move after another
certain kind of move sometimes gets\lyou extra attention.\pIf you know what you're doing,
you can score big in appeal.\pOf course, your opponents might try
disrupting your POKéMON's showing.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyPapaIsContestJudge
lines.text: My papa, he's a CONTEST JUDGE.\pI wonder what I should be when I\ngrow up, a JUDGE or a GYM LEADER?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
lines.text:
Hey, man, I'm like majorly cheesed,
you know. Like, you know, I just\lwanted to know why my POKéMON\lnever won, you know, like, hey?\pSo, like, I gave the JUDGE my two
cents, you know, they're free.\pAnd he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey!
So, like, total bummer, man!\pHey, like, you! Zip it, you know?
Just, you know, take this!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
lines.text:
That's, like, TM41, you know?
Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?\pLike, it won't let the other guy
use the same move twice in a row, see?\pHey, now, you listen here, like,
I'm not laying a torment on you!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
lines.text:
MC: Oh, my, my!
Now isn't that a dandy of a POKéMON?\pPlease! Do step right up and take
part in our splendid CONTESTS!\pYou'll do well! I'm sure of it!
My eyes have never failed me!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
lines.text:
JUDGE: Well, hello there!
I see that you're a TRAINER!\pThen, it just wouldn't do for you
to miss a POKéMON CONTEST!\pGet a CONTEST PASS in VERDANTURF
CITY and enter anytime!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ItsAppealTime
lines.text: It's appeal time!\nWhat should I lead with?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_DidntPayAttentionToAppeal
lines.text: They didn't pay much attention to\nmy POKéMON's appeal…\pHumph, that JUDGE, he doesn't know\na good thing when he sees it.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
lines.text:
Oh, hi! You must be a serious fan to get
this close to the action.\pI'll reward your enthusiasm with
this sage advice.\pIf a move goes over really well,
the audience will get excited.\pThe POKéMON that makes its appeal
right when everyone's excited…\pWell, you'd think something good has
to happen!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MoreFreakedOutThanMon
lines.text: I can't do this! I'm more freaked out\nthan my POKéMON.\pI'm shivering and my heart is racing!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_BattleAndContestAlike
lines.text: A battle and a CONTEST aren't the\nsame, but they are alike, too.\pYou need to work hard and believe\nin the POKéMON you've raised.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MonLooksOnTopOfGame
lines.text: That POKéMON looks like it's on top\nof its game, huh?\pA POKéMON that does good in the\nsecondary judging seems to be more\lrelaxed when it's doing appeals.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonBetterThanThatLot
lines.text: Will you look at that sorry sight?\pHeh, my POKéMON's absolutely better\nthan that lot!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_GetUrgeToMoveWithMon
lines.text: Don't you get the urge to move with\nPOKéMON if they're putting on an\lenergetic appeal?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_HyperRankStage
lines.text: POKéMON CONTESTS\nHYPER RANK STAGE!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
lines.text:
So, like, I couldn't find myself any
POKéMON that were, like, for me.\pSo, I figured, like, hey, I should file
a complaint to the guy there?\pAnd he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey!
So, like, total bummer, man!\pHey, like, you! Zip it, you know?
Just, you know, take this!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainTorment
lines.text:
That's, like, TM41, you know?
Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?\pLike, it won't let the other guy
use the same move twice in a row, see?\pHey, now, you listen here, like,
I'm not laying a torment on you!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_IllTryUsingBugMons
lines.text: I don't really like BUG POKéMON,\nbut maybe I'll try using some for\la change of pace.\pWho knows, I might even get to like\nthem!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BattleEvenWithoutToughMons
lines.text: You can battle all you want here even\nif you don't have any tough POKéMON.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NiceIfMoreSelection
lines.text: Wouldn't it be nice if they had more of\na selection?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FerryServiceUnavailable
lines.text: I beg your pardon?\nYou're looking for a ship?\pI'm sorry, the ferry service isn't\navailable at present…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
lines.text: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTicket
lines.text: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…\pI'm terribly sorry.\pYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FlashedTicketWhereTo
lines.text: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime
lines.text: Please sail with us another time!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LilycoveItIs
lines.text: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_BattleFrontierItIs
lines.text: BATTLE FRONTIER it is, then!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
lines.text: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
lines.text: Then, where would you like to go?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LoveToGoDeepUnderwaterSomeday
lines.text: A journey to the bottom of the sea…\nI wonder what it'd be like?\pI'd love to go deep underwater like\nthat someday.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
lines.text:
For a ship to sail safely, we need to
know about the weather!\pSpeaking of weather, I heard something
from a guy at the WEATHER INSTITUTE.\pHe was saying abnormal weather has
been reported all over the place!\pYou should visit the WEATHER INSTITUTE
and ask around!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallForMe
lines.text: I wanted to go with CAPT. STERN on\nthe ocean floor exploration.\pBut the sub's too small for me.\pIf I squeezed in, there wouldn't be\nany room for the CAPTAIN…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SameThugsTriedToRobAtMuseum
lines.text: CAPT. STERN: Those thugs…\pThey're the same lot who tried to rob\nthe DEVON GOODS at the MUSEUM.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
lines.text:
ARCHIE: Oh?
Not you again…\pYou are tenacious to track us here,
that much I will give you.\pBut now…
No one can stop us! No one!\pOr, will you follow us back to our
HIDEOUT in LILYCOVE CITY?\pFwahahahaha…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
lines.text:
CAPT. STERN: Why…\pWhy would TEAM AQUA steal my
SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1?\pThey can't be after the slumbering
POKéMON at the bottom of the sea…\pBut even if I were to chase them,
I don't stand a chance against them…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
lines.text:
CAPT. STERN: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pOkay… So TEAM AQUA left before you
could stop them…\pOh, no, don't blame yourself.
You're not responsible for this.\pTrying to catch a submarine…
It's impossible for most people.\pYou would need a POKéMON that knows
how to DIVE…\pPerhaps if you went out to
MOSSDEEP CITY…\pA lot of divers live out there, so
someone might teach you…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
lines.text:
CAPT. STERN: Trying to catch a
submarine… It's impossible.\pYou would need a POKéMON that knows
how to DIVE…\pPerhaps if you went out to
MOSSDEEP CITY…\pA lot of divers live out there, so
someone might teach you…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WontBeLongBeforeWeFinishFerry
lines.text: CAPT. STERN: Oh, yes.\nMR. BRINEY came to our SHIPYARD.\pIt won't be long now before we finish\nmaking the ferry!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
lines.text: CAPT. STERN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pWe finally finished making the ferry\nS.S. TIDAL!\pWe couldn't have done it without\nyour friend MR. BRINEY.\pPlease go for a short cruise on it!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
lines.text:
CAPT. STERN: Oh?
{PLAYER}{KUN}, that item you have…\pThat's a SCANNER! That would sure
help us on our explorations.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, would you trade your
SCANNER for something?\pLike, say, a DEEPSEATOOTH or
a DEEPSEASCALE that I have?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_IfYouWantToTradeLetMeKnow
lines.text: CAPT. STERN: Are you certain?\nIt's useless to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pWell, okay, then. If you want to trade\nyour SCANNER, let me know.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSeaTooth
lines.text: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for\nmy DEEPSEATOOTH?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSeaScale
lines.text: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for\nmy DEEPSEASCALE?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhichOneDoYouWant
lines.text: CAPT. STERN: Which one do you want?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_HandedScannerToStern
lines.text: {PLAYER} handed the SCANNER to\nCAPT. STERN.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ThisWillHelpResearch
lines.text: CAPT. STERN: Thanks, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nThis will help our research a lot!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_House_Text_NatureToDoWithStatGains
lines.text: My POKéMON has a HASTY nature.\pIt has higher SPEED compared to\nmy other POKéMON.\pMaybe their nature has something to\ndo with the stat gains of POKéMON.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_House_Text_MustBeGoingToBattleTent
lines.text: You're a TRAINER, aren't you?\pSince you came to SLATEPORT CITY,\nyou must be going to the BATTLE TENT.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Mart_Text_SomeItemsOnlyAtMart
lines.text: The MARKET does have some interesting\nmerchandise.\pBut there are some items you can only\nget at a POKéMON MART.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_Mart_Text_GreatBallIsBetter
lines.text: A GREAT BALL is better than a POKé BALL\nat catching POKéMON.\pWith this, I should be able to get that\nelusive POKéMON…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_PleasedToRateMonNickname
lines.text: Hi, hi! I'm the NAME RATER!\nI'm the fortune-teller of names!\pI shall be pleased to rate your\nPOKéMON's nickname.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_CritiqueWhichMonNickname
lines.text: Which POKéMON's nickname should\nI critique?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_FineNameSuggestBetterOne
lines.text: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1}, is it? That is\nquite a fine name you bestowed.\pBut! What say you, if I were to\nsuggest a slightly better name?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_WhatShallNewNameBe
lines.text: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new\nnickname be?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MonShallBeKnownAsName
lines.text: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt is a better name than before!\nHow fortunate for you!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_DoVisitAgain
lines.text: I see.\nDo come visit again.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_NameNoDifferentYetSuperior
lines.text: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt looks no different from before,\nand yet, this is vastly superior!\pHow fortunate for you!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MagnificentName
lines.text: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1} it is!\pThis is a magnificent nickname!\nIt is impeccably beyond reproach!\pYou'll do well to cherish your\n{STR_VAR_1} now and beyond.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_ThatIsMerelyAnEgg
lines.text: Now, now.\nThat is merely an EGG!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldYouLikeToEnter
lines.text: Welcome to the OCEANIC MUSEUM.\pThe entrance fee is ¥50.\nWould you like to enter?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
lines.text: Please enjoy yourself.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_NotEnoughMoney
lines.text: Oh? I'm sorry, but you don't seem to\nhave enough money.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CatchUpWithYourGroup
lines.text: Oh? You're with that group that\nwent in earlier?\pYou're the only one who's late.\nYou'd better go catch up to them!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_AquaExistForGoodOfAll
lines.text: We, TEAM AQUA, exist for the good\nof all!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OurBossIsntHere
lines.text: We were told to assemble here,\nso we did, but…\pOur BOSS, the linchpin, isn't here.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldStuffHereMakeMeRich
lines.text: If I ripped off the stuff here,\nwould it make me rich?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CanLearnForNefariousDeeds
lines.text: What I learn here, I can put to use on\nnefarious deeds…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RustboroBungled
lines.text: If our goons didn't bungle things\nin RUSTBORO, we wouldn't be here!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DidntHaveMoney
lines.text: I didn't have ¥50, so it took a long\ntime getting by the receptionist.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_LearnAboutSeaForBattling
lines.text: I want to learn about the sea and\nuse that knowledge for battling.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_SternIsRoleModel
lines.text: I get all giddy and gooey when\nI see the sea!\pFor me, CAPT. STERN is the number\none role model!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_MustBePokemonWeDontKnow
lines.text: The sea is vast without end, and\ninfinitely deep…\pThere must be many POKéMON that\nwe don't know about.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WantSeaPokemon
lines.text: I want a sea POKéMON.\pI think it would feel cool and nice\nto hug.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RememberMeTakeThis
lines.text:
Aiyeeeh!
What are you doing here?\pMe? I'm the TEAM AQUA member
you thumped before, remember?\lBack in RUSTURF TUNNEL?\pHere, take this!
You have to forgive me!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_HopeINeverSeeYouAgain
lines.text: That TM, it suits you more than it\ndoes me.\pHope I never see you again!\nWahahaha!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_YouHaveToTakeThis
lines.text: Awww, come on!\nYou have to take this and let me go!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WhirlpoolExperiment
lines.text: A blue fluid is spiraling inside\na glass vessel.\p“This is an experiment to create a\nWHIRLPOOL artificially using wind.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WaterfallExperiment
lines.text: A red ball is bobbing up and down\ninside a glass vessel.\p“This is an experiment simulating a\nWATERFALL using the ball's buoyancy.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanSoilDisplay
lines.text:
It's a sample of soil from the ocean
floor.\p“Over many years, the remains of
life-forms settle at the bottom of\lthe sea, making sedimentary layers.\p“By analyzing these layers, the
ancient past is revealed.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_BeachSandDisplay
lines.text: It's a sample of beach sand.\p“Stones from mountains are washed\ndown by rivers where they are\lchipped and ground down.\p“They are reduced to grains and end\nup as sand on beaches.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact1
lines.text:
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 1
Why is seawater blue?\p“Light is composed of many colors.\p“When light passes through water,
most kinds of light lose color.\p“However, blue light retains its
color, making the sea appear blue.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact2
lines.text:
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 2
Why is the sea salty?\p“Seawater contains dissolved salt in
the form of sodium and chlorine ions.\p“These ions leech out of rocks
and are carried out to sea by rain.\p“The concentration of dissolved salt
makes the sea salty.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact3
lines.text:
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 3
Which is bigger? The sea or land?\p“The sea covers about 70% of
the planet, and the rest is land.\p“The sea is therefore more than twice
the size of land.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_FossilDisplay
lines.text:
It's a fossil with wavy ridges on it.\p“Soil on the ocean floor gets scoured
by the tide.\p“The flowing seawater marks the soil
with small ridges and valleys.\p“If this soil becomes fossilized, it is
called a ripple mark.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DepthMeasuringMachine
lines.text: A strange machine is rotating under\na glass dome.\pMaybe it's for measuring the depth\nof something…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ThankYouForTheParts
lines.text:
Yes? If you're looking for STERN,
that would be me.\pAh! Those must be the parts I ordered
from MR. STONE of DEVON.\pThank you! That's great!
We can prepare for our expedition now.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WellTakeThoseParts
lines.text: Hehehe, hold it!\nWe'll take those parts!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternWhoAreYou
lines.text: CAPT. STERN: Wh-what?\nWho are you people?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WereTeamAqua
lines.text: We're TEAM AQUA!\pOur BOSS wants those parts!\nShut your yap and fork them over!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
lines.text: Awaaaah!\nA kid beat me!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_BossGoingToBeFurious
lines.text: Oh, man, what a disaster…\nThe BOSS is going to be furious…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_LetMeTakeCareOfThis
lines.text: Humph, sniveling wimp!\nLet me take care of this!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
lines.text: What?!\nI lost, too!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_MeddlingKid
lines.text: Now what? If we don't get the parts,\nwe're in for it!\pArrgh, I didn't count on being meddled\nwith by some meddling kid!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_CameToSeeWhatsTakingSoLong
lines.text: I came to see what was taking so\nlong to snatch some parts, and you\lsimps are held up by a mere child?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
lines.text:
We are TEAM AQUA,
and we love the sea!\pAnd I am TEAM AQUA's leader,
ARCHIE!\pWhat makes you interfere with us?\p…No! You can't be!
You're not one of TEAM MAGMA?\pWait, that can't be right.
You're not dressed for the part.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pPOKéMON, people… All life depends on
the sea.\pSo, TEAM AQUA is dedicated to
the expansion of the sea.\pDon't you agree? What we are doing
is a magnificent undertaking.\pAh, fine…
You're still too young to understand\lour noble objective.\pBut, I warn you, don't even consider
interfering with our plans again.\pThe consequences will cost you
dearly!\pAnd don't you forget it!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternThankYouForSavingUs
lines.text:
CAPT. STERN: You're…
Ah, okay, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pAnyway, that was a tense situation!
Thank you for saving us!\pOh, yes, I almost forgot that you
even brought the parts from DEVON!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternIveGotToGo
lines.text:
CAPT. STERN: Whoops!
There's no time to lose!\pWe have to set out on our ocean-floor
expedition really soon.\pThanks again, but now I've got
to go!\pFeel free to wander around and check
out our facilities, though.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_RemindsMeOfAbandonedShip
lines.text: I saw a model of a ship here.\pIt reminded me of the ABANDONED SHIP\nnear DEWFORD TOWN…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_DontRunInMuseum
lines.text: Don't you dare run around inside\nthe MUSEUM!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WantToRideSubmarine
lines.text: Wow, the submarine's awesome!\nI want to go for a ride!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WaterQualitySample1
lines.text: “WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 1,” the\nlabel says.\pThe sea is all connected, but the\nwater seems to differ by region.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WaterQualitySample2
lines.text: “WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 2,” the\nlabel says.\pDoes the saltiness of seawater differ\nby region, too?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_PressureExperiment
lines.text:
A rubber ball is expanding and
shrinking.\p“In the sea, the weight of water itself
exerts pressure.\p“In shallow water, the pressure is not
very heavy.\p“However, in extremely deep water,
the pressure can reach even tens of\lthousands of tons on a small area.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_HoennModel
lines.text: “MODEL OF HOENN REGION”\pIt's a miniature diorama of the\nHOENN region.\pWhere is LITTLEROOT TOWN on this?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_DeepSeawaterDisplay
lines.text: It's a display on the flow of seawater.\p“Near the bottom of the sea, water\nflows due to differences in such\lfactors as temperature and salinity.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SurfaceSeawaterDisplay
lines.text: It's a display on the flow of seawater.\p“Toward the surface, seawater flows\nas currents driven by the winds.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSTidalReplica
lines.text: “THE FERRY S.S. TIDAL\p“A scale replica of the ship under\nconstruction at STERN'S SHIPYARD.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SubmarineReplica
lines.text: “SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1\p“A replica of the high-performance\nocean floor exploration submarine.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SumbersibleReplica
lines.text: “SUBMERSIBLE POD\p“A replica of a compact, unmanned\npod for seafloor exploration.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSAnneReplica
lines.text: “S.S. ANNE\p“A replica of the luxury liner that\ncircles the globe.”$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RaiseDifferentTypesOfPokemon
lines.text:
Want a tip for battling?\pI'd say it's raising different kinds
of POKéMON in a balanced manner.\pIt's no good to make just one
POKéMON strong.\pIf it has a type disadvantage,
it might not stand a chance.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedMonWithFriend
lines.text: I trade POKéMON with my friends.\pIf a traded POKéMON is holding an\nitem, it makes me twice as happy!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetChairman
lines.text:
Er-hem! I am the CHAIRMAN of the
POKéMON FAN CLUB!\pBeing the CHAIRMAN, I am naturally
the most important!\pNo one can best me when it comes
to raising POKéMON. No one!\pWell, let me tell you about
POKéMON CONTESTS.\pThey're events where one can show off
POKéMON for the world to see!\pHowever, they're held in far-off towns,
so I cannot participate often enough.\pThat is why we gather here to show
off our POKéMON, and have others\lshow us theirs.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_LikeToSeeEnteredContestPokemon
lines.text: The POKéMON of a TRAINER who has\nentered a POKéMON CONTEST…\lThat, I would like to see.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowMeToExamineYourPokemon
lines.text:
Er-hem! I see you've participated in
a POKéMON CONTEST!\pPlease! Allow me to examine how you
have raised your POKéMON.\pIt delights me no end to see POKéMON
raised by other TRAINERS.\pThe happy expressions of POKéMON
raised with proper care…\pThe kindly eyes of the TRAINER that
nurtured and raised the POKéMON…\pThe very thought fills my heart to
overwhelming with joy.\pOh! I do beg your pardon!
Forgive me for prattling on so!\pPlease! Allow me to examine how much
your POKéMON has grown!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HowIsYourPokemonGrowing
lines.text: How is your POKéMON growing?\nAllow me to examine it.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HmHmISee
lines.text: Hm, hm…\nI see…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_GiveMonMorePokeblocks
lines.text:
Hmmm… It's not bad, but it's not
good, either…\pYou, the TRAINER, must put more
effort into raising this POKéMON!\pFor instance, may I suggest that
you give it more {POKEBLOCK}S?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NoSpaceForReward
lines.text: Oh, my…\pYour POKéMON is growing quite well,\nso you deserve a reward.\pUnfortunately, you have no space for\nthis in your BAG.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonMostImpressiveGiveItThis
lines.text: Your {STR_VAR_1}, it is growing in\na most impressive manner!\lIt is one fine specimen!\pBut! If you were to give it this,\nit would grow even better! Indeed!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainRedScarf
lines.text: Let a POKéMON hold that RED SCARF.\pEveryone will recognize the coolness\nof that POKéMON!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainBlueScarf
lines.text: Let a POKéMON hold that BLUE SCARF.\pIts beauty will be accentuated much\nmore than now!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainPinkScarf
lines.text: Let a POKéMON hold that PINK SCARF.\pIt will draw out the cuteness of\nthe POKéMON some more!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainGreenScarf
lines.text: Let a POKéMON hold that GREEN SCARF.\pThat will enhance the\nsmartness of POKéMON!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainYellowScarf
lines.text: Let a POKéMON hold that YELLOW SCARF.\pIt will bolster your POKéMON's\ntoughness so much more!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NothingElseToGiveYou
lines.text: I'm sorry, but I've nothing else to\ngive you! None at all!\pAfter all, you're blessed with the gift\nof raising POKéMON without resorting\lto any items!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ShowMePokemonThatLoveYou
lines.text:
I love seeing POKéMON that love
their TRAINERS.\pPOKéMON are very sensitive to
the feelings of their TRAINERS.\pIf you treat your POKéMON with love
and care, they'll love you back.\pWhen your POKéMON grow to love you,
please come show me.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PokemonAdoresYou
lines.text: Your POKéMON really adores you.\pFor you, a most compassionate\nTRAINER, a gift from the FAN CLUB!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_TreatPokemonWithLove
lines.text: POKéMON are very sensitive to\nthe feelings of their TRAINERS.\pIf you treat your POKéMON with love\nand care, they'll love you back.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PokemonDontLikeFainting
lines.text:
If you keep letting a POKéMON faint
in battle, it'll come to resent it.\pSoon, it will become less trusting
of the TRAINER.\pIn other words, it certainly won't
like you very much.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonEnjoyedProtein
lines.text: Do POKéMON enjoy having items used\non them?\pMine acted really happy when I gave\nit some PROTEIN.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Skitty
lines.text: SKITTY: Fffnyaaaah…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Zigzagoon
lines.text: ZIGZAGOON: Kyuuu…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Azumarill
lines.text: AZUMARILL: Marimari?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CantMakeHeadsOrTails
lines.text:
Umm… If this goes here, and that
goes over there…\pThen where does this thing go?
And what about that doohickey?\pAaargh! I can't make heads or tails
of this!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
lines.text:
Hm?
Hi, I'm DOCK.\pCAPT. STERN commissioned me to
design a ferry.\pOh! That there…
Are they DEVON GOODS?\pBut, hmm…
This won't do…\pCAPT. STERN went off somewhere.
He said he had some work to do.\pCould I get you to go find CAPT.
STERN and deliver that to him?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldYouFindStern
lines.text: DOCK: Where could CAPT. STERN have\ngone off to?\pCould you go find CAPT. STERN and\ndeliver that parcel to him?$
