lines.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldUseAdviceFromVeteran
lines.text: DOCK: Shipbuilding is an art.\pA lot of things can't be figured out\njust by calculating.\pI really could use advice from a veteran\nwho knows the seas…$

lines.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_BrineyJoinedUs
lines.text: DOCK: Hi! MR. BRINEY's joined us to\nlend us his help.\pThanks to the veteran sailor, the\nferry is steadily coming together.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
lines.text:
DOCK: The ferry is finally ready!\pThe new S.S. TIDAL is truly a marvel
of technology!\pBut, I get the feeling that we can
make something even better.\pYou know, there's never an end to
technology's march.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
lines.text:
MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
It's been too long!\pAye, since I met you, this old sea dog's
been feeling frisky!\pSo I've decided to help DOCK make
a ferry.\pAye, after all, a ferry would be able
to carry a lot of people.\pBut, you know, that DOCK is really
something special.\pWith his knack for technology and
my experience, I'm sure that we can\lbuild one great ship, aye!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
lines.text:
The seasons, the weather, where
the moon sits in the sky…\pThese and other conditions make
the sea change its expression.\pThat's right!
The sea is like a living thing!$

lines.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_GetSeasickEasily
lines.text: I get seasick real easily.\nSo I get to help out here instead.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_ShipDesignMoreLikeBuilding
lines.text: Designing a large ship is more like\nmaking a big building than putting\ltogether a transportation vehicle.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_FloatsBecauseBuoyancy
lines.text: Don't you think it's strange that\na ship made of heavy iron floats?\pIt floats because of a principle\ncalled buoyancy.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_GymSign
lines.text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: JUAN\p“The GYM LEADER with the beauty\nof pure water!”$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_CitySign
lines.text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY\p“The mystical city where history\nslumbers.”$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoorIsClosed
lines.text: The door is closed.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_PhysicallyFitLivingHere
lines.text: Diving in the sea. Climbing up and\ndown stairs all the time…\pIf you live in this town, you end up\ngetting physically fit.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenlyAppeared
lines.text:
These giant POKéMON suddenly appeared
in the middle of the city!\pAnd, I've never seen them before!\pWhy are they smashing into each
other like that?\pWhy can't they be friends, those
POKéMON?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatIsThatGreenPokemon
lines.text: What? What? What?\nWhat is that green POKéMON?!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhereDidLegendariesGo
lines.text: GROUDON and KYOGRE…\nWhere did they go?\pWill they cause droughts or downpours\nsomewhere else?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_TwoPokemonArentAngry
lines.text: I just get this sense somehow that\nthe two POKéMON aren't angry.\pI think… They probably can't control\ntheir own power…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_FlyingMonStoppedRampage
lines.text: That flying POKéMON came down from\nthe sky and stopped the rampaging\lPOKéMON…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_WonderWhatWorldIsLike
lines.text: I… I've never been out of this city.\pI wonder what the world is like on\nthe other side of this round sky?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThisIsWicked
lines.text: Wow!\nThis is wicked!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThatWasWicked
lines.text: Wow!\nThat was wicked!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_GoRedAndBlueMon
lines.text: Go for it, red POKéMON!\nDon't back off, blue POKéMON!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoYouKnowMonNames
lines.text: … … … … … …\pHi, do you know the names of those\nPOKéMON fighting over there?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_GreenOneSettlesThings
lines.text: I was wondering which one would win,\nthe red one or the blue one, but, oh no,\lit's the green one that settles things!\pTalk about a huge turn of events!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnEyes
lines.text:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by\la colossal battle between POKéMON.\pWell, I'm seeing that happen with
my very own eyes!\pWhoa! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes
lines.text:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by\la colossal battle between POKéMON.\pWell, I saw that happen with
my very own eyes!\pWhoa! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_BigPokemonFighting
lines.text: A big POKéMON is fighting with\nanother big POKéMON!\pPlease, someone make them stop!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_PrettyMonCameFromSky
lines.text: A pretty POKéMON came down from\nthe sky…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisWillBeWrecked
lines.text: Oh, no!\nSOOTOPOLIS CITY will get wrecked!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisDidntGetWrecked
lines.text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY didn't get wrecked!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_NoOrdinaryTourist
lines.text: Hm!\nYou've come all the way to SOOTOPOLIS?\lYou're no ordinary tourist.\pBut I suppose that doesn't make you\nan extraordinary tourist, either.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_CityRegainedCalm
lines.text: The city has regained its calm…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLeave
lines.text: Who might you be?\pThis is the CAVE OF ORIGIN.\pThe spirits of POKéMON, becalmed at\nMT. PYRE, are said to be revived here.\pPlease leave.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerToCave
lines.text:
A person with a strong will and
superior talent…\pA TRAINER who has knowledge and
experience of many kinds of POKéMON…\pIf such a person were to appear, I was
instructed by WALLACE to lead that\lTRAINER to this CAVE.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_AwakenedPokemonClash
lines.text: Oh, my…\pThe clash between the two awakened\nPOKéMON was quelled by the awakening\lof a third POKéMON…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginSleepsToo
lines.text: This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN…\pWith the passing of the crisis,\nthe cave, too, shall sleep…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautiful
lines.text:
SOOTOPOLIS sprang up as a town in
the crater of a volcano.\pIf you look up at the sky, the lip of
the crater is also visible.\lSo, all you see is the sky in a circle.\pBut that's what makes the sky above
SOOTOPOLIS the most beautiful.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiganticPokemonFight
lines.text: When two POKéMON that gigantic\nare fighting that savagely, there's\lnot much that we can do.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_FearedWorstWhenPokemonFlewDown
lines.text: When that third POKéMON flew down,\nI feared the worst.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_NightSkyFavoriteScenery
lines.text: A circle of a night sky framed by\nthe crater of a volcano…\pAnd in that ring, stars flicker and\nblink as if they were alive…\lIt's my favorite scenery.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild
lines.text:
The weather was clear this morning,
but…\pAll of a sudden, dark clouds brewed up,
rain started falling in sheets, and\lthere was thunder and lightning, too.\pThe weather just went completely
wild!\pIs all of this because of those
POKéMON?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_YouBroughtFlyingMon
lines.text: Oh?\pIt was you who brought that flying\nPOKéMON here?\pWell, aren't you amazing!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop
lines.text: MAXIE: G… GROUDON…\nPlease! Stop what you're doing!\pI know the extent of your power now!\pIf you keep going, all HOENN, not just\nSOOTOPOLIS, will be utterly ruined!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming
lines.text:
MAXIE: So the super-ancient POKéMON
weren't only GROUDON and KYOGRE…\pAfter all our fruitless scheming and
frantic efforts, that one POKéMON's\lsimple action puts everything right\lagain as if nothing had happened…\pFu…
Fuhahaha…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_KyogreCalmDown
lines.text:
ARCHIE: KYOGRE! What's wrong?!
Look over here! It's the RED ORB!\lCalm down! KYOGRE!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pIt's no good!
It's not responding at all!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToPokemon
lines.text:
ARCHIE: KYOGRE and GROUDON both
flew off to who knows where.\pThe weather in HOENN has returned
to its normal state…\pHaha…
Hahaha…\pMaybe what we were trying to do was
something small, even meaningless,\lto POKéMON…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
lines.text:
STEVEN: Those POKéMON fighting…
GROUDON… And KYOGRE…\pThe two super-ancient POKéMON
were awakened from a long sleep…\pAnd now they are smashing each other
with their uncontrollable energy…\p…{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pYou being here now I'll take to mean
that you're prepared to become\linvolved in this crisis.\pWell, then, there's someone that
I'd like you to meet.\pCome with me, please.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon
lines.text:
STEVEN: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pDoes seeing GROUDON and KYOGRE make
you think POKéMON are to be feared?\pBut that's not true.
POKéMON are really more…\p…Why am I asking you this?
You already know.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWallace
lines.text: STEVEN: Okay, here we are!\pInside here you'll find someone named\nWALLACE.\pI think you have what's needed to\nhelp him…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_KnowWhatsNeededToHelpHim
lines.text: STEVEN: I think you have what's\nneeded to help him…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_NeverBeenToSkyPillar
lines.text: STEVEN: The SKY PILLAR…\pI've never been there.\nI wonder where it could be?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza
lines.text: STEVEN: So that's RAYQUAZA…\pIt's incredible how the two rampaging\nPOKéMON would flee from it in fear…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_MaxieArchieLeft
lines.text: STEVEN: It looks like both MAXIE and\nARCHIE have gone away somewhere.\pPerhaps they've gone to MT. PYRE to\nreturn those ORBS…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPillar
lines.text:
WALLACE: Oh?
{PLAYER}{KUN}?\pHaven't you scaled the SKY PILLAR
yet?\pI'm sure that you can make it to
the top of the SKY PILLAR…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHarm
lines.text: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pThe leaders of TEAM MAGMA and AQUA,\nI don't think they meant harm.\pIt wouldn't hurt to hear what they\nhave to say for themselves.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAcceptThis
lines.text:
WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
My eyes didn't deceive me.\pThanks to your help, SOOTOPOLIS…
No, all of HOENN was saved.\pOn behalf of the people, I thank you.\pThis is a gift from me.
Please accept it.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoToGym
lines.text:
That HIDDEN MACHINE contains
WATERFALL.\pIf you have the RAIN BADGE, a POKéMON
that has learned that HM move can\lforce its way up waterfalls.\pAnd where does one get the RAIN BADGE?
You know, don't you?\pThat's right! You have to beat
the SOOTOPOLIS GYM LEADER.\pWhen you're all set to go, step through
that door.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_DazzledByMentor
lines.text: WALLACE: I'm sure that you will be\ndazzled by my mentor's breathtakingly\lelegant battle style.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
lines.text:
Yo! How's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pSOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER JUAN is
a master of WATER-type POKéMON.\pAnd, to get to JUAN, an icy floor
will hamper your progress…\pListen, I'm sorry, but that's all the
advice that I have for you.\pThe rest of the way, you have to
go for it yourself!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
lines.text: Yow! You've beaten even JUAN, who\nwas supposedly the best in all HOENN!\pOkay! Check out your TRAINER CARD.\pIf you've gotten all the BADGES, you're\nset for the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
lines.text:
Let me ask you.
Did you know?\lAh, I should not be so coy.\pIt was I who taught WALLACE everything
there is to know about POKéMON.\pOnce, I had given up my position as
the GYM LEADER.\pIn my place, I had entrusted WALLACE
with the GYM.\pHowever, a compelling reason arose for
me to make a comeback.\pAh, but enough chatter.
Let us begin our match, shall we?\pPlease, you shall bear witness to
our artistry.\pA grand illusion of water sculpted
by POKéMON and myself!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
lines.text:
Ahahaha, excellent!
Very well, you are the winner.\pFrom you, I sense the brilliant shine
of skill that will overcome all.\pHowever, compared with me or even
WALLACE, you are lacking in elegance.\pPerhaps I should make you a loan
of my outfit?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pHahaha, I merely jest!\pRather than my clothes, I shall reward
you with this, the RAIN BADGE!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedRainBadge
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the RAIN BADGE\nfrom JUAN.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBadgeTakeThis
lines.text:
Having the RAIN BADGE shall assure you
the full obedience of all your POKéMON\lto your every command.\pThe RAIN BADGE also allows the use
of the HM move WATERFALL to scale\lwalls of cascading water.\pAnd, so that you never forget the
battle we shared, take this…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainWaterPulse
lines.text: The TECHNICAL MACHINE I handed you\ncontains WATER PULSE.\pIn use, it will occasionally confuse\nthe target with ultrasonic waves.\p… … … … … …$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredJuan
lines.text: Registered GYM LEADER JUAN\nin the POKéNAV.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattle
lines.text:
The TRAINERS who have gathered all
the GYM BADGES of HOENN should make\lway to the ultimate destination.\pThe POKéMON LEAGUE.\pTravel to the easternmost reaches
of HOENN, to the island EVER GRANDE.\pThere, you shall find the POKéMON
LEAGUE.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GoGetFortreeBadge
lines.text: There remains but one BADGE to\nobtain in HOENN.\pIf you wish to challenge the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must obtain the last\lBADGE from the GYM in FORTREE.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatue
lines.text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
lines.text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM\pJUAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematch
lines.text:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…\pBut our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!\pWell, my friend, most certainly!\pI shall be delighted to dance with you
as often as you wish!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchDefeat
lines.text: Ahahaha, you are the winner!\nYou have defeated me again!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRematch
lines.text:
JUAN: If I told you to become my
apprentice, you will refuse, I am sure.\pI would like to make a gift of my coat
to you.\pBut again, you will refuse.
I imagine that to be so.\pAnd that, my friend, is a certain sign
of nobility!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
lines.text:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…\pBut our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!\pWell, my friend, most certainly!
I shall be delighted to dance with you…\pAh, no, no, no.
You have with you but one POKéMON.\pI wish that you would return with
two, perhaps more, POKéMON, please.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaIntro
lines.text: I'll show you the sublime techniques\nI learned from our LEADER JUAN!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaDefeat
lines.text: Please forgive me, JUAN…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaPostBattle
lines.text: Watch what happens if you crack all\nthe floor tiles.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro
lines.text: You came all the way here, but you won't\nget to see JUAN.\pNot if you lose to me, you won't!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyDefeat
lines.text: You're strong!\nI was fooled by your cute looks!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyPostBattle
lines.text: You might be good enough to avoid\nbeing wiped out in one hit by JUAN.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro
lines.text: The sight of JUAN conducting\na battle…\pThe very beauty of it compelled me to\nbecome a TRAINER.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneDefeat
lines.text: You battled with more beauty than\nI could muster…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBattle
lines.text: The grace you bring to battle is\nfabulous.\pOh… I'm so fortunate to have found\nPOKéMON.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieIntro
lines.text: I should teach you how harsh battles\ncan be.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieDefeat
lines.text: Oh.\nYou're strong.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBattle
lines.text: I'll tell you something good.\pIf you want to reach JUAN, you\nneed to walk on each floor tile once.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro
lines.text: The POKéMON GYM of the highest level\nin the HOENN region…\pThat's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetDefeat
lines.text: What a high level you are!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetPostBattle
lines.text: Rather than being satisfied by being\nin a strong GYM, I imagine training in\lother places will make you stronger.\lBut above all, it looks more fun.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro
lines.text: I train my POKéMON together with\nJUAN.\pDon't think I'm a pushover.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaDefeat
lines.text: I was beaten…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaPostBattle
lines.text: I think you have potential.\nWhy don't you stay and train with us?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro
lines.text: A graceful glide across the ice while\ncrossing no lines…\pA TRAINER putting on that performance\nwould be elegantly beautiful!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyDefeat
lines.text: Well, excuse me?!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyPostBattle
lines.text: This is really obvious, but how strong\nyou are as a TRAINER has nothing to do\lwith how young or old you are.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyIntro
lines.text: When I'm with my POKéMON, the time\nflies by before you can say, “Oops!”$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyDefeat
lines.text: Oops!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyPostBattle
lines.text: I wish I could forget about lost causes\nbefore I can manage an “Oops!”$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaIntro
lines.text: I can battle with really rare POKéMON\nif you'd like.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaDefeat
lines.text: Oh, there now! Did you have a good look\nat my POKéMON?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBattle
lines.text: I came to this GYM because JUAN\npraised me for my darling POKéMON.\pOh, if only I'd met JUAN years ago\nwhen I was younger…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaIntro
lines.text: Giggle…\nYour grim look is so charming.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaDefeat
lines.text: Oh, dear.\nI went much too easy on you.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaPostBattle
lines.text: You couldn't lay a finger on JUAN,\nI'm sure. Giggle…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_DevelopedThisTM
lines.text: For thirty years I've remained in\nSOOTOPOLIS honing my skills.\pI developed a shattering TM.\nI bequeath it to you!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_ExplainBrickBreak
lines.text: TM31 contains BRICK BREAK! It's a move\nso horrible that I can't describe it.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_Kecleon
lines.text: KECLEON: Puu puhyaah.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAboutMtPyreOrbs
lines.text: MT. PYRE…\pAt its peak are two orbs placed side\nby side. Did you know?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSideBySide
lines.text: Yes, two orbs side by side…\pThe sight of them together…\nIt is somehow soothing…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_OughtToVisitAndSee
lines.text: Is that so?\nPerhaps you ought to visit and see…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
lines.text: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?\pSOOTOPOLIS's JUAN has many fans.\nEven more than his student WALLACE!\pDo you have any?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_YouMustBePrettyStrong
lines.text: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWorkingHarder
lines.text: Oh, dear…\nThat's a little lonesome.\pTry working a little harder to get\na fan following.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClubWasWild
lines.text: Dedicated fans come over from even\noutside of HOENN.\pIt was really wild when I went to the\nTRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasuresWaitingInSea
lines.text:
Listen up, and I'll tell you something
good.\pThere's supposed to be an ancient
ruin in the sea around here.\pThere could be treasures just waiting
to be discovered down there.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_StrollUnderwaterWithPokemon
lines.text: Ancient treasures…\pIt would be nice if they existed, but\neven if they didn't, it would be so\lbeautiful to take an underwater\lstroll with my POKéMON.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_Azumarill
lines.text: AZUMARILL: Marurii.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtPyreConnection
lines.text: There appears to be some connection\nbetween SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE.\pMy friends and I did some research on\nit at the lab where I used to work.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_BrotherUsedToStudySea
lines.text: My big brother used to study the sea.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_FirstGuestInWhileTakeDoll
lines.text: Hello! You're our first guest in\na good while.\pYou've brightened up my day, so I'll\ngive you a big WAILMER DOLL.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_TakeGoodCareOfIt
lines.text: Take good care of it!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_IllHoldItForYou
lines.text: Oh, you want it, but not right now?\nOkay, then I'll hold it for you.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_DontWantThisDoll
lines.text: Are you sure?\nYou don't want this DOLL?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_LovePlushDolls
lines.text: I love plush DOLLS!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CityFromEruptedVolcano
lines.text:
An underwater volcano erupted and
forced itself up from the depths.\pIts crater emerged from the sea and
became filled with rainwater.\pThat's how SOOTOPOLIS CITY came into
being.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CaveMadeToKeepSomething
lines.text: The cave that links SOOTOPOLIS and\nthe outside world…\pIt seems as if the cave was made to\nkeep something from getting out.\pOr am I just imagining things?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
lines.text:
Do you know the POKéMON SEEDOT?
It's hardly ever seen in SOOTOPOLIS.\pAnyway, I love big SEEDOT.
The bigger the better.\pBut my younger brother, he says that
LOTAD is bigger.\pThat's silly.
SEEDOT has to be bigger than that!\pHuh? Do you have a SEEDOT with you?
P-p-please, show me!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_GoshMightBeBiggerThanLotad
lines.text:
{STR_VAR_2} inches!
Oh, my gosh, this is a big one!\pIt might even beat the big LOTAD
my younger brother saw!\pThanks for showing me.
This is my thanks!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ReceivedPotion1
lines.text: {PLAYER} received a POTION.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BagCrammedFull1
lines.text: Hunh?\nYour BAG is crammed full.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerSeedot
lines.text: {STR_VAR_2} inches, is it?\pHmm… I've seen a bigger SEEDOT\nthan this one.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ThatsNotSeedot
lines.text: Oh, now this is quite something…\nBut it's not a SEEDOT!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigSeedot
lines.text: You don't have a big SEEDOT?\nThat's too bad…\pIf you get a big SEEDOT, please\ncome show me.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestSeedotInHistory
lines.text: The biggest SEEDOT in history!\n{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}-inch giant!\pA SEEDOT bigger than a LOTAD\nalways wanted!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
lines.text:
Do you know the POKéMON LOTAD?
It's rarely seen in SOOTOPOLIS.\pI love, I mean love, big LOTAD!\pMy big brother says that SEEDOT is
bigger.\pBut that's wrong! Everyone knows that
LOTAD is a lot bigger.\pHunh? Do you have a LOTAD?
P-p-please show me!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_WowMightBeBiggerThanSeedot
lines.text:
{STR_VAR_2} inches!
Wow, that is big!\pIt might be even bigger than the huge
SEEDOT my big brother saw.\pThanks for showing me!
This is my thanks!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ReceivedPotion2
lines.text: {PLAYER} received a POTION.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BagCrammedFull2
lines.text: Hunh?\nYour BAG is crammed full.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerLotad
lines.text: {STR_VAR_2} inches?\pHmm… I've seen a bigger LOTAD\nthan this one here.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ThatsNotLotad
lines.text: Well, isn't this something!\nBut it's no LOTAD!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigLotad
lines.text: Don't you have a big LOTAD?\nHow disappointing…\pIf you get a big LOTAD, please\ncome show me!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestLotadInHistory
lines.text: The biggest LOTAD in history!\n{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}-inch colossus!\pA LOTAD bigger than a SEEDOT\nalways wanted!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat
lines.text: PP UP is great!\pIt raises the POWER POINTS, the PP,\nof a POKéMON move.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside
lines.text: What…\nWhat is happening?\pI really want to know, but it's too\nscary to go outside.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItemOfDreams
lines.text: Do you know FULL RESTORE?\pFull restoration of HP!\nEradication of all status problems!\pIt's truly an item of your dreams!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_DidSomethingAwaken
lines.text: This weather…\nDid something awaken?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_OnlyAmusementWatchingBattles
lines.text: When I was young, I traveled the world\nas a POKéMON TRAINER.\pNow that I've become an old buzzard,\nmy only amusement is watching young\lTRAINERS battle.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_DoorAppearsToBeLocked
lines.text: The door appears to be locked.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
lines.text: A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1}\nis visiting my home.\pWould you like to challenge\n{STR_VAR_1}?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_YouWontBattle
lines.text: You won't battle? I'm disappointed\nthat I can't see you battle…$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_KeepItTo3On3
lines.text: Oh, good, good!\pBut my house isn't all that sturdy.\pCould I ask you to keep it down to\na 3-on-3 match?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_SaveProgressBeforeBattle
lines.text: Before you two battle, you should\nsave your progress.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_HopeToSeeGoodMatch
lines.text: I hope to see a good match!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Tie
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_B1F_Text_MatchEndedUpDraw
lines.text: The match ended up a draw.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_BrilliantStandoff
lines.text: So, it became a standoff.\pIt was a brilliant match in which\nneither side conceded a step!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Won
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_ThatWasSuperlative
lines.text: That was superlative!\pWhy, it was like seeing myself in\nmy youth again!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Lost
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_TooBadForYou
lines.text: Ah, too bad for you!\pBut it was a good match.\nI hope you can win next time.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WallaceToughestInHoenn
lines.text:
WALLACE is rumored to be the toughest
TRAINER in the whole HOENN region.\pThis town's GYM is led by the TRAINER
who taught WALLACE.\pBut the ELITE FOUR… They're said to be
even stronger than WALLACE's mentor.\pHow strong could they be?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneTakenRefuge
lines.text: Everyone in town has taken refuge\nand won't come out of their homes.\pEven I would rather not venture\noutside.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AlwaysBeFriendsWithPokemon
lines.text: Whenever, wherever, and whatever\nhappens, I will always be friends with\lPOKéMON.\pBecause it's fun to be with POKéMON!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ArentPokemonOurFriends
lines.text: Aren't POKéMON our friends?\pWhy are they going wild this way?$

lines.label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
lines.text:
SCOTT: Well, hi, hi!
{PLAYER}{KUN}, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pSomething's come up, so I have to
disembark, but am I glad to see you!\pCongratulations, LEAGUE CHAMPION!\pThere's a place I'd like to invite
someone like you.\pIt's the…
BATTLE FRONTIER!\pWhat's the place like?
You'll understand when you see it!\pI've spoken with the ship's CAPTAIN
about this.\pThe next time you take a ferry,
you should be able to sail to\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll be waiting for you
at the BATTLE FRONTIER!$

lines.label: SSTidal_Text_FastCurrentsHopeYouEnjoyVoyage
lines.text: This ferry is built to plow through\nfast-running currents.\pWe hope you enjoy your voyage with us.\nFeel free to explore the ship.$

lines.label: SSTidal_Text_HopeYouEnjoyVoyage
lines.text: We hope you enjoy your voyage on\nour ferry.$

lines.label: SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInSlateport
lines.text: We have made land in SLATEPORT CITY.\nThank you for sailing with us.$

lines.label: SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInLilycove
lines.text: We have made land in LILYCOVE CITY.\nThank you for sailing with us.$

lines.label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_CanRestInCabin2
lines.text:
It'll be some time before we make land,
I reckon.\pYou can rest up in your cabin if you'd
like. Your cabin's No. 2.\pThe bed in there is soft and plushy.
I can attest to how comfy it is!$

lines.label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_WeveArrived
lines.text: We've arrived!$

lines.label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_VisitOtherCabins
lines.text: Go visit other cabins.\nTRAINERS bored of the boat trip will\lbe itching to battle.$

lines.label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_EnjoyYourCruise
lines.text: Enjoy your cruise!$

lines.label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_HorizonSpreadsBeyondPorthole
lines.text: The horizon spreads beyond\nthe porthole.$

lines.label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard
lines.text:
MR. BRINEY: Welcome aboard, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pThey made me honorary captain of
the S.S. TIDAL!\pYou can call me CAPTAIN BRINEY now!\pYou know, I retired once before,
but when I saw this majestic ship…\pLet me just say, it stirred my sleeping
soul as a sailor!$

lines.label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Peeko
lines.text: PEEKO: Pihyo pihyohyo…$

lines.label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin1
lines.text: Cabin 1$

lines.label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin2
lines.text: Cabin 2$

lines.label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin3
lines.text: Cabin 3$

lines.label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin4
lines.text: Cabin 4$

lines.label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipIntro
lines.text: Arrrgh! I'm fed up and dog-tired of\ncleaning this huge place!\pLet's have a quick battle!$

lines.label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipDefeat
lines.text: Little bro, I lost!$

lines.label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipPostBattle
lines.text: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!\pThe old one dumps the detergent,\nand the young one does the scrubbing!$

lines.label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardIntro
lines.text: This is the bottom of the ship's hull.\nThere's plenty of room.\lIt'll be alright for a POKéMON battle.$

lines.label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardDefeat
lines.text: Big bro, I lost!$

lines.label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardPostBattle
lines.text: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!\pThe old one dumps the detergent,\nand the young one does the scrubbing!$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_TakeRestOnBed
lines.text: There's a bed…\nLet's take a rest.$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonIntro
lines.text: I often sail to LILYCOVE CITY.\pI enjoy attending CONTESTS,\nyou see.$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonDefeat
lines.text: That was an enjoyable match!$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonPostBattle
lines.text: I get so excited imagining what kinds\nof POKéMON I'll get to see in the next\lCONTEST. The anticipation of it thrills!$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahIntro
lines.text: Are your friends strong?$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahDefeat
lines.text: Your friends are, indeed, strong.$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahPostBattle
lines.text: Friends need not be human.\nFor me, POKéMON are treasured friends!$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasIntro
lines.text: Child…\nDid you knock on the door?$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasDefeat
lines.text: A loss is to be accepted without haste\nor panic.$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasPostBattle
lines.text: To be never ruffled in any situation is\nthe GENTLEMAN's code of conduct.$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedIntro
lines.text: JED: I feel a little shy about this, but…\nWe'll show you our lovey-dovey power!$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedDefeat
lines.text: JED: Sigh…$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedPostBattle
lines.text: JED: It's the first time that our lovey-\ndovey power couldn't prevail!\lYou must be an awesome TRAINER!$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedNotEnoughMons
lines.text: JED: You only have one POKéMON?\nIsn't that just too lonesome?$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaIntro
lines.text: LEA: I feel a little silly, but…\nWe'll show you our lovey-dovey power!$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaDefeat
lines.text: LEA: Oh, boo!$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaPostBattle
lines.text: LEA: I can't believe it!\nOur lovey-dovey power failed…\lYou must be an awesome TRAINER!$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaNotEnoughMons
lines.text: LEA: I wanted to battle…\nBut you don't even have two POKéMON…$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretIntro
lines.text: Ah, you've come just in time.\pI'm bored, you see.\nYou may entertain me.$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretDefeat
lines.text: …That will do.$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretPostBattle
lines.text: Perhaps I shall get Father to acquire\na yacht for me.\lA yacht for me and POKéMON!$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiIntro
lines.text: Oh, you're such an adorable TRAINER.\nWould you like to have tea?\lOr would you rather battle?$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiDefeat
lines.text: I see.\nYou're the active sort.$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiPostBattle
lines.text: A world cruise on a luxury liner has its\ncharms, I must say…\pBut, I will admit there is an appealing\nside to touring HOENN by ferry.$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_NotSuspiciousTakeThis
lines.text: Uh… Hi! I… I'm not acting suspicious!\nUh… You can have this! For free!\pIt… Honestly, I didn't SNATCH it from\nsomeone! I'd never do such a thing!\lIt's clean! You can use it!$

lines.label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ExplainSnatch
lines.text: SNATCH steals the beneficial effects\nof certain moves before they can be\lused by a foe or ally.$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_StillGettingReady
lines.text: This is the TRAINER HILL where\nyou may enjoy tag battles with many\lTRAINERS.\pUnfortunately, we're still getting\nthings ready. Please come back later!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WelcomeToTrainerHill
lines.text: Welcome!\pThis is the TRAINER HILL where\nyou may enjoy tag battles with many\lTRAINERS!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_SaveGameBeforeEnter
lines.text: Is this your first visit here?\pBefore you enter, please save\nyour game.$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersUpToFloorX
lines.text: Let's see…\nThe TRAINERS here now are…\pUp to floor no. {STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersInEveryRoom
lines.text: Let's see…\nThe TRAINERS here now are…\pThere appear to be TRAINERS gathered\nin every room.$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_LikeToChallengeTrainers
lines.text: Would you like to challenge the\nwaiting TRAINERS?$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGetSetGo
lines.text: I will time your progress.\nBest of luck!\pOn your marks…\pGet set…\pGo!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_PleaseVisitUsAgain
lines.text: Please do visit us again!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TooBadTremendousEffort
lines.text: That was too bad.\pI think you put in a tremendous\neffort in your battling.\pPlease come back and try again!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest
lines.text: I hope you give it your best.$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_MovedReceptionHereForSwitch
lines.text: When the TRAINERS switch places,\nthe movement can be hectic.\pTo avoid the stampede, we moved\nthe reception counter here.\pI'm sorry for the inconvenience.$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ThankYouForPlaying
lines.text: Thank you for playing!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainerHill
lines.text:
Here at the TRAINER HILL, we conduct
an event called the Time Attack.\pIt is a race that measures how long
you take to reach our owner on\lthe rooftop from this counter.\pThe fastest times are posted on
the Time Board--try competing with\lyour friends.\pIn TRAINER battles along the way,
neither Exp. Points nor money will\lbe awarded.$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_NeedAtLeastTwoPokemon
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry, but you appear to have\nonly one POKéMON with you.\pYou will need at least two POKéMON\nto enter this event.$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
lines.text:
Hm! Hm!\pYou finally came!
Yes, you have arrived!\pWait! Don't say it!
I know why you came all the way\lhere by yourself!\pYou wanted to see me, the owner
of the TRAINER HILL, because…\pYou want to form a tag team with me!
Wa-hoo!\p…Uh?
That's not it?\pAnyway, I watched you on your way up.
Marvelous battling! Bravo, indeed!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_HaveTheMostMarvelousGift
lines.text: For a marvelous someone like you,\nI have the most marvelous gift!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_FullUpBeBackLaterForThis
lines.text: Oh, no, full up with things!\nYou'll be back later for this!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_GotHereMarvelouslyQuickly
lines.text:
Oh, hold on here! Did you possibly get
here marvelously quickly?\pHow splendid! You needn't have
hurried so to see me!\pThat is so delightful. I'll have the Time
Board at the reception updated!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouWerentVeryQuick
lines.text: But, oh…\nYou weren't very quick getting here.$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_ArriveZippierNextTime
lines.text: Perhaps it would please me more if you\narrived zippier next time.\pThen, I should be pleased to form\na tag team with you!\pUntil we meet again, amigo!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_BuiltTrainerHillToFindPartner
lines.text: I had the TRAINER HILL built for but\none reason and one only!\pTo find the most suitable partner\nwith whom I may form a tag team!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ChallengeTime
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1} min. {STR_VAR_2}.{STR_VAR_3} sec.$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WhatSortOfTrainersAreAhead
lines.text: Who knows what sort of TRAINERS\nand POKéMON combos are ahead?\pAll I know is that I'll knock aside\nanyone that stands in my way!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_CantWaitToTestTheWaters
lines.text: I heard tough TRAINERS come to this\nTRAINER HILL from all over.\pI can't wait to test the waters!\pI'll knock aside anyone that stands\nin my way!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_FriendsTryingToReachTimeBoardTop
lines.text: Do you see the Time Board over there?\pMy friends and I are trying to see who\ncan reach the top in the least time.$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_DoYouKnowWhenTheyOpen
lines.text: Do you know when they're opening\nthis place up?\pI'm waiting here to be the first\nchallenger ever!$

lines.label: TrainerHill_Elevator_Text_ReturnToReception
lines.text: Would you like to return to\nthe reception counter?$

lines.label: Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplorer1
lines.text:
“SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1” is painted
on the hull.\pThis is the submarine TEAM AQUA
stole in SLATEPORT!\pTEAM AQUA must have gone
ashore here.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
lines.text:
My papa told me.\pHe says this tunnel is full of
timid POKéMON.\pThey get all scared of loud noise and
make a big uproar.\pSo they had to stop the big tunnel
project.\pBut there's one man. He's trying to dig
the tunnel by himself!$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManDugTunnelForLove
lines.text: There was a man who dug a tunnel for\na lady he loved.\pI don't really get it, but hey!$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_Text_AirCleanHere
lines.text: The way the winds blow, volcanic ash\nis never blown in this direction.\pThe air is clean and delicious here.\nLiving here should do wonders for even\lfrail and sickly people.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_Text_MakeBattleTentDebut
lines.text: My POKéMON and I, we've been riding\na hot winning streak.\pSo I decided to make my BATTLE TENT\ndebut in this town.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThroughCave
lines.text:
Did you see the cave next to the
POKéMON MART?\pThere's a guy in there who's trying to
bust up boulders so he can bust out\lthrough to the other side.\pIt'd be great if we could go through…
It'll make it easy to visit RUSTBORO.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_Text_EasyToGetToRustboroNow
lines.text: That cave next to the POKéMON MART\nis now a tunnel to the other side.\pIt's great--it's easy to go shop for\nnew DEVON products in RUSTBORO now.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_Text_TownSign
lines.text: VERDANTURF TOWN\p“The windswept highlands with the\nsweet fragrance of grass.”$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_Text_WandasHouse
lines.text: WANDA'S HOUSE$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_Text_BattleTentSign
lines.text: BATTLE TENT VERDANTURF SITE\n“Feast Your Eyes on Battles!”$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
lines.text: RUSTURF TUNNEL\n“Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF\p“The tunnel project has been\ncanceled.”$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_WhichContestYouEntering
lines.text:
Which CONTEST are you entering?
Want a piece of advice?\pIn any CONTEST, for example, a CUTE
CONTEST, I don't think they judge you\lonly on cuteness in the first round.\pYou need to work out ways for raising
POKéMON better.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeCute
lines.text: I raised my POKéMON to be cute.\pI found out you can put POKéMON in\na CONTEST for cuteness!\pI'm so glad I raised my POKéMON with\nloving care…$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_MyMonRules
lines.text: My POKéMON rules!\pIt's cool, tough yet beautiful, cute,\nand smart. It's complete!\pI may as well go for wins in every\nsingle CONTEST.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_NormalRankStage
lines.text: POKéMON CONTESTS\nNORMAL RANK STAGE!$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MonsReluctantToUseDislikedMoves
lines.text:
If it doesn't like a certain move,
a POKéMON will be reluctant to use it.\pIt doesn't matter how strong it is,
either.\pFor example, a POKéMON with a GENTLE
nature probably won't enjoy hurting\lits opponents.\pIf it can't seem to live up to its
potential, it's probably failing at\lusing a disliked move against its will.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_GentleMonsScaryIfAngry
lines.text: My big sister is gentle usually.\nBut when she gets angry,\lshe's really, really scary!\pI bet a gentle POKéMON will be scary\nif it gets angry!$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionRunsDeep
lines.text:
My feelings toward my POKéMON…
The attraction runs deep…\pOh, hi, you didn't see that, did you?
Well, it doesn't matter.\pHow would you like this TM for
your POKéMON?$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionMutual
lines.text: My feelings toward my POKéMON…\nI'm sure the attraction is mutual!\pThey battle exactly the way I want\nthem to!$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TaughtWhatKindsOfMoves
lines.text: What kind of moves have you taught\nyour POKéMON?\pI think you would give yourself\nan advantage if they knew how to\lheal or protect themselves.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottCanMeetToughTrainers
lines.text:
SCOTT: Hey there, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I thought I might see you here.\pA BATTLE TENT's a place where
you can meet tough TRAINERS.\pIt doesn't matter what the rules are,
or how battles are waged, either.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I expect you to do
the best you can!$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottVisitRegularly
lines.text: SCOTT: I visit here regularly in hopes\nof seeing tough TRAINERS in action\lin whatever the situation.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_SeeHowMuchPokemonLikesYou
lines.text: Let me see your POKéMON.\nI'll check to see how much it likes you.\pOh.\nYour POKéMON…$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_AdoresYou
lines.text: It adores you.\nIt can't possibly love you any more.\lI even feel happy seeing it.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_VeryHappy
lines.text: It seems to be very happy.\nIt obviously likes you a whole lot.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_LikesYouQuiteALot
lines.text: It likes you quite a lot.\nIt seems to want to be babied a little.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_GettingUsedToYou
lines.text: It's getting used to you.\nIt seems to believe in you.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_NotUsedToYou
lines.text: It's not very used to you yet.\nIt neither loves nor hates you.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_VeryWary
lines.text: It's very wary.\nIt has scary viciousness in its eyes.\lIt doesn't like you much at all.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_DetestsYou
lines.text: This is a little hard for me to say…\pYour POKéMON simply detests you.\nDoesn't that make you uncomfortable?$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_Pikachu
lines.text: PIKACHU: Pika pika!$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_House_Text_TrainersGatherAtPokemonLeague
lines.text: Far away, deep in EVER GRANDE CITY,\nis the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pThe TRAINERS who gather there are\nall frighteningly well skilled.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_House_Text_DefeatEliteFourInARow
lines.text: In the POKéMON LEAGUE, I think the\nrules say that you have to battle the\lELITE FOUR all in a row.\pIf you lose to any of them, you have\nto begin your challenge again from the\lfirst one.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_XSpecialIsCrucial
lines.text: For any POKéMON match, X SPECIAL\nis crucial.\pIt jacks up the power of some moves\neven though it's only for one battle.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NoStrategyGuidesForBattleTent
lines.text: They don't seem to sell any winning\nstrategy guides for the BATTLE TENT…\pIt seems one must rely on one's\nown wits after all…$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NestBallOnWeakenedPokemon
lines.text: The NEST BALL works better on\nweakened POKéMON.\pVERDANTURF is the only place you can\nbuy it.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaithInYourPokemon
lines.text: You can't consider yourself a real\nTRAINER if you don't have faith\lin your POKéMON.\pOnly those people who can believe\nin their battling POKéMON can win\lthrough to the very end.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitForBattleTent
lines.text:
The reason why anyone would visit
VERDANTURF…\pIt's the BATTLE TENT. It goes without
saying.\pOr is there somebody here that you
came to see?$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_StrongerSpeech
lines.text:
WALLY: I lost to you, {PLAYER}, but I'm
not feeling down anymore.\pBecause I have a new purpose in life.
Together with my RALTS, I'm going\lto challenge POKéMON GYMS and become\la great TRAINER.\pPlease watch me, {PLAYER}.
I'm going to be stronger than you.\pWhen I do, I'm going to challenge you
to another battle.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_StrongerSpeechShort
lines.text: WALLY: Please watch me, {PLAYER}.\nI'm going to get stronger than you.\pWhen I do, I'm going to challenge you\nto another battle.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallysNextDoor
lines.text:
UNCLE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
WALLY's next door.\pBut, boy, there's something I have to
tell you.\pThis natural environment is doing
wonders for WALLY's health.\pMaybe it's not just the environment.
It could be POKéMON that are giving\lthe boy hope.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallySlippedOff
lines.text: WALLY's gone away…\nHe slipped off on his own…$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyGoneThatFar
lines.text: UNCLE: Is that right?\nWALLY's gone away that far all by\lhimself…\pWell, I have to give him credit--he is\nmy little brother's son.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_MeetWanda
lines.text:
WANDA: You are?
Oh, right, I get it!\pYou're the {PLAYER} who WALLY was
telling me about.\pI'm WALLY's cousin.
Glad to meet you!\pI think WALLY's become a lot more lively
and healthy since he came here.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DontWorryAboutWally
lines.text: WANDA: Don't worry about WALLY.\nHe'll be just fine.\pI know my little cousin, and he has\nPOKéMON with him, too.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_CanSeeGirlfriendEveryDay
lines.text: Thanks to you, I can see my girlfriend\nevery day.\lHappy? You bet I am!$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DaughtersBoyfriendDriven
lines.text:
My daughter's boyfriend is a very
driven and passionate sort of person.\pHe's been digging a tunnel nonstop
just so he can see my daughter.\pMy daughter's a little concerned,
so she goes out to the tunnel a lot.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DaughtersBoyfriendWasDigging
lines.text: It's amazing. My daughter's boyfriend\nwas digging the tunnel by hand!\pIt's so incredible!$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_IfAnythingHappenedToWally
lines.text: If anything were to happen to WALLY,\nI would never be able to look his\lparents in PETALBURG in the eye…$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyWasInEverGrande
lines.text: WALLY was in EVER GRANDE?\pHis parents in PETALBURG would be\nastonished to hear that!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
lines.text:
WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!\pI bet you're surprised to see me here!\pI made it all the way here, and it's
all thanks to you!\p{PLAYER}, losing to you that time
made me stronger!\pBut I'm not going to lose anymore!\pI'm going to win! For the POKéMON who
gave me courage and strength!\pOkay… Here I come!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyEntranceDefeat
lines.text: Wow!\n{PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostEntranceBattle
lines.text: WALLY: I couldn't beat you today,\n{PLAYER}, but one of these days, I'll\lcatch up to you!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro
lines.text: WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!\pI've gotten stronger since that last\ntime! I wanted to show you, {PLAYER}!\pOkay… Here I come!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyDefeat
lines.text: Wow!\n{PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostBattle
lines.text: WALLY: I couldn't beat you this time,\ntoo… But one of these days, {PLAYER},\lI'm going to catch up to you…\pAnd challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarIntro
lines.text: I've made it this far a couple times,\nbut the last stretch is so long…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarDefeat
lines.text: My dream ends here again…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarPostBattle
lines.text: You've made it this far. Keep the\nmomentum going and become the\lCHAMPION! If anyone can, it's you!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertIntro
lines.text: I didn't come all this way to lose now.\nThat possibility doesn't exist!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertDefeat
lines.text: Impossible…\nI lost?$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertPostBattle
lines.text: I lost here…\pThat means I lack the qualifications\nto become the CHAMPION…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeIntro
lines.text: This seemingly infinite and harsh road\nlives up to its name of VICTORY.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeDefeat
lines.text: Your battle style is fantastic…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopePostBattle
lines.text: You seem to have the potential for\nbecoming the CHAMPION.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyIntro
lines.text: What is the VICTORY ROAD?\nI'll tell you if you win!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyDefeat
lines.text: Okay!\nWell done!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyPostBattle
lines.text: Getting through here safely--that's\nthe final test for any TRAINER aiming\lto become the POKéMON CHAMPION.\pThat's why it's called the VICTORY\nROAD.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnIntro
lines.text: I have nothing to say to anyone\nthat's come this far. Come on!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnDefeat
lines.text: This is a disgrace…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnPostBattle
lines.text: Humph, go right on ahead.\nSee if I care.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro
lines.text: The thought that I'm getting closer to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE…\pI'm getting stage fright…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelDefeat
lines.text: I couldn't do a thing…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelPostBattle
lines.text: The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant\nagain… What a letdown…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonIntro
lines.text: To win your way through the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you need the trust of your\lPOKéMON.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonDefeat
lines.text: Your relationship is based on\nsolid trust.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonPostBattle
lines.text: By being together all the time, trust\ngrows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleIntro
lines.text: This isn't the goal. It's only a place\non the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleDefeat
lines.text: That's the way!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichellePostBattle
lines.text: You'll do fine, for sure!\nYour POKéMON are all eager to go!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellIntro
lines.text: My POKéMON are cosmically\nawe inspiring!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellDefeat
lines.text: I've never met anyone like you before.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellPostBattle
lines.text: Even outside of battle, I sense\nincredible power emanating from you\land your POKéMON.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleIntro
lines.text: Okay, no need to get your back up!\nRelax, let's take it easy!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleDefeat
lines.text: Whoa!\nWonderful!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle
lines.text: Sure, this is VICTORY ROAD.\pBut it's not all that different from\nthe path you've taken so far.\pTry to enjoy things the rest of\nthe way!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoIntro
lines.text: I trained together with my whole family,\nevery one of us!\lI'm not losing to anyone!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoDefeat
lines.text: Better than my family?!\nIs that possible?!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoPostBattle
lines.text: I was better than everyone in my\nfamily. I've never lost before…\pI've lost my confidence…\nMaybe I'll go home…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenIntro
lines.text: I'd heard that there was a tough\nlittle kid around. Do they mean you?$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenDefeat
lines.text: The little shrimp is tough!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenPostBattle
lines.text: The rumors I heard, that tough little\nkid is from PETALBURG CITY.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineIntro
lines.text: You must be getting a little tired.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineDefeat
lines.text: No signs of tiring at all!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolinePostBattle
lines.text: VICTORY ROAD and the POKéMON LEAGUE\nare long and grueling challenges.\lBeware of fatigue!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieIntro
lines.text: You shouldn't get complacent just\nbecause you have a lot of GYM BADGES.\pThere's always going to be someone\nwho's better than you!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieDefeat
lines.text: You're better than me!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JuliePostBattle
lines.text: Gaze on your collected BADGES and\nremember the TRAINERS you've faced.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixIntro
lines.text: I've come this far, but the tension's\ngiving me awful stomach pain…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixDefeat
lines.text: Ooh…\nIt hurts…$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixPostBattle
lines.text: I can't help getting all tense knowing\nthat I'm nearing the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pIt's all I can do to feign calm.$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneIntro
lines.text: The elite among the elite gather in\nthis cave.\pHow are you finding it?$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneDefeat
lines.text: Not rattled in the least bit!$

lines.label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DiannePostBattle
lines.text: You do have guts! I like that!\nKeep it going!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_WantToMakePokeblocks
lines.text: Oh? Did you want to make some {POKEBLOCK}S\nwith this old-timer?$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_Excellent
lines.text: Excellent!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_MadeOldTimerSad
lines.text: Oh…\nYou've made this old-timer sad…$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_KnowHowToMakePokeblocks
lines.text: Do you know how to make a {POKEBLOCK}?$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender
lines.text: Let's get started, then!\pLet's BERRY BLENDER!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending
lines.text: Okay, a little explanation, then.\pOh, don't worry, it's quite simple.\pWhen the BLENDER's arrow comes to\nyour marker, just press the A Button.\pThat's all you have to do.\nYou'll see how easy it is when you try.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries
lines.text: Oh?\nYou don't have any BERRIES?\pIf you don't have any BERRIES,\nyou can't make any {POKEBLOCK}S.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_CanHaveOneOfMyBerries
lines.text: Well, that won't do at all now, will it?\pIf you don't mind leftovers, you can\nhave one of my BERRIES.\pThat way, we could make some {POKEBLOCK}S\ntogether using the BERRY BLENDER.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerriesToSpare
lines.text: If I had some BERRIES left over,\nI'd gladly give you one…\pBut, I don't have any to spare today.\nWe'll have to do this another time.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull
lines.text: But your {POKEBLOCK} CASE is full.\pYou should use some {POKEBLOCK}S before\nyou come see me again.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase
lines.text: But you don't have a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.\pYou should get a {POKEBLOCK} CASE and then\ncome see me.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsGetBlendingAlready
lines.text: Let's get blending already!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_WhatKindOfPokeblockWillIGet
lines.text: I wonder what kind of {POKEBLOCK} I'll get?\nThis is so exciting!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_WantToBlendPokeblocksWithUs
lines.text: Hi, there! Did you want to blend some\n{POKEBLOCK}S with us?$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_Okay
lines.text: Okay!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_ThatsTooBad
lines.text: That's too bad…\pBut we'll always be around whenever\nyou get the urge to blend!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_KnowHowToMakePokeblocks2
lines.text: Of course, you do know how to\nblend {POKEBLOCK}S, don't you?$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender2
lines.text: Let's get started, then!\pLet's BERRY BLENDER!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending2
lines.text:
Okay!
Let me explain it to you!\pWhen the spinning BLENDER's arrow
reaches your marker, just press\lthe A Button.\pThat's all it takes.
Pretty easy, don't you think?$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries2
lines.text:
Oh, but wait a second here…
You don't have any BERRIES.\pYou can't make any {POKEBLOCK}S without
BERRIES…\pWe'll always be around whenever you
get hold of some BERRIES to blend.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull2
lines.text: Oh, but wait a second here…\nYour {POKEBLOCK} CASE is full.\pYou should use some {POKEBLOCK}S and\nthen come back.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase2
lines.text: Oh, but wait a second here…\nYou don't have a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.\pYou should get a {POKEBLOCK} CASE and\nthen come back.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_MakePokeblocksWithOurGroup
lines.text: Oh, hello! Did you want to make some\n{POKEBLOCK}S with our little group?$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_OhDear
lines.text: Oh, dear!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_LeftUsInShock
lines.text: Oh, dear me…\pYou've left us in shock!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_KnowHowToMakePokeblocks3
lines.text: Naturally, you know how to make\n{POKEBLOCK}S, don't you?$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender3
lines.text: Okay, dear!\nLet's get started!\pLet's BERRY BLENDER!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending3
lines.text: Oh, dear!\pThen, I'll explain it to you nicely.\pWhen the BLENDER's arrow spins to\nyour marker, press the A Button.\pThat's all it takes.\nIsn't it simple?$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries3
lines.text:
You don't have any BERRIES,
do you?\pIf you don't have any BERRIES,
you can't make any {POKEBLOCK}S.\pWe'll always be making {POKEBLOCK}S here,
so let's make some together when\lyou get a BERRY or two.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull3
lines.text: Your {POKEBLOCK} CASE is full,\nit looks like.\pYou should use some {POKEBLOCK}S up\nand then come back.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase3
lines.text: You haven't gotten a {POKEBLOCK} CASE\nyet, it looks like.\pYou need to get a {POKEBLOCK} CASE before\nyou come back.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_SetNewBlenderRecord
lines.text: Okay! Today's going to be the day that\nI set a new BLENDER speed record!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_LookGoodAtBlendingJoinUs
lines.text: Oh, dear!\nYou look as if you're good at blending.\lWould you like to join us?$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_MakeDeliciousPokeblocks
lines.text: I'm going to make delicious {POKEBLOCK}S\nand make my POKéMON cuter.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_SaveGameBeforeBerryBlenderLink
lines.text: {POKEBLOCK}S will be made with your friends \nfrom BERRIES in the BERRY BLENDER.\pIs it okay to save the game before\nlinking with your friends?$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_SearchingForFriends
lines.text: Searching for your friends…\n… … B Button: Cancel$

lines.text: {STR_VAR_1} arrived.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_Player1And2Arrived
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_2} arrived.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_AllPlayersArrived
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}, {STR_VAR_2}, and\n{STR_VAR_3} arrived.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_NoBerriesLink
lines.text: You have no BERRIES.\nThe BERRY BLENDER can't be used.$

lines.text: Your {POKEBLOCK} CASE is full.\nThe BERRY BLENDER can't be used.$

lines.text: You don't have a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.\nThe BERRY BLENDER can't be used.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_LoveMakingPokeblocks
lines.text: I love making {POKEBLOCK}S.\pI always have some BERRIES with me.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_MakePokeblocksUsingBerryBlender
lines.text: If you'd like, we could make some\n{POKEBLOCK}S together using the\lBERRY BLENDER.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerriesHaveOne
lines.text: Oh?\nYou don't have any BERRIES?\pWell, that won't do at all now, will it?\pIf you don't mind leftovers, you can\nhave one of my BERRIES.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_UseItToMakePokeblocksTogether
lines.text: We'll use it to make {POKEBLOCK}S together\nusing the BERRY BLENDER.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerriesNoneToSpare
lines.text:
Oh?
You don't have any BERRIES?\pIf I had some left over, I'd gladly
give you one…\pBut, I don't have any to spare today.
Sorry about that.$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_ItsSoftLoamySoil
lines.text: It's soft, loamy soil.$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_WantToPlant
lines.text: It's soft, loamy soil.\nWant to plant a BERRY?$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_PlantedOneBerry
lines.text: {PLAYER} planted one {STR_VAR_1} in\nthe soft, loamy soil.$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_BerryGrowthStage1
lines.text: One {STR_VAR_1} was planted here.$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_BerryGrowthStage2
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1} has sprouted.$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_BerryGrowthStage3
lines.text: This {STR_VAR_1} plant is growing taller.$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_BerryGrowthStage4
lines.text: These {STR_VAR_1} flowers are blooming\n{STR_VAR_2}.$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_CareAdverbGreat
lines.text: very beautifully$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_CareAdverbPoor
lines.text: cutely$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_CareAdverbGood
lines.text: prettily$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_WantToPick
lines.text: You found {STR_VAR_2} {STR_VAR_1}!\pDo you want to pick the\n{STR_VAR_1}?$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_PickedTheBerry
lines.text: {PLAYER} picked the {STR_VAR_2} {STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_PutAwayBerry
lines.text: {PLAYER} put away the {STR_VAR_1}\nin the BAG's BERRIES POCKET.\pThe soil returned to its soft and\nloamy state.$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_BerryPocketFull
lines.text: The BAG's BERRIES POCKET is full.\pThe {STR_VAR_1} couldn't be taken.$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_BerryLeftUnpicked
lines.text: {PLAYER} left the {STR_VAR_1}\nunpicked.$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_WantToWater
lines.text: Want to water the {STR_VAR_1} with the\nWAILMER PAIL?$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_WateredTheBerry
lines.text: {PLAYER} watered the {STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: BerryTree_Text_PlantIsDelighted
lines.text: The plant seems to be delighted.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ReceptionDontHavePokeblockCase
lines.text:
Hello!\pThis is the reception counter for
POKéMON CONTESTS.\pOh? It appears that you don't have
a {POKEBLOCK} CASE yet.\pIn that case, we need to provide you
with this!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_NowThatWeveClearedThatUp
lines.text: Okay, now that we've cleared that\nup…\pHello!\pThis is the reception counter for\nPOKéMON CONTESTS.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestReception
lines.text: Hello!\pThis is the reception counter for\nPOKéMON CONTESTS.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_CounterOnlyFor4PlayerContests
lines.text: Hello!\pThis reception counter is only\nfor 4-player POKéMON CONTESTS.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EnterContest1
lines.text: Would you like to enter your POKéMON\nin our CONTESTS?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhichTopic1
lines.text: Which topic would you like?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
lines.text:
A POKéMON CONTEST involves four
TRAINERS entering one POKéMON each\lin competitive judging.\pA CONTEST has two stages of judging,
primary and secondary.\pPrimary judging is a popularity poll
involving the audience.\pSecondary judging features appeals
by the POKéMON using their moves.\pPlan appeals carefully to earn the
most attention of the JUDGE and\lexcite the audience.\lDo your best to stand out.\pThe primary and secondary scores are
added at the end.\pThe POKéMON garnering the highest
score is declared the winner.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestTypes
lines.text: There are five kinds of CONTESTS.\pCOOL, BEAUTY, CUTE, SMART, and\nTOUGH are the five categories.\pChoose the CONTEST that is right for\nthe POKéMON you plan to enter.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks
lines.text:
There are four ranks of POKéMON
CONTESTS.\pNORMAL, SUPER, HYPER, and MASTER
are the four ranks.\pIn the NORMAL Rank, any POKéMON may
enter.\pAny POKéMON that won a NORMAL Rank
CONTEST may move up to the SUPER Rank\lin the same category.\pIn the same way, a SUPER Rank winner
can move up to the HYPER Rank, and\la HYPER Rank winner can advance to\lthe MASTER Rank in the same category.\pA POKéMON that won in the MASTER Rank
may compete in the MASTER Rank as\loften as its TRAINER wants.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EnterWhichRank
lines.text: Which Rank would you like to enter?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EnterWhichContest1
lines.text: Which CONTEST would you like to enter?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EnterWhichPokemon1
lines.text: Which POKéMON would you like to enter?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MonNotQualifiedForRank
lines.text: I'm terribly sorry, but your POKéMON\nis not qualified to compete at this\lRank yet…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EggCannotTakePart
lines.text: I'm sorry, but an EGG cannot take part\nin a POKéMON CONTEST.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MonInNoConditionForContest
lines.text: Your POKéMON appears to be in no\ncondition to take part in a CONTEST…$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PickYourPrize
lines.text: Okay, the first thing you have to do\nis pick the prize for the person that\lanswers your quiz correctly.\pBut beware, if the person taking\nthe quiz can't get it right, I get to\lkeep the prize!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_QuitChoosingPrize
lines.text: If you don't choose a prize,\nyour quiz can't be made.\pAre you going to quit making\nyour quiz?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WriteYourQuiz
lines.text: Oh, how nice!\nThat's a wonderful prize!\pNext, you need to write your quiz\nquestion and its answer.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_QuitWritingQuizQuestion
lines.text: Are you going to quit writing\nyour quiz question?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_QuitWritingQuizAnswer

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IllLookForAChallenger
lines.text: Thank you!\nYou've put together a nice quiz.\pI'll go look for someone who'll take\nyour quiz challenge right away.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ImTheContestLady

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThankForPokeblock
lines.text: Thanks for your {POKEBLOCK} before!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MyFriendDisplaysQuality

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DontHaveAPokeblockCase
lines.text: So, I need your help!\pPlease, may I have one {POKEBLOCK}?\nAll I'm asking for is one!\p…Oh, but…\nDon't you have a {POKEBLOCK} CASE?\lThat's no good. Next time, then!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AskingForOnePokeblock
lines.text: So, I need your help!\pPlease, may I have one {POKEBLOCK}?\nAll I'm asking for is one!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WhatACheapskate

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IllUseYourPokeblock

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NoChangeThanks

lines.label: LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReallyImprovedThanks

lines.label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IKnowNoTales

lines.text:
What's that?!
You… You…\p{STR_VAR_2}
{STR_VAR_1} time(s)?!\pThat is indeed magnificent!
It's the birth of a new legend!$

lines.label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
lines.text:
You make your own profile by putting
together four words or phrases.\pHere, I'll show you an example of a
profile using four pieces of text.\pYou can switch those four pieces with
other text pieces any which way you\llike to make your own profile.\pThere are a lot of text pieces that
you can use.\pThey are arranged in groups like
POKéMON, lifestyles, and hobbies so\lit is easier to look them up.\pSo, first, choose the group of text
pieces to display a list of choices.\pThen, pick the choice you want.\pRepeat for the remaining text choices,
and you'll have your very own profile.$

lines.label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
lines.text:
Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\pHere, you may witness many kinds of
POKéMON rarely seen in HOENN.\pAnd, you'll see them in their wild,
untamed state in natural habitats.\pWhat's more, we've thrown open the
gates to POKéMON TRAINERS.\pYou're encouraged to catch POKéMON
for keeps!\pCome in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!$

lines.label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeFirstTime
lines.text: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\nIs it your first time here?$

lines.label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_ComeInAndEnjoy
lines.text: Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!$

lines.label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_FirstTimeInfo
lines.text: When you enter the SAFARI ZONE, you\nstart with 30 SAFARI BALLS for\lcatching POKéMON.\pThe SAFARI Game is over when you run\nout of SAFARI BALLS, or when you've\lwalked 500 steps.\pCome in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!$

lines.label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WouldYouLikeToPlay
lines.text: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\pAll you can catch for just ¥500!\nWould you like to play a SAFARI Game?$

lines.label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PlayAnotherTime
lines.text: Okay.\nPlease play another time!$

lines.label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_NotEnoughMoney

lines.label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_ThatWillBe500Please
lines.text: That will be ¥500, please.$

lines.text: Here are your SAFARI BALLS.$

lines.label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Received30SafariBalls
lines.text: {PLAYER} received 30 SAFARI BALLS.$

lines.label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
lines.text: We'll let you know when your game\nis over.\pSo, until then, enjoy yourself, please!\nOff you go on your wild excursion!$

lines.label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PCIsFull
lines.text: Excuse me!\nYour PC BOX is full.$

lines.label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
lines.text:
Excuse me!
You seem to be without a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.\pYour SAFARI Game will be much more
fruitful if you use {POKEBLOCK}S.\pPlease come back with a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.\pYou may obtain a {POKEBLOCK} CASE from
the LILYCOVE CONTEST HALL.$

lines.label: SafariZone_South_Text_StillHaveTimeExit
lines.text: You still have time left. Would you like\nto exit the SAFARI ZONE now?$

lines.label: SafariZone_South_Text_EnjoyTheRestOfYourAdventure
lines.text: Please enjoy the rest of your wild\nadventure!$

lines.label: SafariZone_South_Text_ExitEarlyThankYouForPlaying
lines.text: Okay.\pI'll take back your remaining SAFARI\nBALLS.\pThank you for playing.\nWe hope to see you again.$

lines.label: SafariZone_South_Text_GoodLuck
lines.text: Good luck!\pIf you need anything, don't hesitate\nto tell me, please!$

lines.label: SafariZone_South_Text_Boy
lines.text: Did you know?\pIf you put a {POKEBLOCK} in that square box,\nPOKéMON gather around.$

lines.label: SafariZone_South_Text_Man
lines.text: I want to keep going deeper, but I\nforgot to bring a BIKE.\pSomething tells me that rare POKéMON\nlive in the outlying areas.$

lines.label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_Woman
lines.text: Sometimes, when I toss a {POKEBLOCK} at \nPOKéMON, it gets ignored.\pDo POKéMON have likes and dislikes\nabout what they eat?$

lines.label: SafariZone_Northwest_Text_Man
lines.text: Gasp… Gasp…\nI…made it out here…but…\pI'm exhausted… I don't have the\nenergy to catch POKéMON…$

lines.label: SafariZone_North_Text_Fisherman
lines.text: I'm on a mission to find WATER POKéMON\nyou don't see in HOENN.\pDo you have any idea where the lake is?$

lines.label: SafariZone_North_Text_Man
lines.text: I'm going to catch a lot of rare POKéMON\nhere and trade them with my friends!$

lines.label: SafariZone_South_Text_Youngster
lines.text: I put a {POKEBLOCK} on the {POKEBLOCK} FEEDER.\nBut it seems to have disappeared.\pI guess POKéMON must have eaten it\nwithout me noticing.$

lines.label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_TrainerTip
lines.text: SAFARI ZONE TRAINER TIP!\pThrow {POKEBLOCK}S at wild POKéMON to make\nthem less likely to flee.$

lines.label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_RestHouseSign
lines.text: “Relieve your tired feet.”\nREST HOUSE$

lines.label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_Youngster
lines.text: I don't have any {POKEBLOCK}S, but I caught\na good number of POKéMON.\pYou can improve your chances of making\na catch by getting closer to them\lbefore throwing a SAFARI BALL.$

lines.label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_PsychicM
lines.text: If you use {POKEBLOCK}S, wild POKéMON won't\nbe so quick to run away.\pIt's not much use to give {POKEBLOCK}S to\nPOKéMON that don't flee easily.$

lines.label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_FatMan
lines.text: If you put a {POKEBLOCK} on the FEEDER,\nPOKéMON are attracted to it.\pI think POKéMON with the same sort of\nnature are drawn by a certain {POKEBLOCK}.$

lines.label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_ExpansionIsFinished

lines.label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_LittleGirl

lines.label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_FatMan
lines.text: The POKéMON in this area are all\nnew to me.\pAnd I'm allowed to catch these rare\nPOKéMON! Too cool!$

lines.label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_RichBoy
lines.text: The POKéMON around here seem to be\nfrom somewhere other than HOENN.$

lines.label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Boy
lines.text: I only have a couple SAFARI BALLS left.\pI'm having a hard time trying to\ndecide what I should catch.$

lines.label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Woman

lines.label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Girl

lines.label: Route111_Text_MakingRoomUseTMToMakeYourOwn
lines.text:

What am I doing?\pI'm thinking about making my own room
here using a POKéMON move.\pI know! I'll give you this TM.
Will you use it to make your own room?$

lines.label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
lines.text:
Find a big tree that looks like it might
drop some vines.\pUse SECRET POWER in front of the tree.
Some vines should get free and drop\ldown, so you can climb the tree.\pYou'll find a lot of space for putting
your favorite things.\pIt'll be your own secret room…
A SECRET BASE!\pYou should make one, too.\pAnother thing, you don't always have
to make your SECRET BASE in a tree.\pTry using SECRET POWER on rock walls
that have small indents in them.\pI'm going to look for other places, too.
Okay, bye!$

Please teach me about POKéMON!$
