lines.text: Oh… B-but…\nSnivel… Waaaaaaah!\pPlease!\nI'm begging you, please!$

lines.text:

Awesome! Wicked! Awoooh!\pOh… I'm sorry…

{STR_VAR_1}?
Waaaaah!\pOh! I'm so sorry!

lines.text:
Wowee! You're {PLAYER}, aren't you?

Can you be my teacher and tell me\llots about being a TRAINER?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching1
lines.text: Aww, why?\nOh, please? Pretty please?\lPlease be my teacher, please!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode1
lines.text: Yay! Great!\pThe first thing I wanted to ask you is\nabout the BATTLE TOWER!\pThe Level 50 and Open Level Rooms…\nWhich would be perfect for me?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks1
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}, huh? That's true!\nI'll do my best there!\pIf we meet here again, please teach\nme something else, teacher!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach2
lines.text:
Um… Are you {PLAYER}?
My name is {STR_VAR_1}.\pI want to become a POKéMON TRAINER,
but I don't know what to do…\pSo I thought maybe I could ask you for
advice because you're so famous.\p{PLAYER}, could you give me advice?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching2
lines.text: Oh, but…\pI sincerely want to become a POKéMON\nTRAINER!\pPlease, can you answer my questions?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode2
lines.text:
Thank you!
Here's my first question right away!\pThe BATTLE TOWER has two levels,
Level 50 and Open Level, right?\pWhich level do you think is more
suitable for me?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks2
lines.text: Oh, the {STR_VAR_1} challenge?\nUnderstood!\pIf I have another question, I'll come\nback here for your advice!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach3
lines.text:
Oh? Huh? You're…
No, that can't be true.\pThere isn't any way that someone
like me could meet {PLAYER}.\p…You really are {PLAYER}?
I can't believe I'm talking to you!\pWhen something this good happens,
only terrible things will happen to me\lnow, I just know it…\p…I'm sorry…
I'm… {STR_VAR_1}…\pThere isn't anything special about
me that I can be proud of…\pI shouldn't even say anything about
myself because you'll forget…\pI had this dream that if I ever met
you, {PLAYER}, that maybe I could ask\lyou for advice as a TRAINER.\pBut I don't think you would agree
to that.\p…Or will you be so kind as to give
me advice?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching3
lines.text:
I knew it…\pIt had to happen because I'm such
a really boring nobody…\pBut I thought just maybe…
You won't reconsider, will you?\pBut I can't give up just like that.
I'll ask you while I'm still lucky!\pPlease, will you be so kind as to give
me advice?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode3
lines.text:
Really? I can't believe it!
I can't believe you'll advise me!\lI… I'm so happy…\pWhat I want to ask you is really
trivial, but I can't decide…\pAt the BATTLE TOWER, they let you
choose Level 50 or Open Level.\pWhich course do you think even I may
have a chance at?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks3
lines.text:
{STR_VAR_1}? Okay!
But do you really think someone like\lme would have a chance?\pI'll do my best, even though I don't
think it will work.\pThank you very much for spending
time with someone like me.$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach4
lines.text:
Oh! You're {PLAYER}{KUN}, aren't you?\pI've heard that you're tough at
POKéMON!\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}!
I'll be your friend!\pDid you know?\pYou can't win at the BATTLE FRONTIER
if all you know is what they teach at\lthe TRAINER'S SCHOOL.\pI'm willing to listen to your advice.
You'll agree, of course?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching4
lines.text: Huh? Why are you refusing me?\nIt's me who's asking you!\lYou have to reconsider!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode4
lines.text:
Okay, so there is this something.
I want you to decide it for me.\pYou know that the BATTLE TOWER has
Level 50 and Open Level Rooms?\pWhich do you think would be good
for me, {PLAYER}{KUN}?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks4
lines.text:
Okay, {STR_VAR_1} is suitable for me?
Thank you!\pKnowing that you made the decision,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.
Bye!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach5
lines.text:
Oh, hi, there! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I know you because you're famous!\lCall me {STR_VAR_1}! Glad to meet you!\pI'm a TRIATHLETE, so I keep myself
fit even while I raise POKéMON.\pI'm also involved with other things
like work, napping, ballroom dancing…\pBeing this busy, it's not so easy for
me to become a decent TRAINER.\pSo, I have a proposition!\pThere must be a reason why we met.
So, {PLAYER}{KUN}, how about sharing your\lwisdom with me every so often?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching5
lines.text: Oh, but, please?\nA guy like me needs someone like\lyou, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHonestly, I need your advice!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode5
lines.text:
Thank you! That's more like it!
So, let's start with an easy one!\pYou know about the BATTLE TOWER's
two courses, right?\lYou know, Level 50 and Open Level.\pMe being a busy guy, which one should
I gear up for?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks5
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}, huh? Okay, gotcha.\nI'll find time somehow and give it a go!\p…Whoops, I'd better go to work!\nThanks! See you around!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach6
lines.text:
No way! Uh-uh!
Are you maybe the real {PLAYER}?\pA-hah! Awesome! I'm {STR_VAR_1},
so pleased to meet you!\p{PLAYER}, you're very strong,
aren't you?\pEveryone's talking about you!\pOh! I just had this great idea!
I'll get advice off you, {PLAYER}!\lI'm sure it will make me tougher!\pIsn't it a great idea?
Please, I want your advice!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching6
lines.text: Ahahaha, you can pretend to be mean,\nbut you can't fool me!\lYou really mean okay, don't you?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode6
lines.text:
Yay! I knew you'd have a big heart,
{PLAYER}!\pWhat should I ask you first?
…Oh, I thought of something!\pDrum roll, please!
The question I have is…\pIf I were to take a BATTLE TOWER
challenge, which way should I go?\pLevel 50 or Open Level?
Which suits me more?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks6
lines.text:
Oh-oh-oh!
{STR_VAR_1}, you say!\lThank you for a totally cool reply!\pI guess that's about all I wanted
to ask you today.\pLet's meet here again, okay?
Thanks!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach7
lines.text:
I beg your pardon, but…
Are you {PLAYER}?\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, and I am delighted to
make your acquaintance.\pI have long been an admirer
of yours…\p… … … … … …\pUm… I hope you don't find this
request too much of a burden, but…\pMay I become your apprentice,
{PLAYER}?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching7
lines.text:
Oh…!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\p…I must have fainted from shock.
I'm sorry, I must have misheard you.\pPlease! Please say that you will
accept me as your apprentice!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
lines.text:
Oh… I'm delighted!\pI don't wish to waste your time,
so please advise me on this.\pI plan to take a BATTLE TOWER
challenge soon.\pHowever, there are two levels…\pWhich would be most suitable for me?
Level 50 or Open Level?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks7
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1} is your choice!\nI see. I will do my best!\pThank you, {PLAYER}.\nI hope I can count on you again.\lPlease take care!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
lines.text:
Eek! Eek! {PLAYER}!
You spoke to me!\lI… I'm overjoyed!\pMe! My name is {STR_VAR_1}!
I just became a TRAINER!\pI'm delighted I met you, {PLAYER},
the big name in POKéMON circles!\pOh-oh-oh, I know!
May I ask a huge favor, {PLAYER}?\pPlease take me in as your apprentice!
I want to learn from you!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching8
lines.text: Waaaah!\n{PLAYER} turned me down…\lIt… It's an invaluable experience!\p{PLAYER}, please! I want to hear\nan affirmative answer this time!\pI beg you for your guidance!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
lines.text:
Hieeeeh! {PLAYER} said yes!
{PLAYER} said yes!\pI won't be able to sleep tonight…
Thank you ever so much!\pThen, here's my question!\pAt the BATTLE TOWER, what is right
for me, Level 50 or Open Level?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks8
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1}! Perfectly understood!\nI understand perfectly!\lI'm deliriously delighted!\pI hope you'll be willing to teach me\nsome more another time.$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
lines.text:
Whoa! Could you be…
Might you be… {PLAYER}{KUN}?!\lThat strong and famous TRAINER?\lWell, hello, aren't I just the luckiest!\pHello, the name's {STR_VAR_1}!\pI've been on the lookout for
a POKéMON teacher.\pAnd with impeccably good timing,
along came you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pSo, there you have it, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Let me apprentice under you!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching9
lines.text: Gwaaaah!\nYou're quite cool and tough…\pDon't be that way, please.\nI'm asking you!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9
lines.text:
Oh, yeah! That's a solid reply!
Excellent, I might add!\pSo how about a first piece of advice
on the BATTLE TOWER?\pIf I were to go, what would be better?
Level 50 or Open Level?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks9
lines.text: Uh-huh, {STR_VAR_1} it is!\nOK, A-OK!\lI'll go show my mettle, like, jam!\pAll right, I'll look to you as my mentor!\nAdios!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
lines.text:
Oh, hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?
The police were looking for you!\p… … …
Of course I'm lying!\pMe, I'm {STR_VAR_1}. Despite the way
I look, I'm the POKéMON CHAMPION!\l…That's a lie, too!\pThis is no lie, though.
I'm not very good at battling.\pSo, how about you becoming my master
about all things POKéMON?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
lines.text:
If you're going to act cold like that,
I'll show you what I'll do!\pWaaah! Waaah! Waaah!
Hiccup!\pHahaha, that was my FAKE TEARS!\pCome on, will you please be

lines.text:
Yippee!
I'll buy you a boat for that!\pOf course I'm lying again!

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks10
lines.text:
Okay, so {STR_VAR_1} is better!

I'll obey your teaching, master!\pThanks, master!
I hope you'll keep teaching me!$

am I!\pYour turn now, tell me a little about

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching11
lines.text: But!\nYou have to work with me!\pDon't be such a tease!\nBecome my mentor, please!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11

{PLAYER}, you've got the spirit!\pSo here's my first question

which is the one that's good for me?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks11
lines.text: Okay, {STR_VAR_1} it is, you say!\nI'll go and take it on my way!\pIf it's advice I ever need,\n{PLAYER}, your word I'll always heed!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
lines.text:
Say, hey, aren't you {PLAYER}?
What should I do? Talk to you?\lWhy not? I'm already talking to you!\p{PLAYER}, are you surprised at me?
I'd better tell you who I happen to be!\p{STR_VAR_1} is what you can call me.
The brightest star in guitardom,\lthat's me!\pAre you receiving me?
You are receiving me!\pMy luck's at its best,
I'll hit you with a request!\p{PLAYER}, let me be your underling!

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching12
lines.text: You're turning me down, then?\nI'll just have to ask you again!\p{PLAYER}, I beg to be your underling!\nI need you to teach me everything!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode12
lines.text:
Lucky, yeah, woohoo!
Should I pop a question to you?\pSince we're near the BATTLE TOWER,
how about a question about its power?\pOf the choices you see,
which is the right one for me?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks12
lines.text: If {STR_VAR_1} is what you suggest,\nit must be the very best!\pWell, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free,\nbut don't you forget about me.\pSee you again, my smart friend!$

lines.text:

advice?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching13
lines.text: Oh, why?\pI won't be a big bother, I promise!\nPlease?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode13
lines.text: Thank you. Mighty good of you!\n…Cough! Cough!\pOogh, I have to toughen up quick…\pI'll be heading off to the BATTLE TOWER\nright away, but what would be better\lfor me? Level 50 or Open Level?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks13
lines.text: Hm, all right. That's {STR_VAR_1}.\nI'll go there right away.\pI hope I can keep hitting you up for\nhelp--after all, you're my mentor!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
lines.text:
Er… Um…
{PLAYER}{KUN}…?\pPlease, don't look at me that way.
You're making me all self-conscious.\pI… I'm {STR_VAR_1}.\pI'm really embarrassed to say this,
but I explore ancient ruins and such.\pI'm even more embarrassed to admit
I'm interested in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, you have a reputation as
a tough TRAINER…\pIt's hard for me to say this,
but I want to ask something.\pCould you become my teacher and
give me advice?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching14
lines.text: Please don't brush me off like this!\nI can't live with the humiliation.\pPlease become my teacher!\nI need your advice!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
lines.text:
Th-thank you…\pBut please don't look at me like that.
It makes me all flustered.\pPlease, answer me without looking
at my eyes.\pAt the BATTLE TOWER…
Which level should I attempt?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks14
lines.text:
Oh… Okay!
I'll try my hand at that.\pI hope I can make a valiant challenge
without getting all flustered…\pThank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
If we meet again, I hope you will be\las helpful.$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
lines.text:
Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}…
But are you really real?\pYou may call me {STR_VAR_1}.\pI have been toying with the idea of
apprenticing under a strong TRAINER.\pSo, I must say I'm lucky you came along!
…You really are {PLAYER}{KUN}, yes?\pNo, no, if you are real, it's fine.
I merely want you to recognize me\las your apprentice.$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching15
lines.text:
Oh?
But what would compel you to refuse?\pI apologize for being skeptical about
your identity.\pPlease accept my apology and
accept me as your apprentice.$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode15
lines.text:
You really are accepting me?
I don't wish to celebrate prematurely.\pIf it is true, I apologize.
But now, I need your advice.\pIf I were to enter the BATTLE TOWER,
what would be worthy of me?\lLevel 50 or Open Level?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
lines.text:
{STR_VAR_1}?
Are you certain?\pI see. If that's the case, that's fine.
I thank you for your time.\pI realize I can annoy, but it delights
me that you have accepted me.\pLet us meet again!$

lines.text:

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem0
lines.text: Oh, I'm so glad…\nI think I have that {STR_VAR_1}, too.\pI'm delighted it's settled!\nAwesome! Wicked! Awoooh!\pThank you so much!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended0
lines.text: Waaaah! Please don't be mean!\pThat item {STR_VAR_1} was already\nrecommended to me before, sob…\pOr do you mean I shouldn't make\nmy {STR_VAR_2} hold anything?$

lines.text:

Great! I wanted to ask you something!\pDo you make your POKéMON hold items?
I want to make mine hold items, but…\pWhat item would be good for

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing1
lines.text: Huh? You mean my {STR_VAR_1} doesn't\nhave to hold anything?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem1
lines.text: Oh, I get it! I'll do that!\nThanks for teaching me!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem1
lines.text: Oh, wow! One {STR_VAR_1}, huh?\nOkay, I'll do that!\pThanks for teaching me!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended1
lines.text: Oh, uh, no, that's not what I meant.\nI want to know about a different item\lthan the ones I already know.\pOr do you mean that my POKéMON doesn't\nhave to hold anything this time?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem2
lines.text: {PLAYER}, hello!\nIt's about my {STR_VAR_1}…\pI want to make it hold a good item.\nWhat would be good for it?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing2
lines.text: Oh, then my {STR_VAR_1} doesn't have\nto hold anything?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem2
lines.text: Okay, I got it!\nSee you again!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem2
lines.text: Oh, the item {STR_VAR_1}?\nUnderstood!\pI'll do my best to find one!\nSee you again!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended2
lines.text:
Somebody taught me about
the {STR_VAR_1} already.\pI want my POKéMON to hold a different
kind of item.\pOr do you think {STR_VAR_2} doesn't
have to hold anything?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem3
lines.text:
Hello, {PLAYER}…
I'm sorry to disturb you, but I have\lsomething else I wanted to ask you.\pI don't think I'm good enough to win
matches on my own, so I'm thinking of\lmaking my {STR_VAR_1} hold an item.\pBut I don't know what would be good.\p{PLAYER}, please, could you decide
for me?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing3
lines.text: A POKéMON belonging to someone like me\nwould be better off without an item?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem3
lines.text: I understand…\nYou're saying I shouldn't rely on items.\lI'll do my best not to!\pThank you very much!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem3
lines.text: The item {STR_VAR_1}, okay.\nI'm not sure if I can get one…\lNo! I'll do my best to get it.\pThank you very much!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended3
lines.text:

my {STR_VAR_2} hold anything?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem4
lines.text:

There's something I wanted to ask you.\pYou know how you decided which
POKéMON I should have for me?\pBut I never asked you what item
it should be holding.\pSince you already gave me advice,
how about seeing this to the end?\pWhat would be good? I want to make
my {STR_VAR_1} hold something.$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing4
lines.text: Oh! So my {STR_VAR_1} should do\nthe best it can empty-handed?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem4
lines.text: If you think that's best, I'll do that.\pKnowing that you made the decision,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.\nBye!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem4
lines.text:

Not bad. I'll use it!\pKnowing that you made the decision,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.
Bye!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended4
lines.text: Huh? What are you saying?\nYou told me about the {STR_VAR_1}\lalready before.\pOr do you mean my {STR_VAR_2} should\ndo the best it can empty-handed?$

lines.text:

into each other often anyway!\pToday I have to do some walking,

my precious {STR_VAR_1} anything.\pI don't have any time, so how about
giving me advice on what I should make\lmy {STR_VAR_1} hold?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing5
lines.text: Oh, so me being a busy guy, you say\nmy {STR_VAR_1} doesn't need anything?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem5
lines.text: Okay, gotcha.\nI won't need any time for that.\pThanks today!\nSee you around!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem5
lines.text: Okay, gotcha.\nI'll find time somehow and find\lthat {STR_VAR_1} you recommended.\pI'm glad I met a good mentor in you.\nThanks! See you around!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended5
lines.text: Huh? I already know about\nthat {STR_VAR_1}.\pOh, right, I get it.\nSo me being a busy guy, you say\lmy {STR_VAR_2} doesn't need anything?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem6
lines.text:

{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pFrom now on, we're rivals!
Thanks for everything!$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
lines.text:
Er… Um…
{PLAYER}{KUN}…\pPlease, don't look at me that way.
You're making me all nervous.\pI… I need your advice again.
I'll make it my last, though…\pIt's really embarrassing to ask,
but what if I win a battle?\lWhat should I say?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
lines.text:
{STR_VAR_1}\pOh… Okay!
I'll try to say that!\lI might be too nervous to say it…\pThank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I have to say good-bye now.\pI'll obey all that you've taught me,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, and do the best I can.$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
lines.text:
Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}…
But are you really?\lPerhaps a clever {PLAYER} DOLL?\pOh, no, no, no, don't worry!
If you really are real, please\lforget about my rudeness.\pNo need to be so angry. All I wish for
is more of your fine advice.\pIt concerns a saying.\pMore precisely, what should I say
if I win a battle?$

lines.label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
lines.text:
{STR_VAR_1}\p… … … … … …
When I win a match…\p{STR_VAR_1}\p…Are you serious?\pI see. If you are serious, that's fine.
I thank you for your time.\pI do hope even I will be able to
put that saying to good use.\pI seem to have run dry on what advice
I need.\pI do believe it's high time I bid you
farewell and strike out on my own.\pThank you, my mentor!
I apologize for my skepticism!$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
lines.text: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT\nFALLARBOR SITE!\pI am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
lines.text: Now, do you wish to take the challenge\nof a Set KO Tourney?$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge
lines.text: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainFallarborTent
lines.text:
In the FALLARBOR BATTLE TENT,
we undertake the Set KO Tourney.\pAll participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.\pThe three POKéMON must be lined up
in the order that they are to appear in.\pDuring battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.\pOnce a POKéMON enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.\pIf a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.\pIf you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.\pIf you pull off the feat of beating
three TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with a fine prize.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_SaveBeforeChallenge
lines.text: Before showing you to the BATTLE\nTENT, I must save. Is that okay?$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
lines.text: We offer two levels of challenge,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice?$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
lines.text: Very well, now select your\nthree POKéMON, please.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
lines.text:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pWhen you have made your preparations,
please do return.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
lines.text:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pTo qualify, you must bring three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pWhen you have made your preparations,
please do return.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_GuideYouToBattleTent
lines.text: I shall now guide you to\nthe BATTLE TENT.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
lines.text:
My dear challenger!\pYou did not save the game before
shutting down, did you?\pIt is unfortunate, but that has
resulted in your disqualification\lfrom your challenge.\pYou may, of course, start with a fresh
challenge.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_BeatThreeTrainers
lines.text: How splendid! You have beaten\nthree TRAINERS in succession!$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WaitWhileSaveGame
lines.text: Please wait while I save the game.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize
lines.text: In commemoration of your 3-win streak,\nwe present you with this prize.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
lines.text: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize
lines.text: Oh?\nYour BAG seems to be full.\pI urge you to clear space and\nreturn for your prize.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSaving
lines.text: Thank you so much for participating!\pPlease wait while I save the game.$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge2
lines.text: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!$

lines.label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrival
lines.text: We have been looking forward to\nyour arrival.\pBefore I show you to the BATTLE TENT,\nI must save the game. Please wait.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
lines.text: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT\nVERDANTURF SITE!\pHere, the TRAINER's trust toward\nPOKéMON is tested.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
lines.text: Do you wish to take the VERDANTURF\nBATTLE TENT challenge?$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainVerdanturfTent
lines.text:
In the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT,
there is one crucial rule that must\lbe obeyed.\pTRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.\pTRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.\pYou must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.\pIf you achieve the honor of beating
three TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with a prize.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnFortified
lines.text: When you have fortified your heart\nand POKéMON, you must return.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode

Sigh…\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for the challenge.\pTo enter, you must provide three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not be holding
the same kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pCome back when you have made
your preparations.$

lines.text: Good.\nNow, follow me.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded
lines.text: I feel privileged for having seen\nyour POKéMON's exploits.\pThe results will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AchievedThreeWinStreak
lines.text: To achieve a 3-win streak…\pThe bonds that bind your heart with\nyour POKéMON seem firm and true.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_FeatWillBeRecorded

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize
lines.text: For the feat of your 3-win streak,\nwe present you with this prize.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
lines.text: Welcome to the BATTLE TENT\nSLATEPORT SITE!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nTournament.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
lines.text: Would you like to take the Battle\nSwap challenge?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSlateportTent
lines.text:
Here at the SLATEPORT BATTLE TENT,
we hold Battle Swap events\lusing rental POKéMON.\pFirst, you will be loaned three
POKéMON specifically for this event.\pUsing the supplied rental POKéMON,
you must conduct a SINGLE BATTLE.\pIf you win, you are permitted to trade
one of your rental POKéMON.\pRepeat this cycle of battling and
trading--if you win three times in\la row, you will earn a fine prize.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextVisit
lines.text: We look forward to your next visit.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
lines.text: Which level do you wish to challenge?\nLevel 50 or Level 100?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_SaveBeforeChallenge
lines.text: Before you begin your challenge,\nI need to save data. Is that okay?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_HoldMonsForSafekeeping
lines.text: Okay, I will hold your POKéMON for\nsafekeeping while you compete.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_StepThisWay
lines.text: Please step this way.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnRentalMonsSaveResults
lines.text: Thank you for participating!\pI will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.\pI must also save your event results.\nPlease wait.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnMonsExchangeRentals
lines.text: I will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WonThreeMatchesReturnMons
lines.text:
Congratulations!
You've won three straight matches!\pI will return your POKéMON in exchange
for our rental POKéMON.\pI must also save your event results.
Please wait.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_AwardYouThisPrize
lines.text: In recognition of your 3-win streak,\nwe award you this prize.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NoRoomInBagMakeRoom
lines.text: Oh?\nYou seem to have no room for this.\pPlease make room in your BAG and\nlet me know.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BeenWaitingForYou
lines.text: We've been waiting for you!\pBefore we resume your challenge,\nI must save the game.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
lines.text: I'm sorry to say this, but you didn't\nsave before you quit playing last time.\pAs a result, you have been disqualified\nfrom your challenge.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnPersonalMons
lines.text: We'll return your personal POKéMON.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
lines.text: The Battle Swap rules are listed.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
lines.text: Which heading do you want to read?$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
lines.text: In a Battle Swap event, you may use\nonly three POKéMON.\pWhether you are renting or swapping,\nyour team may not have two or more\lof the same POKéMON.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
lines.text: You may swap POKéMON only with\nthe TRAINER you have just defeated.\pYou may swap for only those POKéMON\nused by the beaten TRAINER.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
lines.text: After every battle you win, you may\nswap for one of your defeated\lopponent's POKéMON.\pYou will not be able to swap POKéMON\nwith the third TRAINER in the event.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
lines.text:
There are two key points to be aware
of when swapping POKéMON.\pFirst, when swapping, you can't check
the stats of the POKéMON you are\labout to receive.\pSecond, the POKéMON on your team
are lined up in sequence, depending on\lthe order in which you rented them.\pThis sequence remains unchanged
even when swaps are made.$

lines.label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
lines.text: The POKéMON of the SLATEPORT\nBATTLE TENT are all rentals.\pAll rental POKéMON are kept at\nLevel 30.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed2
lines.text: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT\nrules are listed.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
lines.text: Which heading do you want to read?$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
lines.text: Here at the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT,\nPOKéMON are required to think and\lbattle by themselves.\pUnlike in the wild, POKéMON that live\nwith people behave differently\ldepending on their nature.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
lines.text:
Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.\pAnother POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.\pYet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.\pDepending on its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good\lat using.\pIt may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
lines.text:
There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.\pThere are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or\lused to heal HP and so on.\pThere are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with\lstat problems including poison and \lparalysis.\pPOKéMON will consider using moves in
these three categories.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules
lines.text:
When not under command by its TRAINER,
a POKéMON may be unable to effectively\luse certain moves.\pA POKéMON is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.\pIf a POKéMON only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often\lbe unable to live up to its potential.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainWhenInDangerRules
lines.text: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may\nstart using moves that don't match its\lnature when it is in trouble.\pIf a POKéMON begins behaving oddly\nin a pinch, watch it carefully.$

lines.label: BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainLevelRules
lines.text: At this BATTLE TENT, the levels of\nyour opponents will be adjusted to\lmatch the levels of your POKéMON.\pHowever, no TRAINER you face will\nhave any POKéMON below Level 30.$

lines.label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
lines.text: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT\nrules are listed.$

lines.label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GiveEnigmaBerry
lines.text: DAD: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pI just received a very rare BERRY.\nI'd like you to have it.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis
lines.text: If you see BERRIES growing in loamy\nsoil, feel free to take them.\pBut make sure you plant a BERRY in the\nsame spot. That's common courtesy.\pHere, I'll share this with you.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBerries
lines.text:
The way you look, you must be a
TRAINER, no?\pTRAINERS often make POKéMON hold
BERRIES.\pIt's up to you whether to grow BERRIES
or use them.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeBerry
lines.text: I watered the plants every day.\nThey grew lots of flowers.\pAnd they gave me lots of BERRIES, too.\pHere you go!\nYou can have it!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_GoingToTryToMakeDifferentColorBerries
lines.text: I'm going to try really hard and make\nBERRIES in different colors.\pI hope you try hard, too!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_WhatColorBerriesToLookForToday
lines.text: I wonder what color BERRIES I'll look\nfor today?$

lines.label: Route114_Text_LoveUsingBerryCrushShareBerry
lines.text: I love using the BERRY CRUSH machine,\nso I'm collecting BERRIES.\pI'll share one with you, if you'd like.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_TryBerryCrushWithFriends
lines.text: You should try the BERRY CRUSH\nmachine with your friends.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_FunToThinkAboutBerries
lines.text: Which BERRY should be planted?\nShould you use or hoard BERRIES?\pIt's fun to think about.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_BerriesExpressionOfLoveIsntIt
lines.text: BERRIES grow by soaking up sunlight.\pWe help the BERRIES grow by watering\nthem regularly.\pIt's an expression of love, isn't it?$

lines.label: Route120_Text_YesYouUnderstand
lines.text: Yes, yes.\nYou understand what I mean.\pYou should take this.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_MakeYourOwnImpressions
lines.text: Oh… But it is important to make your\nown impressions, I guess…\pYou can have this.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_BerryIsRareRaiseItWithCare
lines.text: I think that BERRY is rare.\nI hope you raise it with loving care.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_IllGetMoreBerriesFromBerryMaster
lines.text: I'll get more BERRIES from\nthe BERRY MASTER.$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
lines.text: When it gets right down to it…\pThe same way suits suit me perfectly,\na crisp breeze suits the sea.\pAnd you, a BERRY suits you to a “T”…\pWhy should that be so?$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_BecauseYoureTrainer
lines.text: When it gets right down to it…\pIt's because you're a TRAINER!$

lines.label: LilycoveCity_Text_PokeblocksSuitPokemon
lines.text: When it gets right down to it…\pThe way dignified simplicity suits me,\n{POKEBLOCK}S perfectly suit POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDeservingOfBerry
lines.text: You may call me the BERRY MASTER.\pI dream of filling the world with\nbeautiful flowers, so I raise BERRIES\land hand them out to everyone.\pYou're deserving of one!$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_WhyBeStingyTakeAnother
lines.text: Why be stingy?\nTake another!$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_VisitPrettyPetalFlowerShop
lines.text: Be sure to visit the PRETTY PETAL\nflower shop near RUSTBORO.\pLet flowers fill the world!$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_DoneForToday
lines.text: I'm done for today.\nCome again another day.\pLet flowers fill the world!$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGoodSayingLately
lines.text: The way my husband grows BERRIES,\noh, he's the best in the world.\pHe makes me proud, that he does.\pIncidentally, child, have you heard\na good saying lately?$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_InspirationalTakeThis
lines.text: Ah! What a remarkable saying!\nInspirational, it is!\pI want you to have this.$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_GoodSayingTakeThis
lines.text: Oh! A good saying it is.\nYou're quite remarkable.\pI want you to have this.$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_JoyNeverGoesOutOfMyLife
lines.text: Our four grandchildren should become\nmore accomplished than my husband.\pJoy never goes out of my life!$

lines.label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_Ah
lines.text: Ah…$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ThisIsPrettyPetalFlowerShop
lines.text: Hello!\pThis is the PRETTY PETAL flower shop.\nSpreading flowers all over the world!$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_LearnAboutBerries
lines.text: {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about\nBERRIES?$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
lines.text: Your name is?\p{PLAYER}{KUN}.\nThat's a nice name.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about\nBERRIES?$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
lines.text:
BERRIES grow on trees that thrive
only in soft, loamy soil.\pIf you take some BERRIES, be sure to
plant one in the loamy soil again.\pA planted BERRY will soon sprout,
grow into a plant, flower beautifully,\lthen grow BERRIES again.\pI want to see the whole wide world
filled with beautiful flowers.\lThat's my dream.\pPlease help me, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Plant BERRIES
and bring more flowers into the world.$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_FlowersBringHappiness
lines.text: Flowers bring so much happiness to\npeople, don't they?$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
lines.text: Hello!\pThe more attention you give to flowers,\nthe more beautifully they bloom.\pYou'll like tending flowers. I'm sure\nof it. You can have this.$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
lines.text:
While BERRY plants are growing,
water them with the WAILMER PAIL.\pOh, another thing.\pIf you don't pick BERRIES for a while,
they'll drop off onto the ground.\lBut they'll sprout again.\pIsn't that awesome?
It's like they have the will to live.$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ImGrowingFlowers
lines.text: I'm trying to be like my big sisters.\nI'm growing flowers, too!\pHere you go!\nIt's for you!$

lines.label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
lines.text: You can plant a BERRY and grow it big,\nor you can make a POKéMON hold it.\pBut now they have a machine that mixes\nup different BERRIES and makes candies\lfor POKéMON.\pI want some candy, too.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
lines.text: Hi, what's your name?\p… … …  … … …  … … …\nOkay. That's nice!\pMy name is KIRI.\pMy mommy and daddy named me that so\nI would grow healthy and warmhearted.\lThat's what they wished.\pYou can have one of these.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiveYouThisBerryToo
lines.text: KIRI will give you this BERRY, too!\nI really like it lots!$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatKindOfWishInYourName
lines.text: I wonder what kind of wish is included\nin your name.$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_LikeSeasonBornIn
lines.text: Spring, summer, autumn, and winter.\pIf you're born in springtime, do you like\nthe spring, and if you're born in the\lsummer, do you like the summer?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThenILoveAutumn
lines.text: Then KIRI was born in the autumn,\nso I love the autumn!\pWhich season do you like?$

lines.label: SootopolisCity_Text_OhDoesntMatter
lines.text: Oh…\nIt doesn't matter…\pThere's so much that I want to know…$

lines.label: gText_Birch_Welcome
lines.text: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!\pWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\pMy name is BIRCH.\pBut everyone calls me the POKéMON\nPROFESSOR.\p$

lines.label: gText_Birch_Pokemon
lines.text: This is what we call a “POKéMON.”\p\n$

lines.label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
lines.text:
This world is widely inhabited by
creatures known as POKéMON.\pWe humans live alongside POKéMON,
at times as friendly playmates, and\lat times as cooperative workmates.\pAnd sometimes, we band together
and battle others like us.\pBut despite our closeness, we don't
know everything about POKéMON.\pIn fact, there are many, many
secrets surrounding POKéMON.\pTo unravel POKéMON mysteries,
I've been undertaking research.\lThat's what I do.\p$

lines.label: gText_Birch_AndYouAre
lines.text: And you are?$

lines.label: gText_Birch_BoyOrGirl
lines.text: Are you a boy?\nOr are you a girl?$

lines.label: gText_Birch_WhatsYourName
lines.text: All right.\nWhat's your name?$

lines.label: gText_Birch_SoItsPlayer
lines.text: So it's {PLAYER}{KUN}?$

lines.label: gText_Birch_YourePlayer
lines.text: Ah, okay!\pYou're {PLAYER}{KUN} who's moving to my\nhometown of LITTLEROOT.\lI get it now!\p$

lines.label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
lines.text:
All right, are you ready?\pYour very own adventure is about
to unfold.\pTake courage, and leap into the
world of POKéMON where dreams,\ladventure, and friendships await!\pWell, I'll be expecting you later.
Come see me in my POKéMON LAB.\p$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendWithTheBlendMaster
lines.text: BLEND MASTER: Indeed I am!\nThe BLEND MASTER am I!\pBlend with me, and you shall witness\nthe mastery I bring to blending!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_SeeMyMasteryInAction
lines.text: BLEND MASTER: Hmmm! So, you wish to\nsee my mastery in action?$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_TooBusyNowIsee
lines.text: Hmmm!\pSo, you are too busy now, I see!\pBut fear not!\nI shall be here all day!\lHurry back from your errand!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoBerries
lines.text: Hmmm!\pYou haven't got a single BERRY!\pI shall be here all day!\nHurry back with some BERRIES!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterKnowHowToMakePokeblocks
lines.text: Of course!\nOf course!\pIncidentally…\nYou do know how to blend {POKEBLOCK}S\lfrom BERRIES?$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
lines.text: Hmmm!\pAh, but it is a simple process!\pWhen the BLENDER's arrow comes to\nyour marker, just press the A Button.\pThat's all you have to do.\pWhen you see how precisely I press\nthe A Button, you will understand.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterLetsBerryBlender
lines.text: Fine!\pLet's get started, then!\pAll together with the BLEND MASTER,\nlet's BERRY BLENDER!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoPokeblockCase
lines.text: Hmmm!\pYou don't appear to have gotten\nthe {POKEBLOCK} CASE!\pI shall be here all day!\nObtain the {POKEBLOCK} CASE and hurry back!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterPokeblockCaseFull
lines.text: Hmmm!\pYour {POKEBLOCK} CASE appears to be full!\pI shall be here all day!\nUse some {POKEBLOCK}S and hurry back!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_WhoaAwesome
lines.text: Whoa!\nAwesome!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_WickedlyFast
lines.text: Wickedly fast!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_WhatAnExpert
lines.text: What an expert!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_MadeAmazingPokeblocksWithMaster
lines.text: When I blended with the MASTER,\nwe made amazing {POKEBLOCK}S!$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_QualitiesOfBlendMaster
lines.text:
Eyes that track the arrow with
machinelike intensity…\pA hand that taps the A Button
with clockwork-like precision…\pPossessing these qualities makes
the BLEND MASTER truly great.$

lines.label: BerryBlender_Text_MasterWorksOnSkillsInMountains
lines.text: The BLEND MASTER's supposed to work\non his skills deep in the mountains.\pSometimes, he comes to LILYCOVE\nto blend BERRIES all day long.$

lines.label: CableClub_Text_ExplainBattleModes
lines.text:
There are three Battle Modes.\pSINGLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.\pDOUBLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS

up here.\pI'll show you how the Wireless
Communication System works.\pFirst, I need to show you this
floor of our POKéMON CENTER.\pRight this way, please.$

rooms.\pFirst, the room on the left.

around you who have also entered\lthe UNION ROOM.\pWith them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.\pSecond, the room on the right is
the DIRECT CORNER.\pYou may trade or battle POKéMON

connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.\pIf that is the case, you must go
to the DIRECT CORNER.\pI hope you enjoy the Wireless 
Communication System.$

lines.label: EventTicket_Text_ShowOldSeaMap
lines.text: The ferry to SLATEPORT is…\pI beg your pardon?\nCan we sail to this place on the map?\pI know someone who will help you better.\nPlease wait.$

lines.label: EventTicket_Text_ThatPass
lines.text: The ferry to SLATEPORT is…\pOh?\nThat PASS…$

lines.label: EventTicket_Text_ShowEonTicket
lines.text:
Aye, mate, are you the one who brought
that mighty odd PASS?\pI'll tell you, you're trying to reach a
tiny spit of an island far in the south.\pThere's no telling what we'll encounter
once we reach there, aye.\lThat shivers my timbers!\pAll aboard!$

lines.label: EventTicket_Text_SouthernIslandSailBack
lines.text: Aye, mate, there's nothing here to\nsee or do on this forgettable island.\pWhat say we sail back to LILYCOVE?$

lines.label: EventTicket_Text_SailHome
lines.text: Aye, right, then!\nSail home we will!$

lines.label: EventTicket_Text_AsYouLike
lines.text: Aye, right, as you like, then.$

lines.label: SouthernIsland_Interior_Text_Sign
lines.text: “All dreams are but another reality.\nNever forget…”$

lines.label: SouthernIsland_Exterior_Text_Sign
lines.text: “Those whose memories fade seek to\ncarve them in their hearts…”$

lines.label: EventTicket_Text_OldSeaMapTooFar
lines.text:
What's up, youngster?\pWhat, it's you who's supposed to have
a tattered old map?\pLet's have a look.
… … … … … …\pBoy, this is quite a ways away.
I'm afraid I can't help you…$

lines.label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyHoldOnASecond
lines.text: BRINEY: Hold on a second!\pWhat's the idea of turning down\nsomeone that I owe so much to?$

lines.label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail
lines.text: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm terribly sorry.\pYou came to me seeking my help,\nand we almost turned you away.\pWell, let me make things right.\pWe'll sail right away, of course!\pLet's find this island on\nthis OLD SEA MAP!$

lines.label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard
lines.text:
Is it you who brought that odd
ticket?\pWhere you're trying to go is an island
that's far, far away.\pNo one knows what awaits there…\pThe very thought excites my blood
as a sailing man!\pGet on board, youngster!$

lines.label: FarawayIsland_Entrance_Text_SailorReturn
lines.text: CAPT. BRINEY can be so maddeningly\nfickle…\pDo you want to return to LILYCOVE?$

lines.label: BirthIsland_Harbor_Text_SailorReturn
lines.text: What an oddly shaped island, eh?\nDo you want to return to LILYCOVE?$

lines.label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketsWhereTo
lines.text:
Is it you who brought those
odd tickets?\p… … …Hm.\pThese tickets will get you to islands
that are far, far away.\pNo one knows what awaits there,
or what may happen there.\pThe very thought excites my blood
as a sailing man!\pGet on board, youngster!
Where shall we sail first?$

lines.label: NavelRock_Harbor_Text_SailorReturn
lines.text: Did… Did you hear that?\nThat low growling from deep in there.\pAre you sure it's safe?\nDo you think we should leave?$

lines.label: FarawayIsland_Entrance_Text_Sign
lines.text: The writing is fading as if it was\nwritten a long time ago…\p“…ber, 6th day\nIf any human…sets foot here…\lagain…et it be a kindhearted pers…\l…ith that hope, I depar…”$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeWhichMon
lines.text: Okay! I'll teach it!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTaught
lines.text: When a POKéMON waggles its finger\nlike a METRONOME, all sorts of nice\lthings happen.\pWouldn't it be nice if we could\nuse it, too?$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach
lines.text:
Humph! My wife relies on HIDDEN
POWER to stay awake.\pShe should just take a nap like I do,
and SLEEP TALK.\pI can teach your POKéMON how to
SLEEP TALK instead. Interested?$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkDeclined
lines.text: Oh, fine, fine. You want to stay awake\nwith HIDDEN POWER, too…$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkWhichMon
lines.text: Ah, an appreciative child!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTaught
lines.text: I've never once gotten my wife's\ncoin trick right.\pI would be happy if I got it right\neven as I SLEEP TALK…$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach
lines.text:
When I see the wide world from up
here on the roof…\pI think about how nice it would be
if there were more than just one me\lso I could enjoy all sorts of lives.\pOf course it's not possible.
Giggle…\pI know! Would you be interested in
having a POKéMON learn SUBSTITUTE?$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteDeclined
lines.text: Oh, no?\pA POKéMON can make a copy of\nitself using it, you know.$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteWhichMon
lines.text: Giggle…\nWhich POKéMON do you want me to\lteach SUBSTITUTE?$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTaught
lines.text: We human beings should enjoy our\nown lives to the utmost!\pI hope you'll get that way, too!$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
lines.text:
I can't do this anymore!\pIt's utterly hopeless!\pI'm a FIGHTING-type TRAINER,
so I can't win at the MOSSDEEP GYM\lno matter how hard I try!\pArgh! Punch! Punch! Punch!
Punch! Punch! Punch!\pWhat, don't look at me that way!
I'm only hitting the ground!\pOr do you want me to teach your
POKéMON DYNAMICPUNCH?$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchDeclined
lines.text: Darn! You're even making fun of me?\nPunch! Punch! Punch!$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchWhichMon
lines.text: What? You do? You're a good person!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTaught
lines.text: I want you to win at the MOSSDEEP GYM\nusing that DYNAMICPUNCH!$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
lines.text:
Sigh…\pSOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER is really
lovably admirable.\pBut that also means I have many
rivals for his attention.\pHe's got appeal with a DOUBLE-EDGE.
I couldn't even catch his eye.\pPlease, let me teach your POKéMON
the move DOUBLE-EDGE!$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeDeclined
lines.text: Oh…\nEven you rejected me…$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeWhichMon
lines.text: Okay, which POKéMON should I teach\nDOUBLE-EDGE?$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTaught
lines.text: I won't live for love anymore!\nI'll become tough!$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTeach
lines.text:
I don't intend to be going nowhere
fast in the sticks like this forever.\pYou watch me, I'll get out to the city
and become a huge hit.\pSeriously, I'm going to cause
a huge EXPLOSION of popularity!\pIf you overheard that, I'll happily
teach EXPLOSION to your POKéMON!$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionDeclined
lines.text: Gaah! You're turning me down because\nI live in the country?$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionWhichMon
lines.text: Fine! An EXPLOSION it is!\nWhich POKéMON wants to blow up?$

lines.label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTaught
lines.text: For a long time, I've taught POKéMON\nhow to use EXPLOSION, but I've yet\lto ignite my own EXPLOSION…\pMaybe it's because deep down,\nI would rather stay here…$

the honor of resting your POKéMON!$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_AreYouCurious
lines.text: PROF. BIRCH: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pAre you curious about how your\nPOKéDEX is coming along?$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_Cancel
lines.text: Hm? Oh, you haven't caught enough\nPOKéMON to make it worthwhile.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_SoYouveSeenAndCaught
lines.text: Hmhm…\pSo, you've seen {STR_VAR_1} POKéMON,\nand you've caught {STR_VAR_2} POKéMON…$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan10
lines.text: Go into grassy areas more and look\nfor POKéMON more carefully.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan20
lines.text: I guess you're getting the hang\nof it. But, it gets harder from here.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan30
lines.text: Some POKéMON only appear in\ncertain areas.\lYou must be persistent.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan40
lines.text: Well, it could use more quantity,\nbut this is looking more like\la POKéDEX now.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan50
lines.text: This is coming along pretty good.\nKeep up the effort.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan60
lines.text: Are you using any RODS?\nThere are many POKéMON in the sea.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan70
lines.text: Instead of just catching POKéMON,\nhow about making them evolve, too?$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan80
lines.text: This is going to be a fantastic\nPOKéDEX.\lThat's the feeling I'm getting.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan90
lines.text: You've collected this many…\nYour talent is remarkable!$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan100
lines.text: Have you visited the SAFARI ZONE?\pI hear there are some POKéMON that\ncan only be caught there.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan110
lines.text: You've finally reached\nthe 100-kind mark.\pThis is an impressive POKéDEX!$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan120
lines.text: There might be POKéMON that can be\nfound using ROCK SMASH.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan130
lines.text: You should get some more POKéMON\nby trading with others.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan140
lines.text: I've heard of POKéMON that evolve\nwhen they come to fully love their\lTRAINERS.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan150
lines.text: I had no idea that there were so\nmany POKéMON species in the HOENN\lregion.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan160
lines.text: On occasion, some POKéMON appear\nin large numbers like outbreaks.\pDon't miss opportunities like\nthose.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan170
lines.text: One can get a very good idea about\nthe POKéMON of the HOENN region\lby looking through your POKéDEX.$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan180
lines.text: I would say you already qualify as\na POKéMON PROFESSOR, and a good\lone, too!$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan190
lines.text: With a POKéDEX this complete,\nyou're a real professional at this!$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan200
lines.text: You're very close to completing\nthis POKéDEX.\lI can feel it in my bones!$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_DexCompleted
lines.text: Congratulations!\nYour POKéDEX is complete!$

lines.label: gBirchDexRatingText_OnANationwideBasis
lines.text: Hmhm…\nOn a nationwide basis…\pYou've seen {STR_VAR_1} POKéMON,\nand you've caught {STR_VAR_2} POKéMON…$

lines.label: gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Upcoming
lines.text:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pSLATEPORT's most popular kind of guy,
the ENERGY GURU, is in the news again!\pHe promises to, “Stupendously go for
it in just this many days: {STR_VAR_1}!”\pWhile he refused to elaborate on what
he will stupendously go for, the\lENERGY GURU advised, “Save up your\lmoney. That'll be good…”\pIt sounds like a trip to SLATEPORT
would be well worth your while that day.\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

lines.label: gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Ongoing
lines.text:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pThis is the news you've all been
waiting for!\pSLATEPORT'S ENERGY GURU is going
for it stupendously in the MARKET!\pHe promises unbeatable bargain
prices on CALCIUM and PROTEIN!\pA trip to SLATEPORT CITY sounds
worthwhile. Why not visit and shop\lto your heart's content?\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

lines.label: gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Ending
lines.text:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pThis is the news you've all been
waiting for!\pSLATEPORT'S ENERGY GURU is going

may be lucky on this particular day!\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$

and ROULETTE?\pThe location is MAUVILLE CITY.

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0Intro
lines.text: Have you made a SECRET BASE already?\pI went here, there, everywhere before\nchoosing this place.\pSince you're already here, how would\nyou like to battle?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0AcceptBattle
lines.text: Okay!\nHere we come!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0DeclineBattle
lines.text: Hunh?\nOh, you can't now…$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0Defeated
lines.text: Waaargh! You're too strong!\nAbout me losing… Please keep it secret!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PostBattle
lines.text: What do you think of my SECRET BASE?\nCome visit me again tomorrow.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PreChampion
lines.text: Have you made a SECRET BASE already?\pI went here, there, everywhere before\nchoosing this place.\pFeel free to hang out!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Intro
lines.text: There're a lot of places where\nyou can make a SECRET BASE.\pBut I like this spot best.\nDon't you think it's nice?\pOh, would you like to have a battle?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5AcceptBattle
lines.text: Okay, here goes!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5DeclineBattle
lines.text: Oh…\nYou can't now, okay.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Defeated
lines.text: Hmmm… It's our loss…\nBut don't tell anyone!\lIt's a confidential secret!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PostBattle
lines.text: If you're in this area again,\nI hope you'll visit me.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PreChampion
lines.text: There're a lot of places where you can\nmake a SECRET BASE.\pBut I like this spot best.\nDon't you think it's nice?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Intro
lines.text:
This is a popular spot.
It's always taken.\pOh! Were you thinking about
taking this spot, too?\pI'll tell you what, you can have this
spot if you can beat me.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1AcceptBattle
lines.text: Okay!\nI'm going to defend my SECRET BASE!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1DeclineBattle
lines.text: Hunh? Is that right?\nYou're not interested in this spot?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Defeated
lines.text: I can't keep going!\nI surrender!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PostBattle
lines.text: Okay, when I move one day,\nthis place will be yours!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PreChampion
lines.text: This is a popular spot.\nIt's always taken.\pI waited a long time for it to open.\nI finally got to use it!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Intro
lines.text: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.\pI carry out research on battling in\nsecrecy.\pWould you like to see how strong I am?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6AcceptBattle
lines.text: I'm going to go all out!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6DeclineBattle
lines.text: Oh.\nSome other time, then!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Defeated
lines.text: Hmm… I've still got lots to learn.\nI have to study some more.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PostBattle
lines.text: Thanks for battling with me.\nPlease come back again tomorrow.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PreChampion
lines.text: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.\pI carry out research on battling in\nsecrecy.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Intro
lines.text: A big mansion is nice, but I like this\nsort of place more.\pI like it because all kinds of people\ncome visit me.\pSo, how would you like a battle?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2AcceptBattle
lines.text: That's the way!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2DeclineBattle
lines.text: When you're ready, give me a shout!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Defeated
lines.text: Aww! Done in!\nBut it's still fun to battle!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PostBattle
lines.text: Well, anyway, I should go buy some\ndecorations and furniture.\pI want my SECRET BASE to be a place\nother people can enjoy.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PreChampion
lines.text: A big mansion is nice, but I like this\nsort of place more.\pI like it because all kinds of people\ncome visit me.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Intro
lines.text:
I simply adore shopping for decorations
and furniture.\pI also love raising POKéMON just
as much.\pIf you would be so kind, will you battle
with my POKéMON?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7AcceptBattle
lines.text: Thank you.\nShall we begin?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7DeclineBattle
lines.text: Oh.\nHow disappointing…$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Defeated
lines.text: I concede…$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PostBattle
lines.text: That was all in good fun!\nI should go enjoy shopping now.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PreChampion
lines.text: I simply adore shopping for decorations\nand furniture.\pI also love raising POKéMON just\nas much.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Intro
lines.text: Some people make their SECRET BASES in\nhard-to-find places.\lDo they want to just lie low?\pBut since you found me, how about we\nhave a battle?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3AcceptBattle
lines.text: I'm not going down easily!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3DeclineBattle
lines.text: Oh… Are you maybe tired from searching\nfor this place?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Defeated
lines.text: I went down…$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PostBattle
lines.text: Where's your SECRET BASE?\nI should go visit you there.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PreChampion
lines.text: Some people make their SECRET BASES in\nhard-to-find places.\lDo they want to just lie low?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Intro
lines.text: People have told me that you can get\ndecorations in several ways.\pWe should have a race to see who can\nget nicer decorations and furniture!\pIn the meantime, want to battle?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8AcceptBattle
lines.text: This is my SECRET BASE.\nI can't lose!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8DeclineBattle
lines.text: I'll battle with you anytime.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Defeated
lines.text: Huh?\nDid I just lose?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PostBattle
lines.text: I won't lose at collecting decorations.\nCome visit again!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PreChampion
lines.text: People have told me that you can get\ndecorations in several ways.\pWe should have a race to see who can\nget nicer decorations and furniture!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Intro
lines.text:
I found a spot I liked, and I did it up
with my favorite decorations.\pI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow
stronger with it.\pThat's what I do.
Want to battle with me?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4AcceptBattle
lines.text: Show me what you're made of!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4DeclineBattle
lines.text: I guess there are times when you're not\ninto it.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Defeated
lines.text: I know exactly what you're made of now.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PostBattle
lines.text: We can both become stronger.\nLet's keep at it!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PreChampion
lines.text: I found a spot I liked, and I did it up\nwith my favorite decorations.\pI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow\nstronger with it.\pEvery day is a great day.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Intro
lines.text: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\ldecorations they have, and how they\ldisplay them.\pWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?\pWant to see my taste in battling?$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9AcceptBattle
lines.text: There's no holding back!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9DeclineBattle
lines.text: I'll be happy to demonstrate my style\nanytime.$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Defeated
lines.text: You're supremely talented!\nYour power seems to be limitless…$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PostBattle
lines.text: What did you think of my style?\nI'll keep on polishing it!$

lines.label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PreChampion
lines.text: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\ldecorations they have, and how they\ldisplay them.\pWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?$

lines.label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_AreYouPlanningOnGoingInThere
lines.text:
Are you planning on going deep
in there?\pHow about bringing me back some
SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS?\pI can make you something good if
you bring me the ingredients.$

lines.label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_BringMe4ShoalSaltAndShells
lines.text: If you bring me four each of the\nSHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS,\lI can make you a SHELL BELL…\pYou can get those ingredients\nevery day.$

lines.label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WouldYouLikeShellBell
lines.text: Oh, hey! SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS!\nAnd enough of them, too!\pWould you like me to make you\na SHELL BELL with them?$

lines.label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_MakeShellBellRightAway
lines.text: All righty, then! I'll make you\na SHELL BELL right away.\p… … … … … … … …\n… … … … … … … …\pThere! Done!$

lines.label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_ExplainShellBell
lines.text:
Have a POKéMON hold on to that.
It'll love it, that's for certain.\pWhy, the SHELL BELL's chime…
It's simply sublime!\pYou can get its ingredients every day,
so I can make you more.$

lines.label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WantedToMakeShellBell
lines.text: Oh… Is that so…\nI wanted to make a SHELL BELL…$

lines.label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_NoSpaceInYourBag
lines.text: You don't have space in your BAG\nif I were to make it for you.\pYou should make room and come back\nfor a SHELL BELL.$

lines.label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoalSaltNowNothing
lines.text: There was some SHOAL SALT here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.$

lines.label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoallShellNowNothing
lines.text: There was a SHOAL SHELL here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.$

lines.label: gText_WantToUseSurf
lines.text: The water is dyed a deep blue…\nWould you like to SURF?$

lines.label: gText_PlayerUsedSurf
lines.text: {STR_VAR_1} used SURF!$

lines.label: Route102_Text_CalvinIntro
lines.text: If you have POKéMON with you, then\nyou're an official POKéMON TRAINER!\lYou can't say no to my challenge!$

lines.label: Route102_Text_CalvinDefeated
lines.text: Arrgh, I lost…\nI should have trained mine more…$

lines.label: Route102_Text_CalvinPostBattle
lines.text: Listen, you. If you're strong,\nyou should have told me before!$

lines.label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegister
lines.text: I've been working hard at this since\nI saw you before.\pI'd like to battle you again, so can\nyou register me in your POKéNAV?$

lines.label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegisterShort
lines.text: I'd like to battle you again, so can\nyou register me in your POKéNAV?$

lines.label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchIntro
lines.text: Ever since I lost to you, I desperately\ntrained my POKéMON.\lYou can't say no to my challenge!$

lines.label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchDefeated
lines.text: Arrgh, I lost…\nIs my training method not right?$

lines.label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchPostBattle
lines.text: If you're going to get stronger,\nI'll get stronger, too.$

lines.label: Route102_Text_AllenIntro
lines.text: Did you just become a TRAINER?\nWe're both beginners!$

lines.label: Route102_Text_AllenDefeated
lines.text: I called you because I thought\nI could beat you…$

lines.label: Route102_Text_AllenPostBattle
lines.text: I haven't won once yet…\nI wish I would win soon…$

lines.label: Route102_Text_RickIntro
lines.text: Hahah! Our eyes met!\nI'll take you on with my BUG POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route102_Text_RickDefeated
lines.text: Ow! Down and out!$

lines.label: Route102_Text_RickPostBattle
lines.text: If you lock eyes with a TRAINER,\nyou have to challenge! It's a rule!$

lines.label: Route102_Text_TianaIntro
lines.text: I'm going to keep winning and aim\nto be the best TRAINER.\pHelp me further my career!$

lines.label: Route102_Text_TianaDefeated
lines.text: I ended up furthering your career…$

lines.label: Route102_Text_TianaPostBattle
lines.text: To keep winning my way up, I see that\nI have to catch more POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_DaisyIntro
lines.text: Did you feel the tug of our\nsoul-soothing fragrance?$

lines.label: Route103_Text_DaisyDefeated
lines.text: You weren't led astray by our aroma…$

lines.label: Route103_Text_DaisyPostBattle
lines.text: Aromatherapy is a form of mental\nhealing that works with fragrances.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_AmyIntro
lines.text: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\lWe battle together!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_AmyDefeated
lines.text: AMY: Uh-oh, we lost.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_AmyPostBattle
lines.text: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\lagainst two TRAINERS.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_AmyNotEnoughPokemon
lines.text: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\lYou can't battle us like that.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_LivIntro
lines.text: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_LivDefeated
lines.text: LIV: Oh, we lost, big sister…$

lines.label: Route103_Text_LivPostBattle
lines.text: LIV: We work perfectly together,\nme and my big sister…\pBut we still lost…$

lines.label: Route103_Text_AmyLivRegister
lines.text: LIV: Really, we're a lot better…\nIt's true! We'll show you next time!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_LivNotEnoughPokemon
lines.text: LIV: If you want to battle us,\nyou have to have two POKéMON!\lIt's not fair if you don't!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchIntro
lines.text: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\lWe battle together!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchDefeated
lines.text: AMY: Aww, boo!\nWe couldn't win again…$

lines.label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchPostBattle
lines.text: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\lagainst two TRAINERS.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchNotEnoughPokemon
lines.text: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\lYou can't battle us like that.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_LivRematchIntro
lines.text: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_LivRematchDefeated
lines.text: LIV: Awww, we lost again…\nBig sister…$

lines.label: Route103_Text_LivRematchPostBattle
lines.text: LIV: We work perfectly together,\nme and my big sister…\pBut why did we lose again?$

lines.label: Route103_Text_LivRematchNotEnoughPokemon
lines.text: LIV: If you want to battle us, you\nhave to have two POKéMON!\lIt's not fair if you don't!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_AndrewIntro
lines.text: Gah! My fishing line's all snarled up!\nI'm getting frustrated and mean!\lThat's it! Battle me!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_AndrewDefeated
lines.text: Gah! Lost it!\nI'm even more annoyed now!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_AndrewPostBattle
lines.text: Gah, I'm still boiling mad…\nGrrrrr…$

lines.label: Route103_Text_MiguelIntro
lines.text: My POKéMON is delightfully adorable!\nDon't be shy--I'll show you!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_MiguelDefeated
lines.text: Oh, my gosh!\nMy darling POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_MiguelPostBattle
lines.text: My delightful POKéMON looks darling\neven when it's fainted!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_MiguelRegister
lines.text: I'll get you to come out and look in\non my delightful POKéMON again!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchIntro
lines.text: Hi, you! My delightfully adorable\nPOKéMON has become more darling!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchDefeated
lines.text: Oh!\nMy darling POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchPostBattle
lines.text: The more I spend time with it,\nthe more adorable my POKéMON becomes.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_PeteIntro
lines.text: This sort of distance…\nYou should just swim it!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_PeteDefeated
lines.text: Oh, that's good going!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_PetePostBattle
lines.text: Oh, I understand where you're coming\nfrom now.\pIf I had a POKéMON that trusty,\nI'd want to SURF on it, too!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_IsabelleIntro
lines.text: Watch where you're going!\nWe're going to crash!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_IsabelleDefeated
lines.text: Groan…$

lines.label: Route103_Text_IsabellePostBattle
lines.text: I'm a poor swimmer so I was practicing…\nSorry for almost crashing into you.$

lines.label: Route103_Text_RhettIntro
lines.text: Whoa!\nHow'd you get into a space this small?$

lines.label: Route103_Text_RhettDefeated
lines.text: Whoa!\nThe kid can rock!$

lines.label: Route103_Text_RhettPostBattle
lines.text: Do you like cramped quarters\nlike this?$

lines.label: Route103_Text_MarcosIntro
lines.text: Did my guitar's wailing draw you in?$

lines.label: Route103_Text_MarcosDefeated
lines.text: My one-man show is ruined…$

lines.label: Route103_Text_MarcosPostBattle
lines.text: I was playing my guitar where few\npeople were around, but a lot of fans\lhave gathered.\pHeh, maybe I should turn pro.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_GinaIntro
lines.text: GINA: Okay, let's battle with our\nPOKéMON!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_GinaDefeat
lines.text: GINA: Losing upsets me!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_GinaPostBattle
lines.text: GINA: You are strong!\nWe have to train lots more!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_GinaNotEnoughMons
lines.text: GINA: Oh? Only one POKéMON?\nThen, we don't battle with you.\pIf there's only one POKéMON, it will\nbe lonesome. That's not nice.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_MiaIntro
lines.text: MIA: We are twins, so we battle\nPOKéMON together.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_MiaDefeat
lines.text: MIA: We battled together, but we\nboth lost…$

lines.label: Route104_Text_MiaPostBattle
lines.text: MIA: We will train our POKéMON more\nand be strong like you.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_MiaNotEnoughMons
lines.text: MIA: You want to battle with us?\pIt's a big no-no if you don't have two\nPOKéMON with you.\lWe're too strong for you!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_IvanIntro
lines.text: Why keep it a secret?\nI'm the WATER POKéMON expert!\pHuh?\nYou don't know me?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_IvanDefeat
lines.text: I thought I wasn't too bad, if I may\nsay so, but I guess not… Bleah…$

lines.label: Route104_Text_IvanPostBattle
lines.text: I got too into fishing.\nI forgot I had to raise my POKéMON…$

lines.label: Route104_Text_BillyIntro
lines.text: Leaving footprints in the sand is\nso fun!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_BillyDefeat
lines.text: Waah! I got sand in my runners!\nThey're all gritty!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_BillyPostBattle
lines.text: I want to leave my footprints in\nthe sand everywhere, but they\ldisappear quickly…$

lines.label: Route104_Text_HaleyIntro
lines.text: Should I…\nOr shouldn't I?\pOkay, sure, I will battle!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_HaleyDefeat
lines.text: I shouldn't have battled…$

lines.label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostBattle
lines.text: If you're faced with a decision and\nyou let someone else choose for you,\lyou will regret it, however things\lturn out.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister1
lines.text: You're strong, but should I register\nyou in my POKéNAV?\lMaybe I shouldn't…\pOkay, sure, I will register you!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister2
lines.text: You're strong, but should I register\nyou in my POKéNAV?\lMaybe I shouldn't…\pOkay, sure, I will register you!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_HaleyRematchIntro
lines.text: Come on, battle with me!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_HaleyRematchDefeat
lines.text: Ohh…\nI thought I could win…$

lines.label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostRematch
lines.text: I made the decision to battle, so\nI can accept this loss with grace.\pI am still upset about losing!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_WinstonIntro
lines.text: Oh, sure, I'll accept your challenge.\nI have a lot of money.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_WinstonDefeat
lines.text: Why couldn't I win?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_WinstonPostBattle
lines.text: There are some things money can't buy.\nThat's POKéMON…$

lines.label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister1
lines.text: Hm?\nAh, you've obtained a POKéNAV.\pI will gladly register you.\nAfter all, I have plenty of money.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister2
lines.text: Hm?\nAh, you've obtained a POKéNAV.\pI will gladly register you.\nAfter all, I have plenty of money.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_WinstonRematchIntro
lines.text: After I lost to you, I learned a bunch\nof things about POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_WinstonRematchDefeat
lines.text: I lost again?\nWhy couldn't I win?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_WinstonPostRematch
lines.text: I'm fabulously wealthy, but I can't\nseem to win at POKéMON…\pIt's so deep, the world of POKéMON…$

lines.label: Route104_Text_CindyIntro
lines.text: We must have been fated to meet.\nMay I ask you for a battle?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_CindyDefeat
lines.text: Oh, my!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_CindyPostBattle
lines.text: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister1
lines.text: Hello, we meet again.\pWe seem to be drawn together. Let's\nregister each other in our POKéNAVS.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister2
lines.text: We should commemorate how we seem\nto be drawn to each other.\pLet's register each other in our\nPOKéNAVS.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_CindyRematchIntro
lines.text: Hello, we meet again.\nMay I ask you for a battle?$

lines.label: Route104_Text_CindyRematchDefeat
lines.text: Oh, my…\nI did the best that I could…$

lines.label: Route104_Text_CindyPostRematch
lines.text: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.$

lines.label: Route104_Text_DarianIntro
lines.text: I fished up a tough-looking POKéMON!\pIt has this magical quality to it!\nIt surely looks tough, yes it does!$

lines.label: Route104_Text_DarianDefeat
lines.text: What the…$

lines.label: Route104_Text_DarianPostBattle
