lines.text: Hey, MAGIKARP, you sure don't live up\nto your name, do you?$

lines.label: Route105_Text_FosterIntro
lines.text: There's supposed to be a mystical\nrock around here.\lDo you know anything about it?$

lines.label: Route105_Text_FosterDefeated
lines.text: I was thinking too much about that\nrock, while my POKéMON remained weak…$

lines.label: Route105_Text_FosterPostBattle
lines.text: I can spend hours and hours staring\nat a nice rock without growing bored.$

lines.label: Route105_Text_LuisIntro
lines.text: Whew! I was worried that a kid was\ndrowning when I saw you.\pYou seem to be okay, so what do you\nsay to a battle?$

lines.label: Route105_Text_LuisDefeated
lines.text: Glub… Glub…$

lines.label: Route105_Text_LuisPostBattle
lines.text: If you are drowning, the signal is to\nwave one arm toward the beach.$

lines.label: Route105_Text_DominikIntro
lines.text: Swimming the deep blue sea…\nIt feels the greatest!$

lines.label: Route105_Text_DominikDefeated
lines.text: I lost…\nNow I'm feeling blue…$

lines.label: Route105_Text_DominikPostBattle
lines.text: Why is the sea blue?\pI learned about that at the MUSEUM in\nSLATEPORT, but I forgot.$

lines.label: Route105_Text_BeverlyIntro
lines.text: My body feels lighter in the water.\nIt's as if I've gotten slimmer!$

lines.label: Route105_Text_BeverlyDefeated
lines.text: I'm floating…$

lines.label: Route105_Text_PostBattle
lines.text: Your body weight is reduced to just\none tenth in the water.\pThat would make me…\nWhoops! I'm not telling you my weight!$

lines.label: Route105_Text_ImaniIntro
lines.text: The blue, blue sky…\nThe vast sea…\lIt's so peaceful…$

lines.label: Route105_Text_ImaniDefeated
lines.text: I lost while I was lounging!$

lines.label: Route105_Text_ImaniPostBattle
lines.text: I want to be told I'm relaxing to be\nwith. Giggle.$

lines.label: Route105_Text_AndresIntro
lines.text: I'm convinced that the sea keeps\nsecrets from us.$

lines.label: Route105_Text_AndresDefeated
lines.text: Yes…\nI am no good at battling…$

lines.label: Route105_Text_AndresPostBattle
lines.text: I'm sure there are many secrets to be\ndiscovered in the world's seas.\pI mean to find them all!$

lines.label: Route105_Text_AndresRegister
lines.text: Huh? I'm so weak, but you're willing\nto register me in your POKéNAV?$

lines.label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchIntro
lines.text: I've told you that I'm weak…\nAre you sure you want to do this?$

lines.label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchDefeated
lines.text: Yes…\nI didn't think I could win.$

lines.label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchPostBattle
lines.text: I may be weak at battling, but my\ndrive to explore can't be bested.\pI will travel the seas all around\nthe world!$

lines.label: Route105_Text_JosueIntro
lines.text: I'm exhausted from swimming.\nI'm just not used to it.\pI need a battle for a change of pace!$

lines.label: Route105_Text_JosueDefeated
lines.text: I lost because I battled at sea.$

lines.label: Route105_Text_JosuePostBattle
lines.text: Yeah, for me, the sky is a much better\nmatch than the sea.$

lines.label: Route106_Text_ElliotIntro
lines.text: Which do you prefer, fishing in the\nsea or a stream?$

lines.label: Route106_Text_ElliotDefeated
lines.text: Like in deep-sea fishing, I lost\nspectacularly!$

lines.label: Route106_Text_ElliotPostBattle
lines.text: Fishing is the greatest whether it's\nin the sea or a stream.\lYou agree with me, right?$

lines.label: Route106_Text_ElliotRegister
lines.text: Fishing's great, but so is battling.\nIf you don't mind, can we meet again?$

lines.label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchIntro
lines.text: I caught a bunch of POKéMON fishing.\nI'll show you an impressive battle!$

lines.label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchDefeated
lines.text: I lost again spectacularly!$

lines.label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchPostBattle
lines.text: Win or lose, POKéMON are the greatest!\nYou agree with me, right?$

lines.label: Route106_Text_NedIntro
lines.text: What do people do if they need to go\nto a washroom?\pWhat if my ROD hooks a big one while\nI'm in the washroom? I just can't go…$

lines.label: Route106_Text_NedDefeated
lines.text: I lost because I'm trying to not go\nto the washroom…$

lines.label: Route106_Text_NedPostBattle
lines.text: Oh, no! I've got this feeling I'll hook\na big one!$

lines.label: Route106_Text_DouglasIntro
lines.text: Hahahah! I'm a lousy runner, but in\nthe water you can't catch me!$

lines.label: Route106_Text_DouglasDefeated
lines.text: I give up!$

lines.label: Route106_Text_DouglasPostBattle
lines.text: I wouldn't lose in a swim race…$

lines.label: Route106_Text_KylaIntro
lines.text: The sea is my backyard. I'm not going\nto take it easy because you're a kid!$

lines.label: Route106_Text_KylaDefeated
lines.text: Did you take it easy on me by any\nchance?$

lines.label: Route106_Text_KylaPostBattle
lines.text: Drifting along with the waves…\nI love it! Why don't you give it a try?$

lines.label: Route107_Text_DarrinIntro
lines.text: Yawn…\pI must have drifted off to sleep while\nI was drifting in the waves.$

lines.label: Route107_Text_DarrinDefeated
lines.text: Ahaha, I lost…\nI'll take a snooze, I think…$

lines.label: Route107_Text_DarrinPostBattle
lines.text: Floating and being rocked by\nthe waves--it's like sleeping in\la plush, comfy bed.$

lines.label: Route107_Text_TonyIntro
lines.text: The sea is like my backyard.\nLet's battle!$

lines.label: Route107_Text_TonyDefeated
lines.text: I lost on my home field…\nI'm in shock!$

lines.label: Route107_Text_TonyPostBattle
lines.text: I swim the seas with a heart full of\ndreams…\pIt's a song!\nAnyways, I'm swimming some more.$

lines.label: Route107_Text_TonyRegister
lines.text: You've shocked me to the bone!\nWell, so you won't forget me…$

lines.label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchIntro
lines.text: Swimming in the big, wide sea,\nmy POKéMON has grown stronger!$

lines.label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchDefeated
lines.text: What a shock!\pMy POKéMON has gotten stronger, but\nI stayed weak as a TRAINER!$

lines.label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchPostBattle
lines.text: What you learn in battle makes you\na stronger TRAINER.\lThe waves taught me that.$

lines.label: Route107_Text_DeniseIntro
lines.text: Do you know a little town called\nDEWFORD?$

lines.label: Route107_Text_DeniseDefeated
lines.text: I hate this!$

lines.label: Route107_Text_DenisePostBattle
lines.text: A weird saying is getting really\ntrendy at DEWFORD HALL.$

lines.label: Route107_Text_BethIntro
lines.text: Did you want to battle me?\nSure, I'll go with you!$

lines.label: Route107_Text_BethDefeated
lines.text: I wasn't good enough for you.$

lines.label: Route107_Text_BethPostBattle
lines.text: I think you're going to keep getting\nbetter. I'll go for it, too!$

lines.label: Route107_Text_LisaIntro
lines.text: LISA: We challenge you as a sister\nand brother!$

lines.label: Route107_Text_LisaDefeated
lines.text: LISA: Awesome.\nYou're in a different class of tough.$

lines.label: Route107_Text_LisaPostBattle
lines.text: LISA: Do you have any friends who\nwould go to the beach with you?$

lines.label: Route107_Text_LisaNotEnoughPokemon
lines.text: LISA: If you want to battle with us,\nbring more POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route107_Text_RayIntro
lines.text: RAY: We always battle POKéMON,\nme and my sister.\pI always lose, but we can beat you\n2-on-2!$

lines.label: Route107_Text_RayDefeated
lines.text: RAY: Wowee, you're at a higher level\nthan us!$

lines.label: Route107_Text_RayPostBattle
lines.text: RAY: My sister gave me my POKéMON.\nI raised it, and now it's my important\lpartner!$

lines.label: Route107_Text_RayNotEnoughPokemon
lines.text: RAY: If you want to battle us,\ngo bring some more POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route107_Text_CamronIntro
lines.text: I'm in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut I'm nowhere near tired!$

lines.label: Route107_Text_CamronDefeated
lines.text: That exhausted me…$

lines.label: Route107_Text_CamronPostBattle
lines.text: I still have swimming and running left\nto do after this.\pAm I going to be okay?$

lines.label: Route108_Text_JeromeIntro
lines.text: My dream is to swim the world's seven\nseas!$

lines.label: Route108_Text_JeromeDefeated
lines.text: I won't be able to swim the seven seas\nlike this…$

lines.label: Route108_Text_JeromePostBattle
lines.text: Playing with marine POKéMON is one of\nthe pleasures of swimming!$

lines.label: Route108_Text_MatthewIntro
lines.text: Ahoy, there! Are you going out to\nthe ABANDONED SHIP, too?$

lines.label: Route108_Text_MatthewDefeated
lines.text: I'm sinking!\nGlub… Glub…$

lines.label: Route108_Text_MatthewPostBattle
lines.text: Some people even go inside that\nABANDONED SHIP.$

lines.label: Route108_Text_TaraIntro
lines.text: My liar of a boyfriend told me that\nI look great in a bikini…$

lines.label: Route108_Text_TaraDefeated
lines.text: Oh, boo!$

lines.label: Route108_Text_TaraPostBattle
lines.text: Even if it's a lie, I love being told\nI look great…\lWe girls are so complex…$

lines.label: Route108_Text_MissyIntro
lines.text: I love the sea!\nI forget all my worries when I swim!$

lines.label: Route108_Text_MissyDefeated
lines.text: When I lose a battle, I get all\nstressed out!$

lines.label: Route108_Text_MissyPostBattle
lines.text: Work off your stress by swimming!\nIt's so healthy!$

lines.label: Route108_Text_CoryIntro
lines.text: I love WATER-type POKéMON.\nI love other POKéMON, too!$

lines.label: Route108_Text_CoryDefeated
lines.text: Waaah! I lost!\nWaaah! Waaah!$

lines.label: Route108_Text_CoryPostBattle
lines.text: Shouting is good for me!\nIt uplifts me!$

lines.label: Route108_Text_CoryRegister
lines.text: I love tough TRAINERS, too!\nRegister me in your POKéNAV!$

lines.label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchIntro
lines.text: Win or lose, I love battling at sea!$

lines.label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchDefeated
lines.text: Waaah! I lost again!\nWaaah! Waaah!$

lines.label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchPostBattle
lines.text: If you're faced with a challenge,\ntry shouting at the sea!$

lines.label: Route108_Text_CarolinaIntro
lines.text: I take huge pride in my POKéMON.\nWe'll show you one speedy battle!$

lines.label: Route108_Text_CarolinaDefeated
lines.text: That wasn't cute at all.$

lines.label: Route108_Text_CarolinaPostBattle
lines.text: Since I'm at sea like this, I wouldn't\nmind putting on a pink, frilly swimsuit…$

lines.label: Route109_Text_DavidIntro
lines.text: Hiyah! Look at my chiseled abs!\nThis is what you call “cut”!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_DavidDefeated
lines.text: Aiyah!\nFlubbed out!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_DavidPostBattle
lines.text: Hiyah!\pMy sculpted abs have nothing to do\nwith POKéMON battles!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_AliceIntro
lines.text: Are you properly protected against\nthe sun?$

lines.label: Route109_Text_AliceDefeated
lines.text: Ouch, ouch, ouch!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_AlicePostBattle
lines.text: Cheeks are the most prone to burning!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_HueyIntro
lines.text: I've laid anchor in ports around\nthe world, but SLATEPORT's the best.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_HueyDefeated
lines.text: You're the best!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_HueyPostBattle
lines.text: In the best port was the best\nTRAINER…$

lines.label: Route109_Text_EdmondIntro
lines.text: Urrrrppp…\nBattle? With me?$

lines.label: Route109_Text_EdmondDefeated
lines.text: Urp… Ooooooohhhhhh…\nUrrrrpppp…$

lines.label: Route109_Text_EdmondPostBattle
lines.text: I'm usually stronger than this!\nI'm just seasick as a dog!\pI'm a SAILOR, but…$

lines.label: Route109_Text_RickyIntro
lines.text: I'm thirsty… I could go for a SODA POP\nat the SEASHORE HOUSE…$

lines.label: Route109_Text_RickyDefeated
lines.text: Groan…$

lines.label: Route109_Text_RickyPostBattle
lines.text: I'm getting famished… My inner tube\nlooks like a giant doughnut…$

lines.label: Route109_Text_RickyRegister
lines.text: Will you have another match with me\nwhen I'm not all thirsty?$

lines.label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm hungry, but I've got enough pep in\nme for a battle!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchDefeated
lines.text: I lost…\nIt's because I'm hungry…$

lines.label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchPostBattle
lines.text: When you eat on a beach, everything\nseems to taste a little better.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_LolaIntro
lines.text: Doesn't a beach umbrella look like\na giant flower?$

lines.label: Route109_Text_LolaDefeated
lines.text: Mommy!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_LolaPostBattle
lines.text: If you look at the beach from the sky,\nit looks like a big flower garden!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_LolaRegister
lines.text: Me?\nI'm here every day!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm not losing to you again!\nThat's why I have my inner tube!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchDefeated
lines.text: Mommy!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchPostBattle
lines.text: If I have an inner tube, me and my\nPOKéMON's cuteness goes way up!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_AustinaIntro
lines.text: I can't swim without my inner tube,\nbut I won't lose at POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_AustinaDefeated
lines.text: Did I lose because I have an inner\ntube?$

lines.label: Route109_Text_AustinaPostBattle
lines.text: My inner tube is a fashion item.\nI can't be seen without it.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_GwenIntro
lines.text: Hi, big TRAINER.\nWill you battle with me?$

lines.label: Route109_Text_GwenDefeated
lines.text: Oh, you're strong.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_GwenPostBattle
lines.text: How did you get to be so strong?$

lines.label: Route109_Text_CarterIntro
lines.text: Wahahah! This dude's going to catch\nhimself a big one!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_CarterDefeated
lines.text: This dude just lost one…$

lines.label: Route109_Text_CarterPostBattle
lines.text: This dude thinks you're a big one.\nNo, you're a big-one-to-be!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_PaulIntro
lines.text: PAUL: Well, this is a mood-breaker.\pI wish you wouldn't disturb our\nprecious time together.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_PaulDefeated
lines.text: PAUL: Well, I give up.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_PaulPostBattle
lines.text: PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that\nwe're here.\lThis is just our private world of two!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_PaulNotEnoughPokemon
lines.text: PAUL: We're totally, deeply in love.\nThat's why we make our POKéMON battle\ltogether.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_MelIntro
lines.text: MEL: We're, like, totally in love.\nOur romance is heating up all of HOENN!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_MelDefeated
lines.text: MEL: We lost, and it's my fault!\nPAUL will hate me!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_MelPostBattle
lines.text: MEL: Um, PAUL, are you angry with me?\nPlease don't be angry.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_MelNotEnoughPokemon
lines.text: MEL: We're, like, deeply and truly in love.\nThat's why we make our POKéMON\lbattle together.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_ChandlerIntro
lines.text: Tadaah! See?\nMy inner tube's round!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_ChandlerDefeated
lines.text: Oh, oh!\nToo bad!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_ChandlerPostBattle
lines.text: After I showed you my round inner\ntube, too…$

lines.label: Route109_Text_HaileyIntro
lines.text: I can't swim, so I'm pretending\nto swim.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_HaileyDefeated
lines.text: I thought so!\nI didn't think we could win.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_HaileyPostBattle
lines.text: When I learn how to swim, I think\nmy POKéMON will become tougher.$

lines.label: Route109_Text_ElijahIntro
lines.text: For a guy as macho as me, this kind\nof POKéMON is the perfect match!$

lines.label: Route109_Text_ElijahDefeated
lines.text: I'm cool even in defeat, hey?$

lines.label: Route109_Text_ElijahPostBattle
lines.text: For a guy as macho as me, a port\nis the perfect setting!\pI guess I'll head for SLATEPORT.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_JacobIntro
lines.text: Whoa! Watch it!\nI guess you're not used to BIKE racing.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_JacobDefeated
lines.text: Whoa!\nMy brakes failed!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_JacobPostBattle
lines.text: Flat tires and brake problems can\ncause serious injury!\lInspect your BIKE for problems!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AnthonyIntro
lines.text: Yo, you!\nCan you keep up with my speed?$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AnthonyDefeated
lines.text: Crash and burn!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AnthonyPostBattle
lines.text: Speed alone won't let me win at POKéMON.\nI need to reconsider this…$

lines.label: Route110_Text_BenjaminIntro
lines.text: Don't panic if your BIKE's going fast!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_BenjaminDefeated
lines.text: I shouldn't panic during POKéMON\nbattles…$

lines.label: Route110_Text_BenjaminPostBattle
lines.text: There's no need to panic or stress.\nTake it easy. There's plenty of time.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRegister
lines.text: I'll keep chugging on without stressing.\nGive me a shout if you're up to it.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchIntro
lines.text: Aren't you going a little too fast?\nTake it easy and let's battle.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchDefeated
lines.text: I didn't panic, but I still lost…$

lines.label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchPostBattle
lines.text: There's no need to panic or stress.\nTake it easy. There's plenty of time.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AbigailIntro
lines.text: The triathlon is hard in the extreme.\pYou have to complete the three events\nof swimming, cycling, and running.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AbigailDefeated
lines.text: POKéMON battles are hard, too!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AbigailPostBattle
lines.text: I'm exhausted, so I need a break.\nIt's important to get proper rest.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AbigailRegister
lines.text: You know, I like you!\nLet's have a rematch on CYCLING ROAD.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchIntro
lines.text: Isn't it neat to hold a battle while\ncycling?$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchDefeated
lines.text: Wow…\nHow could you be so strong?$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchPostBattle
lines.text: Were you going after a record?\pI'm sorry if I held you up!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_JasmineIntro
lines.text: I've been riding without stopping.\nMy thighs are like rocks!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_JasmineDefeated
lines.text: I'm worried about muscle cramps…$

lines.label: Route110_Text_JasminePostBattle
lines.text: Oh, you have some GYM BADGES?\nNo wonder you're so strong!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_EdwardIntro
lines.text: I have foreseen your intentions!\nI cannot possibly lose!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_EdwardDefeated
lines.text: I failed to prophesize my own demise!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_EdwardPostBattle
lines.text: I see your future…\pHmm…\nI see a shining light…$

lines.label: Route110_Text_JaclynIntro
lines.text: Ahahahaha!\nI'll dazzle you with my wonders!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_JaclynDefeated
lines.text: I wondrously lost!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_JaclynPostBattle
lines.text: You managed to win only because it was\na wonder! Yes, a wonder!\lDon't think you can win all the time!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_EdwinIntro
lines.text: Could I see your POKéMON?\nJust one look, please?$

lines.label: Route110_Text_EdwinDefeated
lines.text: I wanted to complete\nmy collection…$

lines.label: Route110_Text_EdwinPostBattle
lines.text: When I see a POKéMON that I don't know,\nmy passion as a collector is ignited!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_EdwinRegister
lines.text: I like collecting MATCH CALL\nregistrations, too…$

lines.label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
lines.text: Hi, have you caught any new POKéMON?\pCould I see your POKéMON?\nJust one look, please?$

lines.label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchDefeated
lines.text: Your POKéMON…\nI envy you.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchPostBattle
lines.text: Oh, I long to make all rare POKéMON\nmine!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_DaleIntro
lines.text: Hey!\nDon't sneak up behind me like that!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_DaleDefeated
lines.text: I lost!\nDrat!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_DalePostBattle
lines.text: Fishing is all about concentration.\nYou have to focus on the floater.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_IsabelIntro
lines.text: Ahahaha! I would go anywhere to show\noff my delightful POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_IsabelDefeated
lines.text: Oh, dear, this won't do.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_IsabelPostBattle
lines.text: Rather than battling, perhaps I should\nshow off my POKéMON at the FAN CLUB.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_IsabelRegister
lines.text: That wasn't close to what I could\ndo to show off my POKéMON.\pI'll have you as my captive audience\nas often as possible!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchIntro
lines.text: Ahahahaha! I would be happy to show\noff my POKéMON as often as you like!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchDefeated
lines.text: Oh, dear, this won't do.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchPostBattle
lines.text: I don't think that I could ever stop\nfrom showing off my POKéMON.\pBut I like to battle, too!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_TimmyIntro
lines.text: I found some cool POKéMON in the grass\naround here!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_TimmyDefeated
lines.text: Being cool isn't enough to win…$

lines.label: Route110_Text_TimmyPostBattle
lines.text: It's hard to battle with POKéMON you\njust caught.$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AlyssaIntro
lines.text: I fell off CYCLING ROAD…\pI'll get over my embarrassment by\nbattling with you!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AlyssaDefeated
lines.text: Oops!\nI ended up losing!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_AlyssaPostBattle
lines.text: Falling… Losing…\nThis is so humiliating for me!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_JosephIntro
lines.text: Okay! Full-throttle time! If you can't\ngroove, you get left behind!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_JosephDefeated
lines.text: You got into the groove all right…$

lines.label: Route110_Text_JosephPostBattle
lines.text: This isn't going to bring me down!\nLosing has made me a better man!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_KalebIntro
lines.text: When cute POKéMON help each other…\nYou won't see a more adorable sight!$

lines.label: Route110_Text_KalebDefeated
lines.text: Have you no compassion or pity?$

lines.label: Route110_Text_KalebPostBattle
lines.text: Okay, okay, you've done the best you\ncould, my pretties.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_DrewIntro
lines.text: Oh, hey! Those GO-GOGGLES suit you.\nBut I think they look better on me.\pLet's decide who they look better on\nwith a battle!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_DrewDefeat
lines.text: I couldn't see what was happening at\nmy sides because of the GO-GOGGLES.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_DrewPostBattle
lines.text: The GO-GOGGLES make it possible to\nget through sandstorms.\lThat makes me happy!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_HeidiIntro
lines.text: I'm having a picnic in the desert.\pYou can always find a TRAINER,\nso I can enjoy a battle here, too!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_HeidiDefeat
lines.text: Ohhh! You're mean!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_HeidiPostBattle
lines.text: When you're battling in a sandstorm,\nwatch out for your POKéMON's HP.\pIt can faint if you don't keep\nan eye on it!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BeauIntro
lines.text: Wearing these GO-GOGGLES makes me\nfeel like a superhero.\lRight now, nobody can beat me!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BeauDefeat
lines.text: I can't win on spirit alone…$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BeauPostBattle
lines.text: I'm going to be a real hero one day.\nI'm going to work harder to make me\land my POKéMON stronger.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BeckyIntro
lines.text: I heard there are fossils to be found\nin the desert. Where could they be?$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BeckyDefeat
lines.text: I came up short…$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BeckyPostBattle
lines.text: If they can find fossils in the desert,\nit must have been a sea before.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_DustyIntro
lines.text: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\lI am to be challenged?$

lines.label: Route111_Text_DustyDefeat
lines.text: While I have searched for ruins,\nI've not searched for strong POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_DustyPostBattle
lines.text: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years?\nWhich was it now?$

lines.label: Route111_Text_DustyRegister
lines.text: I haven't been searching for any\ntough POKéMON.\pBut, for some reason, I sure do like\nPOKéNAVS.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_DustyRematchIntro
lines.text: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years?\nAnyway, am I to be challenged?$

lines.label: Route111_Text_DustyRematchDefeat
lines.text: I've found no ruins, nor have I found\nany strong POKéMON…$

lines.label: Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch
lines.text:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years
I've searched?\pHmm… It could even be fifty…
How long have I been at this?$

lines.label: Route111_Text_TravisIntro
lines.text: I'm full of pep!\nAnd my POKéMON is peppy, too!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_TravisDefeat
lines.text: My POKéMON lost its pep…$

lines.label: Route111_Text_TravisPostBattle
lines.text: When I see a TRAINER with a lot of pep,\nI can't help looking.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_IreneIntro
lines.text: I don't know where you're going,\nbut would you like to battle?$

lines.label: Route111_Text_IreneDefeat
lines.text: Oh, you're disgustingly good!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_IrenePostBattle
lines.text: I'm thinking that I should go to\nMT. CHIMNEY, but the view around\lhere is very nice, too.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_DaisukeIntro
lines.text: To train myself, I challenge all\nwhom I meet!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_DaisukeDefeat
lines.text: Uncle! I give up!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_DaisukePostBattle
lines.text: All I can do is keep training until\nI can defeat strong TRAINERS such\las yourself.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_WiltonIntro
lines.text: Show me how much you've toughened\nyour POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_WiltonDefeat
lines.text: I see, you've toughened them\nconsiderably.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_WiltonPostBattle
lines.text: POKéMON and TRAINERS learn much\nthrough battling.\pWhat's important is to never give up\neven if you lose.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_WiltonRegister
lines.text: There is much to be learned from\nyour training style.\pI request a rematch if it\nbehooves you.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_WiltonRematchIntro
lines.text: We're training here to elevate our\ngame to the next level.\lStay and train with us!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_WiltonRematchDefeat
lines.text: Ooh, you're decent!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_WiltonPostRematch
lines.text: Since you're that strong, you should\naim for the POKéMON LEAGUE.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BrookeIntro
lines.text: Oh, your POKéMON look like serious\nactors.\lI have to ask you for an engagement.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BrookeDefeat
lines.text: They didn't just look strong,\nthey are strong!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BrookePostBattle
lines.text: I thought I was raising my POKéMON\ndiligently, but, oh no, there is still\lmuch to be done.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BrookeRegister
lines.text: I wish I could become friends with\nmore strong people like you!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BrookeRematchIntro
lines.text: You can make POKéMON stronger or\nweaker depending on the moves you\lteach them.\pWhat kinds of moves do your POKéMON\nknow?$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BrookeRematchDefeat
lines.text: You've taught them good moves!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BrookePostRematch
lines.text: Maybe I should have stopped my\nPOKéMON from evolving until they\llearned better moves…$

lines.label: Route111_Text_CeliaIntro
lines.text: I shouldn't have come to a place like\nthis for a picnic!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_CeliaDefeat
lines.text: Aww!\nI really shouldn't have come!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_CeliaPostBattle
lines.text: In a sandstorm like this, I can't set\nthe places for a picnic even with my\lGO-GOGGLES on…$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BryanIntro
lines.text: How tough are you?\nWe shall expose that secret!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BryanDefeat
lines.text: Oh! Your strength!\nIt is shrouded in mystery!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BryanPostBattle
lines.text: This desert hoards mysteries in\nits shifting sands!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BrandenIntro
lines.text: I'll give you some of my sandwich\nif you'll lose.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BrandenDefeat
lines.text: Tch! I thought a sandwich would be\nenough of a bribe…$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BrandenPostBattle
lines.text: My SANDSHREW loves eating\nmy sandwiches.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_TyronIntro
lines.text: This is my favorite kind of POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_TyronDefeat
lines.text: Wait!\nDid you get a good look at my POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route111_Text_TyronPostBattle
lines.text: When having a battle, I get a kick out\nof showing off my POKéMON.\pI bet everyone feels that way when\nthey enter a battle!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_CelinaIntro
lines.text: Show me how to put a little excitement\ninto my life.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_CelinaDefeat
lines.text: Oh… My…\nThat was too much excitement.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_CelinaPostBattle
lines.text: My pulse is still racing.\nYou're one fabulous TRAINER.$

lines.label: Route111_Text_HaydenIntro
lines.text: When you're as famished as I am,\nthere is no room for pity!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_HaydenDefeat
lines.text: Groan…$

lines.label: Route111_Text_HaydenPostBattle
lines.text: My stomach is grumbling!\nMaybe I can grill some BERRIES…$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BiancaIntro
lines.text: Did you come from MAUVILLE?\nThen you should be full of energy!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BiancaDefeat
lines.text: Ooh lala!\nThat's a lot to take!$

lines.label: Route111_Text_BiancaPostBattle
lines.text: This road here…\nYou have quite a ways to travel.$

lines.label: Route112_Text_BriceIntro
lines.text: Hahahaha!\nHow about we have a battle?\lYou and me!\lHahahaha!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_BriceDefeat
lines.text: I lost!\nHahahaha!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_BricePostBattle
lines.text: Hahahahaha! Something flew up my nose!\nHahahaha-hatchoo!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_TrentIntro
lines.text: My legs are solid from pounding up\nand down the mountains.\pThey're not going to buckle easily,\nfriend!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_TrentDefeat
lines.text: Ouch! My legs cramped up!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_TrentPostBattle
lines.text: Try hiking, and I mean really\npounding, on these mountain trails\lwith a heavy pack weighing dozens of\lpounds.\pThat, my friend, will get your body\ninto serious shape.$

lines.label: Route112_Text_TrentRegister
lines.text: Ow, my legs have cramped up.\nCan you grab me some bandages from\lmy backpack?\pNo, that's my POKéNAV!\nOh, fine, I'll register you.$

lines.label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchIntro
lines.text: I've been keeping fit by hiking.\nPower, I have in spades!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchDefeat
lines.text: I got trumped in power?$

lines.label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchPostBattle
lines.text: I hear there are some seriously tough\nTRAINERS on top of MT. CHIMNEY.\pI intend to get up there and give them\na challenge!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_LarryIntro
lines.text: I'm strong.\nI won't cry if I lose.$

lines.label: Route112_Text_LarryDefeat
lines.text: Waaaah!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_LarryPostBattle
lines.text: I'm not crying because I miss my mommy!\nSnivel…$

lines.label: Route112_Text_CarolIntro
lines.text: When you're out on a picnic, why,\nyou simply have to sing!\lCome on, sing with me!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_CarolDefeat
lines.text: Oh, you're so strong!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_CarolPostBattle
lines.text: It doesn't matter if you're good or bad\nat singing or POKéMON.\pIf you have the most fun, you win!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_BryantIntro
lines.text: I caught hot POKéMON in FIERY PATH!\nTake a look!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_BryantDefeat
lines.text: What a bumpy ride that was!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_BryantPostBattle
lines.text: I like the way you battle.\nIt has a certain flair to it.$

lines.label: Route112_Text_ShaylaIntro
lines.text: Oh, aren't you an adorable TRAINER!\nPlease, I need a romantic battle!\lI'm somewhat decent!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_ShaylaDefeat
lines.text: Oh, how strong you are!\nYou've given me quite a shock!$

lines.label: Route112_Text_ShaylaPostBattle
lines.text: Are you busy right now?\nI was thinking that maybe we can have\la rematch right now…\lBut it's all right if you're busy.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_JaylenIntro
lines.text: Can you guess why it's so cool\naround here?$

lines.label: Route113_Text_JaylenDefeat
lines.text: Peeuuw!\nThat stinks!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_JaylenPostBattle
lines.text: The volcanic ash blocks the sun,\nso it doesn't get very warm.\pThat's good for me--I can't stand heat!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_DillonIntro
lines.text: The volcano's eruption is proof that\nthe earth is alive.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_DillonDefeat
lines.text: You're some kind of strong!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_DillonPostBattle
lines.text: Ouch! Owww! I can't see!\nI got ashes in my eyelashes!\pGet it? Ashes and eyelashes?\pOkay, that was bad, sorry…$

lines.label: Route113_Text_MadelineIntro
lines.text: I use this parasol to ward off this\nfilthy, yucky volcanic ash from\lmy dear NUMEL.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_MadelineDefeat
lines.text: Huff, huff…\nI am exhausted…$

lines.label: Route113_Text_MadelinePostBattle
lines.text: You're very good at this.\nI must say I'm impressed!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_MadelineRegister
lines.text: Here, slide under my parasol.\nLet me register you in my POKéNAV.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_MadelineRematchIntro
lines.text: Oh, hello, hasn't it been a while?\nMay I invite you to battle?$

lines.label: Route113_Text_MadelineRematchDefeat
lines.text: Oh, how super!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_MadelinePostRematch
lines.text: You've remained very good at this.\nI must say I'm impressed!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_LaoIntro
lines.text: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!\nI challenge thee!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_LaoDefeat
lines.text: With honor I admit defeat!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_LaoPostBattle
lines.text: I must refine the art of concealment.\nI bid thee farewell.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_LaoRegister
lines.text: Yiiyaah! Witness the ancient ninja\ntechnique of POKéNAV registration!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_LaoRematchIntro
lines.text: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!\nI challenge thee!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_LaoRematchDefeat
lines.text: With honor I admit defeat!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_LaoPostRematch
lines.text: My flawless concealment was let down\nby my immature battle skills…\pI bid thee farewell.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_LungIntro
lines.text: Thanks for finding me!\nBut we still have to battle!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_LungDefeat
lines.text: I'll use my ninjutsu on you…\n“VOLCANIC ASH SWIRL CLOAK”!\p…What?\nIt's already over?$

lines.label: Route113_Text_LungPostBattle
lines.text: You know what's crummy about hiding?\nIt's lonely if no one comes along.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_ToriIntro
lines.text: TORI: Both of us, we collect ashes.\nWe battle POKéMON, too.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_ToriDefeat
lines.text: TORI: We lost… It's boring, so I'm going\nto get some more ashes.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_ToriPostBattle
lines.text: TORI: How much ash do we have?\nEnough for a WHITE FLUTE, I hope.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_ToriNotEnoughMons
lines.text: TORI: We want to battle 2-on-2.\nIf we didn't, we would lose!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_TiaIntro
lines.text: TIA: Both of us, we collect ashes.\nWe battle POKéMON, too.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_TiaDefeat
lines.text: TIA: We couldn't win… It's boring,\nso I'm getting some more ashes.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_TiaPostBattle
lines.text: TIA: We have a lot of ashes!\nI think enough for a WHITE FLUTE!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_TiaNotEnoughMons
lines.text: TIA: We want to battle 2-on-2.\nIf we don't, we won't win!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_CobyIntro
lines.text: Pfft, with these wings I can\nflick you away!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_CobyDefeat
lines.text: A… What?$

lines.label: Route113_Text_CobyPostBattle
lines.text: I don't know what to say when I get\nbeaten so easily…$

lines.label: Route113_Text_SophieIntro
lines.text: The warmth here is making me drowsy.\nBattle with me so I can stay awake.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_SophieDefeat
lines.text: This is a dream.\nI'm sure of it…$

lines.label: Route113_Text_SophiePostBattle
lines.text: Losing burns me up…\nI'm just going to sleep right here!\lZzz!$

lines.label: Route113_Text_LawrenceIntro
lines.text: Were you maybe in the middle\nof gathering volcanic ashes?$

lines.label: Route113_Text_LawrenceDefeat
lines.text: Ehehe.\nWe got beaten cleanly.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_LawrencePostBattle
lines.text: I ought to hide under the ashes, too.$

lines.label: Route113_Text_WyattIntro
lines.text: Y-you want to battle with me?\nEven though I just caught my POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route113_Text_WyattDefeat
lines.text: Y-you're all happy to win?\nEven though it's only me?$

lines.label: Route113_Text_WyattPostBattle
lines.text: Oh, so now you want to say a word to\nthe loser?\pAren't you just the coolest?\nHumph!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_LennyIntro
lines.text: Yodelayhihoo!\p… …\pYou're supposed to shout\n“yodelayhihoo” since it doesn't\lecho here!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_LennyDefeat
lines.text: Yodelayhihoo!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_LennyPostBattle
lines.text: When I was a wee tyke, I believed there\nwas someone copying me and shouting\lback, “Yodelayhihoo.”$

lines.label: Route114_Text_LucasIntro
lines.text: If you're not prepared, you shouldn't\nbe up in the mountains!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_LucasDefeat
lines.text: The mountains are unforgiving…$

lines.label: Route114_Text_LucasPostBattle
lines.text: In the winter, mountains turn deadly\nwith blizzards and avalanches.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_ShaneIntro
lines.text: Camping's fun! You can fish, roast\nmarshmallows, and tell spooky stories!\pBut the best of all are the POKéMON\nbattles!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_ShaneDefeat
lines.text: Way too strong!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_ShanePostBattle
lines.text: I think it's great that I can go\ncamping with my POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_NancyIntro
lines.text: I need to exercise after a meal.\nLet's have a match!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_NancyDefeat
lines.text: Oh, no!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_NancyPostBattle
lines.text: I just had a tasty meal.\nI'm getting drowsy…$

lines.label: Route114_Text_SteveIntro
lines.text: Ufufufufufu…\nWant to battle against my POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route114_Text_SteveDefeat
lines.text: M-My POKéMON…$

lines.label: Route114_Text_StevePostBattle
lines.text: A big body that's all lumpy and hard,\nenormous horns, and vicious fangs…\pUfufufufu…\nI wish I had a POKéMON like that…$

lines.label: Route114_Text_SteveRegister
lines.text: Don't forget what you've done to me!\nI'll make it so you can't forget!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_SteveRematchIntro
lines.text: Ufufufufufu…\nCome on, battle my POKéMON…$

lines.label: Route114_Text_SteveRematchDefeat
lines.text: I feel so lucky getting to see your\nPOKéMON…$

lines.label: Route114_Text_StevePostRematch
lines.text: Ufufufufufu…\pWhen I see POKéMON battling, I get all\nshivery and shaky…$

lines.label: Route114_Text_BernieIntro
lines.text: If you're lighting a campfire,\nmake sure you have water handy.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_BernieDefeat
lines.text: Thanks for dousing my fire!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_BerniePostBattle
lines.text: You really do have to be careful with\nany sort of fire in a forest.\pDon't ever underestimate the power\nof fire.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_BernieRegister
lines.text: You set my spirit on fire.\nLet's register each other!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_BernieRematchIntro
lines.text: Have you learned to keep water handy\nfor campfires?$

lines.label: Route114_Text_BernieRematchDefeat
lines.text: I got hosed down before I could\nflare up, I guess.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_BerniePostRematch
lines.text: You really do have to be careful with\nany sort of fire in a forest.\pDon't ever underestimate the power\nof fire.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_ClaudeIntro
lines.text: If we were fishing, you wouldn't stand\na chance against me.\lSo, bring on your POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_ClaudeDefeat
lines.text: If we were fishing, I would've won…$

lines.label: Route114_Text_ClaudePostBattle
lines.text: I think I'll try my luck at landing\na big one at METEOR FALLS.\pThere has to be something in there.\nI just know it.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_NolanIntro
lines.text: I like to fish. But I also like to\nbattle!\pIf anyone challenges me, I'm there,\neven if I'm fishing.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_NolanDefeat
lines.text: I like to battle, but that doesn't\nmean I'm good at it…$

lines.label: Route114_Text_NolanPostBattle
lines.text: This time I'll do it!\pI always think that, so I can't walk\naway from fishing or POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_TyraIntro
lines.text: TYRA: Well, sure.\nI'm in the mood for it.\lI'll teach you a little about POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_TyraDefeat
lines.text: TYRA: What an amazing battle style!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_TyraPostBattle
lines.text: TYRA: I was teaching my junior IVY\nabout POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons
lines.text: TYRA: Giggle…\nIf you want to battle with us, just one\lPOKéMON isn't enough!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_IvyIntro
lines.text: IVY: Who taught you about POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route114_Text_IvyDefeat
lines.text: IVY: What an amazing battle style!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_IvyPostBattle
lines.text: IVY: I started training POKéMON\nbecause TYRA, my student mentor,\ltaught me!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_IvyNotEnoughMons
lines.text: IVY: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nI think it must feel lonesome.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_KaiIntro
lines.text: I landed a big one!\nA huge one, I tell you!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_KaiDefeat
lines.text: What was that about?\nDid mine lose in size?$

lines.label: Route114_Text_KaiPostBattle
lines.text: Okay!\nI'll just fish me a bigger one!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_CharlotteIntro
lines.text: Me!\nI'm not just a pretty face!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_CharlotteDefeat
lines.text: That wasn't cute in the least!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_CharlottePostBattle
lines.text: I don't want a POKéMON that's\njust cute.\pI adore cute ones that have a quirk\nor two!$

lines.label: Route114_Text_AngelinaIntro
lines.text: Have you made your POKéMON evolve\nvery much?$

lines.label: Route114_Text_AngelinaDefeat
lines.text: Oh, I see.\nThat's good to know.$

lines.label: Route114_Text_AngelinaPostBattle
lines.text: Some POKéMON change so much when\nthey evolve, it's startling!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_TimothyIntro
lines.text: Hm…\nYou seem rather capable…\lLet me keep you company!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_TimothyDefeat
lines.text: You're much stronger than\nI'd imagined!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_TimothyPostBattle
lines.text: There is no such thing as a born genius.\nIt all depends on effort!\lThat is what I believe…$

lines.label: Route115_Text_TimothyRegister
lines.text: Hmm… A loss this thorough has been\na distant memory.\pIf you would allow it, I wish for\nanother opportunity to do battle.$

lines.label: Route115_Text_TimothyRematchIntro
lines.text: Hm… As always, your agility speaks\nfor itself.\lCome, keep me company!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_TimothyRematchDefeat
lines.text: As strong as ever!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_TimothyPostRematch
lines.text: All it takes is effort!\pI lost because I haven't put in enough\neffort!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_KoichiIntro
lines.text: You!\pMy MACHOP!\pDemand a battle!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_KoichiDefeat
lines.text: Ouch, ouch, ouch!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_KoichiPostBattle
lines.text: My MACHOP crew!\pSo long as they seek power, I will\ngrow strong with them!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_NobIntro
lines.text: My strongest skill is busting bricks\nwith my forehead!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_NobDefeat
lines.text: Ugwaaaah!\nMy head is busted!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_NobPostBattle
lines.text: I've been teaching my POKéMON karate.\pIt looks like they'll get a lot better\nthan me. I'm excited about that.$

lines.label: Route115_Text_NobRegister
lines.text: You impress me! Give me a rematch\nafter I redo my training!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_NobRematchIntro
lines.text: After you beat me, we trained hard to\nimprove our skills.\lCome on, give us a rematch!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_NobRematchDefeat
lines.text: Ugwaaah!\nWe lost again!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_NobPostRematch
lines.text: My POKéMON will grow stronger!\nI'll redouble my training!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_CyndyIntro
lines.text: This beach is my secret training spot!\nDon't come butting in!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_CyndyDefeat
lines.text: I haven't trained enough!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_CyndyPostBattle
lines.text: The sand acts as a cushion to reduce\nimpact and prevent injury.\lThis is the perfect place to train.$

lines.label: Route115_Text_CyndyRegister
lines.text: Okay, fine, you're free to come here.\nIn return, I'd like to battle you again.$

lines.label: Route115_Text_CyndyRematchIntro
lines.text: Okay, let's get this battle on!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_CyndyRematchDefeat
lines.text: I can battle but my POKéMON…$

lines.label: Route115_Text_CyndyPostRematch
lines.text: Even when I lose, I still get some\nenjoyment out of it.\lIt must be that I love POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route115_Text_HectorIntro
lines.text: I have a rare POKéMON!\nWould you like me to show you?$

lines.label: Route115_Text_HectorDefeat
lines.text: You…\nYou want my POKéMON, don't you?$

lines.label: Route115_Text_HectorPostBattle
lines.text: I have this rare POKéMON.\nIt's enough to keep me satisfied.$

lines.label: Route115_Text_KyraIntro
lines.text: I'll battle while I'm running!\nTry to keep up with me!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_KyraDefeat
lines.text: Gasp, gasp…$

lines.label: Route115_Text_KyraPostBattle
lines.text: I made the mistake of trying to battle\nwhile running!\pI should take a run to calm down…$

lines.label: Route115_Text_JaidenIntro
lines.text: Take that!\nUltra POKéMON ninja attack!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_JaidenDefeat
lines.text: Waaah!\nOur strategy failed!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_JaidenPostBattle
lines.text: But my POKéMON were ultra,\nweren't they?$

lines.label: Route115_Text_HeleneIntro
lines.text: My POKéMON have black belt-level\nstrength!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_HeleneDefeat
lines.text: This is too humiliating!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_HelenePostBattle
lines.text: I rarely meet anyone who's better\nthan me…\pI get it now!\nYou're a GYM LEADER, aren't you?$

lines.label: Route115_Text_AlixIntro
lines.text: Our eyes met!\nThere's no getting away now!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_AlixDefeat
lines.text: Gah!\nNot bad!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_AlixPostBattle
lines.text: Oh, well.\nI think I will TELEPORT home.$

lines.label: Route115_Text_MarleneIntro
lines.text: You've disturbed my meditation…\nYou'll be punished for it.$

lines.label: Route115_Text_MarleneDefeat
lines.text: You've broken my concentration!$

lines.label: Route115_Text_MarlenePostBattle
lines.text: I was meditating with my POKéMON.\nBut this place isn't very peaceful…$

lines.label: Route116_Text_ClarkIntro
lines.text: If the tunnel doesn't go through, then\nI'll just go over the top.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_ClarkDefeat
lines.text: Gasp… Gasp…\nLosing made me tired…$

lines.label: Route116_Text_ClarkPostBattle
lines.text: It's no big deal if there's no tunnel.\nTo a HIKER, mountains are roads!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JoeyIntro
lines.text: My POKéMON rule!\nCheck them out!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JoeyDefeat
lines.text: Ouch! A scrape!\nI have to put on a bandage!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JoeyPostBattle
lines.text: Bandages are signs of toughness!\nI've got another one!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JoseIntro
lines.text: My BUG POKéMON are tough!\nLet's battle!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JoseDefeat
lines.text: I lost!\nI thought I had you!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JosePostBattle
lines.text: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.\nSo they get strong quickly, too.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JaniceIntro
lines.text: Let me teach you how strong my\nadorable POKéMON is!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JaniceDefeat
lines.text: You're a notch above me…$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JanicePostBattle
lines.text: POKéMON that possess cuteness and\npower, that's ideal, I think.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JerryIntro
lines.text: We learn all sorts of things at the\nTRAINER'S SCHOOL.\pI want to test things out for real!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JerryDefeat
lines.text: I slacked off in school…\nThat's why I lost.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JerryPostBattle
lines.text: I'll have to redo some courses at\nthe TRAINER'S SCHOOL.\lIf I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JerryRegister1
lines.text: I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL\nthat a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.\pI don't really get what that means,\nso can I just try it?$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JerryRegister2
lines.text: I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL\nthat a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.\pI don't really get what that means,\nso can I just try it?$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JerryRematchIntro
lines.text: I've been studying seriously at the\nTRAINER'S SCHOOL.\lI won't lose like I did last time.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JerryRematchDefeat
lines.text: Hunh?\nI studied diligently.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JerryPostRematch
lines.text: I'll have to redo some courses at\nthe TRAINER'S SCHOOL.\lIf I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_KarenIntro
lines.text: I study at school, and I study on\nthe way home, too!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_KarenDefeat
lines.text: I'm in shock--I lost?$

lines.label: Route116_Text_KarenPostBattle
lines.text: Awww, I'll never become an elegant\nTRAINER like ROXANNE this way!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_KarenRegister1
lines.text: Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV?\nI have one, too! Please register me!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_KarenRegister2
lines.text: Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV?\nI have one, too! Please register me!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_KarenRematchIntro
lines.text: I studied a whole lot since I saw you.\nYou must see my achievements!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_KarenRematchDefeat
lines.text: I'm in shock.\nI lost again?$

lines.label: Route116_Text_KarenPostRematch
lines.text: You've beaten ROXANNE?\nI can't beat you, then. Not yet.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_SarahIntro
lines.text: Just so you know, I've never once been\nbested by anyone at anything.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_SarahDefeat
lines.text: Oh, my goodness.\nThis is a new experience for me.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_SarahPostBattle
lines.text: My life of luxury affords me all that\nI could possibly desire.\pHowever, when it comes to POKéMON,\nmy wealth has no meaning.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_DawsonIntro
lines.text: When you lay your eyes on my POKéMON's\ngorgeous fur, their beauty will render\lyou helpless!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_DawsonDefeat
lines.text: Oh, baby, say it isn't so!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_DawsonPostBattle
lines.text: Oh, no, no, no!\nYou've mussed up my POKéMON's fur!\lYou've ruined my hairdo, too!\lI'll have to call my stylist now!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_DevanIntro
lines.text: We'll rock you hard!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_DevanDefeat
lines.text: Aiyiyi!\nNo contest at all!$

lines.label: Route116_Text_DevanPostBattle
lines.text: I should try different POKéMON\ntypes, that's what I ought to do.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JohnsonIntro
lines.text: It's a dead end up here.\nI'm bored, so can we battle?$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JohnsonDefeat
lines.text: That was fun even though I lost.$

lines.label: Route116_Text_JohnsonPostBattle
lines.text: Want to stay here and keep\nme company?$

lines.label: Route117_Text_IsaacIntro
lines.text: Listen, could I get you to battle\nthe POKéMON I'm raising?$

lines.label: Route117_Text_IsaacDefeat
lines.text: You've raised yours superbly…$

lines.label: Route117_Text_IsaacPostBattle
lines.text: POKéMON isn't all about power.\pPolishing a unique aspect of one's\ncharacter is another way of enjoying\lPOKéMON.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_IsaacRegister
lines.text: I'm going to redouble my training.\nWould you come look in on us?$

lines.label: Route117_Text_IsaacRematchIntro
lines.text: The POKéMON I've been raising are\nlooking good, just like before.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_IsaacRematchDefeat
lines.text: You know how to raise them properly.\nYou might have DAY CARE skills…$

lines.label: Route117_Text_IsaacPostRematch
lines.text: Your POKéMON are growing good!\nYou should enter them in CONTESTS.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_LydiaIntro
lines.text: Please, allow me to evaluate if you\nhave raised your POKéMON properly.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_LydiaDefeat
lines.text: Yes, they are growing properly.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_LydiaPostBattle
lines.text: Try raising POKéMON with more\nattention to their character traits.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_LydiaRegister
lines.text: I'm glad I met a superb TRAINER in you.\nI hope to see you again.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_LydiaRematchIntro
lines.text: Allow me to reevaluate if you have\nraised your POKéMON properly.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_LydiaRematchDefeat
lines.text: They are growing admirably.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_LydiaPostRematch
lines.text: POKéMON seem to like different kinds\nof {POKEBLOCK}S, depending on their nature.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_DylanIntro
lines.text: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but,\nwhatever, let's have a battle!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_DylanDefeat
lines.text: I ran out of energy!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_DylanPostBattle
lines.text: I may have blown it…\pI might have dropped to last during\nthat battle…$

lines.label: Route117_Text_DylanRegister
lines.text: POKéMON have to be strong, too?\nI'd like you to train me!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_DylanRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm smack in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut I'm comfortably ahead.\lLet's make this a quick battle!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_DylanRematchDefeat
lines.text: I ran out of energy again!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_DylanPostRematch
lines.text: I was tops in swimming and cycling,\nbut I'm not quite that confident with\lPOKéMON yet.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MariaIntro
lines.text: I do my triathlon training with POKéMON,\nso I'm pretty confident about my speed.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MariaDefeat
lines.text: I need to get more practices in,\nI guess.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MariaPostBattle
lines.text: Training is meaningful only if you\nkeep it up regularly.\pOkay! I'll resume my training!\nTomorrow!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MariaRegister
lines.text: You appear to be training properly…\nIf you'd like, I'll battle you later!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MariaRematchIntro
lines.text: Are you keeping up with your training?\nI sure am!\lLet me show you the evidence!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MariaRematchDefeat
lines.text: I need to get more practices in,\nI guess.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MariaPostRematch
lines.text: I'll resume training tomorrow.\nLet's battle again sometime!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_DerekIntro
lines.text: Once a BUG CATCHER!\nAnd now a BUG MANIAC!\pBut my love for POKéMON remains\nunchanged!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_DerekDefeat
lines.text: My ineptitude also remains\nunchanged…$

lines.label: Route117_Text_DerekPostBattle
lines.text: All I did was follow my heart, and now\nthey call me a BUG MANIAC…\pStill, I am an expert on BUG POKéMON,\nso it's only natural that they call me\la BUG MANIAC.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_AnnaIntro
lines.text: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student\npartner. I have to do good!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_AnnaDefeat
lines.text: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student\npartner! Let me win!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_AnnaPostBattle
lines.text: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good\ncombinations.\pI'd say you're second only to us!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_AnnaAndMegRegister
lines.text: ANNA: We can't take this lying down!\nYou will come back, won't you?$

lines.label: Route117_Text_AnnaNotEnoughMons
lines.text: ANNA: If you want to battle us,\nbring two POKéMON with you.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MegIntro
lines.text: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my super\nsenior student partner and beat you!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MegDefeat
lines.text: MEG: Oh, no!\nI'm sorry, ANNA! I let you down…$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MegPostBattle
lines.text: MEG: I dragged ANNA down…\nIf I didn't, she would have won!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MegNotEnoughMons
lines.text: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nWe can't battle with you, then.\pWe want to have a 2-on-2 battle.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchIntro
lines.text: ANNA: I can't keep losing in front of\nmy junior partner, right?$

lines.label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchDefeat
lines.text: ANNA: I couldn't get into the groove.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_AnnaPostRematch
lines.text: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good\ncombinations.\pI'd say you're second only to us!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchNotEnoughMons
lines.text: ANNA: If you want to battle us,\nbring two POKéMON with you.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MegRematchIntro
lines.text: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my\nsenior partner and win this time!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MegRematchDefeat
lines.text: MEG: Too strong!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MegPostRematch
lines.text: MEG: I battled together with my\nsenior partner, but we lost…\pThat's so discouraging…$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MegRematchNotEnoughMons
lines.text: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nWe can't battle with you, then.\pWe want to have a 2-on-2 battle.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MelinaIntro
lines.text: Isn't it nice? To battle while looking\nat pretty flowers?$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MelinaDefeat
lines.text: Oh, that's quite impressive!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_MelinaPostBattle
lines.text: It feels wonderful to go for a jog\nwhile looking at flowers.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_BrandiIntro
lines.text: Let me demonstrate the power\nhidden within a PSYCHIC POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_BrandiDefeat
lines.text: Astonishing!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_BrandiPostBattle
lines.text: PSYCHIC POKéMON are complex.\nYou should try catching some.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_AishaIntro
lines.text: Concentrate on getting the win.\nThat's how I battle!$

lines.label: Route117_Text_AishaDefeat
lines.text: I don't waste any time being angry\nover a loss--I would rather train.$

lines.label: Route117_Text_AishaPostBattle
lines.text: I think that if you worry about losing,\nyou're more likely to lose.$

lines.label: Route118_Text_RoseIntro
lines.text: The aroma of flowers has a magical\npower. It cleanses us body and soul.$

lines.label: Route118_Text_RoseDefeat
lines.text: Oh, dear me.\nI seem to have lost.$

lines.label: Route118_Text_RosePostBattle
lines.text: Flowers, POKéMON…\nI love whatever smells nice.\pStinky things…\nI'll pass.$

lines.label: Route118_Text_RoseRegister
lines.text: Sniff… That odor--it's a POKéNAV!\nWe must register each other!$

lines.label: Route118_Text_RoseRematchIntro
lines.text: Were you drawn here by the sweet\naroma?$

lines.label: Route118_Text_RoseRematchDefeat
lines.text: The power of aroma…\nIt didn't seem to do much.$

lines.label: Route118_Text_RosePostRematch
lines.text: If you use a sweet aroma properly,\nPOKéMON will be attracted by it.$

lines.label: Route118_Text_PerryIntro
lines.text: BIRD POKéMON that FLY elegantly in\nthe sky… They're the best!$

lines.label: Route118_Text_PerryDefeat
lines.text: Urgh…\nI crashed…$

lines.label: Route118_Text_PerryPostBattle
lines.text: You've got great POKéMON.\nI'll have to train mine better.$

lines.label: Route118_Text_ChesterIntro
lines.text: Take flight!\nMy BIRD POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route118_Text_ChesterDefeat
lines.text: They did take flight…$

lines.label: Route118_Text_ChesterPostBattle
lines.text: If they'd get stronger, they'd be able\nto fly more freely…$

lines.label: Route118_Text_BarnyIntro
lines.text: I'm a FISHERMAN, but also a TRAINER.\nI'm raising the POKéMON I caught.$

lines.label: Route118_Text_BarnyDefeat
lines.text: I thought I was doing okay in my\ntraining…$

lines.label: Route118_Text_BarnyPostBattle
lines.text: I couldn't win by training POKéMON\nwhile I fished…\pWas I doing things in half measures?$

lines.label: Route118_Text_WadeIntro
lines.text: For FISHERMEN, equipment is the key.\pBut for TRAINERS, the key ingredients\nare POKéMON and heart, of course!$

lines.label: Route118_Text_WadeDefeat
lines.text: I was beaten in heart?$

lines.label: Route118_Text_WadePostBattle
lines.text: Come to think of it, fishing is a battle\nbetween a FISHERMAN and a POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route118_Text_DaltonIntro
lines.text: Let my melody rock your soul!$

lines.label: Route118_Text_DaltonDefeat
lines.text: La-lalala…$

lines.label: Route118_Text_DaltonPostBattle
lines.text: An electric guitar doesn't always\nhave to be noisy…\pIt can be strummed to squeeze out\nthis heart-stirring melody…$

lines.label: Route118_Text_DaltonRegister
lines.text: When I compose better melodies,\nyou have to come listen, okay?$

lines.label: Route118_Text_DaltonRematchIntro
lines.text: A melody from my POKéMON and me…\nLet us deliver it to your soul.$

lines.label: Route118_Text_DaltonRematchDefeat
lines.text: La-lalala…$

lines.label: Route118_Text_DaltonPostRematch
lines.text: When I play, my emotions should reach\nyou through my electric guitar…$

lines.label: Route118_Text_DeandreIntro
lines.text: Go, go, go!\nPOKéMON 1, 2, and 3!$

lines.label: Route118_Text_DeandreDefeat
lines.text: Come in, POKéMON! Are you okay?\nPOKéMON 1, 2, and 3?!$

lines.label: Route118_Text_DeandrePostBattle
lines.text: Isn't it cool that I have a POKéMON\nbattle team?\pYou can copy me--I don't mind!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_BrentIntro
lines.text: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!\nWe MIMIC what you do!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_BrentDefeat
lines.text: Whoopsie!\nI lost!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_BrentPostBattle
lines.text: What's so good about mimicry?\pFufufu…\nYou'll never understand…$

lines.label: Route119_Text_DonaldIntro
lines.text: So, we finally meet!\nMy BUG POKéMON will keep you company!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_DonaldDefeat
lines.text: I wish we'd never met…$

lines.label: Route119_Text_DonaldPostBattle
lines.text: I want to MIMIC you some more.\nCan you hurry up and move?$

lines.label: Route119_Text_TaylorIntro
lines.text: If you step forward, we step forward.\pIf you turn right, we turn, too…$

lines.label: Route119_Text_TaylorDefeat
lines.text: But if you win, I lose…$

lines.label: Route119_Text_TaylorPostBattle
lines.text: I can't MIMIC you winning the match.\nThat's just impossible…\lIt's burning me up…$

lines.label: Route119_Text_DougIntro
lines.text: Yep, you've finally caught me!\nOr were you trying to avoid me?$

lines.label: Route119_Text_DougDefeat
lines.text: Whoop, that was a great match!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_DougPostBattle
lines.text: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!\nI hope you enjoyed our performance.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_GregIntro
lines.text: You don't know who I am, do you?\pBut, I also don't know you.\nSo, we'll battle!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_GregDefeat
lines.text: You're pretty strong!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_GregPostBattle
lines.text: Until you go away somewhere, we'll\nkeep on mimicking your every move.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_KentIntro
lines.text: The MIMIC CIRCLE was formed by people\nwho like to MIMIC.\pA battle starts the instant we meet!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_KentDefeat
lines.text: I give up!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_KentPostBattle
lines.text: Won't you join our MIMIC CIRCLE?$

lines.label: Route119_Text_JacksonIntro
lines.text: Who has the knowledge and\nthe technique for survival?\pPOKéMON RANGERS, that's who!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_JacksonDefeat
lines.text: I didn't have enough POKéMON\nknow-how…$

lines.label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostBattle
lines.text: To break away from civilization and\nawaken the wild spirit within!\pThat's our vision.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_JacksonRegister
lines.text: I hope you'll give me a rematch without\nmocking my lack of knowledge.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_JacksonRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm going to regain my wild spirit by\nbeing together with POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_JacksonRematchDefeat
lines.text: You've remained strong!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostRematch
lines.text: Believe in your POKéMON.\nBelieve in yourself.\pThe road will reveal itself to you.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_CatherineIntro
lines.text: Oh? Look at you.\pFor someone on an adventure,\nyou're traveling awfully light.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_CatherineDefeat
lines.text: Accidents happen when you're not\nprepared!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostBattle
lines.text: You're traveling light but you have\neverything you need.\pYou're on top of things mentally and\nphysically, too.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_CatherineRegister
lines.text: Do you have a POKéNAV?\nIt's a must-have tool for any TRAINER.\pOh, you do have one!\nLet's register each other, then!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_CatherineRematchIntro
lines.text: How's your journey with POKéMON\ngoing?$

lines.label: Route119_Text_CatherineRematchDefeat
lines.text: I'm still missing something…$

lines.label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostRematch
lines.text: In the same way that you, as a TRAINER,\nrely on your POKéMON, your POKéMON\lrely on you.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_HughIntro
lines.text: The vast sky holds untold promise!\pNothing can compare to the sheer\nexhilaration of flight!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_HughDefeat
lines.text: Down and out!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_HughPostBattle
lines.text: My BIRD POKéMON made my dreams of\nflying come true!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_PhilIntro
lines.text: I'll show you the true potential of me\nand my BIRD POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_PhilDefeat
lines.text: We lacked potential…$

lines.label: Route119_Text_PhilPostBattle
lines.text: Ever since I was a little kid, I always\nadmired BIRD POKéMON…$

lines.label: Route119_Text_YasuIntro
lines.text: To lurk in shadows, and live in\ndarkness… That is my destiny.\pI emerge to challenge you!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_YasuDefeat
lines.text: I admit defeat!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_YasuPostBattle
lines.text: Those defeated in battle withdraw\nquietly back into the shadows.\lThat, too, is destiny…$

lines.label: Route119_Text_TakashiIntro
lines.text: If you're not on your guard,\nyou're in for some pain!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_TakashiDefeat
lines.text: You're surprisingly good!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_TakashiPostBattle
lines.text: My surprise attack ended in\nfailure…$

lines.label: Route119_Text_HideoIntro
lines.text: To hide a tree, use a forest!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_HideoDefeat
lines.text: I bow to your superiority.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_HideoPostBattle
lines.text: To hide a tree, use a forest!\nTo hide a POKéMON, use a POKéMON!\pThere is no deep, hidden meaning\nto that.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_ChrisIntro
lines.text: You spoke to me…\nSo you want to challenge me!\pSure! I'll try out the POKéMON I caught\nwhile SURFING!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_ChrisDefeat
lines.text: I don't have a clue about what it\ntakes to win.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_ChrisPostBattle
lines.text: Go for a SURF on my POKéMON…\pThen fish off its back…\pIt's an indescribably luxuriant moment!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_FabianIntro
lines.text: Hit me with a power chord!\nVictory is mine!\lIt's our time to shine, whoa, yeah!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_FabianDefeat
lines.text: You showed me who's the boss!\nWe'll have to take the loss, oh, no!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_FabianPostBattle
lines.text: Hit me with another power chord!\nLeave me alone!\lYour win you have to atone!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_DaytonIntro
lines.text: Hohoho!\nI like kid TRAINERS!\lLet's have a good one!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_DaytonDefeat
lines.text: You're pretty amazing!\nHohoho!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_DaytonPostBattle
lines.text: Hohoho!\nI'll try emulating the pep of kid\lTRAINERS like you!$

lines.label: Route119_Text_RachelIntro
lines.text: Wherever and whenever I may be,\nI always have my parasol in hand.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_RachelDefeat
lines.text: Oh, but…\nThat's not fair.$

lines.label: Route119_Text_RachelPostBattle
lines.text: You're asking if my parasol is heavy?\nYour BAG is filled with more junk than\lI ever carry around.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_ColinIntro
lines.text: Do you have any moves that can strike\na flying POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route120_Text_ColinDefeat
lines.text: You soared above me!$

lines.label: Route120_Text_ColinPostBattle
lines.text: The move FLY is convenient,\ndon't you think?\pWhile the POKéMON is flying,\nalmost no moves can strike it.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_RobertIntro
lines.text: My POKéMON is strong!\nHow about yours?$

lines.label: Route120_Text_RobertDefeat
lines.text: Your POKéMON were stronger…$

lines.label: Route120_Text_RobertPostBattle
lines.text: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one\nyou can count on.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_RobertRegister
lines.text: You can be counted on to get better.\nI'd like to register you in my POKéNAV!$

lines.label: Route120_Text_RobertRematchIntro
lines.text: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one\nyou can count on.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_RobertRematchDefeat
lines.text: Your POKéMON are seriously strong.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_RobertPostRematch
lines.text: My POKéMON are growing stronger.\nI have to grow stronger, too.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_LorenzoIntro
lines.text: I'll check your POKéMON and see if\nthey're fit for the outdoors.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_LorenzoDefeat
lines.text: With POKéMON that strong, you're in\nno danger of needing rescue!$

lines.label: Route120_Text_LorenzoPostBattle
lines.text: To travel wherever your heart desires\nwith POKéMON…\lThat's the joy of being a TRAINER.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_JennaIntro
lines.text: How's your physical fitness?\nIf you're not fit, you could have a\lrough time in critical situations.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_JennaDefeat
lines.text: I'm totally fit, but…$

lines.label: Route120_Text_JennaPostBattle
lines.text: Fitness training is in my routine.\nI always run with my POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_JeffreyIntro
lines.text: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lWant to battle?$

lines.label: Route120_Text_JeffreyDefeat
lines.text: Lost it…$

lines.label: Route120_Text_JeffreyPostBattle
lines.text: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lI'll try harder…$

lines.label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRegister
lines.text: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lDo you have a POKéNAV…?$

lines.label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRematchIntro
lines.text: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lWant to battle again?$

lines.label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRematchDefeat
lines.text: … … … … … …\nI lost again…$

lines.label: Route120_Text_JeffreyPostRematch
lines.text: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lI'll try harder…\lFor my precious BUG POKéMON…$

lines.label: Route120_Text_JenniferIntro
lines.text: POKéMON have many special abilities.\nIf you want to become a first-class\lTRAINER, learn about them.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_JenniferDefeat
lines.text: You're obviously thinking.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_JenniferPostBattle
lines.text: The special abilities of POKéMON\nwill make battle styles change.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_ChipIntro
lines.text: Who might you be?\pAre you perhaps searching for ancient\nruins that are rumored to possibly\lexist according to legend?$

lines.label: Route120_Text_ChipDefeat
lines.text: What a disgraceful setback…$

lines.label: Route120_Text_ChipPostBattle
lines.text: That giant rock… I would like to\nbelieve it may indeed contain ancient\lruins. But I see no entrance.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_ClarissaIntro
lines.text: Why am I carrying this parasol?\pI'll tell you if you can win against me.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_ClarissaDefeat
lines.text: A parasol can't ward off POKéMON\nattacks…$

lines.label: Route120_Text_ClarissaPostBattle
lines.text: I don't think strong sunlight is good\nfor my POKéMON.\lSo I shield them with my parasol.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_AngelicaIntro
lines.text: Me, POKéMON, and my parasol…\pIf any one of them is missing,\nthe picture of beauty will be ruined.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_AngelicaDefeat
lines.text: You've completely ruined my beauty…$

lines.label: Route120_Text_AngelicaPostBattle
lines.text: A parasol wouldn't suit you at all.\pWhy, something like this would only\nget in your way.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_KeigoIntro
lines.text: I will adopt the movements of POKéMON\nand create new ninja techniques.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_KeigoDefeat
lines.text: The creation of new ninja techniques\nis but a distant dream…$

lines.label: Route120_Text_KeigoPostBattle
lines.text: Perhaps I ought to apprentice under\na ninja sensei.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_RileyIntro
lines.text: We ninja conceal ourselves under our\ncamouflage cloaks.\lI bet you didn't know where I was!$

lines.label: Route120_Text_RileyDefeat
lines.text: I lost!\nI should camouflage my shame!$

lines.label: Route120_Text_RileyPostBattle
lines.text: Our camouflage cloaks are all\nhandmade.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_CallieIntro
lines.text: If you don't pay attention,\nyou could get hurt!$

lines.label: Route120_Text_CallieDefeat
lines.text: Ouch!\nI was the one to get hurt.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_CalliePostBattle
lines.text: I wonder… Should I evolve my POKéMON?\nThey're cute the way they are, though.$

lines.label: Route120_Text_LeonelIntro
lines.text: Your party POKéMON…\nDo you have different types?$

lines.label: Route120_Text_LeonelDefeat
lines.text: I've seen your policy in action!$

lines.label: Route120_Text_LeonelPostBattle
lines.text: I think it's awesome you're so strong\nbattling with your favorite POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_VanessaIntro
lines.text: Will you play with my delightfully\npretty POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route121_Text_VanessaDefeat
lines.text: This isn't what I meant!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_VanessaPostBattle
lines.text: I'm going to a CONTEST in LILYCOVE.\pMy POKéMON should have no problem\nsweeping the MASTER CLASS.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_WalterIntro
lines.text: With my POKéMON, I have traveled\nto the world's four corners.\pYou might say I have some confidence\nin my abilities.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_WalterDefeat
lines.text: Ah, well played.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_WalterPostBattle
lines.text: I would like to circle the globe once\nagain with my POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_WalterRegister
lines.text: Your POKéMON prowess is remarkable.\nAllow me to register you as a memento.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_WalterRematchIntro
lines.text: With my POKéMON, I have traveled\nto the world's four corners.\pYou might say I have some confidence\nin my abilities.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_WalterRematchDefeat
lines.text: Ah, well played.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_WalterPostRematch
lines.text: Your POKéMON and you…\pYour prowess together will be\nconsidered strong, even overseas.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_TammyIntro
lines.text: There are powers beyond our\nunderstanding in the world…$

lines.label: Route121_Text_TammyDefeat
lines.text: I have lost…$

lines.label: Route121_Text_TammyPostBattle
lines.text: MT. PYRE…\nThere is a mysterious power\lat work there…$

lines.label: Route121_Text_KateIntro
lines.text: KATE: Together, we're fearless!\nWe'll demonstrate how tough we are!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_KateDefeat
lines.text: KATE: I blew it in front of my junior\nstudent partner…$

lines.label: Route121_Text_KatePostBattle
lines.text: KATE: When someone's relying on me,\nI get this urge to look cool in front\lof them…$

lines.label: Route121_Text_KateNotEnoughMons
lines.text: KATE: If you've only got one POKéMON,\nwe can't battle with you.\pThat would be bullying.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_JoyIntro
lines.text: JOY: Together, we're fearless!\nWe'll demonstrate how tough we are!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_JoyDefeat
lines.text: JOY: Please forgive me, KATE!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_JoyPostBattle
lines.text: JOY: Ehehe, I'll have to train with KATE,\nmy senior student partner, again.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_JoyNotEnoughMons
lines.text: JOY: You need at least two POKéMON\nif you're going to challenge us!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_JessicaIntro
lines.text: Stop! Have a good look at my precious\nPOKéMON!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_JessicaDefeat
lines.text: Oh, how dare you!\nDon't take it so seriously!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_JessicaPostBattle
lines.text: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at\nthe SAFARI.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_JessicaRegister
lines.text: I took it easy on you this time!\nIt won't be that way the next time!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_JessicaRematchIntro
lines.text: My precious POKéMON grew!\nHave a good look!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_JessicaRematchDefeat
lines.text: Oh, how dare you!\nYou still won't take it easy!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_JessicaPostRematch
lines.text: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at\nthe SAFARI.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_CristinIntro
lines.text: I have this routine.\nDefeat five TRAINERS a day.\lGuess what? You're number five!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_CristinDefeat
lines.text: No!\nYou're horrid!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_CristinPostBattle
lines.text: I didn't expect to lose this easily…\nI'll win next time!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_CristinRegister
lines.text: That was total humiliation!\nI won't forget you…\lHand over your POKéNAV!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_CristinRematchIntro
lines.text: I have this new routine.\nDefeat ten TRAINERS a day.\lGuess what? You're number ten!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_CristinRematchDefeat
lines.text: Wait! That's nasty!\nI demand a rematch!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_CristinPostRematch
lines.text: An opponent I just can't beat…\nSnivel…\lI can't believe this is happening…$

lines.label: Route121_Text_CaleIntro
lines.text: Can't you see that I have all this\nstuff with me?\pDespite that, you still insist that\nwe battle?$

lines.label: Route121_Text_CaleDefeat
lines.text: Of course I lost!\nI'm holding stuff in both hands!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_CalePostBattle
lines.text: I bought too much stuff at\nthe LILYCOVE DEPT. STORE.\pIt's up the road from here.\nI wish I had a BAG like yours.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_MylesIntro
lines.text: There's nothing I love more than\nchecking out other people's POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_MylesDefeat
lines.text: Super awesome!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_MylesPostBattle
lines.text: They're great, your POKéMON!\nHow do you raise them?$

lines.label: Route121_Text_PatIntro
lines.text: I want everybody to see the POKéMON\nI've raised!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_PatDefeat
lines.text: Wow!\nSpectacular!$

lines.label: Route121_Text_PatPostBattle
