lines.text: I raise every POKéMON with the same\nlove and care--I don't pick favorites.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_MarcelIntro
lines.text: My POKéMON have never tasted defeat!\nOn their next win, I'm entering them\lin CONTESTS.$

lines.label: Route121_Text_MarcelDefeat
lines.text: Oh, now what happened here?$

lines.label: Route121_Text_MarcelPostBattle
lines.text: I may have to train my gang some more\nbefore entering any CONTEST.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_WendyIntro
lines.text: Want to determine how strong you are?\nI'll be the test!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_WendyDefeat
lines.text: You passed with flying colors!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_WendyPostBattle
lines.text: To best even me…\nYour strength is marvelous!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_BraxtonIntro
lines.text: You seem to have a big collection\nof GYM BADGES.\pLet me see if you're actually worthy of\nthose BADGES!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_BraxtonDefeat
lines.text: Oh, you're worthy, all right!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_BraxtonPostBattle
lines.text: You did your BADGES proud in that\nmatch!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_VioletIntro
lines.text: They say that good times are filled\nwith good aromas.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_VioletDefeat
lines.text: Oh…\nI smell the bitter scent of misery…$

lines.label: Route123_Text_VioletPostBattle
lines.text: The BERRY MASTER's garden is filled\nwith uplifting fragrances.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_CameronIntro
lines.text: Being a psychic is about willpower.\pI've willed myself not to lose to\nanyone. That makes me strong!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_CameronDefeat
lines.text: I feel sad…$

lines.label: Route123_Text_CameronPostBattle
lines.text: Being a psychic is about willpower.\nI thought I wouldn't lose to you…$

lines.label: Route123_Text_CameronRegister
lines.text: I sense it!\nYou and I shall battle again!\lI can't tell if I'll win, though…\pLet's see your POKéNAV.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_CameronRematchIntro
lines.text: I've convinced myself that I won't\nlose anymore. That makes me strong!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_CameronRematchDefeat
lines.text: I feel sad…$

lines.label: Route123_Text_CameronPostRematch
lines.text: I should train at MT. PYRE…\nI'll never beat you this way…$

lines.label: Route123_Text_JackiIntro
lines.text: Don't be too happy if your POKéMON\ndevelop psychic powers.\pYou need to refine those powers to\nmake them really useful.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_JackiDefeat
lines.text: Overwhelmed!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_JackiPostBattle
lines.text: We all have psychic powers.\nWe've just forgotten how to use them.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_JackiRegister
lines.text: I would like to face you again.\nIs that okay with you?$

lines.label: Route123_Text_JackiRematchIntro
lines.text: Have you awoken the psychic powers\nwithin you?$

lines.label: Route123_Text_JackiRematchDefeat
lines.text: Astounding!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_JackiPostRematch
lines.text: Your power with POKéMON…\nThat could be a psychic power, too.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_MiuIntro
lines.text: MIU: Hello, TRAINER. I hope your\nPOKéMON won't cry when they lose.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_MiuDefeat
lines.text: MIU: Uh-oh, we lost.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_MiuPostBattle
lines.text: MIU: TRAINER, your POKéMON are\nstrong because you are friends.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_MiuNotEnoughMons
lines.text: MIU: It's no fun to battle if you\ndon't have two POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_YukiIntro
lines.text: YUKI: Okay!\nWe're beating the TRAINER's POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_YukiDefeat
lines.text: YUKI: Uh-oh, we lost.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_YukiPostBattle
lines.text: YUKI: Why are you so strong?\nWe've never lost before.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_YukiNotEnoughMons
lines.text: YUKI: It's no fun to battle if you\ndon't have two POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_KindraIntro
lines.text: MT. PYRE…\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep…\lWill your POKéMON sleep?$

lines.label: Route123_Text_KindraDefeat
lines.text: Overflowing with vitality…$

lines.label: Route123_Text_KindraPostBattle
lines.text: MT. PYRE…\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep…\pIt must overflow with a power that\nsoothes spirits…$

lines.label: Route123_Text_FernandoIntro
lines.text: I'll turn your lights out while\nI rip through this tune!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_FernandoDefeat
lines.text: Hey, hold it!\nI was still playing the intro!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_FernandoPostBattle
lines.text: You're rock steady.\nI'd like to write a tune about you.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_FernandoRegister
lines.text: The next time, lend your ears to\nthe full tune, will you?$

lines.label: Route123_Text_FernandoRematchIntro
lines.text: Today's the day I'm going to do it!\nI'll turn out your lights before\lI finish singing my song!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_FernandoRematchDefeat
lines.text: Hey, hold it!\nI haven't even hit the chorus!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_FernandoPostRematch
lines.text: I thought you'd be so enthralled\nby my tune, you'd lose.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_DavisIntro
lines.text: This is my awesome BUG POKéMON!\nMy big brother got it for me.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_DavisDefeat
lines.text: Waaaah!\nYou meanie!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_DavisPostBattle
lines.text: Don't tell my brother I lost.\nYou have to keep it a secret!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_JazmynIntro
lines.text: My confidence will get a boost by\nbeating someone obviously strong!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_JazmynDefeat
lines.text: There goes my confidence…$

lines.label: Route123_Text_JazmynPostBattle
lines.text: They say that you can't judge a person\nby their appearance.\pBut often, their looks don't lie…$

lines.label: Route123_Text_FrederickIntro
lines.text: Hello, child!\nCan you spare some time?$

lines.label: Route123_Text_FrederickDefeat
lines.text: Ah, a mighty capable child!\nLet me contribute to your allowance.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_FrederickPostBattle
lines.text: Contribute to your allowance?\nWasn't the prize money enough?$

lines.label: Route123_Text_AlbertoIntro
lines.text: I have to tell you, BIRD POKéMON\nare my obsession!\pBirds are cool!\nThey're the best!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_AlbertoDefeat
lines.text: Even in defeat, BIRD POKéMON are cool!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_AlbertoPostBattle
lines.text: I gather BIRD POKéMON feathers that\nscatter during battles.\pI'm going to make a hat with\nBIRD POKéMON feathers.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_EdIntro
lines.text: When there are no TRAINERS around,\nI let my POKéMON battle each other.\lI watch them.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_EdDefeat
lines.text: I kind of like your POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_EdPostBattle
lines.text: Hehe, I'm swiping your battling ideas!\nI think they'll make me better.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_JonasIntro
lines.text: I lay in ambush, and a TRAINER has\nlanded in my trap!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_JonasDefeat
lines.text: If you don't lose, how am I supposed\nto have fun playing ninja?$

lines.label: Route123_Text_JonasPostBattle
lines.text: I'm going to ambush a weaker-looking\nTRAINER next time.$

lines.label: Route123_Text_KayleyIntro
lines.text: I just bought this parasol.\nMy cuteness should be up by a third!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_KayleyDefeat
lines.text: You're better than me by about\nfive times!$

lines.label: Route123_Text_KayleyPostBattle
lines.text: Using accessories effectively is\nthe secret behind fashion appeal.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_SpencerIntro
lines.text: Hey, are you lost at sea?\pIf you can beat my POKéMON,\nI can serve as your pilot.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_SpencerDefeat
lines.text: I lost my bearings in battle!$

lines.label: Route124_Text_SpencerPostBattle
lines.text: Many people lose their bearings at sea.\pIf you're that sort, you should refer\nto the POKéNAV's MAP.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_RolandIntro
lines.text: Hm! You're riding a POKéMON instead\nof swimming yourself…\pI am envious!$

lines.label: Route124_Text_RolandDefeat
lines.text: Oh!\nI can't…$

lines.label: Route124_Text_RolandPostBattle
lines.text: I'm getting chilled…\nI've been in the water too long…\pI wish I could ride a POKéMON like you…$

lines.label: Route124_Text_JennyIntro
lines.text: If you just float in the sea like\nthis, POKéMON come around to play.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_JennyDefeat
lines.text: Oh, darn.\nI've gone and lost.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_JennyPostBattle
lines.text: While swimming, I noticed that some\nPOKéMON attack, and some just watch.\pI guess POKéMON have personalities\nof their own.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_JennyRegister
lines.text: It's only on a whim, but maybe I'll get\nyou to register me in your POKéNAV.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_JennyRematchIntro
lines.text: If you just float in the sea like this,\nTRAINERS challenge you!$

lines.label: Route124_Text_JennyRematchDefeat
lines.text: That's strange…\nI lost again…$

lines.label: Route124_Text_JennyPostRematch
lines.text: This has nothing to do with anything,\nbut maybe I'll visit the TRICK HOUSE.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_GraceIntro
lines.text: I'm growing bored of swimming…\nHow about a battle?$

lines.label: Route124_Text_GraceDefeat
lines.text: I had no idea that you were\nthis strong!$

lines.label: Route124_Text_GracePostBattle
lines.text: All the effort you put in must have\nmade you this strong.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_ChadIntro
lines.text: Fufufufu… I dive deep underwater\nto go deep under cover.\lPlumbing the depths is where I excel!$

lines.label: Route124_Text_ChadDefeat
lines.text: Glub, glub, glub…\nI'm sinking…$

lines.label: Route124_Text_ChadPostBattle
lines.text: I have it on good authority that\nthere's a DIVE spot around here.\pIt gives me the urge to go deep\nagain…$

lines.label: Route124_Text_LilaIntro
lines.text: LILA: Sigh…\pHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\pLet's battle so I won't have to dwell\non that!$

lines.label: Route124_Text_LilaDefeat
lines.text: LILA: ROY! It's your fault we lost!\nYou're in for it later!$

lines.label: Route124_Text_LilaPostBattle
lines.text: LILA: Sigh…\pIf only it wasn't my little brother\nnext to me, but a nice boyfriend…$

lines.label: Route124_Text_LilaNotEnoughMons
lines.text: LILA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have two POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_RoyIntro
lines.text: ROY: My big sister is tough at POKéMON!\pDon't cry when you lose!$

lines.label: Route124_Text_RoyDefeat
lines.text: ROY: Uh-oh…\nMy big sister will chew me out…$

lines.label: Route124_Text_RoyPostBattle
lines.text: ROY: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\pThat's why she doesn't have a\nboyfriend.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_LilaRoyRegister
lines.text: ROY: Will you battle with us again?\nBut take it easy next time, okay?$

lines.label: Route124_Text_RoyNotEnoughMons
lines.text: ROY: Did you want to battle us?\nBring two POKéMON, then.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchIntro
lines.text: LILA: Sigh…\pHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\pOh, hi, it's been a while. Let's battle\nso I won't have to dwell on things!$

lines.label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchDefeat
lines.text: LILA: ROY!\nIt's your fault we lost again!\pWe're having a training session later!$

lines.label: Route124_Text_LilaPostRematch
lines.text: LILA: Sigh…\pIf I had a nice boyfriend, we'd beat\nanyone with lovely combinations…$

lines.label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchNotEnoughMons
lines.text: LILA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have two POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchIntro
lines.text: ROY: If we lose, I'll catch heck.\nI'm going to go totally all out!$

lines.label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchDefeat
lines.text: ROY: Uh-oh…\nMy big sister will chew me out again.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_RoyPostRematch
lines.text: ROY: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\pShe's going to make me train really\nhard with POKéMON later…$

lines.label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchNotEnoughMons
lines.text: ROY: Did you want to battle us?\nBring two POKéMON, then.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_DeclanIntro
lines.text: Here I am swimming by my lonesome\non this wide, beautiful sea.\pThere's no other word for it.\nThis is pathetic!$

lines.label: Route124_Text_DeclanDefeat
lines.text: I'm feeling blue.\nBlue as the sky…$

lines.label: Route124_Text_DeclanPostBattle
lines.text: I should chat up lady SWIMMERS\nand invite them on a long swim.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_IsabellaIntro
lines.text: I'm not going to lose to some\nsurfer TRAINER.$

lines.label: Route124_Text_IsabellaDefeat
lines.text: I've only got sweat in my eyes!\nI am not crying!$

lines.label: Route124_Text_IsabellaPostBattle
lines.text: You can find pretty colored shards\nof things around here.$

lines.label: Route125_Text_NolenIntro
lines.text: I heard you approaching, so I hung\naround for you!$

lines.label: Route125_Text_NolenDefeat
lines.text: I surrender!$

lines.label: Route125_Text_NolenPostBattle
lines.text: Sound travels faster in water than\nit does through air.$

lines.label: Route125_Text_StanIntro
lines.text: Hey, there!\nCheck out my sweet POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route125_Text_StanDefeat
lines.text: I floundered…$

lines.label: Route125_Text_StanPostBattle
lines.text: I was blown away by HORSEA's charm,\nso I started swimming, too.$

lines.label: Route125_Text_TanyaIntro
lines.text: I'm tired of swimming.\nAre you up for a battle with me?$

lines.label: Route125_Text_TanyaDefeat
lines.text: You're too much!$

lines.label: Route125_Text_TanyaPostBattle
lines.text: Whew…\nWhich way is it to MOSSDEEP CITY?$

lines.label: Route125_Text_SharonIntro
lines.text: How would you like to take on the\nWATER-type POKéMON I raised?$

lines.label: Route125_Text_SharonDefeat
lines.text: Lost it…$

lines.label: Route125_Text_SharonPostBattle
lines.text: Your power… You're the real deal.\nI'm amazed!$

lines.label: Route125_Text_ErnestIntro
lines.text: Ahoy! I'm a buff, tough SAILOR!\nI've braved the world's seas!$

lines.label: Route125_Text_ErnestDefeat
lines.text: Gwrroooar!\nI couldn't win!$

lines.label: Route125_Text_ErnestPostBattle
lines.text: The tide ebbs and flows inside the\nSHOAL CAVE.\pBy the way, it's about six hours from\nhigh tide to low tide. Did you know?$

lines.label: Route125_Text_ErnestRegister
lines.text: Register me in your POKéNAV,\nand I'll tell you something good.$

lines.label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchIntro
lines.text: It's high time I get my payback\nfrom you! Come on, we're battling!$

lines.label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchDefeat
lines.text: I couldn't win!\nI flat out couldn't win!$

lines.label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchPostBattle
lines.text: The SHOAL CAVE…\pThere are places you can and can't\nget to depending on the rise and fall\lof the tide.\pBy the way, it's about six hours from\nhigh tide to low tide. Don't forget!$

lines.label: Route125_Text_KimIntro
lines.text: KIM: A funny old man lives in the\nSHOAL CAVE. Someone told me.\lAre you going to see him, too?$

lines.label: Route125_Text_KimDefeat
lines.text: KIM: I thought we would win.$

lines.label: Route125_Text_KimPostBattle
lines.text: KIM: A funny old man lives in the\nSHOAL CAVE, doesn't he?\pLet's go see him, IRIS!$

lines.label: Route125_Text_KimNotEnoughMons
lines.text: KIM: No, no, no! You need two POKéMON,\nor it's just no good!$

lines.label: Route125_Text_IrisIntro
lines.text: IRIS: KIM, can you tell me what we're\nlooking for out here?$

lines.label: Route125_Text_IrisDefeat
lines.text: IRIS: Oh, we came sort of close.$

lines.label: Route125_Text_IrisPostBattle
lines.text: IRIS: KIM, are we really going into\nthe SHOAL CAVE?\lWe'll get all wet.$

lines.label: Route125_Text_IrisNotEnoughMons
lines.text: IRIS: Oh, we could never, ever do\nanything like a 2-on-1 battle.$

lines.label: Route125_Text_PresleyIntro
lines.text: Why would a BIRDKEEPER like me\ncome out to the sea?$

lines.label: Route125_Text_PresleyDefeat
lines.text: Okay.\nI'll tell you why I'm here.$

lines.label: Route125_Text_PresleyPostBattle
lines.text: I put a message in a bottle and put\nit out to sea.\pI'm sure that a girl SWIMMER will\nfind it!$

lines.label: Route125_Text_AuronIntro
lines.text: Hey! Was it you throwing garbage\ninto the sea?$

lines.label: Route125_Text_AuronDefeat
lines.text: Oh, you weren't throwing trash into\nthe sea.$

lines.label: Route125_Text_AuronPostBattle
lines.text: I found an unsightly bottle bobbing\nin the waves earlier.\pIt angers me that someone would\npollute the sea!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_BarryIntro
lines.text: Swimming is a full-body workout!\nYou will get fit!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_BarryDefeat
lines.text: I admit it!\nYou win!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_BarryPostBattle
lines.text: Thanks to my daily swimming routine…\nLook! Feast your eyes on this physique!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_DeanIntro
lines.text: This towering white mountain of rock\nis SOOTOPOLIS CITY.$

lines.label: Route126_Text_DeanDefeat
lines.text: I was done in?$

lines.label: Route126_Text_DeanPostBattle
lines.text: I can't find the entrance to\nSOOTOPOLIS. Where could it be?$

lines.label: Route126_Text_NikkiIntro
lines.text: Ufufufufu!\nI'm a mermaid!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_NikkiDefeat
lines.text: My fantasy burst as if it were a bubble!\nBlub, blub, blub…$

lines.label: Route126_Text_NikkiPostBattle
lines.text: You thrashed me… I want to\ndisappear in a wave of despair…$

lines.label: Route126_Text_BrendaIntro
lines.text: Hello, kiddo!\nWant a battle with me?$

lines.label: Route126_Text_BrendaDefeat
lines.text: Oh, noooooh!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_BrendaPostBattle
lines.text: I love frolicking with POKéMON in\nthe sea like this!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_PabloIntro
lines.text: Check out this sculpted body!\nI'm more cut than a BLACK BELT!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_PabloDefeat
lines.text: Whoops! Too strong!\nNot bad! Not bad at all!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_PabloPostBattle
lines.text: Losing to you stimulated my senses!\nI'll train myself and POKéMON harder!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_PabloRegister
lines.text: Yep, you're not bad at all!\nI'd like to get to know you more!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_PabloRematchIntro
lines.text: Check out this beautiful body!\nI'm more shapely than a SWIMMER!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_PabloRematchDefeat
lines.text: Whoops! Really too strong!\nNot bad! Not bad at all!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_PabloPostRematch
lines.text: I'm going to train even harder!\nYou're a great motivator!\lYou have to come back again!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_LeonardoIntro
lines.text: I couldn't even swim last year,\nbut now I'm a decent SWIMMER.\pI think I'm capable of anything now.$

lines.label: Route126_Text_LeonardoDefeat
lines.text: Sheesh, getting greedy didn't do\na thing for me.$

lines.label: Route126_Text_LeonardoPostBattle
lines.text: If you practice at something,\nyou will get better at it.\pYou're young--don't be afraid to\ntry all sorts of things!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_IsobelIntro
lines.text: If seawater gets up your nose,\ndoesn't it feel terrible?$

lines.label: Route126_Text_IsobelDefeat
lines.text: Ack! Why, you…\nGlub!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_IsobelPostBattle
lines.text: Ooh, I choked on some water!\nIt's bitter! It's salty!!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_SiennaIntro
lines.text: I'm throwing my whole heart\ninto this!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_SiennaDefeat
lines.text: You had more heart!$

lines.label: Route126_Text_SiennaPostBattle
lines.text: I need to cool down now…\nI think I'll go for a dive.$

lines.label: Route127_Text_CamdenIntro
lines.text: I can see it in your face.\nYou want to challenge me.$

lines.label: Route127_Text_CamdenDefeat
lines.text: Awawawawawa…$

lines.label: Route127_Text_CamdenPostBattle
lines.text: A well-played match leaves me feeling\nrefreshed and serene.$

lines.label: Route127_Text_DonnyIntro
lines.text: Do you have a rival whom you just\nhate to lose against?$

lines.label: Route127_Text_DonnyDefeat
lines.text: Arrrgh!\nI hate losing!$

lines.label: Route127_Text_DonnyPostBattle
lines.text: If you have a rival, don't you get the\nfeeling that you have to keep getting\lbetter?$

lines.label: Route127_Text_JonahIntro
lines.text: Through fishing, I have attained a\nstate of becalmed serenity…\pPlease, allow me to demonstrate…$

lines.label: Route127_Text_JonahDefeat
lines.text: Though I have lost, my heart remains\ncalm…$

lines.label: Route127_Text_JonahPostBattle
lines.text: It matters not that I catch nothing.\nThe line remains in the water…$

lines.label: Route127_Text_HenryIntro
lines.text: Whoops! Don't tell me I snagged\na SURFING POKéMON?$

lines.label: Route127_Text_HenryDefeat
lines.text: I can't keep up!$

lines.label: Route127_Text_HenryPostBattle
lines.text: It'd be a handful if I hooked\nyour tough POKéMON!$

lines.label: Route127_Text_RogerIntro
lines.text: Well, hey! This is a match between\na POKéMON fan and a fishing buff!$

lines.label: Route127_Text_RogerDefeat
lines.text: No! My line's all tangled!\nThe party's over!$

lines.label: Route127_Text_RogerPostBattle
lines.text: My fishing line's doing a dance!\nThe tangle tango! Hahaha, snarl!$

lines.label: Route127_Text_AidanIntro
lines.text: BIRD POKéMON have excellent vision.\nThey spot prey from great heights.$

lines.label: Route127_Text_AidanDefeat
lines.text: Whew… I give up.$

lines.label: Route127_Text_AidanPostBattle
lines.text: There're lots of diving spots in\nthe sea around here.\pYou can spot them easily from the sky\nbecause of their darker color.$

lines.label: Route127_Text_KojiIntro
lines.text: Run in your bare feet.\nThat will toughen up your soles!$

lines.label: Route127_Text_KojiDefeat
lines.text: Yowch!\nI got a pebble under a toenail!$

lines.label: Route127_Text_KojiPostBattle
lines.text: Going barefoot feels great.\nBut your RUNNING SHOES are cool, too.$

lines.label: Route127_Text_KojiRegister
lines.text: This is what I do to people who beat me!\nI hope we can do this again.$

lines.label: Route127_Text_KojiRematchIntro
lines.text: I still run in my bare feet daily.\nMy soles are tough!$

lines.label: Route127_Text_KojiRematchDefeat
lines.text: Yowch!\nPebbles dug into my arches!$

lines.label: Route127_Text_KojiPostRematch
lines.text: Want to go barefoot for a while?\nSo I can try your RUNNING SHOES?$

lines.label: Route127_Text_AthenaIntro
lines.text: We should have a slow and methodical\nmatch.$

lines.label: Route127_Text_AthenaDefeat
lines.text: You didn't give me the chance to\ndo any strategizing.$

lines.label: Route127_Text_AthenaPostBattle
lines.text: When I'm surrounded by the blue sea\nand sky, it feels as if time slows down.$

lines.label: Route128_Text_IsaiahIntro
lines.text: EVER GRANDE CITY is still a long ways\naway…$

lines.label: Route128_Text_IsaiahDefeat
lines.text: My first victory seems to be far\naway, too…$

lines.label: Route128_Text_IsaiahPostBattle
lines.text: My whole life has been about losing,\nbut I will never give up!$

lines.label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRegister
lines.text: I know I'm not good now, but I think\nI can win eventually.\pPlease register me in your POKéNAV.$

lines.label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro
lines.text: I'm still feeling good. I'll keep on\nswimming to EVER GRANDE CITY.$

lines.label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchDefeat
lines.text: I've yet to taste my first victory…$

lines.label: Route128_Text_IsaiahPostRematch
lines.text: I'll eventually reach EVER GRANDE CITY\nwhere I can eventually win…$

lines.label: Route128_Text_KatelynIntro
lines.text: You have to swim, cycle, and then run\na marathon in a triathlon.\pIt's a grueling race that consists\nof three events.$

lines.label: Route128_Text_KatelynDefeat
lines.text: A POKéMON battle is grueling, too…$

lines.label: Route128_Text_KatelynPostBattle
lines.text: I have to ride a BIKE next, but…\nI'm about to throw in the towel…$

lines.label: Route128_Text_KatelynRegister
lines.text: Well, I may as well make the best\nof this. I'd like a rematch sometime.$

lines.label: Route128_Text_KatelynRematchIntro
lines.text: A triathlon is long. But I guess the\nroad to become the POKéMON CHAMPION\lis also a long and grueling one.$

lines.label: Route128_Text_KatelynRematchDefeat
lines.text: A POKéMON battle really is harsh\nand unforgiving…$

lines.label: Route128_Text_KatelynPostRematch
lines.text: You should give serious thought to\nchallenges on VICTORY ROAD.$

lines.label: Route128_Text_AlexaIntro
lines.text: We've been working so hard to mount\na POKéMON LEAGUE challenge…\pWe can't afford to lose now!$

lines.label: Route128_Text_AlexaDefeat
lines.text: Oh!\nHow could this happen?!$

lines.label: Route128_Text_AlexaPostBattle
lines.text: After all I've done to get here,\nI won't give up after one setback.$

lines.label: Route128_Text_RubenIntro
lines.text: There is no stronger TRAINER than I!$

lines.label: Route128_Text_RubenDefeat
lines.text: This can't be!$

lines.label: Route128_Text_RubenPostBattle
lines.text: There probably is no stronger TRAINER\nthan you!$

lines.label: Route128_Text_WayneIntro
lines.text: I want to visit EVER GRANDE, so I\ncaught myself a POKéMON that knows\lthe move WATERFALL to crest the falls.$

lines.label: Route128_Text_WayneDefeat
lines.text: I'm crestfallen!$

lines.label: Route128_Text_WaynePostBattle
lines.text: Awww, phooey!\pMy POKéMON knows WATERFALL, but\nI don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!$

lines.label: Route128_Text_HarrisonIntro
lines.text: You're looking awfully tough.\nI wonder if I can win?$

lines.label: Route128_Text_HarrisonDefeat
lines.text: Ouch!\nI guess it was impossible to win.$

lines.label: Route128_Text_HarrisonPostBattle
lines.text: There are tough TRAINERS galore\naround EVER GRANDE.\pDo you think I may be out\nof my league?$

lines.label: Route128_Text_CarleeIntro
lines.text: The sunlight seems to be more harsh\nin this area.$

lines.label: Route128_Text_CarleeDefeat
lines.text: I couldn't see very well because of\nthe sun's glare.$

lines.label: Route128_Text_CarleePostBattle
lines.text: I should go back soon.\nI need to reapply my sunscreen.$

lines.label: Route129_Text_ChaseIntro
lines.text: This is my first triathlon.\nI'm all tense and nervous!$

lines.label: Route129_Text_ChaseDefeat
lines.text: Wroooaaar!\nI failed to win!$

lines.label: Route129_Text_ChasePostBattle
lines.text: If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to\ngive it my all.$

lines.label: Route129_Text_AllisonIntro
lines.text: I'm in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut, sure, why don't we battle?$

lines.label: Route129_Text_AllisonDefeat
lines.text: I was sure I'd win!$

lines.label: Route129_Text_AllisonPostBattle
lines.text: Do you know what's the greatest thing\nabout triathlons?\pTesting the limits of your own\nstrength and endurance against\lMother Nature!$

lines.label: Route129_Text_ReedIntro
lines.text: Say hey, hey!\nLet's get on with it!$

lines.label: Route129_Text_ReedDefeat
lines.text: Beat, I'm beaten.\nThat's it, done!$

lines.label: Route129_Text_ReedPostBattle
lines.text: There's nothing for a loser.\nTime for me to beat it home.$

lines.label: Route129_Text_TishaIntro
lines.text: What's the hurry?\nLet's take it slow and easy.$

lines.label: Route129_Text_TishaDefeat
lines.text: Oh, my.\nI wanted to relax a little more…$

lines.label: Route129_Text_TishaPostBattle
lines.text: Don't you hate making mistakes when\nyou're in a rush?\pThat's why I try to take things\nslowly.$

lines.label: Route129_Text_ClarenceIntro
lines.text: Surfing isn't as easy as it seems,\nisn't that right?$

lines.label: Route129_Text_ClarenceDefeat
lines.text: Winning sure isn't easy.$

lines.label: Route129_Text_ClarencePostBattle
lines.text: You have your sights on the POKéMON\nLEAGUE? Keep at it!$

lines.label: Route130_Text_RodneyIntro
lines.text: What a surprise! I didn't expect to\nsee a TRAINER out in the sea.\pI think we should battle!$

lines.label: Route130_Text_RodneyDefeat
lines.text: This kid's awfully tough…$

lines.label: Route130_Text_RodneyPostBattle
lines.text: Your eyes have that look of someone\nwho's experienced harsh challenges\land won. It suits you well!$

lines.label: Route130_Text_KatieIntro
lines.text: In the deep blue sea,\nmy shattered blue heart finds\lcomfort among waves.$

lines.label: Route130_Text_KatieDefeat
lines.text: Like the vast blue sea,\nthe world of POKéMON spans\ldepths beyond belief.$

lines.label: Route130_Text_KatiePostBattle
lines.text: The world's children dream\nof one day becoming\lthe POKéMON CHAMPION.$

lines.label: Route130_Text_SantiagoIntro
lines.text: Floating on the open sea like this…\nIt's peaceful.$

lines.label: Route130_Text_SantiagoDefeat
lines.text: I needed to be a little less peaceful!$

lines.label: Route130_Text_SantiagoPostBattle
lines.text: Swimming and battling like this…\nI'm one happy guy…$

lines.label: Route131_Text_RichardIntro
lines.text: The sea is teeming with POKéMON.\nIt's not easy swimming, I tell you.$

lines.label: Route131_Text_RichardDefeat
lines.text: POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are\nseriously tough…$

lines.label: Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle
lines.text:
Gasp… Gasp…
I'm wiped out…\pThe going's easy. It's the leaving
that's the hard part.\pWill I have any energy left to make
the return trip?$

lines.label: Route131_Text_HermanIntro
lines.text: The sea… The sea… The sea…\nThe sea as far as these eyes can see!\lI'm sick and tired of the sea!$

lines.label: Route131_Text_HermanDefeat
lines.text: Bleah!$

lines.label: Route131_Text_HermanPostBattle
lines.text: Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.\pI'm a born swimmer!\nThat's what I am.$

lines.label: Route131_Text_SusieIntro
lines.text: Hi, sweetie, wait!\nWe should battle, you and I!$

lines.label: Route131_Text_SusieDefeat
lines.text: You're tough in spite of the way\nyou look!$

lines.label: Route131_Text_SusiePostBattle
lines.text: Did you see a guy over there who whines\nthat he's bored of the sea?\pThat's all talk.\nHe's hopelessly in love with the sea!$

lines.label: Route131_Text_KaraIntro
lines.text: Why do men love bathing suits so much?\pThey all ogle me!$

lines.label: Route131_Text_KaraDefeat
lines.text: I'm out of my depth!$

lines.label: Route131_Text_KaraPostBattle
lines.text: Maybe it's not my bathing suit that\nmakes men look. It must be my beauty!$

lines.label: Route131_Text_ReliIntro
lines.text: RELI: We'll work together as siblings\nto take you on!$

lines.label: Route131_Text_ReliDefeat
lines.text: RELI: We couldn't win even though we\nworked together…$

lines.label: Route131_Text_ReliPostBattle
lines.text: RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\ntogether with the sea and POKéMON from\lthe time they are born.$

lines.label: Route131_Text_ReliNotEnoughMons
lines.text: RELI: You don't have two POKéMON?\nWe can't enjoy a battle, then.$

lines.label: Route131_Text_IanIntro
lines.text: IAN: I'm doing my best together with\nmy sis!$

lines.label: Route131_Text_IanDefeat
lines.text: IAN: I did my best with my sis,\nbut we still couldn't win…$

lines.label: Route131_Text_IanPostBattle
lines.text: IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is\na floating town?\pSo, wherever there is the sea,\nthat's a part of PACIFIDLOG!$

lines.label: Route131_Text_IanNotEnoughMons
lines.text: IAN: If you have two POKéMON,\nwe'll take you on!$

lines.label: Route131_Text_TaliaIntro
lines.text: If you can beat me, I'll give you some\ngreat information!$

lines.label: Route131_Text_TaliaDefeat
lines.text: Oh?\nDid I lose?$

lines.label: Route131_Text_TaliaPostBattle
lines.text: There is an odd place nearby.\nThere's a huge tower there.\lWhy don't you go take a look?$

lines.label: Route131_Text_KevinIntro
lines.text: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\na peaceful bunch.\pThey never get angry.\nThat goes for me, too.$

lines.label: Route131_Text_KevinDefeat
lines.text: Oops!$

lines.label: Route131_Text_KevinPostBattle
lines.text: Tch! …Oh, wait.\nI'm not angry. Honestly!\pBut, boy, you're strong!\nHahaha!$

lines.label: Route132_Text_GilbertIntro
lines.text: I used to catch colds all the time as\na kid, but I became totally fit after\lI started swimming.$

lines.label: Route132_Text_GilbertDefeat
lines.text: I crave more power…$

lines.label: Route132_Text_GilbertPostBattle
lines.text: TRAINERS travel the fields and\nmountains, so they must be fit, too.$

lines.label: Route132_Text_DanaIntro
lines.text: I try not to swim where the currents\nare too strong.$

lines.label: Route132_Text_DanaDefeat
lines.text: Oh, please, no!$

lines.label: Route132_Text_DanaPostBattle
lines.text: If I get swept away, I'll lose all my\nsense of place…$

lines.label: Route132_Text_RonaldIntro
lines.text: Win or lose, you'll never know until\nyou try!$

lines.label: Route132_Text_RonaldDefeat
lines.text: Waah!\nI sank in defeat!$

lines.label: Route132_Text_RonaldPostBattle
lines.text: I never battle when I know I'll win.\nI like to battle at the razor's edge of\lvictory and defeat!$

lines.label: Route132_Text_KiyoIntro
lines.text: I contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day.\nHow could you possibly beat me?$

lines.label: Route132_Text_KiyoDefeat
lines.text: I lose.\nI will concede defeat.$

lines.label: Route132_Text_KiyoPostBattle
lines.text: Urggh…\nYou're a POKéMON fanatic, aren't you?\pYou must contemplate POKéMON 24 hours\na day, don't you?$

lines.label: Route132_Text_MakaylaIntro
lines.text: I'm always with my husband,\nbut I can win even without him.$

lines.label: Route132_Text_MakaylaDefeat
lines.text: Oh, I guess I wasn't good enough.$

lines.label: Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle
lines.text: That young man over there looks just\nlike my husband when he was young.\pHe's making me blush!$

lines.label: Route132_Text_JonathanIntro
lines.text: Someone's been watching me intently.\nWas it you?$

lines.label: Route132_Text_JonathanDefeat
lines.text: Wow!\nThat's pretty strong, all right!$

lines.label: Route132_Text_JonathanPostBattle
lines.text: I can't shake this feeling that\nsomeone's watching me.\pI can't concentrate!$

lines.label: Route132_Text_PaxtonIntro
lines.text: Now where could my wife have gone?\nI'm always with her.\lI wonder if I can win on my own.$

lines.label: Route132_Text_PaxtonDefeat
lines.text: Ah, I see that I couldn't manage\nto win on my own after all.$

lines.label: Route132_Text_PaxtonPostBattle
lines.text: My wife must be looking for me.\nI'd best go find her right away.$

lines.label: Route132_Text_DarcyIntro
lines.text: I liked training here by myself.\nIt's awful that all these people came!$

lines.label: Route132_Text_DarcyDefeat
lines.text: Okay! I won't complain about other\npeople being here.$

lines.label: Route132_Text_DarcyPostBattle
lines.text: I suppose I can partner up with that\nold man and challenge that other team.$

lines.label: Route133_Text_FranklinIntro
lines.text: Did the currents carry you here, too?\nThis must have been fated.\lLet's battle!$

lines.label: Route133_Text_FranklinDefeat
lines.text: Strong!\nToo much so!$

lines.label: Route133_Text_FranklinPostBattle
lines.text: It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER\nlike you would drift here…\lI must be cursed…$

lines.label: Route133_Text_DebraIntro
lines.text: I've led a life of woe and misery…\nI've been cast away, and this is where\lI've drifted…$

lines.label: Route133_Text_DebraDefeat
lines.text: Another loss…$

lines.label: Route133_Text_DebraPostBattle
lines.text: A life adrift…\nI don't want it anymore!$

lines.label: Route133_Text_LindaIntro
lines.text: Welcome!\nI've been expecting you!$

lines.label: Route133_Text_LindaDefeat
lines.text: No! Please!$

lines.label: Route133_Text_LindaPostBattle
lines.text: A strong child TRAINER…\nThat's so annoying!$

lines.label: Route133_Text_WarrenIntro
lines.text: I want to win like everyone else, but I\nwon't raise POKéMON like everyone else.$

lines.label: Route133_Text_WarrenDefeat
lines.text: Darn it!\nMy way is still too slack!$

lines.label: Route133_Text_WarrenPostBattle
lines.text: It's way more fun to do things the way\nI want than to be like everybody else.\lI mean, that's obvious!$

lines.label: Route133_Text_BeckIntro
lines.text: I came all the way out here with my\nBIRD POKéMON.$

lines.label: Route133_Text_BeckDefeat
lines.text: You…\nYou're stunningly cool!$

lines.label: Route133_Text_BeckPostBattle
lines.text: I'd like to go back to FORTREE,\nbut I've grown to like this place, too.$

lines.label: Route133_Text_MollieIntro
lines.text: I must have battled thousands\nof times. I've lost count.$

lines.label: Route133_Text_MollieDefeat
lines.text: I may have lost thousands of times,\nbut a loss still stings.$

lines.label: Route133_Text_MolliePostBattle
lines.text: Keep at this, youngster. So you can\nbecome like my husband and me.$

lines.label: Route133_Text_ConorIntro
lines.text: Young people are too happy to go with\nthe flow. They're without direction.$

lines.label: Route133_Text_ConorDefeat
lines.text: You have a firm sense of purpose.$

lines.label: Route133_Text_ConorPostBattle
lines.text: Don't let others lead you astray.\nDon't lose direction as you grow older.$

lines.label: Route134_Text_JackIntro
lines.text: Even those POKéMON that can swim are\ncarried along by the rapid currents.$

lines.label: Route134_Text_JackDefeat
lines.text: Aiyeeeeh!$

lines.label: Route134_Text_JackPostBattle
lines.text: I think POKéMON enjoy the fast-running\ncurrents around these parts.$

lines.label: Route134_Text_LaurelIntro
lines.text: My LUVDISC are looking for a fun\nmatch. Will you join us?$

lines.label: Route134_Text_LaurelDefeat
lines.text: Oopsie!$

lines.label: Route134_Text_LaurelPostBattle
lines.text: There's a collector who's after\nthe SCALES of LUVDISC.$

lines.label: Route134_Text_AlexIntro
lines.text: Okeydokey! That's enough rest, gang!\nIt's time for a match!$

lines.label: Route134_Text_AlexDefeat
lines.text: Tuckered out again…$

lines.label: Route134_Text_AlexPostBattle
lines.text: My BIRD POKéMON get tired quickly after\na long flight…$

lines.label: Route134_Text_HitoshiIntro
lines.text: You're a POKéMON TRAINER.\nNo need for words. We battle now.$

lines.label: Route134_Text_HitoshiPostBattle
lines.text: It was I who challenged you, and yet\nI lost. I am deeply shamed…$

lines.label: Route134_Text_AaronIntro
lines.text: The savage tide in this area serves to\nmake us stronger than ever.$

lines.label: Route134_Text_AaronDefeat
lines.text: I willingly concede defeat.$

lines.label: Route134_Text_AaronPostBattle
lines.text: We will return for more training at\nMETEOR FALLS.\pIf you'd like, you should go, too.\nIt will definitely toughen you up!$

lines.label: Route134_Text_KelvinIntro
lines.text: O-our boat!\nThe tide carried it away!$

lines.label: Route134_Text_KelvinDefeat
lines.text: Awawawawah!\nPlease, stop! Please!$

lines.label: Route134_Text_KelvinPostBattle
lines.text: If we can't SURF, how are we supposed\nto get home?\pActually, I know a fainted POKéMON\ncan still SURF, but it feels wrong.$

lines.label: Route134_Text_MarleyIntro
lines.text: Can your POKéMON dodge our\nlightning-quick attacks?$

lines.label: Route134_Text_MarleyDefeat
lines.text: I never knew such a technique existed!\nYou've defeated us thoroughly.$

lines.label: Route134_Text_MarleyPostBattle
lines.text: I haven't lost my passion for speed.\nI will try harder.$

lines.label: Route134_Text_ReynaIntro
lines.text: My POKéMON can't be taken down\neasily!$

lines.label: Route134_Text_ReynaDefeat
lines.text: You're kidding!\nExplain how I lost!$

lines.label: Route134_Text_ReynaPostBattle
lines.text: Haha!\nYou won, all right!\pI'll work my way back up by taking on\nTRAINERS I happen to meet!$

lines.label: Route134_Text_HudsonIntro
lines.text: Listen, have you seen another SAILOR\naround here?$

lines.label: Route134_Text_HudsonDefeat
lines.text: Now, that's something!$

lines.label: Route134_Text_HudsonPostBattle
lines.text: Our boat drifted out to sea.\pMy buddy's a timid fellow, so I'm\nworried about him.$

lines.text:
IN SEARCH OF TRAINERS…\pGABBY: Hi! Today I'm visiting an area
near {STR_VAR_1}.\pWe're trying to spot some up-and-
coming new talent in the field.\pToday, we turned our lens on the
TRAINER {PLAYER}.\pThere's something about this TRAINER
that piqued our interest.$

lines.label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText01
lines.text: We've battled {PLAYER} before, but we\ncan attest that the TRAINER has most\ldefinitely improved from before.\pI knew we were onto someone special\nwhen we spotted this TRAINER!$

lines.label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText02
lines.text:
The best way to determine how strong
a TRAINER is…\pWell, the fastest way is to battle.
And so we began our investigation!\p… …\pThat's how we ended up in battle
with {PLAYER}.\pIn a dominating performance, we were
flattened, rolled up, and tossed aside!\p{PLAYER} is ruthlessly strong…\pHere's our impressions after having
battled our featured TRAINER.$

lines.label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText03
lines.text:
The combination of {STR_VAR_1} and
{STR_VAR_3} was divine!\pThe sight of them--{STR_VAR_1} and
{STR_VAR_3}--selflessly supporting\leach other in the thick of battle…\pIt was a marvelous sight to behold!\p{STR_VAR_2} was the move the TRAINER
used last in our battle.\pThe move {STR_VAR_2} is {STR_VAR_1}
and {STR_VAR_3}'s sign of friendship!$

lines.label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText04
lines.text:
…I lost confidence in myself as
a result of our encounter.\pWe were beaten before we could launch
a single attack.\lOhhh… Snivel…\pIn spite of that, {PLAYER}'s battles
are worth seeing.\pI recommend confident TRAINERS to
challenge {PLAYER}.$

lines.label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText05
lines.text:
There's only one thing to be said.
Don't you dare throw a POKé BALL during\la TRAINER battle!\p{PLAYER} is certainly strong, but has
no clue about the basic rules.\pTo our TV audience, I have a request.\pIf you see {PLAYER}, please caution
the TRAINER!$

lines.label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText06
lines.text: {PLAYER} is adept at reading the\nopponent's actions.\pThe timing of item usage was remarkably\neffective!$

lines.label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText07
lines.text:
Honestly speaking, I thought that
I might even be pretty good.\pWhile we did end up losing, we did have
a hotly contested battle.\pBut if you're struggling against me,
you have a ways to go, {PLAYER}!$

lines.label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
lines.text:
After our battle, we asked {PLAYER} for
a succinct summary.\pThe TRAINER replied, “{STR_VAR_1}.”\p{PLAYER}'s POKéMON {STR_VAR_2} and
{STR_VAR_3}…\lAnd “{STR_VAR_1}”…\pMmm! That's deep! There's deep
significance behind that quote!\pIt's no surprise--a good TRAINER has
good things to say.\pThat's all for today!
See you again on our next broadcast!$
